Further, the District Social Defence Officer will have to obtain an undertaking from the applicant that the female beneficiary has not received disability marriage assistance from her state.
benefits: 1. Under this scheme, when two individuals with disabilities marry each other, the couple is entitled to a total assistance of ₹1,00,000/-, equating to ₹50,000/- per person. 1. If a person without disabilities marries someone with a disability, the individual with a disability is eligible to receive assistance of ₹50,000/-.
summary: Under this scheme, financial assistance is provided to persons with disabilities when a person with a disability marries another person with a disability, as well as when a non-disabled person marries someone with a disability.

title: Dr. Savitaben Ambedkar Inter Caste Marriage Assistance Scheme
eligibility_details: 1. One person of the inter-caste marriage couple should be a native of Gujarat. 1. One person of the inter-caste marriage couple should belong to Scheduled Caste Category. 1. Such marriages have to be registered and applications for assistance under the scheme have to be made within two years of the marriage. 1. The parents of the inter-caste marriage couple should have been residing in the state of Gujarat for five years. 1. Any person other than a Scheduled Caste who is a migrant shall be required to furnish a certificate to the effect that he is not an untouchable in that Province or State and that he practices the Hindu religion. 1. If a widower or a widow who does not have children remarries, assistance will be available under this scheme. 1. There is no income limit.
benefits: The scale of assistance provided to the couple in the case of inter-caste marriage under the scheme is as follows: 1. An assistance of ₹1,00,000/- is provided to the couple for domestic expenses, for purchasing household appliances. 1. An assistance of ₹1,50,000/- is provided in the form of National Savings Certificates in the joint name of the married couple. 1. A total financial assistance of ₹2,50,000/- will be provided to the couple under the scheme.
summary: The scheme has been implemented as part of social empowerment by addressing inequality through marriages between individuals from Scheduled Castes of Hinduism and those from castes other than Scheduled Castes of Hinduism.

title: Financial Assistance to Destitute Elderly and Disabled Person
eligibility_details: 1. Applicant must be a resident of Gujarat. 1. Applicant must be: - Aged 60 years or more and does not have a son aged 21 years or above. - OR, aged 45 years or more and has a disability of more than 75%. - OR, listed in the BPL category (Score 0–20) in rural areas or included in the urban BPL list. 1. Annual Family Income must be: - ₹1,20,000 or less for rural residents. - ₹1,50,000 or less for urban residents.
benefits: - For beneficiaries aged 60 to 79 years: ₹1,000/- per month- For beneficiaries aged 80 years or more: ₹1,250/- per month
summary: The scheme "Financial Assistance to Destitute Elderly and Disabled Person" provides monthly financial aid to elderly individuals (60+) and severely disabled persons who meet specific income and dependency criteria.

title: Free Cycles to SC Girl Students Studying in Standard IX (Sarasvati Sadhna Yojana)
category: Social welfare & Empowerment, Women and Child
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a girl student. 1. The girl student should belong to the Scheduled Caste Category of Gujarat. 1. The student should be studying in the 9th Standard. 1. The annual family income of the student should not be more than ₹6,00,000/- (for both Rural Areas & Urban Areas).
benefits: - Under this scheme, free cycles are given to scheduled caste girl students who are studying in Standard IX.
summary: The “Free Cycles to SC girl students studying in Standard IX” scheme is administered by the Directorate of Scheduled Caste Welfare, Department of Social Justice & Empowerment, Government of Gujarat. Under this scheme, free bicycles are given to scheduled caste girl students who are studying in Stand

title: Free Travel in S.T Bus to the Disabled Persons
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should have a disability of 40% or more in order to avail of the benefits under the scheme.
benefits: 1. Under this scheme, a free traveling facility is provided to Persons with Disabilities in all types of buses of Gujarat State Road Transport Corporation. 1. The benefit of free travel is also provided up to the final/last station of the bus route in the case of travel outside the state of Gujarat. 1. A card is also issued by the District Social Defense Officer after the approval of the application.
summary: Under this scheme, the benefit of free travel in all types of busses of the Gujarat State Road Transport Corporation is provided to Person with Disabilities in all state routes and also provides the benefit of travel to the last route out of state.

title: Funeral Assistance Scheme (GBOCWWB)
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a legal heir of the deceased worker. 1. The deceased worker should have been engaged in any building or other construction work. 1. The deceased worker should have been registered with the Gujarat Building and Other Construction Worker’s Welfare Board. 1. Financial assistance is provided to the legal heir of the deceased worker in the event of their death during the ongoing membership.
benefits: 1. Under the scheme, financial assistance of ₹10,000/- shall be given to the legal heirs of the deceased construction workers.
summary: The objective of this scheme is to provide financial assistance to the heir of a deceased construction worker registered with the Gujarat Building and Other Construction Worker’s Welfare Board in case of death during the ongoing membership.

title: Ganga Swarupa Pension Scheme
eligibility_details: - The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat. - The applicant must be a widowed woman. - The applicant must be aged 18 years or above. - The applicant’s annual income must not exceed ₹1,20,000/- in rural areas and ₹1,50,000/- in urban areas.
benefits: Monthly Pension: Monthly financial assistance of ₹1,250/-.
summary: The scheme provides financial assistance to widowed women, ensuring self-reliance through monthly pensions.

title: Ganga Swarupa Punah Lagna Arthik Sahay Scheme
category: Social welfare & Empowerment, Women and Child
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant must be aged between 18 to 50 years. 1. The applicant must be a beneficiary of the &quot;Ganga Swarup Economic Assistance Scheme&quot;.
benefits: - Assistance through Direct Bank Transfer (DBT): ₹25,000/- will be credited directly to the beneficiary's savings account through Direct Bank Transfer (DBT). - Assistance for National Savings Certificates: ₹25,000/- will be issued to the beneficiary in the form of National Savings Certificates (NSC), providing a secure and long-term savings option.
summary: The scheme supports remarried women who are beneficiaries of the Ganga Swarupa Pension Scheme, aiming to reintegrate them into society with financial support.

title: Go-Green Shramik Scheme (GBOCWWB)
eligibility_details: 1. The construction workers registered with the Gujarat Building and Other Construction Worker’s Welfare Board will be eligible to get the benefit of this scheme. 1. Registration period for construction workers should be one year or more. 1. A registered construction worker should have purchased a lithium-ion battery high-speed vehicle in his own name. 1. The registered construction worker should have a license to drive two-wheelers. 1. The benefit of this scheme will be available once per registered construction worker. 1. A registered construction worker cannot sell the vehicle for three years after purchasing it.
benefits: 1. Under the scheme, a One-time subsidy will be available to the extent of 50% of the price of the battery-operated Two-Wheeler or ₹30,000/- whichever is less. 1. The assistance will also be available for the amount of Registration Fee and Road Tax paid for the first time for a new two-wheeler i.e. RTO Tax and Road Tax will be reimbursed. Note 01: After deducting the amount of subsidy payable to the vehicle dealer from the ex-showroom price of the two-wheeler, the remaining amount will have to be paid by the construction contractor. Note 02: This additional subsidy will be provided in addition to the subsidy available under the electric vehicle-related schemes of the government.
summary: Under the scheme, a one-time subsidy will be provided on the purchase of electric two-wheelers to construction workers who are registered with the Gujarat Building and Other Construction Worker’s Welfare Board.

title: Go-Green Three Wheelers Scheme (GBOCWWB)
eligibility_details: 1. The construction workers should be registered with the Gujarat Building and Other Construction Worker’s Welfare Board. 1. The registered construction workers who become disabled or incapacitated due to an accident while working at a construction site will be eligible to get the benefit of this scheme. 1. The registered construction disabled worker (Shramyogi) should have purchased a lithium-ion battery-operated vehicle in his own name. 1. The registered construction disabled worker (Shramyogi) should hold a tri-cycle license to operate a tri-cycle. 1. The benefit of this scheme will be available once per registered construction disabled worker.
benefits: 1. Under this scheme, a one-time subsidy will be available to the extent of 50% of the Ex-Showroom Price or ₹48,000/- whichever is less. 1. The assistance will also be available for the amount of Registration Fee and Road Tax paid for the first time of the new Three-Wheeler. (RTO Tax and Road Tax would be reimbursed as well.) Note 01: The cost of the motor vehicle tax amount of the new three-wheeler, fixed by the State Government and at the prevailing rate applicable to persons with disabilities, will be borne by the registered disabled construction worker here. Note 02: This additional subsidy will be provided in addition to the subsidy available under the electric vehicle-related schemes of Government.
summary: Under the scheme, a one-time subsidy will be provided on the purchase of battery-operated tricycle (e-rickshaw) vehicles to registered construction disabled workers. Also, assistance will be available for the amount of Registration Fee and Road Tax paid for the first time of the new Three-Wheeler.

title: Hostel Assistance Scheme for Children of Migrant Construction Workers (GBOCWWB)
eligibility_details: 1. The children of registered construction workers who are studying in the government primary and secondary schools of the district can avail the benefits under the scheme. 1. The construction workers should be registered with the Gujarat Building and Other Construction Worker’s Welfare Board.
benefits: 1. Under the scheme, children of migrant construction workers should be provided free accommodation in primary school.
summary: Under the scheme, hostel facilities for free accommodation and meals shall be provided to the children of migrant construction workers in primary school. The aim of the scheme is to provide primary, secondary, and higher education to the children of migrant construction workers.

title: Jyoti Gramodyog Vikas Yojana
occupation_requirement: Artisan / Vendor / Worker / Startup / Business Owner
eligibility_details: - The applicant must be aged between 25 to 50 years. - The applicant must have passed at least Class 10 from a recognized educational board. - The applicant must possess at least one year of experience in the proposed business activity or relevant training from a recognized institution. - The applicant must be either an individual artisan/entrepreneur or part of a Grade-II active Self Help Group engaged in small-scale production. The applicant's proposed project must be located in a rural area with a population not exceeding 20,000. - The applicant must not represent a partnership firm, private limited company, joint venture, HUF, or similar commercial entity. - For SC/ST, women, and physically handicapped applicants, additional benefits are provided as specified in the benefits section.
benefits:
Margin Money Subsidy For General Category - 25% for projects up to ₹10,00,000/-. - 25% on first ₹10,00,000/- + 10% on remaining cost (up to ₹25,00,000/-). For SC/ST/Women/Physically Handicapped - 30% for projects up to ₹10,00,000/-. - 30% on first ₹10,00,000/- + 10% on remaining cost (up to ₹25,00,000/-).
Project Cost Coverage - Includes machinery, raw materials, and working capital (max 10% of total cost). - Excludes land/building expenses. Disbursement The subsidy is credited to the beneficiary’s account after 2 years of successful operation (upon verification by DIC).
summary: The scheme provides margin money subsidies (25–30%) for new rural industrial projects (₹1,00,000/- to 25,00,000/-) to artisans, entrepreneurs, and SHGs, leveraging a 24-hour electricity supply in villages. Beneficiaries must be aged 25–50 years with a Class 10th education.

title: Kaidi Sahay Yojana
eligibility_details: - Applicant must be a family member of a prisoner currently serving sentence in a state jail in Gujarat. - The prisoner should be the sole or main earner of the family. - The prisoner's family must be economically dependent on the prisoner. - The total family income should not exceed ₹1,50,000/- per annum. - The family should not be fragmented (i.e., should be living together and dependent on the prisoner).
benefits: - Financial Assistance: A one-time assistance of ₹25,000/-.
summary: The "Kaidi Sahay Yojana" by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Gujarat, provides financial assistance of ₹25,000/- to the family of a prisoner who is the sole or main earner, to support them through self-employment.

title: Kunwar Bai Nu Mameru Yojana
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a native of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should belong to Scheduled Castes Category. 1. The annual income limit in this scheme is ₹6,00,000/- in rural areas and ₹6,00,000/- in urban areas. 1. Benefit under this scheme till the marriage of two (2) adult girls of the family. 1. In case of remarriage the benefit under this scheme will not be available. 1. The age limit of the girl at the time of marriage should be 18 years and the age of the boy should be 21 years. 1. The application for assistance must be made within two years of marriage. 1. The assistance of the scheme will be available to girls from the Sat Fera Samuh Lagna Yojana. 1. Beneficiary girls participating in group marriages will be eligible for benefits under both schemes if they fulfill all the conditions of the Sat Fera Samuh Lagna Yojana and Kunwar Bai Nu Mameru Yojana.
benefits: 1. Scheduled caste girls who marry after 01/04/2021 will receive financial assistance of ₹12,000/- under the scheme. 1. Scheduled caste girls who marry before 01/04/2021 will receive financial assistance of ₹10,000/- under the scheme.
summary: The scheme was initiated in 1991. Under the scheme, financial assistance is provided on the occasion of the marriage of two adult girls belonging to the Scheduled Caste category.

title: Mahila Adhikarita Yojana (Gujarat Safai Kamdar Development Corporation)
eligibility_details: - The applicant must be a woman sweeper or a dependent of a woman sweeper. - The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat.
benefits: - Loan Assistance: An amount of ₹20,000/- at 5% interest rate, with a repayment period of 5 years.
summary: "Mahila Adhikarita Yojana" introduced by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Gujarat, is a centrally sponsored financial support scheme offering loans of ₹20,000/- at a subsidized interest rate to women sweepers and their dependents to promote self-reliance and upliftment.

title: Mahila Samriddhi Yojana (GTKVN)
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should be a woman from Thakor or Koli caste. 1. The applicant should be between 21 to 50 years of age at the time of application. 1. The applicant’s annual family income should not exceed ₹3,00,000/-. 1. The applicant should have relevant technical skills and experience in the proposed trade/business. 1. The applicant will have to provide suitable collateral to get the loan. Note: At least 50% of the total loan amount will be allocated for families with annual income up to ₹1,50,000/-.
benefits: - Maximum Loan Amount: Up to ₹60,000/-.- Interest Rate: 4% per annum.- Loan Coverage: Up to 100% of the loan will be given for the proposed business/trade.- Repayment: The loan amount will have to be repaid in 48 equal monthly installments (4 years) including interest.
summary: The scheme aims to empower women entrepreneurs from Thakor & Koli communities by providing access to micro-loans for self-employment. Under this scheme, financial assistance in the form of low-interest loans is provided to eligible beneficiaries to set up small businesses based on their skills.

title: Mahila Swavlamban Scheme
category: Women and Child, Social welfare & Empowerment, Business & Entrepreneurship
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a woman. 1. The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant must belong to the BPL (Below Poverty Line) category 1. The applicant's annual income must be ₹1,20,000/- in rural areas and ₹1,50,000/-in urban areas.
benefits: - Subsidy Support: A subsidy of 15% or up to ₹30,000/- (whichever is lower) is provided to eligible women to support their business ventures. - Loan Facility: Women can avail of loans up to ₹2,00,000/- to start or expand their economic activities.
summary: The scheme provides financial assistance to women from rural and urban areas for undertaking economic activities, with support in the form of a subsidy and loans.

title: Mai Ramabai Ambedakar Saat Phera Samuh Lagna Yojana
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a native of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste category. 1. The annual income limit in this scheme is ₹6,00,000/- in rural areas and ₹6,00,000/- in urban areas. 1. In case of remarriage, the benefit will not be available under this scheme. 1. The age limit of the girl at the time of marriage should be 18 years and the age of the boys should be 21 years. Proof of age of bride and groom to be married will be mandatory. 1. Applications for assistance must be made within two years of the marriage. 1. The beneficiary girl participating in the group marriage will be eligible for the benefits under this scheme. 1. The assistance of the scheme will be available to girls from Kunwar Bai Nu Mameru Yojana. 1. Marriage registration certificate has to be submitted compulsorily to avail the benefits of this scheme. 1. The organization/institution organizing the group wedding has to apply to the concerned authority within two years from the date of marriage. 1. The bride must produce a certified copy of the caste certificate obtained from the competent authority of the bride.
benefits: 1. Under the scheme, couples participating in group marriages are given an incentive of ₹12,000/- per couple in the name of the bride. 1. For organizing Group Marriage Functions, the organizer/organizing institution will be paid an incentive of ₹3,000/- per couple up to a maximum of ₹75,000/-.
summary: Under the scheme, incentives are provided to couples who participate in group marriages, as well as to the organizing institution. If people adopt the practice of group marriages, they can avoid the unnecessary expenses associated with individual weddings and promote financial growth.

title: Manav Kalyan Yojana
eligibility_details:
- The applicants must be between 18 and 60 years of age to qualify for the scheme. - The applicants from Scheduled Castes (SC), Scheduled Tribes (ST), or Socially and Educationally Backward Classes (SEBC) nomadic tribes are eligible without any income proof requirement. - The applicants from general categories must have a family annual income of ₹6,00,000/- or less, and must submit an income certificate as proof.
Additional Requirement for Rural Applicants The rural applicants must - a) either be listed in the Below Poverty Line (BPL) list with a poverty score of 0 to 16. b) or submit an income certificate issued by the relevant authority.
Income Criteria Exemptions The income limit does not apply to the following: a) Individuals from the 12 most backward sub-castes within the Scheduled Castes. b) Members of the most backward, nomadic, or de-notified tribes under the SEBC category. *For all other applicants, the annual family income must not exceed ₹6,00,000/-, whether residing in rural or urban areas.
benefits: Toolkit Assistance: E-vouchers for toolkits in 10 specified trades. Trades Covered: Dairy Product Sales, Plumber, Bharat Kaam (Embroidery), Centering Work, Beauty Parlor, Electric Appliances Repairing, Papad Making, Pickle Making, Vehicle Servicing, Puncture Kit *The maximum cost limits per toolkit are predefined (exact amounts not specified in the document). Training Option: Applicants can opt for skill training during the application process. Transparent Disbursement: E-vouchers (QR codes) are generated post-approval and redeemed at approved dealers.
summary: The scheme provides toolkit assistance (e-vouchers) to economically weak individuals (annual income ≤ ₹6,00,000/-) for self-employment in 10 trades like dairy, plumbing, and beauty parlors. Beneficiaries include SC/ST, nomadic tribes, and BPL families.

title: Maternity Assistance Scheme (GBOCWWB)
category: Social welfare & Empowerment, Women and Child
eligibility_details: 1. The construction workers registered with the Gujarat Building and Other Construction Worker’s Welfare Board will be eligible to get the benefit of this scheme. 1. The construction worker should have an active membership of the Board. 1. Financial assistance is provided for the first two births of both a registered female construction worker and the wife of a registered construction worker. Note: Application should be made within 12 (twelve) months after delivery.
benefits: 1. Under the scheme, financial assistance of ₹6,000/- is provided to the wife of a registered construction worker for the first two deliveries. 1. Financial assistance of ₹37,500/- is provided to a registered female construction worker for the first two deliveries. Note 01: Financial assistance is disbursed directly from DBT to the beneficiary's account. Note 02: The scheme also provides benefits in case of miscarriage. Note 03: The application period is up to six months from the date of conception. Rules and Conditions: 1. ₹17,500/- before maternity assistance in case of registered women construction workers should be applied in 06 (six) months along with a Surgeon/Gynecologist/Gynecology PHC-approved doctor's certificate/copy of a Mamta card (in case of registered women worker)/Doctor's certificate. 1. The application should be inwarded in the office before the completion of 06 months (six) counting the period from the date of inwarding of the application in the office of the board in the copy of the card. 1. In the case of female construction workers registered in the post-delivery application, post-delivery financial assistance of ₹20,000/- and ₹6000/- in the case of the wife of a construction worker is provided.
summary: The objective of this scheme is to provide financial assistance during pregnancy to women construction workers and construction workers' wives registered with the Gujarat Building and Other Construction Worker’s Welfare Board and to provide social stability to construction workers.

title: Mill Gate Price Subsidy Scheme
eligibility_details: - The applicant must be a handloom cooperative society, NGO, or development center. - The applicant must purchase yarn from NHDC-recognized depots (e.g., Gujarat State Handloom & Handicrafts Development Corporation).
benefits:
Yarn Purchase Subsidy 15% subsidy on yarn bought from NHDC-recognized depots.
Freight Reimbursement - Non-Silk/Jute Yarn: Plain Area: 1.00%, Hills/Remote: 1.75%, North-East: 3.00% - Silk Yarn: Plain Area: 1.00%, Hills/Remote: 1.25%, North-East: 1.50% - Jute/Jute Blended Yarn: Plain Area: 7.00%, Hills/Remote: 8.00%, North-East: 8.50% *Additional 2.5% depot operating charges.
Disbursement Mode 15% subsidy credited via RTGS/e-payment. Freight reimbursement is processed separately.
summary: The scheme provides 15% subsidy on yarn purchases from NHDC depots to handloom weavers, cooperatives, and NGOs, along with freight reimbursement (1–8.5%). Intended beneficiaries include weavers below the poverty line.

title: Mukhyamantri Bhagyalaxmi Bond Scheme (GBOCWWB)
category: Social welfare & Empowerment, Women and Child
eligibility_details: 1. The construction workers registered with the Gujarat Building and Other Construction Worker’s Welfare Board will be eligible to get the benefit of this scheme. 1. The construction workers are eligible to avail the benefits of the scheme in the event of the birth of a girl child. 1. The benefit of the scheme is given upto one girl child. 1. The application form should be made within 12 months from birth.
benefits: 1. Under the scheme, a bond of ₹25,000/- or of the amount as resolved from time to time, with maturity at 18 year of the age of the girl child, upto one girl is given to the registered Building and other Construction workers. 1. The amount can be withdrawn by the daughter after completing 18 years of age.
summary: The scheme has been implemented with the objective of "Beti Bachao Beti Padhao" to prevent female foeticide and to meet the education and marriage expenses of the daughter of a construction worker.

title: Mukhyamantri Mahila Utkarsh Yojana
category: Social welfare & Empowerment, Women and Child
eligibility_details: Eligibility 1. The applicant should be a woman who is a permanent resident of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should be 18 years of age or above. 1. The applicant should have passed at least the 8th standard. 1. The applicant should have a valid Aadhaar card.
benefits:
Details Under the scheme, the government provides interest-free loans of up to Rs. 1 lakh to women entrepreneurs who wish to start a new business or expand their existing one. The loans are provided without any collateral security, and the repayment period is up to five years. The scheme also provides training and skill development programs to women entrepreneurs to help them build their business acumen and enhance their knowledge of entrepreneurship. The Mukhyamantri Mahila Utkarsh Yojana is a great initiative to promote women's entrepreneurship and to empower them to become financially independent. over the scheme name, launch date, ministry/dept. name, target beneficiary, benefits, etc.)
Objectives: The main objectives of the scheme are: 1. To promote women's entrepreneurship and provide them with financial assistance to start or expand their businesses. 1. To provide interest-free loans to women entrepreneurs to promote their business ventures. 1. To provide training and skill development programs to women entrepreneurs to enhance their knowledge of entrepreneurship. 1. To create employment opportunities for women in the state.
Features of the Scheme: 1. Interest-Free Loans: Under the scheme, women entrepreneurs can avail of interest-free loans of up to Rs. 1 lakh to start or expand their businesses. The loans are provided without any collateral security. 1. Repayment Period: The repayment period for the loan is up to 5 years. 1. Training and Skill Development: The scheme provides training and skill development programs to women entrepreneurs to help them build their business acumen and enhance their knowledge of entrepreneurship.
- Subsidy: The government also provides a subsidy of 6% per annum to women entrepreneurs who repay their loans on time. - No Processing Fee: The scheme does not charge any processing fee for the loan application. - No Income Limit: There is no income limit for women entrepreneurs to apply for the scheme.
summary: Mukhyamantri Mahila Utkarsh Yojana is a scheme launched by the Government of Gujarat to empower women in the state. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to women entrepreneurs and to promote their entrepreneurial spirit.

title: Nalanda Award
eligibility_details: - The organization must have made outstanding contributions in the field of social welfare. - The welfare work should benefit socially and educationally backward classes (SEBC).
benefits: - Financial assistance to the selected organization.
summary: The "Nalanda Award" implemented by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Gujarat, recognizes organizations for exceptional work in the field of social welfare, particularly for the socially and educationally disadvantaged sections.

title: Palak Mata-Pita Yojana
eligibility_details: - The applicant must be a close relative, guardian, or foster parent taking care of the child. - The applicant must be caring for a child aged between 0 to 18 years. - The applicant must be taking care of a child whose both parents are deceased, or whose father is deceased and mother has remarried. - The applicant must ensure that the child between 3 to 6 years is enrolled in an Anganwadi center. - The applicant must ensure that the child above 6 years is enrolled in a school for compulsory education. - The applicant must submit a certificate from the school or institution every year confirming the child’s ongoing education. - The applicant must have an annual family income not exceeding ₹27,000/- in rural areas. - The applicant must have an annual family income not exceeding ₹36,000/- in urban areas.
benefits: Financial Assistance: ₹3,000/- per month.
summary: The "Palak Mata-Pita Yojana" introduced on 29th August, 2009 by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department, Gujarat, provides a monthly assistance of ₹3000 to foster parents raising orphaned children or children whose mother has remarried after the father's death.

title: Pandit Dindayal Upadhyay Awas Yojana (Developing Caste Welfare) (EBC)
eligibility_details: - Applicant must belong to the Economically Backward Class (EBC). - Applicant must be a resident of Gujarat. - Applicant's family income should not exceed ₹6,00,000/- per annum. - Applicant must own land or have been allotted land/house under a government poverty housing scheme.
benefits: - Financial Assistance of up to ₹1,20,000/- for house construction.
summary: The scheme aims to support Economically Weaker Sections (EWS) by offering financial aid up to ₹1,20,000/- for house construction. This scheme also ensures that Economically Weaker Sections receive support in securing shelter.

title: Pandit Dindayal Upadhyay Awas Yojana (Developing Caste Welfare) (NT-DNT)
eligibility_details: - Applicant must be a resident of Gujarat. - Applicant must belong to the Nomadic Tribe (NT)/ Denotified Tribe (DNT) (https://socialjustice.gov.in/writereaddata/UploadFile/Draft%20List%20of%20Denotified%20Tribes%20for%20Mail.pdf). - Applicant’s annual family income must not exceed ₹6,00,000/-.
benefits: - Financial Assistance: Up to ₹1,20,000/- for house construction.
summary: The "Pandit Dindayal Upadhyay Awas Yojana (Developing Caste Welfare) (NT-DNT)" provides financial assistance of up to ₹1,20,000/- to the people belonging to Nomadic Tribes and Denotified Tribes.

title: Pandit Dindayal Upadhyay Awas Yojana-Developing Caste Welfare
eligibility_details: - The applicant must belong to the Socially and Educationally Backward Class (SEBC)/ Economically Backward Class (EBC) or Nomadic Exempted Caste. - The applicant must be a permanent resident of Gujarat. - The applicant must have a total annual family income not exceeding ₹6,00,000/-. - The applicant must have legal ownership of land or a valid allotment order for the construction of a house.
benefits: - Financial Assistance: Up to ₹1,20,000/- for house construction.
summary: The "Pandit Dindayal Upadhyay Awas Yojana-Developing Caste Welfare" provides financial assistance of up to ₹1,20,000/- to socially and educationally backward classes, economically backward classes, and nomadic exempted castes for constructing houses across Gujarat.

title: Pashupalan Dhiran Yojana
eligibility_details: - The applicant must belong to the Rabari or Bharwad caste, classified under socially and educationally backward classes (SC). - The applicant must be between 21 and 45 years of age. - The applicant must have a family annual income not exceeding ₹3,00,00/-. - The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat. - The applicant must be engaged in or intending to undertake animal husbandry activities.
benefits: - Financial Assistance: Loan up to ₹1,30,000/- for animal husbandry. Note: - Loan Amount: 95%- Beneficiary Contribution: 5%
summary: "Pashupalan Dhiran Yojana" by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department provides loan assistance for animal husbandry to Rabari and Bharwad castes from the socially and educationally backward classes.

title: Prosthetic Aid and Appliances for Person with Disabilities
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a native of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should have 40 % or more disability. 1. Employment-oriented tools will not be provided to individuals under the age of 16. 1. Under this scheme, employment-oriented and disability-relieving equipment will be available only once in a period of 5 years. 1. Both employment-oriented and disability-relieving equipment are available for persons with disability under the scheme.
benefits: Under this scheme, the following equipment is given within a limit of ₹20,000/-. 1. Artificial limb, crutch or calipers, tricycle, folding wheelchair to Person with Disabilities. 1. Hearing aids and other tool assistance for mute and deaf persons. 1. Musical instruments, brail kit for visually impaired persons. 1. M. R. child kit for mentally challenged persons. 1. For self-employment, hand carts, sewing machines, instruments of electric repairing, tools of cycle repairing, hair cutting kit, etc.
summary: Under this scheme, a Person with Disabilities with 40% or more disability is given relief in his/her disability as well as equipment for self-employment within the limit of ₹20,000/-. The scheme is fully funded by the state government.

title: Sant Surdas Scheme
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a native of Gujarat. 1. The applicant should be 0 to 17 years age group. 1. Percentage of disability of 80 or more or those who cannot move even with help of artificial limbs independently. 1. The applicant should be registered in the Below Poverty Line (BPL) list and BPL score is up to 20. 1. The benefit of this scheme is eligible to the disabled person of Gujarat living under the Below Poverty Line (disabled person included in the BPL from the Ministry of Rural Development, Government of India for the rural area and the Ministry of Housing & Urban Poverty Alleviation, Government of India for the urban area) are eligible to get the benefit of this scheme. 1. The applicant should be possessing disability card issued by state government. Note: The amount of assistance will be stopped when the applicant/beneficiary reached age of 18 years.
benefits: 1. Under the scheme, a monthly assistance of ₹1,000/- is paid to the beneficiary by the State Government through DBT.
summary: Under the scheme, monthly financial assistance is provided to Persons with Disabilities aged between 0 and 17 years, who have a disability of more than 80% and are registered in the Below Poverty Line (BPL) list.

title: Satyvadi Raja Harishchandra Marnotar Sahay Yojana
eligibility_details: 1. The deceased person as well as the applicant should be a native of Gujarat. 1. The deceased person as well as the applicant applying should belong to Scheduled Castes only. 1. The annual income limit of the applicant should be more than ₹6,00,000/- for rural areas and ₹6,00,000/- for urban areas. 1. The application must be made within a time limit of six months of the death. 1. The death registration certificate of the deceased person must be produced. 1. Only one person in the family of the deceased can take the benefit at that time.
benefits: 1. Under the scheme, scheduled caste families receive financial assistance of ₹5,000/- at the time of a family member's death to cover funeral expenses.
summary: The scheme was launched in the year 2000 to provide financial assistance to scheduled caste families at the time of the death of a family member to cover funeral expenses, due to their poor economic conditions.

title: Scheme to Provide Electric Scooter to Disabled Person
eligibility_details: - The applicant must be a resident of Gujarat. - The applicant must be between 18 to 50 years of age. - The applicant must have an orthopedic disability of 40% or more, certified by a civil surgeon. - The applicant must possess a Disability Identity Card issued by the Social Security Department. - The applicant must be listed in the BPL (Below Poverty Line) category with a score of 0 to 20. - The applicant must not have already availed benefits under this scheme in the last five years, unless the previously allotted electric scooter is damaged and the applicant remains otherwise eligible. - The applicant must purchase the electric scooter from an agency approved by JEDA at the government-approved price. Note: The applicant will be given priority if their name appears in the SECC-2011 (Socio-Economic Caste Census) data.
benefits: - Financial Assistance: Up to the limit of 50% of the basic cost of the electric scooter + 50% of the disability kit or ₹25,000/-.
summary: The "Scheme to Provide Electric Scooter to Disabled Person" provides financial assistance of up to ₹25,000 for the purchase of electric scooters to eligible persons with orthopedic disabilities.

title: Scheme to Provide Financial Assistance for the Production and Publication of Excellent Original Children's Literature
ministry: Sports, Youth and Cultural Activities Department
eligibility_details: - The applicant must be the original author of a children's book manuscript written in Gujarati. - The book must be unpublished, original, and appropriate for children’s literature in terms of content and presentation. - Authors who have received five grants or more under any Sahitya Academy schemes are not eligible. - Only one application per financial year is allowed. - Manuscript must be typed, bound, paginated, and submitted in two copies by the deadline.
benefits: Financial Assistance: - For books up to 64 pages: Up to ₹5,000/-.- For books exceeding 64 pages: Up to ₹10,000/-. Printing Size Guidelines: - For “Demy” size: ₹2,300/- (paperback).- For “Double Crown” size: ₹2,500/- (paperback), ₹2,700/- (hardcover). Note: Whichever is lower between actual expense and ceiling will be granted.
summary: The scheme aims to promote high-quality literary works for children by providing financial support to Gujarati authors for publishing original, unpublished children's books that contribute to cultural and moral development.

title: Shramik Annapurna Yojana (GBOCWWB)
eligibility_details: - The benefits of this scheme can be availed by construction workers registered with Gujarat Building and Other Construction Worker’s Welfare Board and their family members.
benefits: - Under this scheme, healthy and nutritious meals will be provided to the construction workers at a concessional rate of ₹5/- per meal.
summary: Under the scheme, registered construction workers are entitled to receive nutritious meals at concessional rates at the workplace or on Kadianaka. This benefit extends to the registered worker's family members as well.

title: Shramik Parivahan Yojana (GBOCWWB)
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be engaged in any Building or Other Construction Work. 1. The construction workers who are registered with the Gujarat Building and Other Construction Worker’s Welfare Board will be eligible to get the benefit of this scheme.
benefits: 1. Under the scheme, registered construction workers will receive a bus pass at a concessional rate for commuting from Kadianaka to the workplace. 1. Under the scheme, the beneficiary is required to contribute 20% of the pass amount, while the board covers the remaining 80%. Note: The pass shall be issued at a concessional rate monthly or quarterly or six-monthly or annually as per the demand of the registered construction worker.
summary: The registered construction workers will be provided a bus pass through the Municipal Corporation at a concessional rate for commuting from Kadianaka to the workplace.

title: Shravan Tirthdarshan Yojna
eligibility_details: - The applicant must be a senior citizen aged 60 years or above. - The applicant must be a permanent resident of Gujarat. - The applicant must not have availed of the benefit previously under this scheme. - The applicant must be physically fit to undertake the journey. - The pilgrimage must be booked through an authorized travel agent/organizer.
benefits: Financial Assistance for Pilgrimage Travel Expenses - Upto ₹5,000/- per person for travel by State Transport (ST) buses. - Upto ₹7,000/- per person for travel by Private Buses. *The financial assistance provided is subject to actual travel cost or the above-mentioned amount, whichever is lower. *Only group travel is allowed (minimum 20 pilgrims required).
summary: The scheme aims to facilitate pilgrimage travel for senior citizens of Gujarat by providing financial assistance for travel expenses. It benefits eligible senior citizens through reimbursements or direct arrangements with authorized travel agents.

title: Small Scale Lending Scheme (Microfinance)
category: Social welfare & Empowerment, Banking,Financial Services and Insurance
eligibility_details: - The applicant must belong to the Rabari and Bharwad castes among the socially and educationally backward classes. - The applicant must be aged between 21 to 45 years. - The applicant must have an annual income of less than or equal to ₹3,00,000/-.
benefits: Loan Amount: Maximum loan limit of ₹1,25,000/-. Interest Rate: Subsidized interest rate of 5% per annum. Loan Coverage: 95% of the project cost is covered through a loan. Beneficiary Contribution: Only 5% contribution is required from the beneficiary. Target Group Support: Specifically designed for small entrepreneurs from the Rabari and Bharwad communities.
summary: The scheme aims to provide microcredit to the small entrepreneurs of the target group. It provides loans up to ₹1,25,000/- at 5% interest rate to eligible beneficiaries belonging to the Rabari and Bharwad castes.

title: Uniform Assistance To SC Students
eligibility_details: 1. The student should be of Scheduled Caste. 1. Students should be studying in classes 1 to 8. 1. No Income Limit.
benefits: Objective - Main Objective is to provide economic support and motivation for education. Under this scheme, assistance is given to Students studying in classes 1 to 8. - Through this scheme, the Gujarat government promotes primary education.
summary: The Government of Gujarat launched a financial Assistance scheme for the student who comes under the scheduled caste.

title: Vanbandhu Kalyan Yojana
eligibility_details: 1. Beneficiary must be from Tribal Category. 1. Must belong to BPL group.
benefits: - Double the income of all tribal families, with a special focus on the migrant families and the Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups - Increas in animal husbandry and dairy based activities - Access to quality education for every eligible tribal child and increased emphasis on higher education. - Double the income of all tribal families including migrant tribal families and Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups - Support the socio-economic development of all tribal families by providing access to necessary amenities for a healthy living. - Provide a house to each tribal family, including those from Particularly Venerable Tribal Groups, - provide access to safe drinking water to all tribal families - Assured income from agriculture to all tribal farmers - Ensure universal electrification for all Scheduled Tribe households and villages for improved quality of life and economic development. - Promote wealth creation in tribal areas and improve the quality of life of all tribal families. - Develop tribal towns as growth engines to augment the income of tribal families.
summary: Vanbandhu Kalyan Yojana focuses on integrated, holistic, and inclusive development of tribal communities. It aims at creation of quality social and civil infrastructure, and sustainable livelihood, employment & entrepreneurship in tribal areas such that the income of every tribal family doubles.

title: Aatmanirbhar Gujarat Scheme for assistance to MSMEs: Net SGST reimbursement to Micro, Small and Medium Manufacturing Enterprise (MSMEs):

title: Aatmanirbhar Gujarat Scheme for assistance to MSMEs: Rehabilitation of Sick Enterprise
eligibility_details: 1. The firm must be a Micro/Small/Medium enterprise. 1. title: Dr.Babasaheb Ambedkar Udyog Uday Yojana: Assistance to Micro and Small Enterprises (MSE) of SC/ST for Plot Developed by GIDC
eligibility_details: 1. The firm must be a Micro/Small/Medium enterprise run by SC/ST entrepreneur. 1. The applicant must apply for a plot within an estate approved by GIDC. 1. The maximum plot size should not exceed 1000 Sq. Mt. (with exceptions for irregular plots). > Note: - SC/ST Enterprise: SC/ST Enterprise means the enterprise in which contribution of SC/ST entrepreneur is 51% or more.
benefits: Quantum of Assistance: 1. An enterprise will be eligible for assistance up to 70% of the allotment price of GIDC. 1. On payment of 30% of the allotment price, GIDC will hand over the possession of the plot and submit the claim of subsidy up to 70% of the allotment price to the commissioner MSME.
summary: The scheme "Dr.Babasaheb Ambedkar Udyog Uday Yojana" aims to support SC/ST entrepreneurs and strengthen MSMEs, making them globally competitive.

title: Scheme for Assistance to Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME): Assistance for Reimbursement of CGTMSE Fees
eligibility_details: - The firm must be a Micro/Small/Medium enterprise. - The enterprise must have availed of a collateral-free term loan under CGTMSE. - The application must be submitted within within one year from the date of first disbursement of Term loan, or on or before the date of commencement of commercial production, whichever is later.
benefits: Collateral-Free Loans: - Government of India has instructed financial institutions to sanction collateral-free loans up to ₹2,00,00,000/-. Support for MSEs: - Assistance is provided to Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs) under this scheme. - Service fees charged by banks/financial institutions are eligible for reimbursement. Annual Service Fees: - 1st Year: 1.8% + Risk Premium. - 2nd Year Onwards: 0.85% or as amended by CGTMSE/RBI. Reimbursement Assistance: - 100% reimbursement of the annual service fees paid by entrepreneurs for up to 5 years.
summary: The "Scheme for Assistance to Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME)" launched by the Industries and Mines Department aims to position Gujarat as a global business hub, promoting sustainable manufacturing, MSME growth, and export competitiveness.

title: Scheme for Assistance to Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME): Assistance for Saving in Consumption of Energy and Water
eligibility_details: - The applicant must be an existing or new enterprise. - The enterprise must conduct an energy/water audit from a recognized institution. - The enterprise must achieve a minimum 10% reduction in energy/water consumption after implementing audit recommendations. - The applicant must install equipment as per the recommendations of the auditing authority. - Enterprises with increased energy/water consumption due to production growth will be reviewed separately.
benefits: Reimbursement for Energy/Water Audit: 75% cost of energy/water audit conducted by a recognized institution/ consultant subject to maximum ₹ 50,000/- for each will be reimbursed once during the operative period of the scheme. Subsidy on Recommended Equipment: 25% of the cost of equipment recommended by the Auditing authority subject to a maximum ₹20,00,000/- one time assistance will be eligible during the operative period of the scheme.
summary: The "Scheme for Assistance to Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME)" launched by the Industries and Mines Department aims to position Gujarat as a global business hub, promoting sustainable manufacturing, MSME growth, and export competitiveness.

The applicant must have paid power connection charges to the distribution licensee during the scheme's operative period. 1. The application for reimbursement must be submitted within one year of payment.

title: Scheme for Assistance to Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME): Assistance for Quality Certification
eligibility_details: 1. The firm must be a Micro/Small/Medium enterprise. 1. The enterprise must be in the manufacturing sector. 1. The enterprise must be registered under MSME/Udyam Registration. 1. The ERP system cost must be related to software and services (not hardware). 1. The enterprise must apply within one year from the date of certificate issuance.
benefits:

title: Scheme for Assistance to Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME): Financial Support to MSMEs in ZED Certification
eligibility_details: 1. The firm must be a Micro/Small/Medium enterprise. 1. The enterprise must be in the manufacturing sector. 1. The MSME should apply for ZED certification under the scheme. 1. The MSME must comply with government environmental and quality regulations.
benefits: - Financial Assistance: MSMEs receive a subsidy of 50% of certification charges, up to a maximum of ₹50,000/-. - Quality Enhancement: Encourages MSMEs to improve product quality and adopt advanced manufacturing techniques. - Energy Efficiency: Promotes the use of energy-efficient manufacturing processes.
summary: The scheme "Scheme for Assistance to Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME)" launched by the Industries and Mines Department aims to position Gujarat as a global business hub, promoting sustainable manufacturing, MSME growth, and export competitiveness.

title: Scheme for Assistance to Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME): Rehabilitation of Sick Enterprises
eligibility_details: 1. The enterprise must be an MSME (Micro, Small, or Medium Enterprise). 1. The enterprise must satisfy the RBI guidelines for sickness. 1. The application must be submitted with audited balance sheets for verification.
benefits: - Financial Reimbursement: 50% of the cost of preparing the Draft Rehabilitation Scheme is reimbursed, up to a maximum of ₹1,00,000/-.
summary: The "Scheme for Assistance to Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME)" launched by the Industries and Mines Department aims to position Gujarat as a global business hub, promoting sustainable manufacturing, MSME growth, and export competitiveness.

title: Scheme or assistance for Start Ups/ Innovation: Assistance to Startups having a Significant Impact on Society
eligibility_details: - Any individual or group of individuals with an innovative idea or concept, recommended by an approved Nodal Institution, is eligible. - The scheme is open to startups in any sector or branch of science, technology, engineering, agriculture, healthcare, etc., making it sector-agnostic. benefits: - Financial Support: Up to ₹10,00,000/- assistance is provided for innovative projects which have a significant impact on society,

title: Agricultural Activities for Persons with Disabilities
ministry: Welfare of Scheduled Caste & Backward Classes Department
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Haryana. 1. The applicant should have a disability of at least 40%. 1. The applicant should be above 18 years old. For persons with mental retardation, the age requirement is relaxed to 14 years instead of the usual 18 years.
benefits: 1. Under this scheme, loans up to ₹10,00,000/- are provided to persons with disabilities for agricultural production, irrigation, horticulture, sericulture, purchasing agricultural machinery/equipment for agricultural services, marketing agricultural products, etc.
summary: This scheme provides loans up to ₹10,00,000/- to the persons with disabilities for agricultural production, irrigation, horticulture, sericulture, the purchase of agricultural machinery and equipment for agricultural services, and the marketing of agricultural products etc.

title: Bhavantar Bharpai Yojana
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a landowner, lessee, or tenant farmer in Haryana. 1. The farmer should cultivate one of the 21 listed crops. Note 1: Registration on the Meri Fasal, Mera Byora portal (https://fasal.haryana.gov.in/) during the sowing period is mandatory. Note 2: The land and crop details must be certified by the Horticulture Department.
benefits: 1. To make vegetable growers risk free. 1. To fix protected price for the crops (Ladyfinger, Chilli, Bottle Gourd, Bitter Gourd, Cabbage, Radish, Tomato, Onion, Potato, Cauliflower, Carrot, Peas, Capsicum, Brinjal, Turmeric, Garlic, Mango, Kinnow, Guava, Litchi, Plum) 1. In case of selling of fruits/vegetables at lower prices in the market within the prescribed period, the difference in price upto the protected price will be compensated by the Government to the registered farmers. Note: The incentive amount will be released into the Aadhar linked bank account of the farmer.
summary: The scheme is implemented by the Department of Horticulture, Government of Haryana, aims to protect horticultural farmers from market price fluctuations and compensate them if they receive low prices for their produce in the market.

title: Dairy Farming Scheme (HSFDC)
ministry: Welfare of Scheduled Caste & Backward Classes Department
category: Banking,Financial Services and Insurance, Business & Entrepreneurship
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Haryana. 1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste Category. 1. The applicant should belong to a Below Poverty Line (BPL) family. 1. The applicant's annual family income should not exceed ₹1,80,000/- in both rural and urban areas. 1. The applicant's annual family income should not exceed the BPL limit. 1. The applicant's name should be included in the BPL Survey List. Note: The eligibility of the applicant is verified by the field staff before sponsoring the same to the bank for sanction.
benefits: Project Cost Ceiling: - Up to ₹1,50,000 /-. Subsidy: - Subsidy @ 50% of the total project cost (Maximum amount of subsidy is ₹10,000/-) Bank Loan: - Besides subsidy, the composite loan i.e. subsidy, and the balance amount of the bank loan is provided by the banks to the seller of the assets on behalf of the beneficiaries.
summary: Under this scheme, the Corporation provides loans/benefits to individuals from Below Poverty Line (BPL) families, whose annual family income does not exceed ₹1,80,000/-, in both rural and urban areas for self-employment income generating activities such as dairy farming.

title: Integrated Horticulture Development Plan Scheme for Scheduled Caste Families
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a farmer. 1. The farmer should be a resident of Haryana. 1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste community. 1. The applicant should own or lease agricultural land. Note: The scheme targets Scheduled Caste families with small landholdings in the state.
benefits: - Under this scheme, Scheduled Caste farmers receive 90% subsidy on components like Mushroom Trays, Bamboo Stacking in vegetable crops, Protected Structures (Poly House/Net House/Walk-in-Tunnels), Cultivation of High Value vegetables/ flowers under Protected Structures and other cultivation technologies in Haryana. - Training will be provided on various aspects of horticultural crops cultivation technologies.
summary: Under this scheme, Scheduled Caste farmers will be provided with quality planting material and other inputs for mushroom cultivation, bamboo stacking in vegetables, and protected cultivation with a subsidy of up to 90%. Additionally, training will be offered on various aspects of these practices.

title: Intensive Fisheries Development Programme - Subsidy on Commercial Four-Wheeler Vehicles
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Haryana. 1. The applicant should possess a valid Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP). 1. The applicant should be at least 18 years of age.
benefits: - Subsidy under the scheme is provided at the rate of 25% of the actual cost of the four-wheeler (₹9 lakh) or ₹2.25 lakh, whichever is lower.
summary: The scheme aims to strengthen the fisheries value chain by providing transportation support to fish farmers. Under this scheme, eligible fish farmers receive a subsidy of 25% of the actual cost on the purchase of a commercial four-wheeler vehicle used for fisheries-related activities.

title: Intensive Fisheries Development Programme - Subsidy on Insurance Premium for Shrimp Crop Insurance
category: Agriculture,Rural & Environment, Banking,Financial Services and Insurance
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Haryana. 1. The applicant should be a farmer and involved in shrimp farming. 1. The applicant should possess a valid Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP ID). 1. The applicant should be at least 18 years of age.
benefits: - 50% subsidy on the insurance premium paid for shrimp crop insurance.
summary: The scheme aims to promote sustainable aquaculture by reducing financial risk of shrimp farmers through subsidized insurance coverage.Under this scheme, a 50% subsidy is provided on insurance premium paid by eligible fish farmers for shrimp crop insurance, helping them mitigate potential crop losses

title: Intensive Fisheries Development Programme - Subsidy on Purchase of Fishing Nets (Scheduled Caste)
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Haryana. 1. The applicant should possess a valid Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP). 1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste (SC) category. 1. The applicant should be at least 18 years old. 1. The applicant should present a GST-paid bill for the purchase of fishing nets. 1. The applicant can apply only once in two years for this subsidy.
benefits: Financial Assistance is provided to Fish Farmers under the scheme: - Financial assistance of 60% subsidy on the purchase of fishing nets of amounting to ₹40,000/-. - The maximum subsidy amount is ₹24,000/-. Note: Subsidy is available only once in two years per beneficiary.
summary: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to individuals from Scheduled Caste families engaged in fishing activities for the purchase of fishing nets. Under this scheme, a 60% subsidy or up to ₹24,000, on the purchase of fishing nets worth ₹40,000/- will be provided to eligible beneficiaries.

title: Intensive Fisheries Development Programme - Subsidy on Solar System for fish/shrimp culture
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should have a Parivar Pehchaan Patra (PPP). 1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Haryana. 1. The applicant's age should be a minimum of 18 years. 1. The applicant should not be a government or semi-government employee. 1. A minimum of 2.5-acre area is required for fish/shrimp culture. Note: The benefit/subsidy will be provided only once to a beneficiary on a single unit.
benefits: 1. A subsidy of 60% on the total project cost amounting to ₹50,000 per kilowatt (KW) or a subsidy amount of ₹30,000 per KW, whichever is less, is provided. 1. The maximum limit for this subsidy is 30 KW for shrimp farmers. 1. The maximum limit for this subsidy is 10 KW for fish farmers.
summary: Under this scheme, subsidies on solar systems for fish/shrimp culture are provided to eligible fish and shrimp farmers. The subsidy is given at 60% of the total project cost, or ₹30,000 per kW, whichever is lower. The maximum subsidy is limited to 30 kW for shrimp farmers and 10 kW for fish farmers.

title: Pandit Deen Dayal Upadhyay Samoohik Pashudhan Beema Yojana
eligibility_details: - The applicant should be a livestock owner. - The applicant should be above 18 years of age. - The applicant should possess a Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP), issued by the state of Haryana. Preference and Relaxations - Applicants from Scheduled Caste and Below Poverty Line categories will be given priority. - Scheduled Caste beneficiaries are exempt from paying premiums; the state and central governments fully subsidize their insurance.
benefits: Financial Protection - Coverage for livestock loss due to death, providing financial security to farmers. - Sum insured is determined based on the market value of livestock and milk yield. - Maximum coverage is up to five large animals or equivalent small animals per household. Subsidized Premiums - APL beneficiaries pay ₹100/200/300 per large animal per year based on milk yield or ₹25/- per small animal. - BPL beneficiaries receive additional subsidies, and SC beneficiaries have their entire premium covered by the state and central government. Mode and Frequency of Disbursement - Claims are settled through direct bank transfers to beneficiaries. - Accidental death claims are covered immediately; non-accidental death claims are covered after a 21-day waiting period. Expected Time of Disbursement Insurance companies are required to settle claims within 15 days of document submission. Delays incur a penalty of 12% compound interest per annum.
summary: The scheme "Pandit Deen Dayal Upadhyay Samoohik Pashudhan Beema Yojana" aims to provide socio-economic security to livestock farmers in the state by covering livestock under an insurance scheme. Financial protection against the risk of loss due to animal death is extended to livestock owners.

title: PMMSY: Construction of Fish Retail Markets including Ornamental Fish/Aquarium Markets - Haryana
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must have a Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP). 1. The applicant must submit an undertaking in the Detailed Project Report (DPR)/Self-Contained Proposal (SCP) stating that all operational, maintenance, and post-construction management costs of the infrastructure facilities will be borne by them. 1. The applicant must commit to keeping the fish market in operational condition for 10 years. 1. The applicant must agree to permanently display a board at the infrastructure facility indicating that the fish market was constructed with Central Assistance under the Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY). 1. Central assistance will be restricted to one unit per individual beneficiary. 1. Projects with land on a long-term registered lease will also be considered for Central financial assistance. The registered lease period or agreement must not be less than a minimum period of 10 years.

The subsidy provided is: - 40% of the project cost is for beneficiaries belonging to the General Category. - 60% of the project cost is for beneficiaries belonging to the Scheduled Caste (SC) or Women categories.
summary: The scheme aims to support the construction of fish retail markets, including those for ornamental fish and aquariums. Through this scheme, financial assistance for project costs is provided to individual beneficiaries.

title: PMMSY: Construction of New Grow Out Ponds - Haryana
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must have a Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP). 1. The construction of new grow-out ponds subsidy will be provided by the State Government for the expansion of fisheries in various urban/semi-urban areas only under the construction of new grow-out ponds under the Pradhan Mantri Matasya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY) scheme. 1. Central financial assistance for the construction of new grow-out ponds will be provided only for the ponds prepared for fisheries. 1. summary: The scheme aims to expand fisheries in various urban and semi-urban areas through the construction of new grow-out ponds. Through this scheme, subsidies are provided for the construction of new grow-out ponds to beneficiaries who are engaged in fisheries.

title: PMMSY: Construction of New ponds for Saline /Alkaline areas-Haryana
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should have a Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP). 1. title: PMMSY: Cycle with Ice Boxes-Haryana
eligibility_details: 1. Beneficiary must have Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP). 1. Beneficiaries should ensure that fish transport facilities are maintained in operational condition. 1. title: PMMSY: Establishment of large RAS / Biofloc culture system - Haryana
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Haryana and possess a valid Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP). 1. The applicant must belong to either the General, Scheduled Caste (SC), or Women category. 1. The applicant must be the owner or legal leaseholder (with a minimum 10-year lease) of the land intended for setting up the unit. 1. The applicant must have access to either surface water or groundwater for aquaculture purposes. 1. The applicant must hold a valid training certificate in fisheries or aquaculture. 1. The applicant must be willing to maintain and operate the unit at personal cost after the initial setup. 1. The applicant must submit a complete Detailed Project Report (DPR) or a Self-Contained Proposal (SCP) for evaluation. 1. The applicant must agree to sign an official agreement with the Fisheries Department to avail of benefits under the scheme.

A 25% subsidy is offered for SC (Scheduled Caste) and Women beneficiaries. Biofloc Subsidy: 1. A 40% subsidy is available for the General Category. 1. summary: The scheme provides capital assistance for setting up large-scale Recirculatory Aquaculture Systems (RAS) and Biofloc culture systems to promote high-yield, sustainable fish farming.

title: PMMSY: Establishment of Medium RAS / Biofloc culture system - Haryana

The applicant must sign an agreement with the Department of Fisheries to avail benefits under the scheme.
benefits: - The project cost is ₹25,00,000/- Subsidy Distribution: 1. 40% subsidy for General Category beneficiaries. 1. 60% subsidy for SC and Women category beneficiaries.
summary: The scheme provides capital assistance to fish farmers and entrepreneurs for establishing medium-scale Recirculatory Aquaculture Systems (RAS) and Biofloc systems.

title: PMMSY: Establishment of New Freshwater Fin Fish Hatcheries-Haryana
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should have a Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP). 1. The freshwater finfish hatchery should have a minimum capacity of 15 million fry per year per unit or 6.00 crore spawn per year per unit. 1. The hatchery should have a minimum area of 0.50 hectares. 1. The fish hatchery should be managed by qualified technical staff. 1. The applicant will ensure the supply of seed produced from the centrally assisted hatcheries to farmers at an affordable and reasonable price. 1. The fish hatchery will include a brooder pond, nursery ponds, rearing tanks, a small laboratory, water and electric supply, and required infrastructure facilities. 1. The cost of accreditation of the hatchery must be mandatorily included in the project estimates. 1. The projects having land on long-term registered lease will also be considered for Central financial assistance under the scheme. 1. The lease period or agreement shall not be less than a minimum period of 10 years. 1. The applicant, having their own land, must furnish revenue records with a clear land title.
benefits: The project cost for one unit is ₹25,00,000/-. - The subsidy will be limited to 40% of the project cost for beneficiaries belonging to the General Category. - The subsidy will be limited to 60% of the project cost for beneficiaries belonging to the Scheduled Caste (SC) category or women beneficiaries.
summary: The scheme aims to support the establishment of new freshwater finfish hatcheries. Through this scheme, financial assistance in the form of subsidies is provided to beneficiaries for setting up these hatcheries.

title: PMMSY: Establishment of small RAS /Biofloc culture system - Haryana

The applicant must submit a Detailed Project Report (DPR) or a Self-Contained Proposal (SCP). 1. The applicant must sign an agreement with the Fisheries Department to be eligible under the scheme.

title: PMMSY: Fish Feed Plants of Production Capacity of at least 100 Ton/Day - Haryana

title: PMMSY: Ice Plant/Cold Storage of Minimum 50-Ton Capacity - Haryana

The applicant will receive central financial assistance only for the initial fish crop (fertilizer) in newly constructed ponds. 1.
