benefits: - The project cost is: 4,00,000/- per hectare Subsidy Distribution: 1. 40% of the project cost for General Category beneficiaries 1. 60% of the project cost for SC/Women beneficiaries
summary: The scheme under Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY) provides input cost subsidy for freshwater aquaculture in newly constructed ponds to expand fisheries production in Haryana.

title: PMMSY: Inputs for Saline /Alkaline Water Aquaculture - Haryana
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must have a valid Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP). 1. The applicant must create new water bodies under the scheme to receive input cost subsidy. 1. The applicant will receive central assistance for input costs only for the initial crop in newly constructed ponds/tanks. 1. The applicant must ensure the ponds/tanks are fully ready for fish or shrimp culture before claiming input cost assistance. 1. The applicant may also use land on a long-term registered lease, provided the lease period is at least 7 years.
benefits: - The project cost is ₹6,00,000/- per hectare. Subsidy Distribution: 1. 40% of the project cost for General Category beneficiaries 1. 60% of the project cost for SC/Women beneficiaries
summary: The subsidy for Inputs for Saline /Alkaline Water Aquaculture under Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY) provides input cost subsidy for saline/alkaline water aquaculture in newly created water bodies to expand fisheries production in Haryana.

title: PMMSY: Installation of Cages in Reservoirs Scheme - Haryana
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be an individual farmer, cooperative society, self-help group, or joint liability group. 1. The cooperative society, self-help group, or joint liability group having a minimum of 10 members. 1. The applicant must possess a Family Identity Card (Parivar Pehchan Patra). 1. The applicant must obtain prior permission from the Government of Haryana and competent authorities. 1. The cage location must have year-round water availability and a minimum of 8 meters depth. 1. The applicant should take government permission for rearing exotic fish species.
benefits: Grant Amount: - ₹3,00,000/- per unit (per cage). Grant Proportion: - 40% of unit cost for General Category beneficiaries. - 60% of unit cost for Scheduled Caste/Women beneficiaries. Cage Limit for Assistance: - Up to 5 cages for individual farmers. - Up to 20 cages for registered cooperative societies/self-help groups/joint liability groups (with at least 10 members).
summary: The scheme aims to promote cage fish farming. It provides grants per unit to the individuals and groups for sustainable aquaculture practices.

title: PMMSY: Insulated Vehicles - Haryana
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a fish farmer. 1. The applicant must possess a Family Identity Card (Parivar Pehchan Patra). 1. The applicant must ensure that the fish transportation facility is maintained in working condition. 1. The applicant must not have availed a grant for a similar insulated (reefer) vehicle earlier.
benefits: Financial Assistance: - Financial grant of up to ₹20,00,000/- per unit for the purchase of an insulated (reefer) vehicle. Grant Limits: - 40% of the unit cost for general category beneficiaries. - 60% of the unit cost for Scheduled Caste (SC) and women beneficiaries. Note - Subsidy is applicable for one vehicle per beneficiary only. - Central assistance is released only after initiating fishery activity. - The applicant should agree that any losses in procurement, operation, or maintenance are their own responsibility, and not that of the Government of India or Haryana.
summary: The scheme aims to provide a subsidy per unit for purchasing insulated vehicles for the beneficiaries to promote cold-chain logistics in fish transportation.

title: PMMSY: Large Fish Feed Mill of Production Capacity of 20 Ton /Day Scheme - Haryana
eligibility_details: 1. Beneficiary must have Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP). 1. The Beneficiaries will submit an undertaking in the DPR to the effect that all operational, maintenance and post construction management costs of the infrastructure facilities will be borne by them and the Fish Feed Plant will be kept in operational condition. 1. Central assistance for Fish Feed Mill will be as per actual cost within the overall ceiling indicated in the respective sub-components/activities under PMMSY. 1. The Beneficiary will ensure supply of feed produced from the government assisted Fish Feed Plant to the fishers and fish farmers at affordable price. 1. The projects having land on long term registered lease shall also be considered for Central financial assistance under the scheme. However, the registered lease period/agreement shall not be less than a minimum period of 10 (ten) years.
benefits: Monetary Assistance: - Grant of ₹20,00,000/- per unit for establishing a fish feed mill with 20-ton/day capacity. Subsidy Provisions: - 40% subsidy on unit cost for General Category beneficiaries. - 60% subsidy on unit cost for Scheduled Caste and women beneficiaries.
summary: The scheme aims to strengthen aquaculture through fish feed production. It provides a grant per unit to the beneficiaries under PMMSY.

title: PMMSY: Live Fish Vending Centres Scheme - Haryana
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a fisherman. 1. The applicant must have a valid Family Identity Card (Parivar Pehchan Patra). 1. The applicant should be engaged in fishery-related activities. 1. The applicant must ensure proper operation and maintenance of the vending center. 1. The applicant will receive assistance for only one live fish vending center. 1. The government will not be responsible for any operational loss or damage.
benefits: Monetary Benefit: - Financial assistance of ₹20,00,000/- per unit for setting up a live fish vending center. - Subsidy of 40% of unit cost for general category beneficiaries. - Subsidy of 60% of unit cost for Scheduled Caste and women beneficiaries.
summary: The scheme aims to support fishers by providing financial assistance for live fish vending centers. A subsidy per unit is provided under PMMSY.

title: PMMSY: Provision of Polythene lining for the Construction of New ponds for Saline/Alkaline area-Haryana
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should have a Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP). 1. The polythene lining cost shall be provided for new water bodies created under the various state government. 1. Beneficiaries shall be provided with central assistance for the polythene lining cost for the initial crop only in newly constructed. 1. Central assistance for the Polythene lining cost shall be released only after the ponds are ready for fish/shrimp culture. 1. The projects having land on long-term lease shall also be considered for Central financial assistance. However, the registered lease period/agreement shall not be a minimum period of 7 (seven) years.
benefits: - The project cost is ₹8,00,000/- per hectare. - The subsidy provided will be limited to 25% of the project cost for all categories.
summary: The scheme aims to provide central assistance for the cost of polythene lining for new ponds in saline/alkaline areas. Through this scheme, polythene lining costs are provided to beneficiaries constructing new water bodies for fish/shrimp culture.

title: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana: Establishment of Backyard mini RAS Units - Haryana
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Haryana. 1. The applicant should have a Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP). 1. The applicant should provide documentary evidence of the availability of the requisite land free from all encumbrances, financial resources, necessary clearances/permissions. 1. The water source for RAS units can be any surface or groundwater source, such as a canal, river, spring, open well, tube well, or ground well. 1. The applicant should ensure that post-construction operation, management, and maintenance of the RAS will be carried out in a satisfactory manner by the beneficiaries at their own cost. 1. The infrastructure created should have essential requirements for RAS, including water treatment units. 1. The projects having land on a long-term registered lease shall also be considered for Central financial assistance under the scheme. However, the lease period/agreement shall not be less than a minimum period of 10 years.
benefits: - Project cost: ₹50,000/- per unit - Subsidy will be limited to 40% of the project cost for the General Category of beneficiaries. - Subsidy will be limited to 60% of the project cost for Weaker sections/Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe/Women and their co-operatives of beneficiaries. Note: - General Category: Ratio 16% State Share, 24% Central Share and 60% Beneficiary Share.- Weaker sections/Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe/Women and their co-operatives: Ratio 24% State Share, 36% Central Share, 40% Beneficiary Share.
summary: Under this scheme, financial assistance in the form of subsidies is provided to eligible beneficiaries for establishing these units. Various surface and groundwater sources such as canals, rivers, springs, open wells, and tube wells can be utilized for operating RAS units.

title: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana: Medium Fish Feed Mill of Production Capacity of 8 Ton/Day
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Haryana. 1. The applicant should possess a valid Parivar Pehchan Patra (Family ID). 1. The applicant should ensure that the medium fish feed mill is in working condition. 1. The applicant should ensure the feed produced from the unit is supplied at affordable price to fishers and farmers. 1. The fish feed mill should be on land owned by the applicant or on a long-term registered lease (minimum of 10 years).
benefits: Tangible Benefits: - Financial assistance for setting up a fish feed mill of 8 tons/day capacity. - Unit cost is ₹1,00,00,000/- per unit. - 40% subsidy of the project cost for General Category beneficiaries (up to ₹40,00,000/-). - 60% subsidy of the project cost for Weaker sections/ SC/ST/Women and their co-operatives of beneficiaries (up to ₹60,00,000/-).
summary: The scheme aims to promote fish feed self-sufficiency and affordability among fish farmers. Under this scheme, financial assistance is provided for setting up medium-sized fish feed mills with a production capacity of 8 tons per day, benefiting entrepreneurs and fish farmers.

title: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana: Medium Scale Ornamental Fish Rearing Unit (Fresh Water) - Haryana
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Haryana. 1. The applicant should possess a valid Parivar Pehchan Patra (Family ID). 1. The applicant should have at least 150 square meters of vacant land with adequate water supply. 1. The applicant should either own the land or possess a registered lease deed valid for at least 7 years.
benefits: Tangible Benefits: - Project Cost: ₹8,00,000/- per unit - Subsidy will be limited to 40% of the project cost for General Category applicant. - Subsidy will be limited to 60% of the project cost for Scheduled Caste (SC)/Women beneficiaries.
summary: Under this scheme, financial assistance in the form of a subsidy is provided to eligible beneficiaries for setting up infrastructure such as sheds, breeding units, and rearing and culture tanks for ornamental fish.

title: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana: Mini Fish Feed Mills of Production Capacity of 2 Ton /Day
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant/beneficiary should be a resident of Haryana. 1. The applicant should possess a valid Parivar Pehchan Patra (Family ID). 1. All operational, maintenance, and post-construction management costs of the infrastructure facilities shall be borne by the beneficiary. 1. The beneficiary should ensure that the Fish Feed Mill remains in functional condition. 1. The beneficiary should supply the feed produced from the government-assisted Fish Feed Mill/Plant to fishers and fish farmers at an affordable price. 1. The applicant should either own the land or have it on a registered lease agreement valid for a minimum of 10 years.
benefits: Tangible Benefits: - Project Cost: ₹30,00,000/- per unit - Subsidy will be limited to 40% of the project cost for General Category of beneficiaries. - Subsidy will be limited to 60% of the project cost for Weaker sections/ SC/ST/Women and their co-operatives of beneficiaries.
summary: Under this scheme, financial assistance, in form of subsidy, is provided to individuals for setting up mini feed mills, ensuring the local availability of quality fish feed at affordable prices for fishers and fish farmers.

title: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana: Motor Cycle with Ice Box - Haryana
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Haryana. 1. The applicant should have a Parivar Pehchan Patra. 1. The applicant should ensure that fish transport facilities are maintained in operational condition. 1. The applicant will be eligible for a subsidy for the purchase of only motorcycle with ice box. 1. The applicant should utilize the vehicle solely for fishery-related transportation activities. 1. The Government of India and the Government of Haryana will not be responsible for any loss incurred in the purchase, operation, maintenance, and management of fish transport facilities.
benefits: Financial Assistance provided under the scheme: - Project Cost: ₹75,000/- per unit - Subsidy will be limited to 40% of the project cost for the General Category of beneficiaries. - Subsidy will be limited to 60% of the project cost for Weaker sections/Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe/Women and their co-operatives of beneficiaries.
summary: The scheme aims to strengthen fish transportation infrastructure and ensure the freshness and quality of fish during transit. Under this scheme, financial assistance is provided to fishers for purchasing motorcycles equipped with ice boxes, ensuring efficient and hygienic fish transport.

title: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana: Refrigerated Vehicles – Haryana
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Haryana. 1. The applicant should have a Parivar Pehchan Patra. 1. The applicant should ensure that the refrigerated vehicle remains operational for fish transportation. 1. The applicant will be eligible for a subsidy for the purchase of only one refrigerated vehicle. 1. The applicant should utilize the refrigerated vehicle solely for fishery-related transportation activities. 1. The Government of India and the Government of Haryana will not be responsible for any loss incurred in the purchase, operation, maintenance, and management of fish transport facilities.
benefits: Financial Assistance provided under the scheme: - Project Cost: ₹25,00,000/- per unit - Subsidy will be limited to 40% of the project cost for the General Category of beneficiaries. - Subsidy will be limited to 60% of the project cost for Weaker sections/Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe/Women and their co-operatives of beneficiaries.
summary: The scheme aims to enhance cold chain infrastructure & ensure hygienic and efficient fish transportation. Under this scheme, financial assistance is provided to fishers for purchasing refrigerated vehicles to maintain the freshness & quality of fish during post-harvest handling & transportation.

title: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana: Three Wheeler with Ice Box Including E-rickshaws for Fish Vending - Haryana
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Haryana. 1. The applicant should have a Parivar Pehchan Patra. 1. The applicant should ensure that the fish transport facility (e-rickshaw) is maintained in working condition. 1. The applicant is eligible to purchase only one new three-wheeler e-rickshaw with an ice box for fisheries activities under this scheme. 1. The applicant should agree that neither the Central Government nor the State Government shall be held responsible for any financial or operational losses incurred in the procurement, operation, maintenance, or management of the fish transport facilities.
benefits: Tangible Benefits: - Project Cost: ₹3,00,000/- per unit (for purchasing a three-wheeler e-rickshaw equipped with an ice-box for selling fish.) - Subsidy will be limited to 40% of the project cost for the General Category of beneficiaries. - Subsidy will be limited to 60% of the project cost for Weaker sections/Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribe/Women and their co-operatives of beneficiaries.
summary: The scheme aims to promote hygienic and efficient fish transportation and retailing through mobile outlets. Under this scheme, financial assistance is provided to eligible beneficiaries for purchasing e-rickshaws equipped with ice boxes for selling fish directly.

title: Scheme for Conservation and Development of Indigenous Cattle and Murrah Development
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Haryana. 1. The applicant must be of the age of 18 - 55 years. 1. A Cow or Buffalo eligible to be recorded must be between 05 to 75 days of the date of its Calving as on date of application. 1. A maximum of two milch animals (two Cows or Two Buffaloes or One Cow and One Buffalo) per applicant/beneficiary would be eligible for the incentive money under this scheme. 1. The cows must be true to Hariana, Sahiwal, or Belahi breed and buffalo must be of Murrah Breed only. 1. Incentive for a particular animal could be provided only twice in its life span i.e. if the incentive is provided to a beneficiary for a particular animal twice, such beneficiary would stand debarred for receiving an incentive for that animal in its subsequent calving in the future. 1. The scheme is individual beneficiary-oriented. Note 01: A maximum of two milch animals per applicant will be eligible for the incentive money under this scheme. However, the recordings of more than two buffaloes/Cows of an applicant may be carried out for collecting data of the top quality Murrah buffaloes/Indigenous cattle (Hariana, Sahiwal, and Belahi). But incentive money would be provided only for two animals (in the highest slabs) of that applicant in a particular year. Note 02: In case an applicant lives at a place other than where the animals are kept or intended to be kept, than the jurisdiction area will be the place where animals are kept (Within state of Haryana only).
benefits: 1. Cash incentives at the following rates in different slabs would be provided to the owners of the recorded Murrah Buffaloes as below: Sl. No.Slabs of Lactation yield in Kg (Peak Yield in Kg)Incentive Money (₹)118 to 22 Kg₹15,000/-2&amp;gt;22 to 25 Kg₹20,000/-3Above 25 Kg₹30,000/-2. Cash incentives at the following rates in different slabs would be provided to the owners of the recorded Cows of different Indigenous breeds as below: (Hariana Cows) Sl. No.Slabs of peak Yield in KgIncentive Money (₹)18 to 10 Kg₹10,000/-2&amp;gt;10 to 12 Kg₹15,000/-3Above 12 Kg₹20,000/-3. Sahiwal Cows Sl. No.Slabs of peak Yield in KgIncentive Money (₹)110 to 12 Kg₹10,000/-2&amp;gt;12 to 15 Kg₹15,000/-3Above 15 Kg₹20,000/-4. Belahi Cows Sl. No.Slabs of peak Yield in KgIncentive Money (₹)15 to 8 Kg₹5,000/-2&amp;gt;8 to 10 Kg₹10,000/-3Above 10 Kg₹15,000/-In lieu of the cash incentive provided, the owner would be under obligation not to sell the recorded Indigenous Cow/Murrah Buffalo and its male progeny at least for one year. The beneficiary would be further bound to look after the male calf properly and the Department will have the first right to purchase it. In case, the beneficiary does not abide by the contract i.e. disposes of the identified Indigenous Cow/Murrah Buffalo and/or its male calf, he would not be eligible for the cash incentive. The owners of the recorded cows/buffaloes would be required to breed their animals through artificial insemination by the Government.
summary: The scheme is implemented by the Department of Animal Husbandry & Dairying, Government of Haryana with the objective of encouraging the farmers for conservation and development of the indigenous breeds of cows and buffaloes.

title: Scheme for Establishment of Backyard Poultry Units
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be of 18 to 55 years of age and a resident of Haryana. 1. There are no mandatory educational qualifications or training requirements. 1. Any applicant who has earlier availed benefits under any Departmental Scheme for the establishment of a livestock unit will not be eligible for availing benefits under the Scheme.
benefits: 1. 50 chicks, 10 day old reared at Government Hatchery along with two feeders and two water drinkers are provided free of cost to each beneficiary family at their doorstep.
summary: The objective of the scheme is to improve the socio-economic and nutritional status of the poor families, small farmers and landless agricultural labourers and other economically weaker section of the society.

title: Scheme for Establishment of Backyard Poultry Units under Mukhya Mantri Antyodaya Parivaar Utthan Yojana
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Haryana. 2. The applicant should be unemployed. 3. The applicant should be between 18 to 60 years old. 4. There are no mandatory educational qualifications or training requirements.
benefits: - 50 chicks, 10 day old reared at Government Hatchery along with two feeders and two water drinkers are provided free of cost to each beneficiary family at their doorstep.
summary: Under this scheme, 50 chicks of 10 days of age from the Government Hatchery Farm along with two feeders and two water drinkers are provided free of cost to each beneficiary family at their doorstep.

title: Scheme for Establishment of Hi-Tech and Mini Dairy Units
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be 18 to 55 years of age and a resident of Haryana. 1. The applicant must be unemployed (employment even in the private sector will bar an applicant from availing assistance under the Scheme). 1. There would be no mandatory educational qualifications or training requirements. 1. The applicant should have space/shed for keeping milch animals. 1. The applicant will have to submit a Self-Declaration for being unemployed and for undertaking to abide by other conditions as required under the Scheme. 1. The applicant applying for 20 and 50 animal dairy units must have 2-acre and 5-acre agricultural land for green fodder production respectively by way of ownership or long lease. 1. Any applicant who has earlier availed benefits under any Departmental Scheme for the establishment of livestock units will not be eligible for availing benefits under the Scheme. Note 1: Any applicant who has earlier availed the benefit of the Departmental Scheme for the establishment of a dairy unit below 20 milch animals that applicant will also be eligible for availing of benefit under the Scheme of Dairy unit of 20 and 50 mulch animals only. Note 2: In case an applicant lives at a place other than where the animals are kept or intended to be kept, than the jurisdiction area Government Veterinary Hospital will be the place where animals are kept or intended to be kept (Within state of Haryana only). Margin Money for 4 and 10 Milch Animal dairy Units only (25 % Subsidy): The beneficiary will have to arrange margin money, as per bank requirements, rest of the amount will have to be arranged as a loan from banks. Margin Money for 20 and 50 Milch Animal dairy Units only (Interest Subvention): The beneficiary will have to arrange margin money, which will be 25% of the Unit Cost ( Livestock Cost only) and the rest of the amount will have to be arranged as a loan from banks.
benefits: Financial Assistance for Interest Subvention under the Scheme: Dairy units of 4 and 10 milch animals: - 25% subsidy on the cost of milch animals can be availed as a loan for the purchase of these milch animals by the beneficiary for the establishment of dairy units of 4 and 10 milch animals; - The subsidy will be provided three months after the purchase/tagging of Milch animals or disbursement of Loan by the bank, whichever is later, and subject to verification of unit by the concerned veterinary surgeon. Dairy units of 20 and 50 milch animals: - Interest subvention on 75% cost of milch animals (25% being the margin money) can be availed as a loan for the purchase of these milch animals by the beneficiary for the establishment of dairy units of 20 and 50 milch animals; - The financial assistance will be provided in the form of interest subvention on loan amount financed by the bank (For Livestock Component only). - The maximum amount for which interest subvention will be provided is as follows:- Sl. No.Type of Dairy UnitMaximum Cost of Unit (Livestock component only) (in ₹)Max Limit of Loan amount as 75% of Total (for Interest Subvention) (in ₹)120 Milch Animals20 Lakhs15 Lakhs250 Milch Animals50 Lakhs37.50 LakhsNote: The Interest Subvention will be provided for the purchase of livestock components only and on the basis of the Maximum limit of the loan amount as shown in the above table or the loan amount financed by the Bank, whichever is lower. Financial Assistance for Insurance of Livestock Unit: - If any Livestock Insurance Scheme is operational by the Department or Haryana Livestock Development Board then the insurance of animals purchased for the establishment of unit is to be covered under that Scheme, wherever permissible. - However, if no Livestock Insurance Scheme is operational then the Beneficiary/Bank would have to arrange for the insurance of the animals at their own. The department would assist the beneficiaries in establishing these units in the following ways: - Sponsoring of loan applications to banks / financial institutions. - Purchase of animals, tagging, and issuance of Health certificates. - Providing Veterinary health and other facilities like free vaccination and management guidance etc. - Imparting 11 days of Dairy husbandry training at the concerned Sub Division I District Level in the State to the desirous persons.
summary: Under this scheme, unemployed persons will be assisted by way of providing financial assistance in form of subsidy for establishing dairy units of 4, 10, 20 & 50 milch animals like buffaloes, indigenous cows (Hariana, Sahiwal, Belahi, Red Sindhi, Tharparkar and Gir breeds only) and crossbred cows.

title: Scheme for Establishment of Hi-Tech and Mini Dairy Units under Mukhya Mantri Antyodaya Parivaar Utthan Yojana
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be of 18 to 60 years of age and a resident of Haryana. 1. The applicant must be unemployed. 1. There would be no mandatory educational qualifications or training requirements. 1. The applicant can apply for a dairy unit of 2 Milch animals only. 1. The applicant should have space/shed for keeping milch animals. 1. The applicant would have to submit a Self-Declaration for being unemployed and for undertaking to abide by other conditions as required under the Scheme.
benefits: Financial Assistance under the Scheme: Dairy units of 2 milch animals: - 25 % subsidy on the cost of milch animals which has been availed as a loan for the purchase of these milch animals by the beneficiary for the establishment of dairy units of 2 milch animals; Financial Assistance for Insurance under the Scheme: - Insurance assistance will be provided as per the available departmental scheme if operational during the year; otherwise, the beneficiaries will have to arrange for insurance of animals and shall pay the insurance premium.
summary: Under this scheme, a resident of Haryana who is between 18 and 60 years of age can avail a 25% subsidy on the cost of two milch animals. The subsidy can be availed as a loan for the purchase of these milch animals by the beneficiary for the establishment of dairy units with two milch animals.

title: Scheme for the Welfare of Schedule Caste Families in Fisheries Sector: Subsidy on 1st Year Lease Money
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Haryana. 1. The applicant should possess a valid Family ID Card (Parivar Pehchan Patra). 1. The applicant should belong to a Scheduled Caste category. 1. The applicant's age should be 18 years or above. 1. The pond lease period should not be less than 5 years. 1. The maximum area eligible for subsidy is 4 hectares per applicant. 1. The subsidy is applicable only on Panchayati ponds and government water sheds.
benefits: *Financial Assistance:* - 50% of the actual lease amount OR ₹50,000/- per hectare, whichever is less. - The subsidy is applicable for a maximum of 4 hectares per beneficiary.
summary: The objective of the scheme is to provide full-time employment to individuals from Scheduled Caste families in the fisheries sector and to uplift these families by promoting fish farming through financial assistance for leasing Panchayati ponds or watershed areas.

title: Scheme for the Welfare of Schedule Caste Families in Fisheries Sector: Subsidy on 2nd Year to 5th Year Lease Money
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Haryana. 1. The applicant should have a valid Family ID Card (Parivar Pehchan Patra). 1. The applicant should belong to a Scheduled Caste category. 1. The applicant's age should be 18 years or above. 1. Subsidy will be provided on lease money from 2nd to 5th year of lease. 1. The maximum area eligible for subsidy is 4 hectares per applicant. 1. The subsidy is applicable only on Panchayati ponds and government water sheds.
benefits: Financial Assistance: - 40% of the actual lease amount OR ₹40,000/- per hectare, whichever is less. - The subsidy is applicable for a maximum of 4 hectares per beneficiary. Note: Subsidy will be provided on lease money from 2nd to 5th year of lease.
summary: The objective of the scheme is to provide full-time employment to individuals from Scheduled Caste families in the fisheries sector and uplift their economic status by promoting fish farming through financial assistance for leasing Panchayati ponds or watershed areas.

title: Scheme for the Welfare of Schedule Caste Families in Fisheries Sector: Subsidy on Annual Auction of Notified Waters
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Haryana. 1. The applicant should possess a valid Family ID Card (Parivar Pehchan Patra). 1. The applicant should belong to a Scheduled Caste category. 1. The applicant's age should be 18 years or above.
benefits: - 50% subsidy of the actual auctioned amount with maximum limit of ₹5,00,000/- per auction, whichever is less.
summary: The objective of the scheme is to provide full-time employment to individuals from Scheduled Caste families in the fisheries sector and uplift their socio-economic status by promoting fish farming through subsidization of fishing contract costs in designated water bodies.

title: Solar Home System (Manohar Jyoti)
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Haryana. 1. The applicant should possess a valid Pariwar Pahichan Patra (PPP).
benefits: - Subsidy for General Category: A subsidy of ₹15,000/- per solar home system is provided to eligible families under the general category. - Subsidy under SCSP: A subsidy covering 90% of the cost is provided to Scheduled Caste families under SCSP component.
summary: The "Solar Home System (Manohar Jyoti)" by the Renewable Energy Department, Government of Haryana, aims to promote renewable energy adoption and ensure sustainable power access through solar solutions. Through this scheme, a subsidized solar home lighting system is provided to families.

title: Solar Inverter Charger
eligibility_details: 1. Any resident family of Haryana with Pariwar Pahichan Patra (PPP) to apply. 1. All the households who have domestic inverter and not installed solar inverter charger on his/her existing inverter. 1. Applicants who have not installed Solar Inverter Charger in past 5 years under the Department Scheme.
benefits: - For 320-watt Solar Inverter Charger System: A subsidy of ₹6,000/- is provided. - For 640-watt Solar Inverter Charger System: A subsidy of ₹10,000/- is provided.
summary: The "Solar Inverter Charger" by the Renewable Energy Department, Government of Haryana, aims to promote the use of renewable energy and reduce electricity dependence by providing a subsidy of ₹6,000/- or ₹10,000/- for solar inverter charger systems to eligible households.

title: Solar Water Heating System (Domestic Sector)
eligibility_details: 1. Any resident family of Haryana. 1. Government employees of Haryana residing in Chandigarh.
benefits: - Subsidy : ₹10,000/- per 100 LPD (Maximum ₹30,000/-) for FPC system and ₹3,000/- per 100 LPD (Maximum ₹9,000/-) is being provided.
summary: The scheme "Solar Water Heating System (Domestic Sector)" by the Renewable Energy Department, Haryana, aims to promote the use of solar energy for domestic water heating by providing a financial subsidy to the residents of Haryana and Haryana Government employees residing in Chandigarh.

title: Solar Water Pumping System
eligibility_details: 1. Any Haryana Resident family with Pariwar Pahichan Patra (PPP). 1. Farmers of Haryana with no electric agricultural connection in his/her name. 1. Water User Associations, Gaushalas, and community/cluster-based irrigation systems. 1. The beneficiaries who have not been covered under the solar pump scheme in past.
benefits: - Subsidy Amount: A 75% subsidy is provided on the cost of solar water pumps.
summary: The scheme "Solar Water Pumping System" by the Renewable Energy Department, Government of Haryana aims to encourage the adoption of renewable energy for irrigation. Through this scheme, solar water pumps are provided at a 75% subsidy to eligible farmers and institutions for irrigation need

title: Free Travelling Facility (HBOCWWB)
eligibility_details: 1. Applicants should be registered with the Haryana Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board. 1. Registered workers must have a minimum of two year’s regular membership. 1. Workers must have an active membership with the Board. 1. Registered construction workers, along with four family members, are eligible to avail benefits under the scheme on a visit to religious or historical places once every four years. 1. The duration of visiting religious and historical places should not exceed 10 days.
benefits: 1. Under this scheme, free travelling facility is provided to the registered construction workers along with 4 family members to visit religious/historical places once in four years. 1. The actual fare incurred by the beneficiary is paid at the rates prescribed by Haryana Roadways (ordinary fare) or actual railway fare (Second Class).
summary: Under this scheme, the amount spent by registered workers and 4 family members for visiting famous religious/historical places once in four years will be paid at the rates prescribed by Haryana Roadways (ordinary fare) or actual railway fare (Second Class).

title: Haryana Provision of Sports Equipment Scheme
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a Municipal Body/Gram Panchayat of Haryana. 1. Field of Play (FOP) should be available in the town/village for the expected play.

(18-piece Mats) with cover.JudoMats size length 1 meter x width 2 meters &amp; thickness 5 cm. summary: "Haryana Provision of Sports Equipment Scheme" by the Sports Dept, Government of Haryana provides sports equipment to Gram Panchayats and Municipal bodies to encourage youngsters in the state towards sports such as Volleyball, Football, Basketball, Handball, Boxing, Wrestling, Judo, Cricket, etc.

title: Laghu Vyavassay Scheme
ministry: Welfare of Scheduled Caste & Backward Classes Department
eligibility_details: - The applicant should be a permanent resident of Haryana. - The applicant should be from a Scheduled Caste. - The applicant should be in the age group of 18 to 45 years. - The income ceiling is atleast 50% of the beneficiaries having annual family income upto ₹1,50,000/- and balance 50% of the beneficiaries having annual family income upto ₹3,00,000/-.
benefits: - Loan for various economic development schemes having unit cost up to ₹2,00,000/-. - Margin Money at 10% of the project cost. - Subsidy at 50% of the total project cost, subject to a maximum of ₹10,000/-.
summary: "Laghu Vyavassay Scheme" is an economic empowerment scheme by the Haryana Scheduled Castes Finance and Development Corporation, Govt of Haryana. In this scheme, loans are provided to individuals from Scheduled Castes for self-employment/ income-generating activities.

title: Mahila Kisan Yojana
ministry: Welfare of Scheduled Caste & Backward Classes Department
eligibility_details: - The applicant should be a female. - The applicant should be a permanent resident of Haryana. - The applicant should be from a 'Scheduled Caste'. - The applicant's annual family income should not exceed the Below Poverty Line (BPL). - The applicant's name should be present in the BPL survey list. - The income ceiling is at least 50% of the beneficiaries having annual family income upto ₹1,50,000/- and balance 50% of the beneficiaries having annual family income upto ₹3,00,000/-.
benefits: - Loan for various economic development schemes having unit cost up to ₹50,000/-. - Margin Money at 10% of the project cost. - Subsidy at 50% of the total project cost (max. ₹10,000/-).
summary: The scheme "Mahila Kisan Yojana" is an economic empowerment scheme by the Scheduled Castes Finance and Development Corporation, Government of Haryana. Through this scheme, loans are provided to the women from Scheduled Castes for the betterment of their economic status through self-employment.

title: Mukhyamantri Tirth Yatra Yojana
ministry: Information, Public Relations and Languages Department
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a bonafide resident of Haryana. 1. The applicant should possess a Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP ID). 1. The applicant should have completed 60 years of age (as on 1st January of the year in which the application is made for availing the scheme). Relaxation in age may be given to the spouse accompanying the applicant. 1. The applicant can avail the benefit of the scheme once every three years. 1. Family Income of the applicant from all known sources should be upto ₹1,80,000/- per annum as verified by PPP. 1. The attendant should be a bonafide resident of Haryana with Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP ID).
benefits: 1. Under this scheme, the facility is provided to senior citizens who wish to visit religious destinations such as Ayodhya, Varanasi, Nanded Sahib, Patna Sahib, Ajmer Sharif, and other such destinations in India. 1. The Scheme also ensures that constraints of travel and local arrangements do not hinder senior citizens from undertaking the journey. 1. The Government shall bear the cost of Rail travel (to and fro) in 3rd tier AC to destinations such as Ayodhya, Varanasi, Nanded Sahib, Patna Sahib, Ajmer Sharif, and other such destinations in India. 1. The Government shall also bear the cost of transport from the place of residence to the Start of Train journey station at normative rates fixed by the Government. This cost shall be reimbursed to the applicant after the confirmation of completion of journey in the bank account of applicant linked with PPP ID. 1. Facility of an attendant to accompany the applicant may be availed by the applicant of age more than 80 years on payment of 50% of railway ticket fare charges either through online payment or by deposit of cash at nearby Antyodaya Saral Kendra.
summary: Under this scheme, members of families with an annual income of less than ₹1.80 lakhs who are over 60 years of age will be taken for pilgrimages to Ayodhya, Varanasi, and other sacred places. The state government will bear all the expenses for their travel.

title: Quality Certification Assistance Scheme
eligibility_details: 1. The unit should not have been placed in the restrictive list as notified by the State government from time to time. 1. The unit should have obtained NOC/CLU from competent Authority if applicable. 1. The unit should be in commercial production. 1. The unit should be in regular production at the time of disbursement and the subsidy shall not be released to the closed unit.
benefits: The scheme offers 75% reimbursement of the cost, up to a maximum of ₹1,00,000/- for certifications approved by the Quality Council of India. These include ISO, HACCP, BSI, WHO-GMP, ZED, TS, and Hallmark certifications. The financial assistance is over and above the support already provided by the Government of India.
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance to Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) in Haryana for obtaining quality certifications such as ISO, HACCP, BSI, WHO-GMP, ZED, TS, and Hallmark. It aims to promote quality standards and enhance competitiveness among MSMEs.

title: Shilpi Samridhi Yojana
ministry: Welfare of Scheduled Caste & Backward Classes Department
eligibility_details: - The applicant should be a permanent resident of Haryana. - The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste category. - The applicant's annual family income should not exceed ₹3,00,000/-. - The applicant should be in the age group of 18 to 45 years. - The applicant should have adequate knowledge and experience of the scheme. - The applicant should not have misused the previous loan obtained from the Corporation. - The applicant should not have any other similar unit. - The applicant should not be a defaulter of the Corporation/banks.
benefits: - Loan for various economic development schemes having unit cost up to ₹50,000/-. - Margin Money at 10% of the project cost. - Subsidy at 50% of the total project cost, subject to a maximum of ₹10,000/-.
summary: "Shilpi Samridhi Yojana" is an economic empowerment scheme by the Haryana Scheduled Castes Finance and Development Corporation, Govt of Haryana. Through this scheme, loans/benefits are provided to the families of the scheduled caste artisans to pursue various economic development activities.

title: Varanasi and Amritsar Yatra Scheme
ministry: Welfare of Scheduled Caste & Backward Classes Department
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Haryana. 1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste. 1. This facility will be given one time only.
benefits: - Reimbursement of ₹1,000/- or the actual cost of a second-class train ticket (to and fro) per person, whichever is less, will be provided. Note: This facility will be given one time only. Expected Time of Disbursement: Reimbursement will be made after the journey on the submission of railway tickets. Mode of Disbursement: Payment will be made directly into the bank account of the beneficiary.
summary: This scheme aims to facilitate pilgrimages to Varanasi and Amritsar for individuals belonging to the Scheduled Castes category. The scheme provides financial reimbursement for second-class train travel, enabling eligible beneficiaries to undertake these religious journeys with ease.

title: Centrally Sponsored Scheme of Post-Matric Scholarship for OBC, EBC and DNT Students for studying in India
eligibility_details: - The applicant should be from Other Backward Classes (OBC) / Economically Backward Classes (EBC) or from Denotified, Nomadic, and Semi-Nomadic Tribes (DNT). - The applicant should be studying at the post-matriculation or post-secondary stage of education. - The applicant should be permanently settled in the State/UT where they are applying. - The applicant should be studying in an institution recognized by the All India Survey on Higher Education (AISHE) or Unified District Information System for Education (UDISE). - The applicant's institution should have National Assessment and Accreditation Council (NAAC) or National Board of Accreditation (NBA) accreditation. - The applicant should maintain Aadhaar-based attendance in the institution. - The applicant must have a valid "Freeship Card" issued by the State/District Authority. Preference/Priority/Reservation/Relaxation: A maximum of 20 slots per annum are reserved for Commercial Pilot License courses, including helicopter and multi-engine training.
benefits: Components of the Scholarship - Maintenance allowance for the complete duration of the course. - Reimbursement of compulsory non-refundable fees. - Study tour charges (if applicable). - Thesis typing/printing charges (for research scholars). - Book allowance for students pursuing correspondence courses. - Additional allowances for students with disabilities. The scholarship covers tuition fees, maintenance allowances, and other academic expenses.

title: Consolidated Stipend Scheme for Scheduled Caste Students Pursuing Higher Education
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste (SC) category. 1. The applicant should be a domicile of Haryana. 1. The applicant should be studying in a government college in Haryana. 1. The applicant should have passed the previous academic year examination. 1. The applicant should maintain at least 60% attendance to receive the stipend.
benefits: 1. Stipend Amount: Eligible SC students receive ₹1,000/- per month.1. Hostel Stipend: Additional ₹500/- per month for 12 months for students availing hostel facilities. Mode of Disbursement: 1. The stipend is disbursed bi-monthly in September, November, January, and March. 1. The amount for January to June is disbursed in March due to the financial year closure. 1. Payments are transferred directly to students' Aadhaar-seeded bank accounts through the Public Financial Management System (PFMS). Frequency of Disbursement: 1. Stipend: Four bimonthly instalments per year.1. Hostel Stipend: Two half-yearly instalments (July-December, January-June). Expected Time of Disbursement: 1. Stipend: First week of the disbursement month (September, November, January, March).1. Hostel Stipend: November and January.
summary: The scheme was launched by the Department of Higher Education, Government of Haryana, on 1st July, 2008, with the aim of attracting SC students towards higher education. Under this scheme, SC students studying in Govt. Colleges will receive a stipend of ₹1,000 per month.

title: e-Adhigam Scheme - Free Tablet
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a student of a government school in Haryana. 1. The applicant must be studying in Class 8, 9, 10, 11, or 12. 1. The applicant must be part of the phased distribution plan as per the Haryana Government’s rollout strategy. 1. Class 11 students will receive tablets only after clearing the Class 10 board exams.
benefits: Tangible Benefits: 1. Free Android Tablets – Provided to students in Classes 8 to 12.1. Pre-loaded Content – Tablets come with pre-loaded educational content, personalized adaptive learning (PAL) platform, and study materials.1. 2GB Free Data Per Month – Enables students to access online study resources. Mode of Disbursement: - Tablets are distributed in government schools under the Haryana Free Tablet Scheme. Frequency of Disbursement: - Tablets are distributed once to eligible students. - Free 2GB of data is provided every month. Validity of Benefits: - The tablets remain the property of the Haryana Government. - Students must return the tablets after completing Class 12.
summary: This scheme was launched with objective of promoting digital education & providing online learning to children from poor & needy families, proving to be a boon for them. Under this scheme, free tablets are provided to students, enabling access to state-of-the-art software & learning materials.

title: Education Loan for Persons with Disabilities- Haryana
ministry: Welfare of Scheduled Caste & Backward Classes Department
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Haryana State. 1. The applicant should have a disability of more than 40%. 1. The applicant's age should be between 18 and 55 years. For persons with mental retardation, the eligible age is above 14 years. An age certificate issued by a competent authority authorized by the State Government, or as mentioned in the 10th certificate or any other government-issued certificate, will be required document. 1. The applicant should have secured admission to a professional or technical course in India or abroad. 1. Unique Disability ID (UDID) registration under the Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities (DEPwD), Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India, is mandatory for loan amounts of ₹15 lakhs and above. 1. The applicant must have a Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP ID).
benefits: Under this scheme, education loans of up to ₹50 lakhs are provided to persons with disabilities (OH/VH/HH/MR) for pursuing professional and technical education both in India and abroad.
summary: Under this scheme, education loans of up to ₹50 lakhs are provided to persons with disabilities (OH/VH/HH/MR) for pursuing professional and technical education both in India and abroad.

title: Education Loan Scheme under NSFDC- Haryana
ministry: Welfare of Scheduled Caste & Backward Classes Department
category: Banking,Financial Services and Insurance, Education & Learning
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Haryana. 1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste Community. 1. The applicant's age should be between 18 and 45 years. 1. The applicant's annual family income should not exceed ₹3,00,000/-. 1. These loans are available to students pursuing regular full-time recognized professional/technical courses in India or abroad. 1. The education loan for a particular student shall be made admissible only once either at Diploma/Graduation or Post Graduation Diploma/Post Graduation level. However, an Educational Loan shall be offered to a student who secures admission in any integrated course of a longer duration covering both levels. Note 1: 50% of the beneficiaries having annual family income up to ₹1,50,000/- and balance 50% of the beneficiaries have annual family income above ₹1,50,000/- and upto ₹3,00,000/-. Note 2: NSFDC`s Educational Loan shall also be admissible for students of the target group who have secured admission to technical /professional courses prior to 1.12.2009 subject to the condition that they have not availed Educational Loan from any other institution.
benefits: Maximum Loan Limit: - For studies within India: Up to ₹10,00,000/- - For studies abroad: Up to ₹30,00,000/- Recovery: - Recovery (Principal & Interest) will commence after 6 months of completion of the course or getting employment, whichever is earlier. The loan will be repaid in 20 quarterly installments in 5 years from the date of first disbursement. - There would be a tag/maker on the Diploma/Degree of the student indicating his repayment liabilities. Note: The Educational Loan, shall, however, be restricted to cover the admissible expenses for the remaining years of study on a pro-rate basis. Further, all Educational Loans shall be sanctioned & disbursed on a case-to-case basis.
summary: This scheme offers educational loans of up to ₹10 lakhs for studies within India and up to ₹30 lakhs for studies abroad. These loans are available to eligible students pursuing regular full-time recognized courses in India or abroad.

title: Education Loan Scheme under NSKFDC- Haryana
ministry: Welfare of Scheduled Caste & Backward Classes Department
category: Banking,Financial Services and Insurance, Education & Learning
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Haryana. 1. The applicant's age should be between 18 and 55 years. 1. There is no income limit. 1. The applicant should be Safai Karamchari or his/her dependent. 1. The loan shall be provided to students for pursuing regular full time recognized professional/technical courses in India or abroad. 1. The Education loan for a particular student shall be made admissible only once either at Diploma/Graduation or Post Graduation Diploma/Post Graduation level. However, an Educational Loan shall be offered to a student who secures admission in any integrated course of a longer duration covering both levels. Note 1: Permanent Safai Karamchari means a person engaged in, or employed for any sanitation work and includes his dependents. Note 2: The applicant shall have to produce a Certificate of Safai karamchari or dependent of Safai karamchari from the head of the Government Departments (i.e. school, colleges, forest, health, education, animal husbandry having rank not less than Gazetted officer), elected members of municipal Body/corporation and pradhan of Gram panchayats, local revenue officer or the cantonment or an officer of the Railways not below the rank of gazette officer. Note 3: NSFDC`s Educational Loan shall also be admissible for students of the target group who have secured admission to technical /professional courses prior to 01.12.2009 subject to the condition that they have not availed Educational Loan from any other institution.
benefits: Maximum Loan Limit: - For studies within India: Up to ₹10,00,000/- - For studies abroad: Up to ₹20,00,000/- Recovery: - Recovery (Principal & Interest) will commence after 6 months of completion of the course or getting employment, whichever is earlier. The loan will be repaid in 20 quarterly installments in 5 years from the date of first disbursement. - There would be a tag/maker on the Diploma/Degree of the student indicating his repayment liabilities. Note: The Educational Loan, shall, however, be restricted to cover the admissible expenses for the remaining years of study on a pro-rata basis. Further, all Educational Loans shall be sanctioned & disbursed on a case-to-case basis.
summary: This scheme offers educational loans of up to ₹10 lakhs for studies within India and up to ₹20 lakhs for studies abroad. These loans are available to eligible students pursuing regular full-time recognized professional/technical courses in India or abroad.

title: Education Loan Scheme- Credit Line 1 for Minority Community
ministry: Welfare of Scheduled Caste & Backward Classes Department
category: Banking,Financial Services and Insurance, Education & Learning
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Haryana. 1. The applicant should be between 16 and 32 years old. 1. The annual family income of the applicant should not exceed ₹98,000/- (Rural Area) and ₹1,20,000/- (Urban Area). 1. The applicant should belong to a minority community, i.e. Muslims, Sikhs, Christians, Buddhists, Parsis, and Jains. 1. The applicant should have obtained admission to any professional and technical course approved by an appropriate agency such as AICTE, Medical Council of India, UGC, etc., in a duly accredited/recognized institute. 1. The applicant must have secured a minimum of 50% marks in the qualifying exam i.e., the exam whose qualification is a pre-requisite for the course. 1. The applicant should have a Parivaar Pehchan Patra (PPP ID).
benefits: 1. Under this scheme, Nigam provides loans up to ₹20,00,000/- for studies in India and up to ₹30,00,000/- for studies abroad at an interest rate of 3%. 1. The education loans are provided for pursuing general/professional/technical courses or training at the graduate and/or higher level to minority communities i.e. Muslims, Sikhs, Christians, Buddhists, Parsis, and Jains.
summary: The scheme, implemented by the Haryana Backward Classes and Economically Weaker Sections Kalyan Nigam, provides education loans for pursuing general, professional, and technical courses or training at the graduate and higher levels to minority communities as notified by the Government of India.

title: Education Loan Scheme- Credit Line 2 for Minority Community
ministry: Welfare of Scheduled Caste & Backward Classes Department
category: Banking,Financial Services and Insurance, Education & Learning
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Haryana. 1. The age of the applicant should be between 16 and 32 years. 1. The annual family income of the applicant should be between ₹98,001/- to ₹8,00,000/- (Rural Area) and ₹1,20,001 to ₹8,00,000/- (Urban Area). 1. The applicant should belong to a minority community, i.e., Muslims, Sikhs, Christians, Buddhists, Parsis, and Jains. 1. The applicant should have obtained admission to any professional and technical course approved by an appropriate agency such as AICTE, Medical Council of India, UGC, etc., in a duly accredited/recognized institute. 1. The applicant must have secured a minimum of 50% marks in the qualifying exam i.e., the exam whose qualification is a pre-requisite for the course. 1. The applicant should have a Parivaar Pehchan Patra (PPP ID).
benefits: 1. Under this scheme, Nigam provides loans of up to ₹20,00,000/- for professional degree courses in India and up to ₹30,00,000/- for courses abroad, with an interest rate of 8% for males and 5% for females. 1. The education loans are provided for pursuing general/professional/ technical courses or training at the graduate and/or higher level to minority communities i.e. Muslims, Sikhs, Christians, Buddhists, Parsis, and Jains.
summary: The scheme is implemented by Haryana Backward Classes & Economically Weaker Sections Kalyan Nigam, aims to provide education loans to sections of minority population on the basis of "Creamy Layer". These loans support pursuing general/professional/technical courses at graduate levels or higher.

title: Financial Assistance for Coaching Classes (HBOCWWB)
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be engaged in building or construction work. 1. The applicant should be registered with the Haryana Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board. 1. The registered worker must have a minimum of one year’s regular membership. 1. The worker must have an active membership with the Board. 1. The son/daughter of the worker should be receiving coaching for admission in professional/technical courses from an institute. 1. The worker should not have applied again for financial assistance for the coaching of his/her child. The assistance will be provided only once. 1. The spouse of the worker should not have received any financial assistance for coaching classes of his/her child from any government department/board/corporate institution, nor should they have applied for such assistance. 1. Financial assistance for coaching will be given up to three children.
benefits: 1. Financial assistance of ₹20,000/- is provided for coaching classes for admission of children of registered workers in professional/technical courses like Degree/Diploma in Medical, Engineering, Management, MCA, Law, Fashion Designing, etc. 1. Upon passing the Preliminary Examination of UPSC/HPSSC, individuals are eligible for ₹1,00,000/- to prepare for the Main Examination.
summary: The scheme provides financial assistance of ₹20,000/- for coaching classes for admission of children of registered workers in professional/technical courses and ₹1,00,000/- for preparation of Main Examination on passing Preliminary Examination of UPSC/HPSSC.

title: Financial Assistance for Coaching- Haryana Labour Welfare Board
occupation_requirement: Student / Researcher / Artisan / Vendor / Worker / Startup / Business Owner
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be employed in an industrial or commercial establishment in Haryana. 1. The applicant should be registered with the Haryana Labour Welfare Board. 1. The applicant's monthly salary must not exceed ₹25,000/-. 1. The applicant must have a minimum of one year of service. 1. Benefits are provided to children of registered workers who are receiving coaching for entrance examinations in professional courses, as well as for those preparing for the main examination after passing the preliminary examination of UPSC and HPSC. 1. The child/candidate should have scored at least 60% marks in the qualifying examination. 1. The benefits of this scheme are available to three girls and two boys of the workers. 1. The child of the worker will not be covered under this scheme if he/she is self-employed or employed. 1. If a worker's child is receiving a scholarship from the Haryana Labour Welfare Board, he/she can also avail the benefits of this scheme. Conditions prescribed for coaching institutes regarding the coaching being taken by students: - The coaching institute must have been providing coaching for at least three years. - The institute should have provided coaching to a minimum of 300 students. - The institute should have been paying service tax (GST) to the government for running coaching classes or a coaching institute for at least three years. - The institute should have paid the Labour Welfare Fund due to the Board and must be registered under the Shop & Commercial Establishment Act, 1958.
benefits: 1. An amount of ₹20,000/- or 75% of the coaching fee (whichever is less) will be payable to the children of workers for coaching in entrance examinations in professional courses. 1. An amount of ₹1,00,000/- will be provided to the children of workers for coaching to prepare for the main examination on passing the Preliminary Examination of UPSC and HPSC.
summary: The objective of the scheme to provide financial assistance up to ₹20,000/- for coaching of entrance examinations for professional courses and ₹1,00,000/- to the children of workers for preparing for the main examination on passing the preliminary examination of UPSC and HPSC.

title: Financial Assistance For Education Of Children Of Registered Worker (HBOCWWB)
occupation_requirement: Student / Researcher / Artisan / Vendor / Worker / Startup / Business Owner
eligibility_details: 1. The worker should be registered under Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HBOCWWB). 1. The registered worker should have a minimum of one-year regular membership. 1. The children of registered workers studying in Class-I to Postgraduate are eligible to apply under the scheme. 1. Only those students who are studying in any institution/school/college of Haryana state will be eligible for this financial assistance. 1. The students who are self-employed or employed will not be eligible for benefits under this scheme. Note 01: Financial assistance will not be given again for the same class in case of failure of the student. Note 02: It is mandatory to upload the certificate issued by the head of the school/institution that the student is continuing regular studies in the school/institution. Note 03: The financial assistance for pursuing professional courses shall be paid directly to the Government Institutions except for the reimbursement of admission fees. Note 04: The claim application of the students studying in private institutions shall be verified by any one of the officers i.e. Deputy Labour Commissioners, Assistant Labour Commissioner, Tehsildars, Naib Tehsildars DEEOs, DEOs, BEEOs, and BEOs. Note 05: The financial assistance for education will be given up to three children only i.e. three female or two male children.

1. The class-wise amount given under the scheme is as follows: Sl. summary: The scheme “Financial Assistance for Education of Children of Registered Worker (HBOCWWB)” was launched by the Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HBOCWWB), Labour Department Haryana.

title: Financial Assistance for Education- Haryana Silicosis Board
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant/worker should be employed in a factory or at a construction site. 1. The worker who is suffering from silicosis as confirmed by the Silicosis Diagnosis Board, Haryana are eligible to apply under this scheme for their children. 1. The worker should be registered with the Haryana Silicosis Board. 1. The children of workers should be studying in a class ranging from Class I to Master’s Degree. 1. Assistance will be available for up to two boys and up to three girls of affected workers, regardless of the order of birth of the children.
benefits: 1. Under this scheme, financial assistance for education will be given to the children of workers at the following rates: Sl. No.Class/CourseAmount of Assistance (Per year)1Class 1-5₹5,000/-2Class 6-8₹6,000/-3Class 9-10₹8,000/-4Class 11-12 ₹10,000/-5ITI Diploma/Graduation/Post-Graduation₹12,000/-
summary: Under this scheme, financial assistance of ₹5,000/- to ₹12,000/- per year is given to the children of workers who are suffering from silicosis as confirmed by the Silicosis Diagnosis Board, Haryana.

title: Financial Assistance for Professional/Technical Courses (HBOCWWB)
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant/worker should be engaged in building or construction work. 1. The applicant/worker should be registered with the Haryana Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board. 1. The registered worker should have a minimum of one year of regular membership. 1. The worker should have an active membership with the Board. 1. The children of registered workers who are pursuing regular technical/professional courses are eligible for benefits under this scheme. 1. Financial assistance for education will be available for up to three children per worker.
benefits: Under this scheme, the full educational expenses of the children of registered workers in professional/technical courses are reimbursed by the Board in the following manner: Sl. No.Professional/Technical CoursesAmount to be paid1Degree/Diploma viz. Medicine, Engineering, Management, MCA, Law, Fashion Designing, etc. in all Government/Private Institutions/ Colleges/Universities etc. The board will bear all the educational expenses of the students studying in government institutions i.e. admission fees, tuition fees, examination fees, etc. In addition, the board will also bear all educational expenses of students studying in private institutions equal to the educational expenses charged by the state government institutions having the highest fee structure in that stream.Note: The financial assistance will be given directly to the Government/Government-recognized Private Institute/ College/ University/ IIT/IIM /AIIMS etc. and the reimbursement of the admission expenses will be given to the candidate on the production of the attested copy of the original receipt.
summary: This scheme is implemented by the Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, Labour Department Haryana. Under this scheme, the full educational expenses of the children of registered workers in professional/technical courses are reimbursed by the Board.

title: Financial Assistance for Purchasing School Uniforms, Books and Notebooks from Class 1st to 12th for Children of Workers- Haryana Labour Welfare Board
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be employed in an industrial or commercial establishment in Haryana. 1. The worker should be registered with the Haryana Labour Welfare Board. 1. The monthly salary of the worker should not exceed ₹25,000/-. 1. The service period of the workers is fixed for two years. 1. The worker's children studying in Class I to Class XII are eligible for the scheme's benefits at the time of admission to continue their studies. 1. The scheme benefits are available to three girls and two boys per worker. 1. The name of the child/children should be mentioned on the Ration Card/ESI Card of the worker. Note 01: The last date for submission of applications in the respective sessions has been fixed as 31st December. Applications submitted after 31st December will not be considered. Note 02: The benefit of the scheme will be made available to the girls as well as boys of the worker.
benefits: Under this scheme, the following amounts of assistance are provided: Sl. No.ClassAmount of Financial Assistance1On Continuing Studies from Class I to Class IV₹3,000/- 2On Continuing Studies from Class V to Class XII₹4,000/-
summary: Under this scheme, one-time financial assistance is provided to the children (2 boys & 3 girls) of workers employed in industrial and commercial establishments of the state of Haryana at the time of admission to continue their studies.

title: Financial Assistance Scheme For Higher Competitive/ Entrance Examination To Scheduled Castes/ Backward Classes Students
ministry: Welfare of Scheduled Caste & Backward Classes Department
eligibility_details: Eligibility of students: 1. The student should be a domicile of Haryana & must belong to a Scheduled caste/Backward Class. 1. The annual Income of the parents/guardians Should not exceed ₹2.50 lacs. 1. The candidate should possess all the requisite qualifications required for the examination. 1. The candidate will not be permitted to avail of more than two chances for a particular competitive examination. Note 01: The selected candidates shall have to attend all classes. In the event of any student remaining absent for more than 5 days at a time maximum of 15 days during the entire course without any valid reason, benefits of free coaching to him/her shall be discontinued and another candidate shall be taken in his/her place. Note 02: Depending on the budget allocation, the total number of students should be fixed in advance and distributed among the agencies; it should not be left open-ended. Note 03: This scheme will be applicable and available for only those courses which are not covered by any other Scheme for Scheduled Castes and Backward Classes run by other departments. Selection of reputed institutions: 1. The Director, Welfare of Scheduled Castes and Backward Classes Department, Haryana will invite proposals from the implementing agencies directly every year. 1. The proposals received from the implementing agencies will be considered and finalized by a committee consisting of the following: - Chairman: Secretary to Govt. Haryana, Welfare of Scheduled Castes And Backward Classes Department. - Member-Secretary: Director, Welfare of Welfare of Scheduled Castes and Backward Classes Department, Haryana - Member: Deputy Director, Welfare of Scheduled Castes & Backward Classes Department, Haryana - Member: District Welfare Officer (concerned District)
benefits: 1. Under the scheme, the Scheduled Castes & Backward Classes candidates will be entitled to free coaching for IAS and other higher services competitive examinations. 1. The Scheduled Castes and Backward Classes candidates can avail of postal/classroom coaching for civil services Examinations like IFS, IAS & Allied Services, and any other services examinations conducted by the UPSC/HPSC/LIC/GIC/ RRB/ BRB, etc., and any other recruiting agency of State and Central Govt. in various private professional institutions. 1. The personal, postal coaching for pre- Entrance examination will also be provided in PMT/PET, and any other coaching for interviews will also be got provided from private institutions. 1. Benefit under the scheme can be availed by a particular candidate two times, irrespective of the number of chances he/she may be entitled to in a particular competitive examination.
summary: The scheme “Financial Assistance Scheme for Higher Competitive/ Entrance Examination to Scheduled Castes/ Backward Classes Students” was launched by the Department of Welfare of Scheduled Castes & Backward Classes, Government of Haryana.

title: Free Books Scheme for Scheduled Caste Students Pursuing Higher Education
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste (SC) category. 1. The applicant should be a domicile of Haryana. 1. The applicant should be studying in a government college in Haryana. 1. The applicant should be pursuing higher education.
benefits: Eligible students will receive ₹2,000/- per year for purchasing books.
summary: The scheme was launched by the Department of Higher Education, Govt. of Haryana, on 1st July, 2008, with the aim of attracting SC students towards higher education. Under this scheme, SC students studying in govt. colleges will receive ₹2,000/- per annum for purchasing books.

title: Free Passport Scheme
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Haryana. 1. The applicant should be a final-year student in a UG or PG course in a government college. 1. The applicant should not possess an existing passport. Note: The application procedure and processing time for getting passport are the same as for a regular passport.
benefits: - Reimbursement of passport application fee of ₹1,500/- to eligible students. Mode of Disbursement: The reimbursement is provided through the respective college where the student is enrolled.
summary: The scheme aims to facilitate higher education and global career opportunities for students by covering the cost of passport issuance. Under this scheme, final-year UG and PG students in government colleges receive reimbursement for passport application fees.

title: Haryana Merit Cum Means Scheme For Minority
eligibility_details: General Eligibility: - The applicant should belong to a notified minority community (Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Jain, or Parsi). - The applicant must be a resident of Haryana, irrespective of the place of study. - The applicant should have secured admission to a professional or technical course in a recognized institution. - The applicant should have scored at least 50% marks in the previous qualifying examination. Income Criteria: - The annual family income should not exceed ₹2,50,000/- from all sources. Preference and Reservation: - 30% of scholarships are reserved for girl students, transferable to male students if no eligible girl candidates are available.
benefits: Financial Assistance: - For Hostellers: ₹30,000/- per annum, including ₹10,000/- as maintenance allowance and up to ₹20,000/- as course fees. - For Day Scholars: ₹25,000/- per annum, including ₹5,000/- as maintenance allowance and up to ₹20,000/- as course fees. - Full course fees are reimbursed for the listed institutions. Conditions Associated with Benefits: - The annual family income of the applicant must not exceed ₹2,50,000/- from all sources. - Scholarships are awarded directly to the student’s bank account. Mode of Disbursement: - Funds are transferred via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to the student's bank account. Frequency of Disbursement: - Disbursed annually upon approval of the application. Validity: - Applicable only for the duration of the course, subject to yearly renewal based on academic performance.
summary: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to meritorious students from minority communities in Haryana for pursuing professional and technical courses.

title: Haryana Post Matric Scholarship For Minority
eligibility_details:
1. The applicant should belong to the Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Jain, or Zoroastrian (Parsi) community. 1. The applicant should have secured a minimum of 50% marks in the previous final examination. 1. The applicant's family annual income should not exceed ₹2,00,000/- from all sources. 1. The applicant should be a regular student in a government or private higher secondary school/college/university. 1. The applicant should not be availing of any other scholarship for the same purpose.
Preferences: - Priority to students from BPL families. - 30% of scholarships are earmarked for girl students.
benefits: 1. Admission and Tuition Fee: - Classes 11 and 12: Up to ₹7,000/- per annum - Technical/Vocational Courses (11 and 12): Up to ₹10,000/- per annum - Undergraduate/Postgraduate: Up to ₹3,000/- per annum 2. Monthly Maintenance Allowance (for 10 months): 1. Classes 11 and 12 (including technical courses): - Hostellers: ₹380/- per month - Day Scholars: ₹230/- per month 2. Undergraduate/Postgraduate (non-technical): - Hostellers: ₹570/- per month - Day Scholars: ₹300/- per month 3. M.Phil and Ph.D.: - Hostellers: ₹1,200/- per month - Day Scholars: ₹550/- per month
summary: Launched in June 2006 under the Prime Minister's New 15 Point Programme for the Welfare of Minorities, the "Post-Matric Scholarship for Students Belonging to the Minority Communities" by the Ministry of Minority Affairs, Government of India, aims to provide better opportunities for higher education.

title: Haryana State Merit Scholarship Scheme
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a citizen of India and a domiciled resident of Haryana. 1. The applicant must have passed the qualifying examination from Punjab, Kurukshetra University, or any other recognized examining body. 1. The applicant must be enrolled in a recognized course in a higher education institution in Haryana or Chandigarh. 1. The applicant must have obtained at least a Second Division in the qualifying examination. 1. For Rural Area Merit Scholarships, the applicant must have secured at least 40% marks in Matric/Higher Secondary (Final)/Pre-University Examinations. 1. The applicant must not be receiving any other merit-based scholarship, except for need-based scholarships from specific welfare boards. Note: Preference/Priority/Reservation/Relaxation: 1. One Ph.D./M.Phil. scholarship is exclusively tenable at Jawaharlal Nehru University, New Delhi. 1. Rural Area Merit Scholarships are limited to students whose parents permanently reside and earn their livelihood in rural areas.
