title: Nalkoop Khanan Yojana- Madhya Pradesh
ministry: Farmer Welfare and Agriculture Development Department
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a native of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should be a farmer. 1. Farmers from Shajapur and Indore districts of Madhya Pradesh are excluded from this scheme. 1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribe category. 1. The applicant should own agricultural land within the state.
benefits: Subsidy for Tube Well Digging: - A grant of 75% of the unit cost (up to a maximum of ₹25,000/-), is provided for digging a tube well. - Applicable for both successful and unsuccessful digging. Subsidy for Submersible Pump Installation: - A grant of 75% of the unit cost (up to a maximum of ₹15,000/-), is provided for the successful installation of a submersible pump on a tube well. - Applicable only for successful installation of a Submersible Pump. Note: The subsidy is transferred to the bank account of the farmers.
summary: Under this scheme, farmers from SC and ST categories are eligible for a subsidy covering 75% of the unit cost (up to ₹25,000/-) for digging a tube well and 75% of the unit cost (up to ₹15,000/-) for the successful installation of a tube well submersible pump.

title: Nationwide Artificial Insemination Programme
eligibility_details: 1. The livestock owner should be a resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should have valid livestock registration documents. 1. The applicant should have the required infrastructure to undertake AI operations. 1. The applicant should not belong to any of the scheduled castes and tribes. 1. The applicant should have the required knowledge and skill to undertake AI operations. 1. The applicant should not have any prior criminal record.
benefits: 1. Increased fertility rate: The programme will help to increase the fertility rate by providing access to artificial insemination services. This will help to improve the fertility rate of cows, buffaloes, goats and sheep in the state. 1. Improved quality of livestock: The programme will help to improve the quality of livestock through the use of improved semen from superior bulls. This will help to improve the production of milk and meat as well as the quality of the animals. 1. Improved animal health: Artificial insemination will help to improve the health of animals by reducing the spread of diseases. This will help to reduce the number of deaths of animals due to disease. 1. Increased production: The programme will help to increase the production of milk and meat, which will help to improve the economic status of farmers.
summary: The Nationwide Artificial Insemination Programme (NAIP), is a flagship program of the Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying. The objective of the programme is to increase the productivity of livestock by improving the genetic potential through artificial insemination.

title: Sabji Shetra Vistar Yojana
eligibility_details: 1. Those farmers who are not currently cultivating vegetables will be encouraged to cultivate vegetables. 1. Farmers having forest rights certificates will also be eligible to avail the benefits. 1. The grant under the scheme will be given to a farmer only once. 1. A farmer can do farming for the first time in as much area as he wants but the grant will be payable for a minimum of 0.25 hectares and a maximum of 2.00 hectares.
benefits: - 50% of the cost of seeds in vegetable crops up to a maximum of ₹10,000/- Whatever is less, a grant will be given per hectare. - Root and tuber commercial crops, arbi etc. production, planting material 50% of the cost subject to a maximum of ₹30,000/- per hectare, whichever is less. This grant will be payable.
summary: Under the Sabji Shetra Vistar yojana, selection of vegetables through quality high yielding varieties to expand the area of crops and increase production.

title: Scheme for Supply of Male Goat on Subsidy Basis
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should be actively involved in goat rearing. 1. The applicant must be a goat rearer of any category. 1. The applicant must possess a minimum of 5 goats.
benefits: Male Goat Package - One improved breed male goat: ₹7,500/- - Insurance coverage (2.75% sum insured for one year): ₹206/- - Mineral mixture: ₹394/- - Training booklet and monitoring card: ₹200/- - Total package value: ₹8,300/- Grant Component - Government contribution: 75% of total cost - Beneficiary contribution: 25% of total cost
summary: "Male Goat Supply Scheme on Grant Basis" aims to improve the breed of indigenous/local goats throughout the state. Through this scheme, one male goat of an improved breed (Jamnapari, Barbari, or Sirohi Bakra) is provided to goat farmers of all categories on a grant basis.

title: Supply of Kadaknath Chicks on Subsidy
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should have basic facilities for poultry farming. 1. The applicant can be from any category of poultry farmers.
benefits: Livestock Support - 40 Kadaknath chicks (₹65 per chick): ₹2,600 - Drug/Vaccination (₹5 per chick): ₹200 - Transportation (including chick box): ₹210 - Poultry feed (48 grams per bird per day for 30 days): ₹1,390 - Total unit cost: ₹4,400 Grant Structure - Government grant: 75% of total cost - Beneficiary contribution: 25% of total cost
summary: The scheme "Supply of Kadaknath Chicken on Grant" aims to improve the economic condition of beneficiaries through poultry farming and protect and promote the Kadaknath breed. Beneficiaries receive 40 chicks along with food grains, medicine, and transportation support for 28 days.

title: Tap Water Scheme (Nal Jal Yojana)
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should belong to a Gram Panchayat area where the scheme is implemented.
benefits: Tap Water Connection is provided by the Gram Panchayat
summary: "Tap Water Scheme" (नल जल योजना) by the Panchayat and Rural Development Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh aims to provide clean water in Gram Panchayat areas in an accessible manner. The application has to be made to the concerned Gram Panchayat.

title: Dr. Bhimrao Ambedkar Aarthik Kalyan Yojana
ministry: Tribal Welfare and Scheduled Caste (SC) Department
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be between 18 and 55 years of age. 1. The applicant should not be an income tax payer. 1. The applicant should not be a defaulter of any bank or financial institution, such as MFI, NBFC, SFB, or PACS. 1. The applicant should not currently be a beneficiary of any other self-employment scheme from the state or central government. 1. The applicant's family income should meet the following definition: - If unmarried: Includes the applicant and dependent parents. - If married: Includes the applicant, spouse, and dependent children (no age limit for dependent, unmarried children).
benefits: 7% interest subsidy on loans for up to 5 years.
summary: The scheme "Dr. Bhimrao Ambedkar Aarthik Kalyan Yojana" under the Tribal Welfare and Scheduled Caste Department, Madhya Pradesh, offers a 7% annual interest subsidy on loans for Scheduled Caste beneficiaries, up to 5 years, subject to regular repayment.

title: Hinglaj Devi Temple and Nankana Sahib Yatra in Pakistan- Madhya Pradesh
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a native of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should have completed the pilgrimage to Hinglaj Devi Temple and Nankana Sahib in Pakistan. 1. The applicant should not be an income taxpayer. 1. Each individual is eligible for the grant only once in their lifetime. Note: To avail of the benefits of this scheme, pilgrims must submit all documents detailing their actual expenses incurred during the journey.
benefits: Under this scheme, the State Government will reimburse 50% of the total expenses incurred during the pilgrimage to Hinglaj Devi Temple and Nankana Sahib in Pakistan, up to a maximum of ₹30,000/- per pilgrim.
summary: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to the pilgrims of the state going on pilgrimage to Hinglaj Devi Temple & Nankana Sahib located in Pakistan. Under this scheme, the State Government will reimburse 50% of the total expenses incurred during the pilgrimage, up to a maximum of ₹30,000/-.

title: Kailash Mansarovar Yatra- Madhya Pradesh
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a native of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant must have completed the Kailash Mansarovar Yatra after being selected by the Ministry of External Affairs, Government of India. 1. Only individuals who have been selected by the Ministry of External Affairs, Government of India, for the pilgrimage are eligible for the benefits of this scheme. 1. The applicant should not be an income taxpayer. 1. Each individual is eligible for the grant only once in their lifetime. Note 1: To avail of the benefits of this scheme, pilgrims must submit all documents detailing their actual expenses incurred during the journey. Note 2: If both husband and wife are selected for the pilgrimage, their eligibility for travel benefits will be as per the guidelines of the Ministry of External Affairs, Government of India.
benefits: Under this scheme, the State Government will reimburse 50% of the total expenses incurred during the Kailash Mansarovar Yatra, up to a maximum of ₹30,000/- per pilgrim, upon submission of the required certificate/documents.
summary: This scheme aims to provide financial assistance to the pilgrims of the state going on the Kailash Mansarovar Yatra. Under this scheme, the State Government will reimburse 50% of the total expenses incurred during the Kailash Mansarovar Yatra, up to a maximum of ₹30,000/- per pilgrim.

title: Mukhya Mantri Seekho Kamao Yojana
ministry: Technical Education and Man Power Planning Department
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be between 18 to 29 years of age. 1. The applicant should be a resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should be educated with a minimum qualification of 12th pass, ITI, or higher. 1. The applicant should be designated as a “Student-Trainee” upon selection.
benefits: - Skill Enhancement: Offers practical training to improve job readiness. - Stipend Support: Provides up to ₹1 lakh as financial aid during training. - 12th Pass: ₹8,000 per month. - ITI Pass: ₹8,500 per month. - Diploma Pass: ₹9,000 per month. - Graduate or Higher Qualification: ₹10,000 per month.
summary: The Mukhya Mantri Seekho Kamao Yojana provides On-the-Job Training (OJT) to educated youth in registered industries and businesses. Annually, 1 lakh youth will benefit, with a stipend of up to ₹1 lakh funded by the state government.

title: Sindhu Darshan Scheme in Ladakh
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a native of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should have completed a pilgrimage to Sindhu Darshan in Ladakh after being selected by the Madhya Pradesh Government's Religious Trust and Endowment Department. 1. Only individuals selected by the Madhya Pradesh Government's Religious Trust and Endowment Department for the pilgrimage are eligible for the scheme's benefits. 1. The applicant must not be an income taxpayer. 1. Financial assistance is available to each individual only once in their lifetime. Note: To avail the benefit of this scheme, pilgrims should submit all the documents detailing their actual expenses during the journey.
benefits: Under this scheme, the State Government will reimburse 50% of the total expenses incurred during the pilgrimage to Sindhu Darshan in Ladakh, up to a maximum of ₹10,000/- per pilgrim.
summary: The objective of this scheme is to provide financial assistance to the pilgrims of the state going on Sindhu Darshan pilgrimage. Under this scheme, the State Government will reimburse 50% of the total expenses incurred during the pilgrimage, up to a maximum of ₹10,000/- per pilgrim.

title: Sri Lanka's Sita Temple Tour
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a native of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should have completed a pilgrimage to the Sita Temple and Ashoka Vatika in Sri Lanka and the Angkor Wat Temple in Cambodia. 1. The applicant should not be an income taxpayer. 1. Each individual is eligible to receive financial assistance only once in their lifetime.
benefits: 1. Under this scheme, natives of Madhya Pradesh who complete visits to Sita Temple & Ashok Vatika in Sri Lanka, as well as Angkor Wat Temple in Cambodia, are eligible for reimbursement. 1. Upon submission of the certificate detailing the actual expenses incurred, the State Government will reimburse 50% of the total expenses, up to a maximum of ₹30,000/-.
summary: The objective of this scheme is to provide financial assistance to state pilgrims traveling to the Sita Temple & Ashoka Vatika in Sri Lanka and the Angkor Wat Temple in Cambodia. Under this scheme, the State Government will reimburse 50% of the expenses of the journey, up to a maximum of ₹30,000/-.

title: Aaws Bhatta Sahayata Yojana
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must belong to the Scheduled Caste category. 1. The applicant must be admitted as a regular student in a government or recognized non-government college. 1. The applicant must not be admitted to any government hostel. 1. The annual income of the student's family must be as per the income limit prescribed in the Post Matric Scholarship Scheme, which is currently ₹6,00,000/- per annum. 1. The college or the student's permanent residence should not be located within the geographical limits of the same local body (urban body/gram panchayat).
benefits: 1. In Bhopal, Indore, Jabalpur, Gwalior, and Ujjain cities ₹2,000/- per student per month. 1. At district headquarters ₹1,250/- per student per month. 1. At the tehsil and development block level ₹1,000/- per student per month.
summary: The Aaws Bhatta Sahaayata Yojana Government of Madhya Pradesh runs this scheme for those poor students belonging to Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe of its state whose college is very far from their house and they have to rent accommodation near the college to study.

title: Admission in Post Matric Hostel
ministry: Backward Classes and Minorities Welfare Department
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should belong to the Backward Class. 1. The applicant should be studying in an educational institution located near the hostel. 1. The applicant should not be a resident.
benefits: Providing free accommodation for education to backward class students
summary: The scheme was launched on 1st January1900, the scheme "Admission in Post Matric Hostel" by the Backward Classes and Minorities Welfare Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh, provides free accommodation to backward class students to support their education.

title: Akanksha Scheme
ministry: Tribal Welfare and Scheduled Caste (SC) Department
eligibility_details: Prescribed Qualification:- - The applicant will have to register his profile in the website www.tribal.mp.gov.in/MPTAAS of the Sarvapatham Department. - The applicant should be a native of Madhya Pradesh and a member of scheduled tribe. - The annual income of the applicant's parents/ guardians/ self from all sources is Rs. Not more than 6.00 lakh. - The student should be eligible to take admission in class 10th by passing class 11th. - The student will be selected for coaching on the basis of merit obtained through the entrance examination conducted by the coaching institute. Required Conditions: - It is mandatory to link bank account with Aadhaar number. - The applicant must have a digital caste certificate. - The result of the student's class 10th examination should be more than 60 percent or 60 percent.
benefits: According to the plan of the Government of Madhya Pradesh, Tribal Affairs Department, the target is to provide coaching to the scheduled tribe students of the state for the preparation of national entrance examination (JEE, NEET / AIIMS, CLET) from reputed coaching institutes in division headquarters Bhopal, Indore, Jabalpur and Gwalior while studying in class 11th and 12th. In the first year 2018-19, along with studies in class 11th, 100 students will be coached for engineering, 50 for medical and 50 for class at each coaching center. In the coming year, continuous coaching facility will be available to the said sales in class 200th. Prescribed Qualification:- - The applicant will have to register his profile in the website www.tribal.mp.gov.in/MPTAAS of the Sarvapatham Department. - The applicant should be a native of Madhya Pradesh and a member of scheduled tribe. - The annual income of the applicant's parents/ guardians/ self from all sources is Rs. Not more than 6.00 lakh. - The student should be eligible to take admission in class 10th by passing class 11th. - The student will be selected for coaching on the basis of merit obtained through the entrance examination conducted by the coaching institute. Required Conditions: - It is mandatory to link bank account with Aadhaar number. - The applicant must have a digital caste certificate. - The result of the student's class 10th examination should be more than 60 percent or 60 percent.
summary: According to the plan of the Government of Madhya Pradesh, Tribal Affairs Department, the target is to provide coaching to the scheduled tribe students of the state for the preparation of national entrance examination (JEE, NEET / AIIMS, CLET) from reputed coaching institutes in division headquarter

title: Alpasankhyak Post-Maitrik Chhaatravrtti Yojana
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a native of the minority category of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The total annual income of the applicant's parents and guardian should not exceed ₹2,00,000/-. 1. Not less than 50 percent marks in the last qualifying examination.
benefits: 1. Tuition fee of ₹3,000/- per year for graduate and postgraduate students. 1. Maintenance allowance of ₹570/- per month for undergraduate and postgraduate hostel students. 1. Maintenance allowance of ₹300/- per month for non-hostel students 1. Maintenance allowance M.Phil. And Ph.D. ₹1,200/- per month to hostel students. 1. Maintenance allowance of ₹550/- per month for non-hostel students 1. Maintenance allowance will be payable for 10 months.
summary: The Alpasankhyak Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme under the Madhya Pradesh Government is to provide financial assistance to students from minority communities in Madhya Pradesh pursuing post-secondary education.

title: Alpsankhyak Merit-Cum-Means Chatravriti Yojana
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a native of the minority category of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The total annual income of the parents and guardians of the applicant should not exceed ₹2,50,000/-. 1. The applicants must have a score of at least 50 percent marks in the last qualifying examination.
benefits: 1. Hostel students receive a maintenance allowance of ₹1,000/- per month for 10 months. 1. Non-hostel students are provided with a maintenance allowance of ₹500/- per month for 10 months. 1. Reimbursement of actual course fees or ₹20,000/- whichever is less.
summary: Under the Alpsankhyak Merit-Cum-Means Chatravriti Yojana, the Government of Madhya Pradesh provided financial support to those people who are not able to study due to financial circumstances.

title: Ashram Schools (Scheduled Tribes)
eligibility_details: 1. The student should be a native of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The student should belong to the Scheduled Tribe category. 1. The student should be studying in a government school in Madhya Pradesh.
benefits: Providing free accommodation, mess, and education facilities.
summary: The scheme "Ashram Schools" was launched on 1st January 1966 by the Tribal Welfare and Scheduled Caste (SC) Department of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme provides free accommodation, mess, and education facilities to Scheduled Tribe students.

title: Aswachh Dhandha Chhaatravrtti
ministry: Tribal Welfare and Scheduled Caste (SC) Department
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste or other deprived categories of society. 1. One or both parents of the applicant should be engaged in unclean/unhygienic occupations (Scavenger/Flayers/Tanner). Students whose parents left these occupations after 1997 are also eligible for the scheme. 1. The applicant should be a student. 1. The applicant should be studying in Class 1st to Class 10th. 1. Only two children from one family are eligible. 1. The applicant should be a native/resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant is not eligible for any other state scholarship.
benefits: 1. Under this scheme, regular students studying in Class 1st to Class 10th are given a scholarship of ₹1,850/- per annum.
summary: The objective of the scheme is to motivate students from marginalized sections of society, whose parents are involved in unclean & hazardous occupations, to pursue their education. Under the scheme, financial assistance of ₹1,850/- per annum is provided to students from Class 1 to Class 10.

title: Award for Success in State Public Service Commission, Union Public Service Commission Examination (MPBOCWWB)
eligibility_details: For Registration 1. The applicant should be a resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should be a Building/ Construction Worker. 1. The applicant should be between 18 and 60 years. 1. The applicant should have engaged in any building or other construction work for at least 90 days during the preceding 12 months. 1. The registration of the applicant should be renewed annually. For Application 1. The applicant should be a son or daughter of a registered Building/ Construction Worker. 1. The applicant should be up to 45 years of age. 1. The applicant should be in possession of a valid identity card issued by the Labour Department. 1. The applicant should be selected at Preliminary or Main Level of either the "State Public Service Commission Examination" or the "Union Public Service Commission Examination".
benefits: Incentives Upon Selection in "Madhya Pradesh Public Service Commission" Exam - Preliminary Exam: ₹15,000/- - Main Exam: ₹25,000/- Incentives Upon Selection in "Union Public Service Commission" Exam - Preliminary Exam: ₹25,000/- - Main Exam: ₹50,000/-
summary: The State Public Service Commission and Union Public Service Commission Examination Success Award Scheme, 2012 provides an incentive to sons and daughters of registered construction workers, up to 45 years of age, selected in State or Union Public Service Commission exams.

title: Backward Class Students Meritorious Award Scheme
ministry: Backward Classes and Minorities Welfare Department
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a student of class 10th or 12th. 1. The applicant should be a resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should be from the backward class category. 1. The applicant should be enrolled in a recognized school in Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should be a top scorer at the district level in the class 10th board exam or among the highest scorers (one male and one female) in the class 12th board exam.
benefits: - Class 10th Board Examination: ₹5,000/- per student - Class 12th Board Examination: ₹10,000/- per student - Frequency of Disbursement: Annual - Time of Disbursement: Distribution on August 15 or January 26
summary: "Backward Classes Student Merit Award Scheme" aims to recognize and reward academic excellence among backward-class students. Monetary awards are provided to one boy and one girl student from backward classes who secure the highest marks at the district level in class 10th and 12th board exams.

title: Backward Classes Foreign Study Scholarship Scheme
ministry: Backward Classes and Minorities Welfare Department
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a student with first class or 60% marks (or equivalent grade) in the previous examination. 1. The applicant should be applying for a research degree (Ph.D.) or have at least 2 years of experience in the relevant field for research programs after completing a research degree. 1. The applicant should be under 35 years of age on 1st January of the year of application. 1. The applicant should be eligible for special relaxation of up to 10 years in certain cases as decided by the committee. 1. The applicant should be from a family whose annual income does not exceed the income limit prescribed for the creamy layer.
benefits: To provide financial assistance to students belonging to the backward class.
summary: Launched on 1st January 2007, the "Backward Classes Foreign Study Scholarship Scheme" by the Backward Classes and Minorities Welfare Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh provides financial assistance to backward class students for postgraduate, Ph.D., and post-research studies abroad.

title: Chhatrawas (Scheduled Caste)
ministry: Tribal Welfare and Scheduled Caste (SC) Department
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste category. 1. The applicant should be a student. 1. The student should be a native of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The student should be enrolled in a recognized educational institution. 1. The student should be a regular student, attending classes in the institution. 1. The student should require residential facilities in the Scheduled Caste hostels.
benefits: Financial Support: Students receive ₹1460/- to ₹1500/- per month. Additional Facilities: Food, Hostel, Material Assistance, Scholarship, Free Food and Accommodation, Sports Equipment, Cosmetic Kit and Library Facility.
summary: Launched in 1966-67, the scheme "Chhatrawas" is a welfare scheme by the Scheduled Caste Welfare Department, Govt of MP. The scheme provides free residential facilities in Scheduled Caste hostels for boys and girls studying in educational institutions.

title: Civil Service Incentive (De-Notified, Nomadic and Semi-nomadic communities )
ministry: Department of De-notified, Nomadic and Semi-nomadic Welfare Department
eligibility_details: - The applicant should be from De-notified, Nomadic, or Semi-Nomadic communities. - The applicant should have passed one of the following stages of the MPPSC or UPSC Examination: Preliminary Exam, Main Exam, or Interview.
benefits: On Passing the Preliminary Examination: - ₹20,000/- (Madhya Pradesh Public Service Commission) - ₹40,000/- (Union Public Service Commission) On Passing the Main Examination: - ₹30,000/- (Madhya Pradesh Public Service Commission) - ₹60,000/- (Union Public Service Commission) On Passing the Interview: - ₹25,000/- (Madhya Pradesh Public Service Commission) - ₹50,000/- (Union Public Service Commission)
summary: The "Civil Service Incentive" by the Department of De-notified, Nomadic, and Semi-Nomadic Welfare, Government of Madhya Pradesh, offers an incentive of ₹20,000 to ₹50,000 for successful candidates from these communities in MPPSC and UPSC civil service exams.

title: Civil Service Incentive Scheme (Madhya Pradesh)
ministry: Tribal Welfare and Scheduled Caste (SC) Department
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be from the Scheduled Caste (SC) /Scheduled Tribes (ST) category. 1. The applicant should be a native of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should cleared the Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) or Madhya Pradesh Public Service Commission (MPSC) examinations. 1. The annual income of the parents of the applicant should not exceed ₹6,00,000/-.
benefits: Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) - ₹40,000 for passing the preliminary examination. - ₹60,000 for passing the main examination. - ₹50,000 for getting selected in the interview. State Public Service Commission (MPSC) - ₹20,000 for passing the preliminary examination. - ₹30,000 for passing the main examination. - ₹25,000 for getting selected in the interview.
summary: The "Civil Service Incentive Scheme (Madhya Pradesh)" scheme by the Tribal Welfare and Scheduled Caste (SC) Department of the Government of Madhya Pradesh provides an incentive amount to encourage SC/ST candidates to appear in Civil Services Examinations.

title: Coaching by Private Institutes for All India Services Civil Services Examination
ministry: Tribal Welfare and Scheduled Caste (SC) Department
eligibility_details:
1. The applicant should be a native of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should be from a Scheduled Tribe. 1. The applicant should have an annual income from all sources not exceeding ₹6,00,000. 1. The applicant should have passed graduation. 1. The applicant should have been selected based on merit in Arts/Commerce/Science/Engineering/Medical groups. 1. The applicant should not have availed the benefits of this scheme before. 1. The applicant should register their profile on the MPTAASC portal of the department. 1. The applicant’s age should be determined by UPSC as per the eligibility criteria for the Civil Services (Pre) exam of the respective year.
Reservation 5% of reserved seats for needy and promising low-income students. Priority The applicant should be given priority if they have passed the Civil Services Main Examination of Madhya Pradesh Public Service Commission in the last three years.
benefits: 1. Coaching Fee up to ₹2,00,000/- or actual fee (whichever is less) paid directly to the empanelled coaching institute in Delhi.1. One-time Assistance of ₹15,000/- for purchasing books, credited directly to the candidate’s account.1. Monthly Stipend of ₹12,500/- for up to 18 months, based on attendance.1. Transport, Housing, and Food facilities of ₹12,500/- per month, paid directly to the candidate’s account.
summary: Launched on 12th September 2013, the scheme "Coaching by Private Institutes for All India Services Civil Services Examination (Scheduled Tribes)" provides financial assistance, education, and training to Scheduled Tribe candidates preparing for the Civil Services Examination.

title: Distribution of Free Books and Stationery to SC/ST Students
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a native of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should be a regular student. 1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribe category. 1. The applicant should be studying in a government college. 1. The applicant should be pursuing either a graduation or post-graduation course.
benefits: Under the scheme, free books worth ₹1,500/- and stationery worth ₹500/- per year are provided to SC/ST students studying in government colleges in undergraduate and postgraduate courses.
summary: Under this scheme, free books and stationery are provided to Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe students who are pursuing undergraduate and postgraduate courses at government colleges. Eligible students receive books worth ₹1,500/- and stationery worth ₹500/- per year.

title: Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Meritorious Students Incentive Scheme (Class 12th Passed)
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The student must have achieved the highest marks in their district in the Class 12 examination. 1. The student must have passed their Class 12 examination from a government school in Madhya Pradesh (Government Higher Secondary School). 1. The student's parents' income from all sources should be less than ₹1,00,000/- per year.
benefits: - Under this scheme, students who achieve the highest marks in the 12th class examination in government schools within their district will receive ₹5,000/-. Note: The scholarship is sent directly to the student's bank account.
summary: The objective of the scheme is to motivate students from the lower economic backgrounds & support them economically. Under this scheme, cash award of ₹5,000/- is given to the students who have obtained the highest marks in the 12th class examination in government schools within their district.

title: Dr. Bhim Rao Ambedkar Meritorious Student Award Scheme
ministry: Tribal Welfare and Scheduled Caste (SC) Department
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a native of Madhya Pradesh. 1. Meritorious students from Scheduled Caste categories who secure the highest marks in the Class 10 and Class 12 board examinations (Board of Secondary Education, CBSE, or ICSE) in the state are eligible for the award. 1. The student should belong to the Scheduled Caste category.
benefits: Awards for securing the highest marks in the Class 10th Board examinations: - 1st prize (Boy/Girl): ₹30,000/- - 2nd prize (Boy/Girl): ₹25,000/- - 3rd prize (Boy/Girl): ₹20,000/- - 4th prize (Only Girl): ₹15,000/- - 5th prize (Only Girl): ₹10,000/- - 6th prize (Only Girl): ₹5,000/- Awards for securing the highest marks in the Class 12th Board examinations: - 1st prize (Boy/Girl): ₹51,000/- - 2nd prize (Boy/Girl): ₹40,000/- - 3rd prize (Boy/Girl): ₹30,000/- - 4th prize (Only Girl): ₹20,000/- - 5th prize (Only Girl): ₹15,000/- - 6th prize (Only Girl): ₹10,000/- Note: Payments are made into the bank accounts of the applicants.
summary: This scheme awards special prizes to meritorious Scheduled Caste students who secure the highest marks in the Class 10th and 12th board examinations conducted by the Board of Secondary Education, CBSE, and ICSE in the state.

title: Education Development Scholarship for Single Girl Child
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a girl student. 1. The applicant should be the only girl child of her parents. 1. The girl student should be a permanent resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The girl student should have scored 60% or more marks in the 10th class examination under the curriculum of the Madhya Pradesh Secondary Education Board. 1. The girl should be studying in Class 11 or 12 at a recognized private school. 1. The school tuition fees should be less than ₹1,500/- per month. 1. The girl student should have passed the previous class. Note 1: If the parents are government employees, a certificate from the head of the office confirming the applicant is the only child or an attested copy of the family list in the ration card, is required. Note 2: If the parents are not government employees, an affidavit from a notary confirming the applicant is the only child, or an attested copy of the ration card, is required.
benefits: - Under the scheme, a scholarship of ₹5,000/- per year is given to single girl child students. Note: The scholarship will be deposited directly into the student's bank account.
summary: The scheme was launched by School Education Department, Govt. of Madhya Pradesh to ensure continuity of education for girl students who are the only daughters of their parents. Under this scheme, eligible girl students who are only child of their parents receive a scholarship of ₹5,000/- per year.

title: Encouragement Scheme for Taking Admission in Science and Contemporary Subjects
ministry: Tribal Welfare and Scheduled Caste (SC) Department
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a native of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The student should belong to the Scheduled Tribe category. 1. The scheme benefits are available to: - Students who have completed Class 10 and are currently enrolled in Class 11 with a Science stream. - Students who have completed Class 12 and are currently pursuing a B.Sc. degree in Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, or Biology.
benefits: Under this scheme, scholarships will be provided to Scheduled Tribe students at the following rates: - Students who passed Class 10th and are enrolled in Class 11th in the Science stream: ₹2,000/-- Students who passed Class 12th and are enrolled in a B.Sc. course in Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, or Biology: ₹3,000/-
summary: This scheme provides scholarships to Scheduled Tribe students who have passed Class 10 and enrolled in Class 11 Science stream, and to those who have passed Class 12 and enrolled in a B.Sc. course in Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, or Biology.

title: Free Caste Hostel (De-Notified, Nomadic and Semi-Nomadic Communities)
ministry: Department of De-notified, Nomadic and Semi-nomadic Welfare Department
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a student belonging to the De-Notified, Nomadic, or Semi-Nomadic tribes. 1. The applicant should be studying in a local educational institution. 1. The applicant should apply for admission before the new academic session. 1. The applicant should secure a vacant seat, as new admissions depend on availability. 1. The applicant should have a higher percentage in the last passed examination for priority admission.
benefits: - A scholarship of ₹1,230 per month for boys. - A scholarship of ₹1,270 per month for girls. - The scholarship is given for 10 months.
summary: The "Free Caste Hostel" scheme by the Department of De-notified, Nomadic, and Semi-Nomadic Welfare, Government of Madhya Pradesh, provides a scholarship of ₹1,230 per month for boys and ₹1,270 per month for girls for 10 months.

title: Free Distribution of Text Books to Students
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a student. 1. The applicant should be studying in class 9th to 12th. 1. The applicant should be studying in a government school in Madhya Pradesh.
benefits: Free textbooks.
summary: Launched on 1st January 2008, the scheme "Free Distribution of Textbooks to Students" by the School Education Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh, provides free textbooks to students studying in classes 9th to 12th in government schools.

title: Free Employment Oriented Training to Educated Unemployed Youth of Backward Class and Minority Class
ministry: Backward Classes and Minorities Welfare Department
eligibility_details: - The applicant should be a permanent resident of Madhya Pradesh. - The applicant should belong to Other Backward Classes (OBC) or Minorities. - The applicant's family income should not exceed the creamy layer limit. - The applicant should be selected by the training institution approved by the government.
benefits: - Free coaching for employment-oriented competitive examinations. - Stipend support during the training period. - Access to well-equipped coaching facilities. - Ideal academic environment for exam preparation.
summary: "Free Employment Oriented Training to Educated Unemployed Youth of Backward Class and Minority Class" aims to provide quality pre-examination training for various employment-oriented competitive examinations to talented but economically disadvantaged young men and women.

title: Gaon Ki Beti
eligibility_details: 1. The student must have secured 60% or more marks in the 12th standard. 1. The girl must reside in a rural area and possess a "Gaon Ki Beti" (Daughter of the Village) certificate. 1. She must be enrolled in a recognized institution for higher education.
benefits: 1. Each year, girls who pass the 12th standard with first-class marks from a village will be eligible. 1. Selected students will receive a scholarship of ₹500/- per month. 1. The scholarship will be provided for a maximum of 10 months per year.
summary: MP Gaon Ki Beti Yojna 2022-23 is a scholarship provided by the Madhya Pradesh government. The MP state government has started this scheme to encourage the higher education of girl children in remote areas in 2005.

title: General Poor Class Scholarship (Class 6 to 8)
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should be studying in Class 6 to 8. 1. The student should be studying at a government school. 1. The student should belong to the Below Poverty Line (BPL) category. 1. The student's parents' total income from all sources should be less than ₹1,00,000/- per year. 1. The student should have passed the previous class.
benefits: - Girl students will receive a scholarship of ₹300/- per year. - Boy students will receive a scholarship of ₹200/- per year. Note: The scholarship amount is directly transferred to the student's bank account.
summary: Under this scheme, scholarships are provided to students studying in Classes 6 to 8 in government schools. Students whose annual family income is less than ₹1,00,000/- and who belong to the Below Poverty Line (BPL) category are eligible for the benefits.

title: Girls Literacy Promotion Scheme for Class 11th
ministry: Department of De-notified, Nomadic and Semi-nomadic Welfare Department
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be from Denotified, Nomadic, or Semi-Nomadic Community. 1. The applicant should be a girl. 1. The applicant should be enrolled in the 11th Standard. 1. The applicant should be studying in a recognized institution. 1. The applicant should have studied continuously without any academic breaks.
benefits: An incentive of ₹3,000/-.
summary: The "Girls Literacy Promotion Scheme Class 11th" by the Madhya Pradesh Government encourages girls from De-notified, Nomadic, and Semi-Nomadic communities to study. Girls enrolling in Class 11 for the first time receive ₹3,000/-

title: Hostel Facility for Students Availing Education in Delhi
ministry: Tribal Welfare and Scheduled Caste (SC) Department
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a native of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should be a regular student currently enrolled in or admitted to an undergraduate (first year) or higher class, or professional course at a government or recognized institution located in Delhi. 1. The student should belong to the Scheduled Caste category.
benefits: Financial assistance is available for students from Madhya Pradesh who are pursuing higher education at institutions (universities and colleges) in Delhi. The assistance covers the following: - Monthly rent: ₹1,000/- per month - Scholarship: ₹500/- per month - Water and electricity expenses: ₹100/- per month - One-time grant (at the time of admission): ₹2,000/- Note: Payments are made into the bank accounts of the applicants.
summary: The objective of the scheme is to provide facilities for residential and other facilities such as water, reimbursement of electricity expenditure, scholarship etc. for scheduled caste students of Madhya Pradesh studying in higher institutions located in Delhi.

title: Hostel Scheme for Disabled Students
ministry: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should be a person with a disability, with a disability percentage of 40 or more. 1. The applicant should be studying in Class 11 or higher at any recognized government or private educational institution. 1. The student should be enrolled as a regular student in a minimum two-year diploma course at a Government Higher Secondary School, College, or Polytechnic College. 1. The annual income of the applicant's parents or guardians must not exceed ₹96,000/-. Note 1: To avail of student home facilities, there must be at least 5 girls or 5 boys students. Note 2: Hostels for boys and girls will be in separate buildings. Note 3: Disability above 40% as defined in Section-2 of the Persons with Disabilities (Equal Opportunities, Protection of Rights and Full Participation) Act, 1995. Note 4: Principals of Government/Non-Government Institutions will be competent to grant admission. Note 5: Students eligible for or already receiving a post-matriculation scholarship, who have an excellent character and are committed to fulfilling the scheme’s requirements, will receive the post-matriculation scholarship at the hostel rate only. Note 6: The students of the hostel are not eligible for any state scholarship.
benefits: Under the scheme, the following benefits are provided to the eligible students who are not getting hostel facility from schools/colleges: - Rental Assistance: Beneficiaries receive ₹750/- per month for renting a student home, the District Officer or Social Justice will approve. - Utility Support: Students are given ₹1,000/- per month to cover electricity and water charges for the student home. - Rent Approval: The District Collector approves a student home rent of up to ₹1,500/- per month.
summary: The objective of the scheme is to provide hostel facilities to such disabled students who are taking admission in class 11th and above on a regular basis and in case hostel facilities are not available in the schools/colleges, by renting private buildings.

title: Incentives to Students who Passed the Civil Service Examination
ministry: Tribal Welfare and Scheduled Caste (SC) Department
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a native of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Tribe category. 1. The applicant should be successful in Civil Services exams (Preliminary, Main, Interview) conducted by MPPSC or UPSC. 1. The applicant is eligible for incentives only for the first success at each stage. 1. The applicant should is eligible to receive 50% of the incentive amount in case of second success. 1. The applicant will be ineligible for benefits after the third success.
benefits: 1. Preliminary Exam Success (All India Civil Services): ₹40,000/-. 1. Main Exam Success (All India Civil Services): ₹60,000/-. 1. Successful After Interview (All India Civil Services): ₹50,000/-. 1. Preliminary Exam Success (Madhya Pradesh Civil Services): ₹20,000/-. 1. Main Exam Success (Madhya Pradesh Civil Services): ₹30,000/-. 1. Successful After Interview (Madhya Pradesh Civil Services): ₹25,000/-. 1. Second-Time Success: Candidates receive 50% of the incentive amount as mentioned above; no benefits are provided for third-time success.
summary: The "Incentives to Students Who Passed the Civil Service Examination" scheme provides incentives to Scheduled Tribe candidates who clear the Civil Services exams (Preliminary, Main, and Interview) conducted by M.P. PSC and UPSC.

title: Integrated Hostel Scheme
ministry: Tribal Welfare and Scheduled Caste (SC) Department
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a native of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should belong to the Other Backward Castes, Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes category. 1. The applicant should be studying in a government school in Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should be studying in class 1 to 12 or college-level classes. 1. The applicant should reside in a remote rural area (priority given). 1. The applicant's school should be within a maximum distance of 3 km for girls or 8 km for boys. 1. The applicant should not have any income restrictions.
benefits: The hostel provides free residential facilities, including accommodation, electricity, water, meals, furniture, bedding, library, coaching, and basic amenities.
summary: "Integrated Hostel Scheme" by the Tribal Welfare and Scheduled Caste (SC) Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh, provides free residential facilities, meals, and basic amenities to SC/ST/OBC students studying in classes 1st to 12th and also to the students pursuing college education.

title: Integrated Scholarship Scheme
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a native of Madhya Pradesh. 2. The applicant should be studying in a government/aided private college. 3. The annual income of parents/guardians of the applicant should not exceed ₹54,000/-. 4. The other qualifications of the applicant: - Ph.D: 55% marks in post-graduation. - Postgraduate: 55% marks in graduation. - Graduation (qualification cum means): 55% marks in the examination of the Board of Secondary Education. - 60% marks in Graduation (qualifying) examination of Board of Secondary Education. - Sports: The applicant should be a member of the national sports team in the school team of Madhya Pradesh, or should be a member of the adult team of the state or should have been in any of the first three places in the state level competition.
benefits: The scholarships are provided at the following rates: Sl. No.Type of scholarshipAmount per month Quota1PhD₹600/- 182M.Phil.₹500/- 143Postgraduate (Merit based only)₹500/- 734Postgraduate (Merit cum means based)₹500/- 735Sports₹300/-226Graduation (Merit based only)₹300/-1467Graduation (Merit cum means based)₹300/-146Note: The scholarship is provided for 10 months.
summary: This scheme offers scholarships for PhD, M.Phil., Postgraduate (qualification-based and qualification cum instrument-based), and sports, as well as merit-based scholarships for graduates, ranging from ₹300/- to ₹600/- per month.

title: Internship Policy Of The Madhya Pradesh Tourism Board
eligibility_details:
The applicant should be studying in one of the following institutes - 1. Institute of Hotel Management. 1. Food Craft Institutes affiliated with the Government of India or Madhya Pradesh. 1. Institutes of Travel and Tourism affiliated with the Government of India or Madhya Pradesh. 1. Indian Institute of Forest Management. 1. Any other institute permitted by the management of the MP Tourism Board.
The applicant should be enrolled in one of the following courses/programs - 1. MBA/BBA/BA (Tourism) / B.Com. (Tourism) 1. B.Sc. in Hotel Management. 1. Diploma/ Certificate in Food Production/ Food & Beverage Service/ Front Office/ Housekeeping. 1. PG Diploma in Forest Management/ Hotel Operations. 1. Any other tourism-related Courses like Photography, Digital Marketing, Advertising, Adventure sports, Bio-diversity, Tour Operators Courses etc.
benefits:
Stipend Courses: Post Graduate Diploma In Forestry Management Period: As per the Requirement Stipend (per Trainee): ₹5,000/month
Courses: B.Sc (in Hotel Management )from IHM or SIHM / MBA/BBA/BA/B.COM (Tourism) Period: As per the Requirement Stipend (per Trainee): ₹2,500/month
Courses: Certificate/Diploma/PG Diploma in Food Production, F&B Service, Housekeeping/ hotel operations from Food Craft Institutes & IGNOU Period: As per the Requirement Stipend (per Trainee): ₹1,500/month
Certificate On successful completion of the internship training, the MP Tourism Board will issue a certificate and inform the respective training institution.
NOTE 1: Apart from the above, on the requirements of any specific training, the stipend will be decided by the management. NOTE 2: All the stipends will be transferred to the bank account of the candidate through NEFT/RTGS. NOTE 3: No travelling expenses will be paid for reaching/ returning to the allotted training place. NOTE 4: No accommodation and food will be provided to interns.
summary: The Internship Policy of the Madhya Pradesh Tourism Board intends to provide practical training experience (in summer/ winter etc.) to the students studying in various hospitality / tourism-related schools in Madhya Pradesh or outside the state.

title: Junior Hostel (Scheduled Tribes)
ministry: Tribal Welfare and Scheduled Caste (SC) Department
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be from the Scheduled Tribes (ST) category. 1. The applicant should be a native of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should be a student of class 6th to 8th. 1. The applicant should be studying in a government or recognized school. 1. The applicant should have passed the previous year's examination.
benefits: Free Accommodation and Mess Facilities.
summary: Launched on 1st January 1966, the scheme "Junior Hostel" by the Tribal Welfare and Scheduled Caste (SC) Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh provides free accommodation and mess facilities to students studying in classes 6th to 8th.

title: Kanya Saksharta Protsahan Yojana
ministry: Tribal Welfare and Scheduled Caste (SC) Department
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a girl. 1. The girl student should be a native/resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The girl student should belong to the Scheduled Tribe community. 1. The applicant should be a regular student. 1. All girls who have passed Class 10th and are entering Class 11th are eligible for the scheme.
benefits: - Under this scheme, all girls belonging to Scheduled Tribes who have passed Class 10th and are entering Class 11th will receive an incentive amount of ₹3,000/- per year. Note: The incentive amount will be paid into the bank accounts of the girl students.
summary: The scheme was launched by the Tribal Welfare Department, Govt. of Madhya Pradesh. The objective of the scheme is to motivate girls towards education. Under this scheme, girls in Class 11th who have passed their 10th class examination will receive ₹3,000/- per year as a monetary incentive.

title: Kanya Saksharta Protsahan Yojana (For Scheduled Caste Girls)
ministry: Tribal Welfare and Scheduled Caste (SC) Department
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a girl student. 1. The girl student should be a native of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The girl student should belong to the Scheduled Caste category. 1. All Scheduled Caste girl students who have passed Class 10 and are entering Class 11 are eligible for the scheme. 1. The parents or guardians of the applicant should not be income taxpayers. 1. The girl student should be pursuing her education continuously. 1. The girl student should be enrolled in a government or recognized government school/institution and attend regularly.
benefits: 1. Under this scheme, all Scheduled Caste girl students who have passed Class 10 and are entering Class 11 will receive an incentive of ₹3,000/- per year. Note: The incentive amount will be paid into the bank accounts of the girl students.
summary: Under this scheme, Scheduled Caste girls who pass the Class 10th and enroll in the Class 11th at a government or recognized institution and study regularly are given an incentive of ₹3,000/- per year.

title: Labour Skill Training Scheme (MPBOCWWB)
eligibility_details: For Registration as a Building/ Construction Worker: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should be a Building/ Construction Worker. 1. The applicant should be between 18 and 60 years. 1. The applicant should have engaged in any building or other construction work for at least 90 days during the preceding 12 months. 1. The applicant should be registration is renewed annually. For the Application of the Welfare Scheme: 1. The applicant should be registered Under the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicants construction workers aged 18 to 45 years and their dependents aged 16 to 45 years. 1. The worker membership with the Welfare Board must be active at the time of application.
benefits: The scheme provides free skill training to construction workers and their dependents.
summary: Launched on 1st August 2018, the scheme "Labour Skill Training Scheme" is a skill development initiative by the Building and Other Construction Workers Board, Govt of MP. It offers free skill training to construction workers aged 18-45 years and their dependents aged 16-45

title: Laptop Supply Scheme
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a student. 1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should have passed the 12th Standard with 80% or above marks.
benefits: An amount of ₹25,000/- is provided for purchasing a laptop.
summary: "Laptop Supply Scheme" by the School Education Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh provides ₹25,000/- for purchasing a laptop to students who score 80% or more in 12th Standard from a Government Higher Secondary School or a Madhya Pradesh Board (MP Board) affiliated school.

title: Madhya Pradesh Professional Talent Examination Award Scheme
ministry: Backward Classes and Minorities Welfare Department
eligibility_details: - The applicant should be a permanent resident of Madhya Pradesh. - The applicant should belong to Other Backward Classes (OBC) as per the list declared by the Government of Madhya Pradesh. - The applicant should have appeared and secured first, second, or third position in entrance examinations (PET, PPT, or MCA) conducted by the Professional Examination Board. - The applicant should be pursuing technical and vocational subjects.
benefits: Prize Money - First Position: ₹1,00,000/- - Second Position: ₹50,000/- - Third Position: ₹25,000/-
summary: "M.P. Professional Talent Examination Award Scheme" aims to recognize and reward backward-class students who excel in professional entrance examinations. Monetary awards are provided to backward-class students who secure the top three positions in entrance examinations like PET, PPT, and MCA.

title: Mukhyamantree Baal Aasheervaad Yojana
eligibility_details:
For After Care 1. Children residing in childcare institutions continuously for 05 years including the year of release date. 1. In the case of an orphan, abandoned child, an exemption will be given in the eligibility related to the period required for residence in the childcare institution. 1. If the child is not getting the benefit of adoption, foster care, but the child is rehabilitated in the child care institution and the period of adoption and foster care will also be counted in the eligibility period. 1. Financial assistance, internship, vocational training, and education will be given for the prescribed time period or till the age of 24 years, whichever is earlier.
For Sponsorship: - Children should be below 18 years of age. - The child's parents have died. - The child should be living with their relative or guardian - Relative/guardian should not come under eligibility under Mukhyamantri covid 19 Bal Seva Yojana,
benefits: Assistance under the scheme will be of two types - 1. AfterCare > Internship - > Internships, employment will be provided according to the qualification of the person. Rs. 5,000/- per month will be given during the internship period, which will be payable till the end of the internship period or one year, whichever is less, but in any case it will not be for a period of more than 01 year. > Vocational training - > Vocational training in government institutions given under Polytechnic Diploma, ITI, Paramedical courses, Nursing, Hotel Management, Tourism, Pradhan Mantri/Chief Minister Skill Development etc. will be provided free of cost by the concerned department. Financial assistance of Rs. 5,000/- per month will be given during the vocational training period, which will be payable till the end of the vocational training period or two years, whichever is less, but in any case it will not be for a period of more than 02 years. > Technical Education, Medical Education and Ayush Education and Legal Education Assistance - > On the basis of entrance examinations in NEET, JEE or CLAT, care leavers who have taken admission to any government/non-government institutions will be given financial assistance of Rs.5,000 to Rs.8,000 per month during the study period and the fee fixed by the Fee Regulatory Commission will be borne by the state government till the course period. 1. Sponsorship > Economic Assistance- > Each child found eligible under the scheme will be given an amount of Rs.4000/- per month, which will be deposited in the joint account of the child and relative or guardian, which will be for a minimum period of 01 year. In the event of no improvement in the economic prosperity of the child or the family, the period can be increased, but in any case the amount will not be payable after the maximum age of 18 years. > Medical Aid - Ayushman card of each child will be prepared by the health department for providing medical aid. District Program Officer, Women and Child Development Department will make necessary information including the list of children available to the Chief Medical and Health Officer for making Ayushman cards.
summary: Madhya Pradesh State government started a scheme "Mukhyamantri Baal Aashirwad Yojana" for orphan youngsters.

title: Mukhyamantri Jankalyan (Shiksha Protsahan Yojna)
ministry: Technical Education and Man Power Planning Department
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant's mother/father should be registered as an unorganized worker in the Labor Department of the Madhya Pradesh Government. 1. The student will be given the benefit of this scheme on admission to the Diploma/Degree and Certificate courses in Government Medical College and Paramedical Science conducted under it. 1. All the government and grant-aided colleges and universities of the state government, in which all graduates and postgraduate courses under the State Higher Education Department, all diploma courses and ITIs conducted in polytechnic colleges, will be given the benefit of this scheme to the students. 1. The benefit of this scheme will be given even after getting admission in the graduation program and integrated post-graduation program conducted in all university institutions of the state government or government of India. 1. For engineering, in the case of fees coming under 1.5 lakh in JEE Mains, full fees will be given upon taking admission in government engineering college and 1.5 lakh rupees and actual tuition fee, whichever is less, will be provided upon admission in aided college. 1. If students have taken admission through the NEET entrance exam for medical studies in MBBS/VIDEO medical and dental college of Central or State Government or MBBS course of private medical located in the college, then the students are eligible to get the benefit of this scheme. are eligible. 1. The benefit of this scheme will also be given on getting admission to National Law University or Delhi University through the Common Law Admission Test for the study of law and the examination conducted by itself.
benefits: 1. The tuition fees for all such students on admission to graduate, polytechnic, diploma and ITI courses will be borne by the state government. 1. For all these courses, the admission fee and actual fee will also be paid by the government as an expenditure. 1. Mess charges and caution money charges are not included in this. 1. Only that fee will be included under this scheme, which has been determined by the Regulatory Committee or Madhya Pradesh Private University Regulatory Commission and the State Government of India. 1. The students of the state will be able to get education. 1. Students will not have to face any financial crunch to get an education. 1. Reducing the unemployment rate of the state. 1. The standard of living of the citizens of the state will also improve.
summary: This scheme has been launched by the Government of Madhya Pradesh. Through the Mukhyamantri Jankalyan Shiksha Protsahan Yojana, financial assistance will be provided for education to students of Madhya Pradesh.

title: Pichda Varg Post Matric Chhatravritti
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a native of Madhya Pradesh belonging to a backward class. 1. The applicant should be passed in the previous class. 1. The total annual income of parents/guardians should not exceed ₹3,00,000/-.
benefits:
- Monthly subsistence allowance : ClassHostel roomNon-hostelerGraduate₹400/-₹230/-Postgraduate₹450/-₹230/-M.Phil, P.H. D.₹850/-₹380/-
Important Point - Reimbursement of non-refundable fees compulsorily paid by the student. - Reimbursement of full tuition fees and other mandatory fees to the students of self-financed courses run in government colleges/government universities. - Payment of fees for enrolment/registration, tuition, sports, uniform, library, magazines, medical check-up,s etc.
summary: Under Pichda Varg Post Matric Chhatravritti Madhya Pradesh Government aimed at providing financial assistance to economically disadvantaged students belonging to these marginalized communities.

title: Post Matric and Top Class Scholarship
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant Should be studying in graduate/post-graduate courses. 1. The maximum annual income of the guardian should be ₹2,50,00/- for post-matric and ₹6,00,000/- for top class. 1. The applicant has 40 percent or more disability.
benefits: 1. Hostel students receive a subsistence allowance of ₹1,200 per month. 1. Non-hostel residents are provided with a subsistence allowance of ₹650 per month. Reimbursement of mandatory and non-refundable fees.
summary: The Scheme Post Matric and Top Class Scholarship for Madhya Pradesh is provide financial assistance to students from economically disadvantaged backgrounds to pursue higher education.

title: Post Matric College Scholarship (Scheduled Caste)
ministry: Tribal Welfare and Scheduled Caste (SC) Department
eligibility_details:
1. The applicant must be a student. 1. The student should belong to the Scheduled Caste category. 1. The student must come from a family with an income limit of up to ₹6.00 lakh to qualify.
Note: One-third of the subsistence allowance will be payable to students residing in departmental hostels who are provided with free lodging/boarding facilities.
benefits: Post-matric students are provided with scholarships.
summary: Launched in 1976-77, the "Post Matric College Scholarship" is a scheme by the Scheduled Caste Welfare Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme provides financial assistance to encourage Scheduled Caste students to pursue higher education.

title: Post Matric Scholarship for Class 11th 12th And College
ministry: Tribal Welfare and Scheduled Caste (SC) Department
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a native of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should be from the Scheduled Tribe category. 1. The applicant should be studying in class 11th, 12th, college, PhD, or professional courses. 1. The applicant should be studying in a government or government self-financed educational institution (income limit restriction has been abolished for these institutions). 1. The parents/guardians of the applicant should have an annual income of up to ₹6.00 lakh if the student is studying in a non-government institution (non-professional courses). 1. The applicant should be eligible for the payment of half the non-refundable compulsory fees, including tuition fees, at prescribed rates for government-related courses.
benefits: This scholarship is provided to Scheduled Tribe students.
summary: The scheme "Post-Matric Scholarship" started in 1945 by the Tribal Welfare and Scheduled Caste (SC) Department, Madhya Pradesh, provides scholarships to Scheduled Tribe students studying in classes 11th, 12th, Colleges, PhD, and Professional Courses.

title: Post Matric Students of Class 11th &12th ( Scheduled Caste)
ministry: Tribal Welfare and Scheduled Caste (SC) Department
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste (SC) category. 1. The student should be enrolled in Class 11th or 12th in a recognized educational institution. 1. The student should provide a valid income certificate of the family, confirming that the annual income is below the prescribed limit. 1. The guardian should provide a declaration stating that there has been no increase in the family income for the last financial year.
benefits: The facility of reimbursement of scholarship fee is provided to the students of class 11th and 12th.
summary: Launched in 1976-77, the "Post Matric Students of Class 11th &12th " scheme is a welfare initiative by the Scheduled Caste Welfare Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme provides a facility for the reimbursement of scholarship fees to students.

title: Post Metric Scholarship - Madhya Pradesh
eligibility_details: • The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste category. • If the applicant studying in non-government institutions, the annual income limit of parents/guardians is up to ₹6,00,000/-. • There is no income limit for government institutions.
benefits: 1. Reimbursement of full fee for professional courses when the fee is fixed by the Admission and Fee Regulatory Commission. 1. Reimbursement of full fee prescribed in the course of government institutions 1. In the courses of non-government colleges, half of the compulsory fee is reimbursed up to the income limit of ₹2,50,000/-, and for students with an income limit of ₹2,50,000/- to ₹6,00,000/-. 1. Monthly living allowance in undergraduate and postgraduate courses- - Non-hosteler- ₹300/- - Hostel - ₹570/-
summary: Under the Post-Matric Scholarship is a Madhya Pradesh Government initiative to provide financial assistance to economically weaker social class students to pursue higher education after matriculation.

title: Post Metric Scholarship (Denotified, Nomadic and Semi-Nomadic)
ministry: Department of De-notified, Nomadic and Semi-nomadic Welfare Department
eligibility_details: - The applicant should be from a Denotified, Nomadic, or Semi-Nomadic Community. - The applicant should be from a family with an annual income of less than or equal to ₹2,50,000/-. - The applicant should be a Student. - The applicant should be enrolled in a government institution where the mandatory fees, including prescribed tuition and examination fees, are paid. - The applicant should not have failed in any academic year.
benefits: - Fee Reimbursement for Class 11th: Upto ₹210/-. - Fee Reimbursement for Class 12th: Upto ₹1,110/-. *The sanctioning authority: determines the full/half fee reimbursement faculty-wise, based on eligibility within the maximum limit.
summary: The "Post-Metric Scholarship" scheme, implemented by the Department of Denotified, Nomadic, and Semi-Nomadic Welfare, Government of Madhya Pradesh, provides financial assistance to students from class 11 to college level, including medical, engineering, science other courses.

title: Post Metric Scholarship For OBC Students
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. Annual family income is up to Rs 3,00,000/- 1. Have passed Class 10. 1. Belong to the OBC category.
benefits: - The benefit of the scholarship depends on the annual family income of the students, institution, course, course subscriber, fee capping, etc. - All students whose annual family income is up to Rs 3,00,000, those students will be eligible for a 100% scholarship.
summary: This scheme is to provide financial assistance to the Other Backward Classes students studying at the post-matriculation stage to enable students to complete their education.

title: Pratibha Kiran Scholarship
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant of the scheme should be a permanent resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant can be a resident of the urban area of MP state. 1. The candidate of the scheme should have passed class 12th with 60% or more then. 1. The candidate who wants to apply for the scheme should belong below the poverty line. Financial assistance under the scheme will only be provided to BPL girl students.
benefits: - Assistance up to ₹5000/- is provided annually to the girl student.
summary: Pratibha Kiran Scholarship has been launched by the Government of Madhya Pradesh. Through this scheme, scholarship will be provided every year to girl students living below the poverty line.

title: Pratibha Yojana
ministry: Tribal Welfare and Scheduled Caste (SC) Department
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a student. 1. The student should be a native of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The student should belong to the Scheduled Tribe category. 1. The applicant's annual family income should not exceed ₹6,00,000/-. 1. The student should have qualified in any of the National Competitive Examinations such as JEE, NEET, CLAT, AIIMS, or NDA. 1. The applicant should have been admitted to one of the following institutions: - IIT/NIT through JEE - Government colleges in Madhya Pradesh for NEET (MBBS only) - AIIMS - NLU through CLAT - NDA through UPSC Note 1: The applicant's Aadhaar must be linked to the bank account. Note 2: The applicant must have the receipt of admission to the institute.
benefits: Under this scheme, eligible students are provided with the following incentives: - A financial assistance of ₹50,000/- is provided to students whose annual parental income is up to ₹3,00,000/-. - A financial assistance of ₹25,000/- is provided to students whose annual parental income exceeds ₹3,00,000/-. Note: The incentive amount is paid into the applicant’s bank account linked to Aadhaar.
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance to Scheduled Tribe students who have passed national competitive examinations such as JEE, NEET, CLAT, AIIMS, and NDA, and have taken admission in IIT, NIT, NLU, MBBS (government colleges located in Madhya Pradesh), AIIMS or NDA.

title: Pre-Matric Scholarship for Backward Class Students
ministry: Backward Classes and Minorities Welfare Department
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a student of classes 6th to 10th. 1. The parents/guardians of the applicant should not be income taxpayers. 1. The parents/guardians of the applicant should not own more than 10 acres of land.
benefits: Classes 6th to 8th - Boys: ₹20/- per month - Girls: ₹30/- per month Classes 9th to 10th - Boys: ₹30/- per month - Girls: ₹40/- per month NOTE: The scheme is individual in nature, covering all of Madhya Pradesh. Scholarships are awarded for 10 months annually and paid in one installment on 30th September.
summary: The scheme "Pre-Matric Scholarship for Backward Class Students" aims to provide financial assistance to backward class students studying at the pre-matriculation level in India. Monthly scholarships of varying amounts are provided to eligible students.

title: Primary Education Scholarship (Madhya Pradesh)
ministry: Department of De-notified, Nomadic and Semi-nomadic Welfare Department
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a student. 1. The applicant should be from a De-Notified (https://samarth.mp.gov.in/Public/Pages/TribesDetail?ID=2), Nomadic, or Semi-Nomadic (https://samarth.mp.gov.in/Public/Pages/TribesDetail?ID=1) Community. *The applicant should not need to apply again for renewal while continuing in classes of the same rate (e.g., classes 1 to 5). *The applicant should be eligible for the scholarship even if they fail one academic year.
benefits: Scholarship of ₹150/- for 10 months at the rate of ₹15/- per month.
summary: The "Primary Education Scholarship" scheme provides ₹150/- annually to students from De-notified, Nomadic, and Semi-Nomadic communities who are studying in classes 1st to 5th. The scholarship distribution is managed through the Directorate of Public Education, Government of Madhya Pradesh.

title: Rani Durgavati and Shankarshah Puraskar Scheme (Reward Scheme for Meritorious Students)
ministry: Tribal Welfare and Scheduled Caste (SC) Department
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should be a Student. 1. The applicant should be from a Scheduled Tribe (ST), or Scheduled Caste (SC) category. 1. The applicant should be enrolled in Class 10th or 12th. 1. The applicant should be selected based on the merit list of the 10th and 12th board examinations conducted by the Board of Secondary Education, Madhya Pradesh.

summary: "Rani Durgavati and Shankarshah Puraskar Scheme (Reward Scheme for Meritorious Students)" provides awards ranging from ₹3,000/- to ₹51,000/- to the meritorious students from the Scheduled Tribe community based on their performance in the 10th and 12th board examinations.

title: Refund of Fees
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be admitted to a college. 1. The applicant should be a native of Madhya Pradesh.
benefits: Refund of remaining fees (after deducting ₹100) if the student leaves
summary: Under the "Refund of Fees" Scheme, Higher Education Department, Madhya Pradesh, students can get a refund of the remaining fee (including caution money) after deducting ₹100 if they leave college, fail after provisional admission, or have their admission cancelled.

title: Reimbursement of Fees of ST Students Studying in Sainik School Private Institutions
ministry: Tribal Welfare and Scheduled Caste (SC) Department
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a native of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Tribe (ST) category. 1. The applicant must be enrolled in a recognized Sainik School or private institution covered under the scheme.
benefits: Free arrangement for accommodation, school fees and studies for the students.
summary: The "Reimbursement of Fees for ST Students" scheme by the Tribal Welfare Department, Madhya Pradesh, offers free accommodation, school fees, and education for eligible students in Sainik Schools and private institutions.

title: Research (PhD) Scholarship for SC/ST Students
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a native of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should be registered for PhD research at a recognized university in India, having, following an interview with the Research Degree Committee. 1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribe category. 1. The applicant should have obtained the minimum qualifying marks in their postgraduate degree as prescribed for SC/ST students by the University Grants Commission. 1. The annual income of the applicant’s parents or guardians should not exceed ₹3,00,000/-, as set by the Madhya Pradesh Government's Tribal Welfare Department. 1. Each year, a quota of 100 scholarships is allocated for Scheduled Castes and 56 scholarships for Scheduled Tribes.
benefits: - Under this scheme, SC/ST students registered for research (PhD) work at any university in India, following an interview with the Research Degree Committee, will receive a monthly scholarship of ₹16,000/-, totaling ₹1,92,000/- per year. - The scholarship is provided for a maximum period of 3 years, subject to meeting the prescribed eligibility criteria.
summary: The scheme is implemented by the Higher Education Department, Govt. of Madhya Pradesh, offers financial support for PhD research work to SC/ST students. Eligible students receive ₹16,000/- per month, totaling ₹1,92,000/- per year, which is directly transferred to their bank accounts.

title: Research Scholarship for Disabled Students
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a native of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should be a disabled student. 1. The applicant should be registered for PhD research work at any recognized university in India, following an interview with the Research Degree Committee. 1. The applicant should have obtained minimum qualifying marks in their postgraduate degree as specified by the University Grants Commission. 1. The annual income of the applicant's parents or guardians should not exceed ₹1,00,000/-. 1. Every year, 10 students are awarded scholarships for their PhD research.
benefits: - Under this scheme, differently-abled students who are registered for PhD research at any university in India receive a monthly scholarship of ₹16,000/-, totaling ₹1,92,000/- per year.
summary: The scheme is implemented by the Higher Education Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh, aims to provide financial support for PhD research to differently-abled students. Eligible candidates receive ₹16,000/- per month, which is directly transferred to their bank accounts.

title: Riyaayati Dar Par Copies Ka Vitaran
eligibility_details: 1. Applicant construction workers should be employed in industrial units/establishments falling within the circle's jurisdiction. 1. The benefit extends to a maximum of two children per worker. 1. It is mandatory for the concerned worker to deposit the amount of copies in the board through the institute.
benefits: - 10 Small Copies: ₹10/- per copy - 10 Registers : ₹14/- per register
summary: The Labor department of Madhya Pradesh state started the scheme "Riyaayati dar par Copies Ka Vitaran" for the children of construction worker.

The applicant's Academic Qualifications should be one of the following: - Post Graduate: 50% marks in degree examination. - Acharya: 50% marks in Shastri or equivalent examination. - Graduate: 50% marks in 10+2 or equivalent examination. - Shastri: 45% marks in Purva Madhyama. - Uttar Madhyama: 45% marks in Prathma or equivalent. - Purva Madhyama: On the basis of merit in the 5th examination.
