title: Scholarship for Children of Deceased/Disabled/Retired Government Employees
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The student should be studying in Class 1 to Class 12. 1. The student should be studying at a government school in Madhya Pradesh. 1. The student should be the child of a deceased, disabled, or retired government employee. 1. The student should not be a beneficiary of any other scholarship. 1. The student must have passed the previous class.
benefits: Under this scheme, scholarships will be given at the following rates:- - Class 1 to 5: ₹50/- per year for Boys and Girls students- Class 6 to 8: ₹120/- per year for Boys and Girls students- Class 9 to 12: ₹250/- per year for Boys and Girls students Note: The scholarship will be deposited directly into the student's bank account.
summary: The objective of this scheme is to motivate children of government employees who are deceased, retired, or disabled. Under this scheme, scholarships ranging from ₹50/- to ₹250/- are provided to children of these government employees who are studying in Class 1 to Class 12 in government schools.

title: Scholarship for Fatherless Girls
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a girl student. 1. The girl student should be a permanent resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The girl student should be studying in Class 1 to 12. 1. The girl student should be studying at a government school in Madhya Pradesh. 1. The girl student who has lost her father is eligible for benefits under this scheme. 1. The girl student should not be a beneficiary of any other scholarship. 1. The girl student should have passed the previous class.
benefits: Under this scheme, the scholarships will be given at the following rates:- - Class 1 to 5: ₹350/- per year - Class 6 to 8: ₹400/- per year - Class 9 to 12: ₹450/- per year Note: The scholarship will be deposited directly into the student's bank account.
summary: The objective of this scheme is to support the education of girls who have lost their fathers and are studying in government schools. Under this scheme, scholarships ranging from ₹350/- to ₹450/- are provided to eligible girls from Class 1 to Class 12.

title: Scholarships for Meritorious Students to Study Abroad
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a native of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should be seeking a postgraduate degree with at least 75% marks in their graduation from a recognized university/institute in Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should have an annual family income not exceeding ₹8 lakh from all sources. 1. The applicant should be under 25 years of age for postgraduate studies and under 35 years of age for PhD research. 1. The applicant should have secured admission to a study program abroad. 1. The applicant should have qualified for international tests such as GRE, GMAT, TOEFL, or IELTS. 1. The applicant should be pursuing a PhD and have: - 75% marks in postgraduate studies in the relevant subject. - Two years of teaching experience or an M.Phil degree in the relevant subject from a recognized university or government college in Madhya Pradesh.
benefits: Financial Support: Covers actual expenses or up to $38,000 annually, plus an additional $2,000 for books, equipment, typing, thesis binding, and other academic work. Total Amount: A maximum of $40,000 annually or its equivalent in the local currency is provided. Bond Requirement: The applicant must sign a bond for the entire amount received under the scheme.
summary: The Scholarships for Meritorious Students to Study Abroad by the Madhya Pradesh Government provides aid to 20 students yearly with family income under ₹8 lakh, 75% in postgraduation, and teaching experience or an M.Phil degree.

title: Senior Hostel (Scheduled Tribes)
ministry: Tribal Welfare and Scheduled Caste (SC) Department
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a native of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Tribes (ST) category. 1. The applicant should be a student of class 9th to 12th. 1. The applicant should be studying in a government or recognized school. 1. The applicant should have passed the previous year's examination.
benefits: Free Accommodation and Mess Facilities.
summary: Launched on 1st January 1966, the scheme "Senior Hostel (Scheduled Tribes)" by the Tribal Welfare and Scheduled Caste (SC) Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh provides free accommodation and mess facilities to students from studying in Class 9th to 12th in a government/recognized school.

title: Shaikshanik Chatravriti Yojana
eligibility_details: 1. Applicant must be a permanent resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The parents of the applicant must be working in a factory or institution established in Madhya Pradesh under the Labor Welfare Fund Act 1982. 1. Only 2 children in a family are eligible to get the benefit of this scheme. 1. Children of officers and employees in managerial capacities working in institutions cannot be benefited from this regime.
benefits: 1. M.Sc. 1. The scholarship amount will be paid by the student by e-payment through the Regional Office after the approval of the Welfare Commissioner as per the bank details given along with the application.
summary: Under MP Shram Kalyan Shaikshanik Chatravriti Yojana, scholarships will be provided to the students in the state to continue their education.

title: Shiksha Protsaahan Puraskaar yojana
eligibility_details: 1. The worker must be employed in an industrial unit or establishment located within the jurisdiction of the Madhya Pradesh Shram Kalyan Mandal. 1. Up to two children of such workers who have studied in educational institutions of Madhya Pradesh are eligible for the award. 1. The children must have secured at least 70% marks in their graduation, post-graduation, and BE examinations. 1. For MBBS students, the minimum required marks is 60% in their previous year's examination.
benefits: 1. General Graduate (B.A., B.Com, B.Sc., B.B.A.) : ₹10,000/- 1. Engineering (B.E./B.Tech.) : ₹15,000/- 1. M.B.B.S./ B.D.S. : ₹25,000/- 1. Pharmacy, Ayurvedic, Homeopathic (U.G., P.G. Diploma) : ₹12,500/- 1. Law Courses : ₹10,000/- 1. General P.G. Courses (M.A, M.Com, M.Sc, MBA) : ₹10,000/- 1. M.E/M.Tech : ₹11,500/-
summary: By the Labour Department of Madhya Pradesh, a scheme (Shiksha Protsahan Puraskar Yojana) was initiated for the financial assistance to the children.

title: Shram Kalyan Shaikshanik Chatravriti Yojana
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The parents of the applicant should be employed in a factory or institution established in Madhya Pradesh under the Labor Welfare Fund Act, 1982. 1. Only 2 children of a family are eligible to get the benefits of this scheme. 1. Children of officers and employees working in institutions with managerial capacity are not eligible to get the benefit of this scheme.
benefits: The scholarship is provided to the students studying From the class 5th to 12th, Graduation, Post Graduation, ITI, Polytechnic, PGDCA, DCA (Computer Course), B.E., M.B.B.S.
summary: Madhya Pradesh State Government started a scheme for the education of working labourers.

title: State Government Backward Class Scholarship (Class 6 to 10)
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a student. 1. The student should be a permanent resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The student should belong to the Backward Classes or Minorities community. 1. Students from Class 6 to 10 are eligible for the benefits under this scheme. 1. The parents or guardians should not be income taxpayers or own more than 10 acres of land. Note: There should not have been any increase in the income of the parents or guardians in the past year.
benefits: Under this scheme, scholarships are provided to Backward Classes students at the following rates: - Class 6 to 8: ₹200/- per year (for boys) and ₹300/- per year (for girls) - Class 9 to 10: ₹300/- per year (for boys) and ₹400/- per year (for girls) Note: The scholarship will be transferred directly into the student's bank account.
summary: The scheme is implemented by the School Education Department, Govt. of Madhya Pradesh, aims to ensure the continuity of education for students from the Backward Classes. Under this scheme, scholarships are provided to Backward Classes students studying in Classes 6 to 10.

title: State Government SC Scholarship (Class 1 to 10)
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a student. 1. The student should be a permanent resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The student should belong to the Scheduled Caste category. 1. Girl students from Class 1 to 5 and all students (both boys and girls) from Class 6 to 10 are eligible for the benefits under the scheme. 1. There is no restriction on the annual family income of the students. Note 1: One-time failure in a class is allowed. Note 2: There is no need to reapply for renewal within the same level (Class 1 to 10).
benefits: Under this scheme, scholarships for Scheduled Caste students are provided at the following rates: - Class 1 to 5: ₹250/- per year (for girls only) - Class 6 to 8: ₹200/- per year (for boys) and ₹600/- per year (for girls) - Class 9 to 10: ₹600/- per year (for boys) and ₹1,200/- per year (for girls) Note: The scholarship will be deposited directly into the student's bank account.
summary: The scheme was launched by School Education Department, Govt. of Madhya Pradesh, aims to improve educational status of SC students by providing scholarships. Under this scheme, scholarships are provided to SC girl students in Classes 1 to 5,and to both boys & girls in SC category in Classes 6 to 10.

title: State Government ST Scholarship (Class 1 to 8)
ministry: Tribal Welfare and Scheduled Caste (SC) Department
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a student. 1. The student should be a native of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The student should be enrolled in Classes 1 to 8. 1. The student should belong to any of the Special Backward Tribes, such as Baiga, Saharia, or Bharia. 1. There is no restriction on the students' annual family income. Note 1: The students will be eligible for scholarships even if they fail for 1 year. Note 2: Reapplication is not required for the renewal of the scholarship.
benefits: Under this scheme, scholarships will be provided to the students belonging to Scheduled Tribes at the following rates: For Classes 1 to 5: - ₹250/- per year (for 10 months) to all girls and boys belonging to special backward tribes (Baiga, Saharia, and Bharia). For Classes 6 to 8: - ₹200/- per year (for 10 months) for boys. - ₹600/- per year (for 10 months) for girls. Note: The scholarship will be deposited directly into the student's bank account.
summary: The scheme was launched by the Tribal Affairs Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh, aims to give benefits for improving the educational status of scheduled tribe students. Under this scheme, scholarships are provided to Scheduled Tribe students in Classes 1 to 8.

title: State Government ST Scholarship (Class 9 to 10)
ministry: Tribal Welfare and Scheduled Caste (SC) Department
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a student. 1. The student should be a native of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The student should be studying in Class 9 or Class 10. 1. The student should belong to the Scheduled Tribe category. 1. There is no restriction on the students' annual family income. Note 1: The students will be eligible for scholarships even if they fail for 1 year. Note 2: Reapplication is not required for the renewal of the scholarship.
benefits: Under this scheme, scholarships will be provided to Scheduled Tribe students at the following rates: - For Classes 9 to 10: ₹600/- per year for boys and ₹1,300/- per year for girls. Note: The scholarship amount will be transferred directly into the student's bank account.
summary: The scheme was launched by the Tribal Affairs Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh, aims to encourage education among Scheduled Tribe students and improve their educational status. This scheme provides scholarships to Scheduled Tribe students in Classes 9 and 10.

title: State Scholarship for Class 6th to 10th (Denotified, Nomadic and Semi-Nomadic )
ministry: Department of De-notified, Nomadic and Semi-nomadic Welfare Department
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a student. 1. The applicant should be from a Denotified, Nomadic, and Semi-Nomadic Community. 1. The applicant should be studying in Class 6th to 10th. *The applicant should be eligible for the scholarship even if they have failed one year. *The applicant should not need to reapply for renewal if they continue in the same category of classes (e.g., 6th to 8th or 9th to 10th).
benefits: Annual Scholarship (for 10 months): For Classes 6th to 8th - Boys: ₹200/- - Girls: ₹600/- For Classes 9th to 10th - Boys: ₹600/- - Girls: ₹1200/-
summary: The "State Scholarship for Classes 6th to 10th" scheme provides an annual scholarship ranging from ₹200/- to ₹1,200/- (for 10 months) to the students belonging to De-notified, Nomadic, and Semi-Nomadic communities studying in classes 6th to 10th.

title: State Scholarship of Class 1st to 5th (Scheduled Caste)
ministry: Tribal Welfare and Scheduled Caste (SC) Department
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a native of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste (SC) category. 1. The student should be enrolled in Class 1 to 5 in a recognized educational institution. 1. The student should be a regular student of the institution.
benefits: Scholarship amount of ₹200/- per year.
summary: Launched in 1966-67, the "State Scholarship of Class 1st to 5th" scheme is a welfare initiative by the Scheduled Caste Welfare Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme provides a scholarship amount of ₹200/- to Scheduled Caste students, which is disbursed until 31st October every year.

title: State Scholarship of Class 6th to 10th (Scheduled Caste)
ministry: Tribal Welfare and Scheduled Caste (SC) Department
eligibility_details: 1. The student should be a resident of Madhya Pradesh 1. The student should belong to the Scheduled Caste (SC) category. 1. The student should be enrolled in classes 6th to 10th in a recognized educational institution.. 1. The student should apply for the scholarship before the 31st of October.
benefits: Scholarship amount: Boy - ₹200/- ,Girl -₹600/- (for 10 months)
summary: Launched in 1966-67, the "State Scholarship for Class 6th to 10th" is a scheme by the Scheduled Caste Welfare Department, Govt of MP. It provides ₹200 per year for boys and ₹600 per year for girls from Scheduled Caste communities, until 31st October.

title: Student Welfare Scheme
ministry: Tribal Welfare and Scheduled Caste (SC) Department
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a student. 2. The student should be a native of Madhya Pradesh. 3. The student should be studying in Class 1 to 10. 4. The student should belong to the Scheduled Tribe category. 5. The student should be enrolled in a government or accredited and approved educational institution/school. 6. A student who has not received financial support from any other government scheme is eligible for this scheme. Note: Any aspect which is supported by any scheme availed, that aspect will not be provided by this scheme
benefits: Under this scheme, financial assistance is provided for the following: • For participation in special events such as art, cultural, intellectual, and scientific activities: ₹3,000/- • For tricycles for disabled students: ₹3,000/- • In case of untimely calamity or any emergency situation: ₹25,000/- • For special diseases such as cancer, TB, and heart disease, etc.: ₹10,000/- • In case of death: ₹25,000/-
summary: The objective of the scheme is to provide assistance to economically weaker ST students to meet their emergency needs in special circumstances. Under this scheme, financial assistance is provided to ST students studying in Class 1 to 10 in cases of urgency or emergency.

title: Study Abroad Scholarships (Scheduled Tribe)
ministry: Tribal Welfare and Scheduled Caste (SC) Department
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be 35 years old as of 1st January. 2. The applicant should have an annual income limit of ₹10 lakhs. 3. The applicant should meet the course duration requirements: - Postgraduate – 2 years - PhD – 4 years - Research – 1 year 6 months 4. The applicant should have the following educational qualifications: - For Postgraduate: Must have passed the graduation final examination with at least 55% marks. - For PhD: Must have passed the postgraduate examination with at least 50% marks. - The applicant should choose the foreign educational institution for admission independently. - The applicant should be applying for a postgraduate or higher-level degree.
benefits: 1. The scheme covers tuition fees of 40,000 US Dollars per year, along with a living allowance of 9,000 US Dollars and a contingency allowance of 1,000 US Dollars. 1. Additional expenses such as visa fees, insurance, poll tax, airfare, and rail/bus fare are also provided. NOTE: The fees are paid into the University account and subsistence/contingency allowance and other allowances are paid directly into the applicant's bank account.
summary: Launched in 2003, the scheme "Study Abroad Scholarships" by the Tribal Affairs Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh covers tuition fees of 40,000 US Dollars per year, along with a living allowance of 9,000 US Dollars and a contingency allowance of 1,000 US Dollars.

title: Subsistence and Transport Allowance to Disabled Students for Pursuing Education in Computer and Management
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a native of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should be a disabled student. 1. The student should be studying a Computer or Management subject/course at a government college. 1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribe category. 1. The annual income of the applicant's parents or guardians should not exceed ₹1,00,000/-.
benefits: Eligible students under this scheme will receive the following assistance: - Reimbursement of fees for computer and management courses. - A monthly subsistence allowance of ₹1,500/-. - A transport allowance of ₹500/- per month for those in Municipal Corporation areas and ₹300/- per month for those in Municipal Council areas.
summary: The scheme was implemented by Higher Education Department, Govt. of Madhya Pradesh, aims to provide incentives to disabled students. This scheme benefits students pursuing computer/management courses at government colleges, provided their annual parental/guardian income does not exceed ₹1.00 lakh.

title: Sudama Pre-Matric Scholarship Scheme (Class 9th to 10th)
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should be studying in Class 9 or Class 10. 1. The student should be enrolled in a government school. 1. The applicant should belong to the Below Poverty Line (BPL) category. 1. The applicant's family income from all sources should be less than ₹1,00,000/- per year. 1. The applicant should have passed the previous year's class.
benefits: - Under this scheme, the girl student will get a scholarship of ₹400/- and boy student will get a scholarship of ₹300/- per year.
summary: Under this scheme, scholarships are provided to students studying in Class 9 and Class 10 in government schools, whose annual family income is less than ₹1,00,000/- and who belong to the Below Poverty Line (BPL) category.

title: Sudama Shishyavritti Scheme (Class 11th and 12th)
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a student. 1. The student should be a resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The student should have passed the Class 10th board exam with a first division and be currently enrolled in 11th or 12th grade, residing in a hostel. 1. The student should be studying in a government school located at the district or development block headquarters within the state. 1. The applicant should belong to the Below Poverty Line (BPL) category. 1. The applicant's family income from all sources should be less than ₹1,00,000/- per year. 1. The applicant should have passed the previous year's class with first division.
benefits: Under this scheme, the girl student will get a scholarship of ₹5250/- and boy student will get a scholarship of ₹5000/- per year.
summary: Under this scheme, scholarships are provided to students studying in Class 11 and Class 12 in government schools who reside in a hostel, have an annual family income of less than ₹1,00,000/-, and belong to the Below Poverty Line (BPL) category.

title: Super 5000
eligibility_details: 1. Children of labor family native of Madhya Pradesh. 1. Children of registered laborers in the unorganized sector. 1. Only students who have passed the 10th/12th board examination conducted by the Madhya Pradesh Board of Secondary Education in a government school and included in the top 5000 children in the merit of the entire state. 1. It is necessary to be a student of the Government school of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The age of the construction worker should be more than 18 years and less than 60 years.
benefits: Scholarship Amount: Rs. 25,000/- only at once.
summary: In 2017, Madhya Pradesh State Government started a scheme "Super 5000" for student scholarships.

title: Swami Vivekananda Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme (Class 11th & 12th)
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should be studying in Class 11 or Class 12. 1. The student should be enrolled in a government school. 1. Students studying in Class 11 must have passed their 10th board examination with a first division, and students studying in Class 12 must have passed their Class 11 examination with a first division to be eligible for this scholarship. 1. The applicant should belong to the Below Poverty Line (BPL) category. 1. The applicant's parents' income from all sources should be less than ₹1,00,000/- per year.
benefits: - Under this scheme, the girl student will get a scholarship of ₹550/- per year and boy student will get a scholarship of ₹500/- per year. Note: The scholarship is sent directly to the student's bank account.
summary: Under this scheme, scholarships are provided to students studying in Class 11 and Class 12 in government schools, whose annual family income is less than ₹1,00,000/- and who belong to the Below Poverty Line (BPL) category.

title: Tuition Fee Reimbursement of Sainik/Public Schools
ministry: Department of De-notified, Nomadic and Semi-nomadic Welfare Department
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be from Denotified, Nomadic, or Semi-Nomadic Community. 1. The applicant should be a Student. 1. The applicant should be enrolled in a Sainik School or institution.
benefits: Reimburses Tuition Fees for Students Upon Admission to Sainik Schools or Institutions.
summary: The "Tuition Fee Reimbursement of Sainik/Public Schools" scheme by the Department of De-notified, Nomadic, and Semi-Nomadic Welfare, Government of Madhya Pradesh, reimburses tuition fees for eligible students enrolled in Sainik Schools or Institutions.

title: Videsh Siksha Yojana (MPBOCWWB)
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a child of a construction worker. 1. Either parent of the applicant should be registered with the Madhya Pradesh Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board and hold a valid identity card for a continuous period of 5 years. 1. To pursue a postgraduate degree, it is mandatory for the applicant to have passed the graduation degree with 60% marks in the first division or its equivalent grade. 1. For PhD degree, it is essential to have passed a postgraduate degree with 60% marks in the first division and 02 years of teaching/research/M.Phil degree in the relevant field. 1. If the student is receiving benefits from any other source, he/she will not be eligible for this scheme.
benefits: The following financial assistance will be provided to the applicant for pursuing education under the scheme:- - Tuition Fee: Payment of actual tuition fee or up to $40,000, whichever is less. - Subsistence Allowance: A maximum of $10,000 per year, based on the monthly expenditure in India and abroad as shown by the educational institution where the student is studying. - In addition to the visa fee and insurance premium, second-class rail/bus fare from the place of residence to the airport and back and actual economy-class airfare to the nearest place of the educational institution and back will be payable. Note: The amount of grant will be credited into the student's account as per the prescribed fee payment schedule of the educational institution upon production of a certificate of continuity of studies in the institution.
summary: The scheme, implemented by the Madhya Pradesh Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, provides assistance for studying abroad to the children of registered construction workers.Since 2019, this scheme has provided assistance upto 50 students annually in pursuing higher education abroad.

title: Vikramaditya Yojna
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must belong to the General category. 1. He/she must have scored at least 60% or more marks in the Class 12 examination. 1. The annual family income of the applicant should not exceed INR 1,20,000 (for higher education) and INR 54,000 (for graduation).
benefits: - Annual financial assistance of a maximum of ₹ 2,500/-
summary: The Department of Higher Education, Government of Madhya Pradesh has created this new scholarship scheme available for candidates belonging to the General categories.

title: Burial and Ex-gratia Payment Scheme in Case of Death of Unregistered Laborer During Work at Construction Site
eligibility_details: 1. The deceased construction worker should have been registered with the Madhya Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (MPBOCWWB). 1. The deceased construction worker should have held an active regular membership. 1. The only person who is a legal heir/dependent family member of the deceased registered worker is eligible to apply under the scheme. 1. The deceased worker should have valid identity card.
benefits: 1. Funeral Assistance: ₹3,000 payable in case of death of a construction laborer.1. Grace Amount: - Death due to an accident during construction work: ₹4,00,000/-. - Permanent disability due to an accident during construction work: ₹2,00,000/-.
summary: Launched in 2014, the "Funeral and Ex-gratia Payment Scheme for Unregistered Laborers" is a welfare scheme by the M.P. Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, Government of Madhya Pradesh, providing funeral assistance and ex-gratia payments in case of death or permanent disability.

title: Civil Services Incentive Scheme for Persons with Disabilities
ministry: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a native of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should have a disability of 40% or more. 1. A disabled candidate who passes any stage (preliminary examination, main examination, or final selection) of the Civil Services Examination conducted by the Union Public Service Commission (UPSC), New Delhi, or the Madhya Pradesh Public Service Commission (MPPSC), Indore, is eligible for the scheme. 1. The application form should be submitted within 6 months of the exam result declaration. 1. The incentive amount is provided only once per candidate at each stage of the examination. Note: As per the definition mentioned in Section-2 of the Persons with Disabilities (Equal Opportunities, Protection of Rights and Full Participation) Act, 1995, the disability should be 40% or more.
benefits: Under this scheme, eligible candidates will receive the following financial incentives: - ₹20,000/- on passing the preliminary examination. - ₹30,000/- on passing the main examination. - ₹20,000/- on final selection. Note: The incentive amount is directly transferred to the applicant's bank account.
summary: The objective of the scheme is to encourage disabled candidates who are successful at various stages of the Civil Services Examination conducted by the Union Public Service Commission (UPSC), New Delhi, and the Madhya Pradesh Public Service Commission (MPPSC), Indore.

title: Gausevak Training (Initial and Refresher)
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be in the age group of 18 to 35 years. 1. The applicant should be unemployed. 1. The applicant should be from a rural area. 1. The applicant should have passed the 10th standard. 1. The applicant should be a cow-helper.
benefits: Initial Training: Training cost: ₹6,000. Stipend: ₹1,200 for six months at ₹1,000 per month. Total: ₹7,200 per Gausevak. Refresher Training: Stipend: ₹500. Study material: ₹100. Total: ₹600 per Gausevak.
summary: The scheme "Gausevak Training (Initial and Refresher)" aims to empower educated unemployed rural youth with self-employment opportunities and the skills to provide primary veterinary services in remote rural areas. A 100% stipend of ₹6,000 for initial training and ₹500 for refresher training.

title: Kalyani Sahayata Yojana (Madhya Pradesh Labor Welfare Board)
category: Social welfare & Empowerment, Women and Child
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should be the widow of the deceased worker. 1. The deceased worker should have been employed in an industrial institution or establishment covered by the Madhya Pradesh Labor Welfare Fund Act, 1982, for at least one year prior to his death. 1. The deceased worker should have been registered with the Madhya Pradesh Labour Welfare Board. 1. The widow should not have remarried. 1. The widow should not be receiving financial assistance from any other government department. Note: The Board must have received regular contributions from the industrial institution or establishment for the deceased worker, in accordance with the rules.
benefits: - Under this scheme, eligible widows of deceased workers receive financial assistance of ₹6,000/- every six months, in June and December. This amounts to a total of ₹12,000/- per year. Time limit: The assistance amount will be paid to the concerned within 30 days of receipt of the application in the designated office for one year from the date of death of worker.
summary: Under this scheme, financial assistance of ₹6,000/- every six months (totaling ₹12,000/- per year) will be provided to the wife of a deceased worker employed in an industrial unit or establishment in Madhya Pradesh.

title: Mukhya Mantri Mahila Sashaktikaran Yojana
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a rape victim woman or girl. 1. The applicant should be a BPL woman saved from trafficking. 1. The applicant should be an acid attack victim. 1. The applicant should be a woman who completed their prison sentence. 1. The applicant should be a BPL woman who is abandoned/ divorced. 1. The applicant should be a girl/woman in distress residing in government and non-government shelter homes, girls’ homes, maintenance homes, etc. 1. The applicant should be a dowry victim woman. 1. The applicant should be a victim of child marriage.
benefits: Under this scheme, permanent training will be provided on various subjects like: - Pharmacy, Beautician, Hotel/Event Management - Nursing, Short Term Management Course (Cooking/Banking), Laboratory Assistant - Physiotherapy, I.T.I./Polytechnic Course, B.Ed./D.Ed. etc. Only from Government Institutions: - Aaya/Dai/Ward Nurse Hospitality, other training as the Government prescribes from time to time. Note: This training will be conducted by institutions whose degrees or certificates are recognized as valid for government and non-government services.
summary: Under this scheme, permanent training will be provided for the economic and social upliftment of women suffering from any form of violence and living in difficult circumstances so that they can get employment.

title: Strengthening Skills, Arts and Employment through ITIs
ministry: Department of De-notified, Nomadic and Semi-nomadic Welfare Department
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be from the De-notified, Nomadic, and Semi-Nomadic communities listed in Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should be a native of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should not be an income taxpayer. 1. The applicant's educational qualification should meet the course requirements.
benefits: The scheme provides employment-oriented training through ITIs, aiming to enhance traditional skills and offer employment or self-employment opportunities.
summary: The "Strengthening Skills, Arts, and Employment through ITIs" initiative by the Department of De-notified, Nomadic, and Semi-Nomadic Welfare, Government of Madhya Pradesh, aims to connect these skills with modern technology, short-term, employment-oriented training has been provided through ITIs.

title: Training on Artificial Insemination for Self-Employment
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be an unemployed youth. 1. The applicant should be at least 18 years old. 1. The applicant should have passed the 10th standard. 1. The applicant should have a keen interest in dairy farming and artificial insemination.
benefits: - Financial Support: Trained Gausevaks receive an honorarium of ₹4,000 and equipment worth ₹18,000.- Skill Development: Provides three months of free training in artificial insemination, including theory and practical sessions.
summary: The "Training on Artificial Insemination for Self-Employment" by the Animal Husbandry Department, Madhya Pradesh promotes milk production and employment. Trained Gausevaks get an honorarium of ₹4,000 and equipment worth ₹18,000.

title: Chief Minister Rural Path Vendor Loan Scheme
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should be a resident of a rural area. 1. The applicant should be a small trader or vendor from the rural poor class. 1. The applicant should not have defaulted on any prior government loans.
benefits: - Low-cost equipment or working capital is made available to poor migrant workers/ small traders of rural areas of the state in the form of loans through banks. - Entrepreneurship Development Training is to be provided to rural migrant workers through the "Self Employment Training Institute (RSET)" for setting up new businesses. - After training, an Interest-free loan of ₹10,000/- is provided by banks for setting up the business.
summary: "Chief Minister Rural Path Vendor Loan Scheme" by the Panchayat and Rural Development Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh provides working capital assistance of up to ₹10,000, promotes regular loan repayment, and trains entrepreneurs in business practices. The scheme targets small traders.

title: Mukhya mantri Swarojgar Yojana
category: Banking,Financial Services and Insurance, Business & Entrepreneurship
eligibility_details: - The applicant Should be a permanent resident of Madhya Pradesh. - The applicant should have passed in the 5th class. - The applicant’s age should be between 18 to 45 years. - The applicant’s family should not be an income taxpayer. - The applicant should not be a defaulter of any bank.
benefits: Financial help Margin money assistance - 15% of the project cost (maximum ₹.1,00,000 for the general category. - 30% of the cost (maximum ₹2,00,000) for Below Poverty Line( BPL) , Scheduled Castes(SC) , Scheduled Tribes(ST), Other Backward Classes(OBC) (except creamy layer)/ Women/ Minority/ Disabled project. Additional provisions - - 30% of the project cost (maximum ₹3,00,000 lakh) to the liberated nomadic and semi-nomadic tribes. - Bhopal gas victim family members are eligible for an additional 20% (maximum ₹1,00,000 on the project cost. interest subsidy - At the rate of 5% per annum of the project cost and for women entrepreneurs at the rate of 6% per annum, for a maximum of 7 years. (Maximum ₹25,000 per annum) - Guarantee Fee (CGTMSE/: CGFMU) Up to a maximum of 7 years at the prevailing rate.
summary: The scheme aims to provide benefits financial assistance, interest subsidies, and a guarantee. the government of Madhya Pradesh gives loans to the state's citizens to establish employment so that all citizens can start employment.

title: Mukhya Mantri Yuva Udyami Yojana
category: Banking,Financial Services and Insurance, Business & Entrepreneurship
eligibility_details: - The applicant should be a permanent resident of Madhya Pradesh. - The applicant should have passed Class 10th. - The applicant’s age should be between 18 to 40 years. - The benefit of this scheme can be availed only once.
benefits: Financial assistance: Margin money assistance - 15% of the capital cost of the project for the general category. (Maximum ₹ 12,00,000.) - 20% of the capital cost of the project for BPL (Maximum ₹ 18,00,000) Interest subsidy - At the rate of 5% per annum on the capital cost of the project and at the rate of 6% per annum for women entrepreneurs, for a maximum of 7 years. (Maximum Rs 5,00,000 lakh per year) - The guarantee fee will be paid at the current rate for up to 7 years.
summary: The scheme "Mukhya Mantri Yuva Udyami Yojana" was launched on 1st August 2014 by the Department of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises, Government of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme provides loans to the citizens of Madhya Pradesh who want to set up their industries.

title: Mukhyamantri Aarthik Kalyan Yojana
ministry: Industrial Policy and Investment Promotion Department
category: Business & Entrepreneurship, Banking,Financial Services and Insurance
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a native of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should be a member of the Scheduled Caste category. 1. The age of the applicant should be between 18 to 55 years as of the date of application. 1. The applicant should not be a defaulter/insolvent defaulter of any nationalized bank/financial institution/cooperative bank. 1. If a person is receiving assistance under any government entrepreneur/self-employment scheme, he will not be eligible under this scheme. 1. The applicant will be eligible for assistance under this scheme only once. Note 01: The working area of ​​the scheme will be the entire Madhya Pradesh (that is, the benefit of the scheme will be given only to those enterprises which are established within the Madhya Pradesh limits). Note 02: The scheme will be for the industry/service business sector.
benefits: 1. The maximum cost of the project under this scheme will be ₹50000/-. 1. Under this scheme, the margin money assistance at 50% of the project cost (maximum ₹15,000/-) will be payable by the government to the beneficiary. 1. The minimum period of the initial moratorium will be 6 months and after the initial moratorium, the loan repayment will be in 5 years.
summary: The scheme “Mukhyamantri Aarthik Kalyan Yojana” was launched by the Department of Industrial Policy and Investment Promotion, Government of Madhya Pradesh on 1st August 2014.

title: Sant Ravi Das Swarojgaar Yojana
ministry: Tribal Welfare and Scheduled Caste (SC) Department
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should be between 18 and 40 years of age. 1. The applicant should be belong to Scheduled Caste category. 1. The applicant should have a minimum educational qualification of 12th class passed. 1. The applicant's annual family income should not exceed ₹12.00 lakhs. 1. The applicant should not be a defaulter of any bank or financial institution, including MFI, NBFC, SFB, or PACS. 1. The applicant should not currently be a beneficiary of any other self-employment scheme of the state or central government. 1. Family Definition: - If unmarried: The applicant and dependent parents. - If married: The applicant, spouse, and dependent children (no age bar for dependent, unmarried children).
benefits: 1. Scheduled Caste beneficiaries can receive a 5% annual interest subsidy on Term and Working Capital Loans for up to 7 years, including the moratorium period. 1. The subsidy is provided on the condition of regular loan repayment as per the prescribed schedule.
summary: The Sant Ravi Das Swarojgaar Yojana under the Tribal Welfare and SC Department, Madhya Pradesh, provides funding for manufacturing units (₹1 lakh to ₹50 lakh) and service/retail trade projects (₹1 lakh to ₹25 lakh) for Scheduled Caste applicants.

title: Funeral Assistance Scheme (Madhya Pradesh)
ministry: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a native of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The deceased should have been a member of a family registered under the labour cadre schemes operated by the Government of Madhya Pradesh.
benefits: A financial assistance of ₹3,000/- is provided.
summary: Launched on 13th August 2013, the "Funeral Assistance Scheme" by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Govt. Madhya Pradesh provides ₹3,000/- for the last rites of destitute or unclaimed bodies. The scheme also supports families registered under labour schemes.

title: Kishori Balika Yojana (Madhya Pradesh)
category: Women and Child, Skills & Employment, Health & Wellness
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should be a girl. 1. The applicant should be aged between 11 and 18 years. 1. The applicant should be from one of the following categories: General, Other Backward Class (OBC), Scheduled Castes (SC), Scheduled Tribes (ST).
benefits: - Each Anganwadi center selects 2 adolescent girls, 1 Anganwadi worker, and 1 Auxiliary Nurse Midwife (ANM) for a two-day master trainer training at monthly intervals. - Master trainers provide vocational, health, and hygiene training at the Gram Panchayat level. - A two-day master trainer training program is provided at monthly intervals.
summary: The scheme "Kishori Balika Yojana" by the Department of Women and Child Development, Government of Madhya Pradesh aims to provide vocational, health, and hygiene training to adolescent girls. Through this scheme, training and material assistance are provided to the girls.

title: Medical Aid Scheme (Ayushman Bharat Scheme 'Niramaya') (MPBOCWWB)
eligibility_details: For Registration 1. The applicant should be a resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should be a Building/ Construction Worker. 1. The applicant should be between 18 and 60 years. 1. The applicant should have engaged in any building or other construction work for at least 90 days during the preceding 12 months. 1. The registration of the applicant should be renewed annually. For Application 1. The applicant should be a female construction worker with a valid identity card, in case of maternity. 1. The applicant should be a male construction worker with a valid identity card, in case of his wife's delivery.
benefits: Free medical treatment up to ₹5,00,000/- per year.
summary: The "Medical Aid Scheme (Ayushman Bharat Scheme 'Niramaya')" under the Labour Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh, provides free medical treatment up to ₹5,00,000/- per year to the registered workers and their families in approved hospitals.

title: Medical Assistance to Beneficiaries (HPBOCWWB)
eligibility_details:
For Registration 1. The applicant should be a resident of Himachal Pradesh 1. The applicant should be a Building/ Construction Worker. 1. The applicant should be aged between 18 and 60 years. 1. The worker should have completed at least 90 days of building and other construction work in the last 12 months. 1. The registration of the applicant should be renewed annually.
For Application 1. The applicant must be engaged in building or construction work. 1. The applicant must be registered under the Himachal Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HPBOCWWB). 1. The worker’s membership with the Welfare Board must be active at the time of application.
benefits: - ₹50,000 is provided annually for outdoor medical treatment. - ₹1,00,000 is available each year for indoor medical expenses. - ₹5,00,000 is granted yearly for critical illness treatment for the registered beneficiary and dependents, with valid medical bills.
summary: The "Medical Assistance to Beneficiaries" scheme under the Labour and Employment Department HP, provides financial support for healthcare. It covers ₹50,000 for outdoor treatment, ₹1,00,000 for indoor treatment, and ₹5,00,000 for critical illnesses each year, upon submission of valid medical bills.

title: Udita Yojana
eligibility_details: - All adolescent girls and women aged 18 to 49 will be beneficiaries.
benefits: - Distribution of sanitary napkins, nutrition and health education, training on menstrual hygiene and nutrition and health issues in adolescent girls are done through Udita Corner established in Anganwadi centers.
summary: Madhya Pradesh State Government started "Udita Yojana" for women health promotions.

title: Chief Minister's Building and Other Construction Workers Housing (Rural) Scheme
eligibility_details: For Registration: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should be a Building/ Construction Worker. 1. The applicant should be between 18 and 60 years. 1. The applicant should have engaged in any building or other construction work for at least 90 days during the preceding 12 months. 1. The registration of the applicant should be renewed annually. For Application: 1. The applicant should not fulfil the eligibility criteria for housing grants under Indira Awas Yojana or Chief Minister Antyodaya Awas Yojana. 1. The applicant should have a family with a maximum of three hectares of agricultural land. 1. The applicant's family's maximum income from all sources should be up to ₹3 lakh per annum. 1. The applicant should have sufficient land available for house construction, as mentioned in clause 6 above. 1. The applicant should be eligible to receive land for housing from the government. 1. The applicant should be willing to construct a house on agricultural land owned by them. 1. The applicant should be eligible to obtain a landholder certificate in the village population. 1. The applicant should agree to obtain a bank loan for constructing a house with a 225 sq. ft. plinth area in the prescribed layout and provide their own contribution in the form of labour/material/inclusion.
benefits: 1. The Board reimburses a minimum loan grant of ₹50,000 to the beneficiary. 1. The Banks may approve an additional loan of up to ₹30,000 based on repayment capacity, with no role for the State Government. 1. The grant is limited to ₹50,000 per case. NOTE: The Board provides the grant to District Labour Offices, which distribute it to banks based on approved loan cases.
summary: Launched in 2013, the "Chief Minister's Building and Other Construction Workers Housing (Rural) Scheme" provides permanent houses to registered construction workers in rural areas of Madhya Pradesh.

title: Chief Minister's Building and Other Construction Workers Urban Housing Scheme (MPBOCWWB)
eligibility_details: For Registration 1. The applicant should be a resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should be a Building/ Construction Worker. 1. The applicant should be between 18 and 60 years. 1. The applicant should have engaged in any building or other construction work for at least 90 days during the preceding 12 months. 1. The registration of the applicant should be renewed annually. For Application 1. The construction workers with valid identity cards and registration as beneficiaries under the Act before the publication of the scheme in the Gazette. 1. The construction workers registered after the publication of the scheme in the Gazette will be eligible to receive benefits after 1 year from the registration date. 1. The beneficiaries must be registered under the Act to qualify for the scheme.
benefits: ₹1,00,000/- assistance to construction workers.
summary: The scheme was revised in 2018, the "Chief Minister's Building and Other Construction Workers Urban Housing Scheme," to provide an additional ₹1,00,000 assistance to eligible construction workers in urban areas, along with grants from the Central and State Governments.

title: Chief Ministers House Rent
ministry: Department of De-notified, Nomadic and Semi-nomadic Welfare Department
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be regularly admitted to colleges or equivalent institutions and not in any government hostel. 1. The applicant should be admitted before the last date and submit 'Appendix-B'. 1. The applicant should be within the income limit of the Post Metric Scholarship Scheme. 1. The applicant should be responsible for any excess rent beyond the prescribed allowance. 1. The applicant should be ineligible for the scheme if they fail in any year. 1. The applicant should be aware of the third-party evaluation and annual review of the scheme.
benefits: - ₹2,000/- per student in Bhopal, Indore, Jabalpur, Gwalior, and Ujjain. - ₹1,250/- at district headquarters. - ₹1,000/- in tehsil/development block headquarters and other cities. - Helps students with housing expenses.
summary: The "Chief Minister's House Rent" scheme by the Department of De-notified, Nomadic, and Semi-Nomadic Welfare, Government of Madhya Pradesh, provides ₹1,000 to ₹2,000 per student per month in Bhopal, Indore, Jabalpur, Gwalior, and Ujjain.

title: Construction Workers Night Shelter Scheme (MPBOCWWB)
eligibility_details: For Registration 1. The applicant should be a resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should be a Building/ Construction Worker. 1. The applicant should be between 18 and 60 years. 1. The applicant should have engaged in any building or other construction work for at least 90 days during the preceding 12 months. 1. The registration of the applicant should be renewed annually. For Application 1. The applicant should be a Construction worker. 1. The Construction worker and their family members should possess valid identity cards. 1. The Construction worker and their family members should have temporarily relocated from other places for work.
benefits: Night shelters for construction workers and their families.
summary: The "Construction Workers Night Shelter Scheme" by the Labour Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh provides for the construction of night shelters in urban areas and large Gram Panchayats. These shelters are intended for construction workers and their dependent family members.

title: Housing Assistance (Madhya Pradesh)
ministry: Tribal Welfare and Scheduled Caste (SC) Department
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a native of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should have passed class 12th from a government or non-government college. 1. The applicant should be enrolled in a graduate, graduate diploma, technical, or paramedical course. 1. The applicant should be regularly admitted in the course they are pursuing. 1. The applicant should not have received admission to a government hostel.
benefits: The scheme provides housing assistance to tribal boys/girls to continue their higher and higher education outside their home town (for whom hostels are not available).
summary: The scheme "Housing Assistance (Madhya Pradesh)" by the Tribal Welfare and Scheduled Caste (SC) Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh, provides housing support to tribal boys and girls pursuing higher education outside their hometown, where hostels are not available.

title: Mukhyamantri Aawasiye Bhu-Adhikaar Yojana
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant family does not have a residence to live independently. 1. The applicant family has less than 5 acres of land. 1. The applicant family holds the eligibility slip for obtaining ration from the Public Distribution System (PDS) shop. 1. No member of the applicant family is income tax payer. 1. No member of the applicant family is in government service. 1. The name of the applicant is registered in the voter list till January 01, 2021 in the village where he wants residential plot.
benefits: - Plot will be provided to all those families who do not have their own house.
summary: Revenue Department of Madhya Pradesh State started this scheme to provide residential plots.

title: Operation of SC Senior Hostel
ministry: Tribal Welfare and Scheduled Caste (SC) Department
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must belong to the Scheduled Caste category. 1. The applicant must be a native of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant must be a regular student of a recognized institution. 1. There is no income limit for senior hostels.
benefits:
Accommodation - Free boarding facilities - Free lodging facilities - Separate hostels for boys and girls - Junior, senior, and college-level accommodations
Additional Facilities - Sports equipment - Toilet kits - Library facilities - Scholarship (90% paid to joint account of Hostel Superintendent and Mess Secretary, 10% to student's account)
summary: The scheme "Operation of SC Senior Hostel" provides accommodations and a conducive learning environment for Scheduled Caste students. Through this scheme, separate junior, senior, and college hostels with free boarding and lodging facilities are provided to both boys and girls.

title: Running of Scheduled Caste Hostel
ministry: Tribal Welfare and Scheduled Caste (SC) Department
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a Student. 1. The applicant should be from a Scheduled Caste. 1. The applicant should be a native of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should be enrolled in a recognized institution. *The applicant should note that there is no income limit for admission to senior hostels.
benefits: - Scholarship, Free Food and Accommodation, Sports Equipment, Toiletry Kit, and Library Facilities. - 90% of the scholarship amount is paid in the joint account of the hostel superintendent and mess secretary (student) for running the mess. - 10% is paid in the student's account.
summary: The "Running of Scheduled Caste Hostels" scheme by the Tribal Welfare and Scheduled Caste (SC) Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh, aims to provide housing and a conducive study environment for Scheduled Caste students. Separate junior, senior, and college hostels are operated for boys & girls.

title: Scheduled Caste Boys/Girls Housing Assistance Scheme
ministry: Tribal Welfare and Scheduled Caste (SC) Department
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be from the Scheduled Caste (SC) category. 1. The applicant should be a native of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should be a College Student. 1. The applicant should meet the income limit prescribed under the Post Matric Scholarship Scheme. 1. The applicant should be residing outside their native city/village.
benefits: - ₹2,000/- per month, if the student is residing in a Divisional headquarters (Bhopal, Indore, Gwalior, Jabalpur, Ujjain). - ₹1,250/- per month, if the student is residing in Other District Headquarters. - ₹1,000/- per month, if the student is residing in a Tehsil/Development Block Headquarters.
summary: The scheme "Scheduled Caste Boys/Girls Housing Assistance Scheme" by the Tribal Welfare and Scheduled Caste (SC) Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh, provides financial support for residential facilities to Scheduled Caste students who are studying in colleges outside their native village/city.

title: Usha Kiran Yojana
eligibility_details: 1. All women of all age groups. 1. All children under the age of 18.
benefits: - Providing protection and support against domestic violence
summary: In 2007, Madhya Pradesh State Government started "Usha Kiran Yojana" for women.

title: Atal Graha Jyoti Yojana
eligibility_details: - The applicant must be a resident of Madhya Pradesh. - The applicant must be a domestic consumer with a monthly electricity consumption of up to 150 units. - The applicant must have an approved load of 1 kilowatt for their electricity connection.
benefits: - Reduced Electricity Bills: Consumers with a monthly consumption of up to 150 units receive a subsidized bill, minimizing their energy expenses. Note: The benefit is automatically applied through the billing system for eligible consumers.
summary: The scheme provides subsidized electricity bills to domestic consumers with monthly consumption up to 150 units, promoting energy conservation and reducing electricity costs for eligible beneficiaries.

title: 6 Varsh Se Adhik Aayu Ke Bahuviklang Aur Mansik Roop Se Aviksit Nisaktjan Ke Liye Sahayata Anudan Yojana
ministry: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities
eligibility_details: - The applicant should be a native of Madhya Pradesh. - The applicant should have a Certificate of 40 percent or more disability. - The applicant's name should be mentioned on the Samagra portal and verified on the Sparsh portal - The applicant should have an age certificate for being above six years of age.
benefits: Cash Benefits- ₹ 600/- per month
summary: The objective of the scheme is M.P. To assist multiple handicapped and mentally underdeveloped persons above the age of six years who are unable to earn a living.

title: Aahar Anudan Yojana
ministry: Tribal Welfare and Scheduled Caste (SC) Department
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a native of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should be a woman. 1. The applicant should be from the Baiga, Bharia or Saharia tribe. 1. The applicant or any member of the applicant's family should not be in government service. 1. The applicant or any member of the applicant's family should not be an income tax payee.
benefits: Financial Assistance of ₹1,000/- per month.
summary: The scheme "Aahar Anudan Yojana" provides monthly assistance of ₹1,000 to students, girls, and women from backward tribes like Baiga, Bharia, and Saharia. The scheme aims to combat malnutrition among special tribal families by ensuring access to nutritious food through financial assistance.

title: Aawaas Sahayata
ministry: Tribal Welfare and Scheduled Caste (SC) Department
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a native of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should be a student. 1. The student should have passed 12th grade from a Government or Non-Government college. 1. The student should be enrolled in a Graduate or Graduate Diploma course. 1. The student should be regularly admitted to a Technical or Paramedical course. 1. The student should not have secured admission to a Government hostel. 1. The student should be a tribal student pursuing higher education outside their hometown.
benefits: The scheme offers housing assistance to tribal students pursuing higher education outside their hometowns where hostels are unavailable.
summary: Launched in 2016, the "Aawaas Sahayata" scheme by the Department of Tribal Affairs, Madhya Pradesh, The scheme provides housing assistance to tribal students pursuing higher education outside their hometowns where hostels are unavailable.

title: Antim Sans‍kar Yojana ​
eligibility_details: 1. Construction worker must be registered with labor department. 1. Beneficiary must not be received assistance for last rites from any other department.
benefits: Lump sum financial assistance amount : ₹6,000/-
summary: This scheme "Antim Sanskar Yojana" started by the Labor department of Madhya Pradesh to provide the financial assistance in the case of death.

title: Chief Minister Help Scheme
ministry: Tribal Welfare and Scheduled Caste (SC) Department
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be from the Scheduled Tribe category. 1. There should have either been a birth of a child OR the death of a member of the applicant's family. 1. No member from the applicant's family should be employed in government service (Class 1/2/3) or a higher category post. 1. In the case of the birth of a child in the applicant's family, the benefits can only be availed for the first or second child of a couple.
benefits: On Birth of a Child: 50 kg of wheat, rice, and cooking utensils. On the Death of a Family Member: - 1 quintal of rice for the following districts: Mandla, Dindori, Balaghat, Shahdol, Anuppur and Umaria. - 1 quintal of wheat for the following districts: Jhabua, Alirajpur, Barwani, Ratlam, Hoshangabad, Betul, Sidhi, Seoni, Chhindwara, Dhar, Khargone, Khandwa, Burhanpur, Sheopur.
summary: Launched on 02-10-2019, the Chief Minister Help Scheme under the Tribal Welfare and Scheduled Caste (SC) Department, Madhya Pradesh, provides food distribution and material aid to Scheduled Tribe beneficiaries whose family members are not in government service.

title: Chief Minister Ladli Behna Yojana
category: Social welfare & Empowerment, Women and Child
eligibility_details: 1. Applicants must be local residents of Madhya Pradesh. 1. Applicants must be married, including widows, divorced and abandoned women. 1. Should have completed 23 years and less than 60 years of age as on January 01, in the calendar year of application.
benefits: - An amount of ₹1,000/- per month will be paid to each eligible woman in her eligibility period in the own Aadhaar linked DBT enabled bank account. - If a woman is below the age of 60 years and already receiving less than ₹1,000/- per month under any other Social Security Pension Scheme, then that woman will be reimbursed up to ₹1,000/-.
summary: In 2023, Madhya Pradesh State Government started "Chief Minister Ladli Behna Yojana" for women empowerment

title: Cycle Anudaan Yojana
eligibility_details: 1. Applicant must be a registered construction worker of the division with a valid identity card. 1. Applicant can get the scheme benefits only at once. 1. Applicant must working as registered construction workers for 3 consecutive years. 1. Bicycle purchased on a grant will be prohibited from sale for 3 years.
benefits: Financial Assistance : 90 percent of actual expenditure or ₹4,000/- whichever is less.
summary: A labor department initiated a scheme "Cycle Anudan Yojana' in 2018 for the construction worker of Madhya Pradesh and provide them financial assistance for cycle.

title: Cycle Distribution Scheme
ministry: Tribal Welfare and Scheduled Caste (SC) Department
category: Social welfare & Empowerment, Women and Child
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a girl student. 1. The girl student should be a native of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The girl student should be studying in Class 11. 1. The girl student should belong to the Scheduled Tribe category. 1. The girl student who did not receive a cycle in Class 9 is eligible under the scheme. 1. The girl student should travel more than 2 km to reach her school. 1. There is no restriction on the annual family income of the student.
benefits: - Under this scheme, a cash amount equal to the cost of the cycle credited directly to the bank account of the applicant.
summary: Under this scheme, tribal girl students in Class 11th who travel more than 2 km to reach school and did not receive a bicycle in Class 9th are given a cash amount equivalent to the cost of a bicycle.

title: Death Assistance Scheme (MPBOCWWB)
eligibility_details: 1. The construction worker must have passed away while he/she was registered with the Madhya Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (MPBOCWWB) when he/she died. 1. The construction worker must have passed away while he/she held an active regular membership with the MPBOCWWB. 1. Only the legal heir or dependent family member of the deceased registered worker is eligible to apply for benefits under the scheme. 1. The construction worker must have passed away while he/she had a valid identity card.
benefits: Funeral Assistance: ₹6,000/- Ex-gratia Payment: 1. In case of normal death: ₹2,00,000/- 1. In case of death due to accident: ₹4,00,000/- 1. In case of permanent disability due to accident: ₹2,0,000/- 1. In case of partial permanent disability due to accident: ₹1,00,000/-
summary: Launched on 2004, the scheme "Death Assistance Scheme" is a welfare scheme by the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (MPBOCWWB), Government of Madhya Pradesh. The scheme provides funeral assistance and ex-gratia payment to the heir of a worker in the event of their death.

title: Divyang Shiksha Protsahan Yojana
ministry: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should Be a native of Madhya Pradesh. 1. Disabled persons aged between 6 years to 18 years. 1. The applicant's percentage of disability is 40 or more. 1. The name should be mentioned on the Samagra portal and verified on the Sparsh portal.
benefits: Financial assistance : ₹ 600/- per month.
summary: Under this scheme, the Madhya Pradesh government provides financial support to Disabled children of the state.

title: Excellent Work Award Scheme for Social Worker of De-Notified Communities
ministry: Department of De-notified, Nomadic and Semi-nomadic Welfare Department
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a member of the De-notified, Nomadic, or Semi-Nomadic communities. 1. The applicant should be a social worker actively engaged in the all-round development, educational advancement, social service, economic development, and eradication of social evils within the De-notified, Nomadic, and Semi-Nomadic communities. 1. The applicant should be an original resident of Madhya Pradesh to qualify for the award.
benefits: Award of ₹1,00,000/- to a social worker.
summary: The "Excellent Work Award Scheme for Social Workers of De-notified Communities" by the Government of Madhya Pradesh awards ₹1,00,000/- to a social worker from De-notified, Nomadic, and Semi-Nomadic communities for outstanding contributions to their social and economic upliftment.

title: Gharelu Hinsa Ki Pidita Ke Liye Sahayta Yojana
eligibility_details: - The applicant must be permanent resident of Madhya Pradesh. - The applicant must be women and girls only. - The applicant must be affected by domestic violence.
benefits: The victim will be assisted as follows 1. If the disabilities of less than 40% resulting from damage to any part of the body, compensation of up to ₹2,00,000/- will be provided. 1. If the disability exceeds 40% due to damage to any part of the body, the compensation increases to a maximum of ₹4,00,000/-.
summary: The Madhya Pradesh State Government started "Gharelu Hinsa Peedit Ke Liye Sahayta" Yojana for victims of domestic violence in Madhya Pradesh, offering various types of assistance including financial aid, legal support, and shelter.

title: Indira Gandhi National Disabled Pension Scheme (Madhya Pradesh)
ministry: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should be a person with disability. 1. The applicant should have a disability of 80% or more. 1. The applicant’s age should be between 18 and 79 years. 1. The applicant should belong to a Below Poverty Line (BPL) family. 1. The applicant should not be receiving pension benefits under any other social security scheme.
benefits: The beneficiary will receive a monthly pension of ₹600/-.
summary: Launched on 1st April 2009, the scheme "Indira Gandhi National Disabled Pension Scheme" is a pension scheme by the Department of Social Welfare, Govt of Madhya Pradesh. In this scheme, a pension of ₹600/- is provided to differently-abled individuals from 'Below Poverty Line'.

title: Indira Gandhi National Vridhavastha Pension Yojana
ministry: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a native of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The age of the applicant (male or female) is 60 years or more. 1. The applicant should belong to a family living below the poverty line as per the criteria set by the Government of India.
benefits: Pension amount: ₹ 600/- per month.
summary: Under this scheme, the Madhya Pradesh government provides financial support to the citizens whose families live below the poverty line.

title: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme-Madhya Pradesh
ministry: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a domicile of the state of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should be from a Below Poverty Line (BPL) family. 1. The application should be aged between 40 to 79 years.
benefits: - The beneficiary will get a monthly pension of ₹ 600/-.
summary: The Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme is being operated to provide financial support to widowed women living below the poverty line.

title: Khiladi Protsahan Yojana
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a native of Madhya Pradesh. 1. Family members registered under MP Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board. 1. The applicant should be a bank account.
benefits: - On selection at various levels, incentive amount is payable as follows:- Levels(Category – A) Incentive amount on getting selected in district/divisional/state level sports.(Category – B) Incentive amount given by the Board for being winner in District/Divisional/State level game.At District Level₹10,000/-₹5,000/-At Division Level₹25,000/-₹15,000/-At State Level₹25,000/-₹30,000/-
summary: In 2017, the Madhya Pradesh Labour Department initiated the Khilaadee Protsaahan Yojana to provide financial assistance to players.

title: Ladli Laxmi Yojana
category: Social welfare & Empowerment, Women and Child
eligibility_details:
For Normal Cases 1. The girl child should be born on or after January 1, 2006. 1. The girl child should be registered in the local Anganwadi center. 1. Parents should be natives of Madhya Pradesh. 1. Parents should not be income taxpayers. 1. Family planning has been adopted after the birth of the second child. 1. Parents who have two or less than two children, family planning has been adopted after the birth of the second child. 1. The girl child born from the first delivery will be given benefits without family planning but It is necessary for the mother/father to adopt family planning in order to get the benefit for the second girl child.
For Special Cases 1. In a family where there are maximum 02 children and the mother or father has died, registration can be done till the girl child is 05 years old. But in this type of case, if the woman/man gets married for the second time and already has 02 children, then the daughter born from the second marriage will not get the benefit of the scheme. 1. If there are 03 girls together born at the time of first delivery, all three girls will get the benefit. 1. Girls born to women prisoners in jail will also be benefited under the scheme. 1. The benefit of the scheme will be given to a girl child born to a rape victim or a girl child. 1. The collector has been given the authority to approve the cases till 02 instead of 01 year in the cases where family planning has not been adopted due to health related reasons. 1. District collector will provide approval/rejection under special cases, after minutely examining the applications received late. 1. The application has to be made by the Superintendent of the Orphanage/Protection Home within 1 year of admission in the Orphanage and before the girl child attains the age of 5 years or within 1 year of adoption by the adoptive parents.
benefits: 1. An assurance certificate of ₹1,43,000/- is issued by the government in the name of the girl child. 1. From the time of registration, ₹6,000/- will be deposited in the Madhya Pradesh Ladli Laxmi Yojana Fund for five consecutive years, the total amount of ₹30,000/- will be deposited in the name of the girl child. 1. To girl child taking admission in class 6th: ₹2,000/- 1. To girl child taking admission in class 9th: ₹4,000/- 1. To girl child taking admission in class 11th: ₹6,000/- 1. To girl child taking admission in class 12th: ₹6,000/- 1. An incentive amount of ₹25,000/- in two equal installments in the first and last year of the course after taking admission to a graduate or professional course (course duration minimum two years) after class 12th. 1. Final payment of ₹1,00,000/- on completion of 21 years of age of the girl child, on appearing in class 12th examination and on the marriage of the girl child, after completing the age prescribed by the government.
summary: Ladli Lakshmi Yojana has been started in Madhya Pradesh for Girl Child in 2007.

title: Lalima Abhiyaan
eligibility_details: The applicant should be one of the following - - School-going girl. - Adolescent Girl. - Pregnant Woman. - Lactating Woman. - Child in the age group of 6 months to 10 years. - Woman of reproductive age group (19 to 49 years).
benefits: 1. Anemia Prevention: Free iron folic acid tablets are provided to combat anemia among children, adolescent girls, and women.1. Improved Nutrition: Awareness campaigns promote healthy diets and better nutrition practices, especially for adolescent girls and mothers.1. Collaborative Approach: The campaign is supported by multiple departments, including Public Health, AYUSH, and School Education, ensuring wide outreach.1. Mission Mode Operation: The campaign works in a focused, large-scale effort to quickly address anemia and improve health outcomes.
summary: The Lalima Abhiyaan aims to improve the health of children, adolescent girls, and women of reproductive age, and focuses on the prevention of anemia and nutrition awareness among adolescent girls.

title: Marriage Assistance Scheme (MPBOCWWB)
eligibility_details: For Registration - The applicant should be a resident of Madhya Pradesh. - The applicant should be a Building/ Construction Worker. - The applicant should be between 18 and 60 years. - The applicant should have engaged in any building or other construction work for at least 90 days during the preceding 12 months. - The registration of the applicant should be renewed annually. For Application - The applicant should be a registered female worker or the daughter of a registered worker. - The applicant should participate in the "Chief Minister Kanya Vivaah/Nikah Scheme". - The bride should be at least 18 years old. - The applicant should not have received similar assistance before.
benefits: - ₹55,000/- Total Assistance - ₹11,000/- Cash Support - ₹38,000/- For Materials - ₹6,000/- For Mass Marriage Organizer
summary: The scheme provides financial assistance for the marriage of a registered female worker herself (including one-time remarriage) and for up to two daughters of a registered worker. The scheme applies to the marriage of the female beneficiary herself and the legal, adopted, or stepdaughter of worker.

title: Maternity Support Scheme (MPBOCWWB)
category: Social welfare & Empowerment, Women and Child
eligibility_details: For Registration as a Building/ Construction Worker: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should be a Building/ Construction Worker. 1. The applicant should be between 18 and 60 years. 1. The applicant should have engaged in any building or other construction work for at least 90 days during the preceding 12 months. 1. The applicant should be registration is renewed annually. For the Application of the Welfare Scheme: 1. The applicant should be registered Under the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should be pregnant. 1. The worker's membership with the Welfare Board must be active at the time of application. NOTE: Assistance is limited to a maximum of three children.
benefits: 1. First Installment: ₹4,000 for registration of pregnancy in the first trimester.1. Second Installment: ₹12,000 for: - Delivery in government or authorized non-government hospitals under the Ayushman Bharat "Niramayam" program for pregnancy and delivery-related high-risk packages. - Registration of newborns after institutional birth. - Early breastfeeding of babies. - BCG, OPV, and Hep B vaccination for the infant. Total Amount: ₹16,000
summary: The "Maternity Support Scheme" by the MPBOCW Welfare Board, Labour Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh provides an amount of ₹16,000/- as maternity allowance, payable in two installments.

title: Mrityu Ki Dasha Me Antyeshti Evam Anugrah Sahayata Yojana
eligibility_details: 1. The worker must have been registered for at least 6 months before their death. 1. Death can be due to only natural causes or an accident. 1. The worker must have a valid identity card. 1. Benefit will only be provided to following successor- - Wife or husband (as the case may be) of a worker holding a valid identity card - Sons and unmarried and dependent daughters - Dependent parents - If there is none of the above, a family member who is dependent on the deceased worker.
benefits: 1. Funeral assistance- ₹6,000/- 1. Ex-gratia payment- - In case of normal death : ₹2,00,000/- - In case of death due to accident : ₹4,00,000/- - In case of permanent disability due to accident : ₹2,00,000/- - In case of partial permanent disability due to accident : ₹1,00,000/-
summary: This scheme "Mrityu ki Dasha Mein Antyeshti Evam Anugrah Sahayata Yojana" started by the Labor department of Madhya Pradesh to provide the financial assistance in the case of death.

title: Mukhya Mantri Shramik Seva Prasuti Sahayata Yojana
category: Social welfare & Empowerment, Women and Child
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a pregnant woman. 1. The applicant should be over 18 years of age. 1. The applicant should be registered as an unorganized worker. 1. The applicant should have the delivery in a government hospital. 1. The applicant should not already have had two live births.
benefits: First Installment: - ₹4,000/- during pregnancy. - Requires four prenatal check-ups by a doctor or ANM in the prescribed period until the last trimester. Second Installment: - ₹12,000/- for delivery in a government hospital. - Requires early breastfeeding initiation, registration of the newborn, and institutional birth. - Infant must receive 0 doses of BCG, OPV, and Hepatitis B vaccinations.
summary: Launched on 1st April 2018, the scheme "Mukhya Mantri Shramik Seva Prasuti Sahayata Yojana" by the Labour Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh, provides maternity support to pregnant women over 18 years of age who are registered as unorganized workers.

title: Mukhyamantri Anusuchit Jaati Vishesh Pariyojana Vitt Poshan Yojana
ministry: Tribal Welfare and Scheduled Caste (SC) Department
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be from the Scheduled Caste (SC) category. 1. The applicant should submit project proposals as per the norms set by the respective line departments. 1. The applicant should ensure that the project proposal is recommended by the concerned department and approved by the State Project Implementation Committee. 1. The applicant should meet any additional requirements as specified by the line departments for the specific project. 1. The applicant should ensure that the project aligns with the objectives of the Mukhyamantri Anusuchit Jaati Vishesh Pariyojana Vitt Poshan Yojana.
benefits: The scheme offers a 100% grant based on government approval for project proposals from line departments, recommended by the evaluation committee.
summary: The scheme "Mukhyamantri Anusuchit Jaati Vishesh Pariyojana Vitt Poshan Yojana" under the Tribal Welfare and Scheduled Caste Department, Madhya Pradesh, aims to provide financial assistance for special project proposals received in the interest of the Scheduled Caste (SC) category.
