This is a 100% State Sponsored Scheme, and only the permanent residents of the state of Punjab can apply for this scheme.
summary: Through the "Direct Lending Scheme", the Punjab Scheduled Castes Land Development & Finance Corporation (PSCLDFC) provides direct loans for the economic upliftment of the members of the Scheduled Castes and Handicapped People in the state of Punjab.

title: Disabled Person Pension Scheme - Punjab
ministry: Department of Social Security and Development of Women and Children
eligibility_details: 1. Applicant should be a Permanent Resident of Punjab. 1. Applicant should be Disabled and the Disability Percentage should be more than 50%. 1. The Annual Income of Family should not be more than Rs. 60,000/- per Year. 1. People with mental disabilities are eligible regardless of their specific disability.
benefits: Amount : ₹ 1,500/- per month
summary: Punjab State Government started a pension for disable person of the state.

title: Ex-gratia Scheme: Disability Compensation (P.B.O.C.W.W.B)
eligibility_details: *For Registration as a Building/ Construction Worker:* - The applicant should be a resident of Punjab. - The applicant should be a Building/ Construction Worker (Unorganised Worker). - The applicant should be between 18 and 60 years. - The applicant should have engaged in building and construction work for at least 90 days in a given year. - The applicant should have a monthly income of ₹15,000/- or below. - The applicant should not be a member of any other Welfare Fund established under any law. - The applicant should not have membership of the Employees' Provident Fund (EPF)/ National Pension System (NPS)/ Employees' State Insurance Corporation (ESIC). - The applicant should not be an income tax payer. *For the Application of the Welfare Scheme:* - The applicant should be a registered member Under the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of Punjab. - The member should have complete or partial disability. - The member should not possess Health Cards issued under the Bhagat Puran Singh Sehat Bima Yojna.
benefits: - Compensation for Complete Disability: Ex-gratia amount of ₹4,00,000/-. - Compensation for Partial Disability: Proportionate amount of ₹4,00,000/- shall be given on the basis of percentage of disability i.e., ₹4,000/- for each 1% disability and maximum of ₹4,00,000/-.
summary: The "Ex-gratia Scheme: Disability Compensation'' by the BOCW Welfare Board, Department of Labour, Punjab, is a welfare scheme that provides financial assistance to the registered worker in the event of complete or partial disability.

title: Family/ Widow Pension Scheme (P.B.O.C.W.W.B)
eligibility_details: *For Registration as a Building/ Construction Worker:* - The applicant should be a resident of Punjab. - The applicant should be a Building/ Construction Worker (Unorganised Worker). - The applicant should be between 18 and 60 years. - The applicant should have engaged in building and construction work for at least 90 days in a given year. - The applicant should have a monthly income of ₹15,000/- or below. - The applicant should not be a member of any other Welfare Fund established under any law. - The applicant should not have membership of the Employees' Provident Fund (EPF)/ National Pension System (NPS)/ Employees' State Insurance Corporation (ESIC). - The applicant should not be an income tax payer. *For the Application of the Welfare Scheme:* - The applicant should be a spouse of a deceased registered construction worker Under the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of Punjab. - The deceased worker should have completed 1 year of membership with the Board.
benefits: Financial Assistance: ₹1,000/- as family pension until remarriage. Note: - If both spouses are Board beneficiaries, the surviving spouse does not receive family pension. - But if the husband/wife, either remarried or he/she gets an old age pension from the Government then they shall not be eligible for family pension. - If both the husband and wife are the beneficiaries of the Board and both are getting pension then in the event of the death of one of them, the other one shall not be eligible for family pension. - If only one spouse receives a pension, then on the eve of death of the pensioner, the surviving spouse receives family pension until they become eligible for their own pension from the Board, at which point the family pension stops.
summary: The "Family/ Widow Pension Scheme'' by the BOCW Welfare Board, Department of Labour, Punjab, is a welfare scheme that provides pension to the spouse of a registered construction worker in the event of his/ her death.

title: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (Punjab)
ministry: Department of Social Security and Development of Women and Children
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Punjab. 1. The applicant should be a person with a disability. 1. The percentage of the disability should be 80% or more. 1. The applicant’s age should be between 18 and 80 years.
benefits: - Pension is Rs. 300/- per month (age 18-79 year) - Pension is Rs. 500/- per month (age 80 and above year)
summary: The "Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (IGNDPS)" provides ₹300/- per month to disabled persons (80% or more disability) aged 18 and above. After age 80, the amount increases to ₹500/-. Dwarfs are also eligible.

title: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (Punjab)
ministry: Department of Social Security and Development of Women and Children
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Punjab. 1. The applicant should be 60 years of age or older. 1. The applicant should be from a Below Poverty Line (BPL) family. 1. The applicant should not be receiving pension benefits under any social security scheme.
benefits: - ₹200/- month, for persons aged 60 to 79 years. - ₹500/- month, for persons aged 80 years and above.
summary: In this scheme, persons aged between 60 and 79 years receive a pension of ₹200/- per month, while those aged 80 years and above receive ₹500/- per month. The scheme applies only to persons belonging to the Below Poverty Line (BPL) category.

benefits: - Pension of ₹300/- per month for widows aged 40 to 79 years. - Pension of ₹500/- per month for widows aged 80 years and above.
summary: "Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme (IGNWPS)" provides a pension of ₹300/- per month to widows aged 40 years and above. After attaining the age of 80 years, the pension amount increases to ₹500/- per month.

summary: Under this scheme, the goal is to support girls from economically weaker families by providing assistance for transportation, enabling regular school attendance.

title: National Family Benefit Scheme (Punjab)

The family should be living Below the Poverty Line (BPL). 1. The deceased should have been between 18 and 60 years old.
benefits: Financial assistance of ₹20,000/-.
summary: The scheme "National Family Benefit Scheme (Punjab)" by the Department of Social Security and Development of Women and Children, Government of Punjab, provides a lump sum assistance of ₹20,000/- is provided to the bereaved household in the event of the death of their breadwinner.

title: Old Age Pension Scheme (P.B.O.C.W.W.B)

eligibility_details: *For Registration as a Building/ Construction Worker:* - The applicant should be a resident of Punjab. - The applicant should be a Building/ Construction Worker (Unorganised Worker). - The applicant should be between 18 and 60 years. - The applicant should have engaged in building and construction work for at least 90 days in a given year. - The applicant should have a monthly income of ₹15,000/- or below. - The applicant should not be a member of any other Welfare Fund established under any law. - The applicant should not have membership of the Employees' Provident Fund (EPF)/ National Pension System (NPS)/ Employees' State Insurance Corporation (ESIC). - The applicant should not be an income tax payer. *For the Application of the Welfare Scheme:* - The applicant should be a registered construction worker Under the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of Punjab. - The applicant should have completed at least 1 year of membership with the Board. - The worker should be a fully (100%) disabled person/ Person with Disabilities (PwD).

The applicant should have registered on an eCommerce platform after the notification of Rajasthan MSME Policy 2024. 1. MSME enterprise will only be eligible for benefits once for each component.
benefits: Financial Reimbursement for Digitization Equipment: - MSMEs are eligible for a one-time reimbursement of 75% of the cost incurred for purchasing software or equipment used in digitization of business process (such as POS systems, barcode scanners machine, inventory management software, etc.). - Maximum Limit: ₹50,000/- per MSME. Financial Reimbursement for eCommerce Platform Fee: - Reimbursement of 75% of the total fee (excluding shipping fees) charged by eCommerce platform. - Maximum Limit: ₹50,000/- per MSME. Note: Assistance would only be eligible for one eCommerce platform per MSME.
summary: The scheme offers MSMEs up to 75% reimbursement (max ₹50,000) for software/equipment costs for digitization, plus 75% of e-commerce platform fees (excl. shipping), also up to ₹50,000. Reimbursement is allowed for one e-commerce platform per MSME only.

title: Assistance for Quality Enhancement
eligibility_details: All Micro and Small Enterprises existing anywhere in Rajasthan will be required to comply with the following conditions to avail benefits under the scheme: 1. The enterprise will be required to have Udyam Registration Certificate (URC) as per MSME Development Act 2006. 1. The enterprise should apply for the one-time reimbursement within 12 months of obtaining the quality certification/(s). 1. Cost of certification will include documentation, testing, accreditation fee, consultation fee, and calibration charges (till the enterprise obtain the certificate), application fee, license fee and other relevant fees. 1. Certification should be related to the product or process of the enterprise. 1. The enterprise should be in commercial production at the time of disbursement and the assistance shall not be released to the closed unit. 1. One MSME enterprise can apply only once under the scheme.
benefits: One-Time Financial Assistance: - Reimbursement of up to 50% of the total cost incurred for obtaining quality certifications (e.g., BIS, FSSAI), system certifications (e.g., ISO, ZED), and Intellectual Property Rights (IPRs), subject to a maximum of ₹3,00,000/- per unit. Note: Micro and Small Enterprises may acquire such certifications from any government agency or an agency authorized by the Government of India or the Government of Rajasthan. Costs Covered: - Documentation and consultation fees - Testing and calibration charges - Accreditation, license, and application fees Mode of Disbursement: - The approved amount is directly transferred to the applicant’s authorized bank account.
summary: The scheme aims to support micro and small enterprises in obtaining quality and system certifications or IPRs. It offers up to 50% reimbursement of certification costs with a ceiling of ₹3,00,000.

title: Assistance to Pilgrims for Kailash Mansarovar Yatra - Rajasthan
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan. 1. The applicant should have successfully completed the Kailash Mansarovar Yatra through the Ministry of External Affairs, Government of India. 1. The applicant receives this grant only once in a lifetime. Note 1: 100 pilgrims are selected each year. If there are more applicants than available slots, selection is done through a lottery system. Note 2: After completing the trip, a certificate from the Ministry of External Affairs confirming the successful completion of the journey is required.
benefits: Financial Assistance - ₹1,00,000 per selected pilgrim after completing the Yatra. Mode of Disbursement Direct transfer to the beneficiary’s bank account via account payee cheque/demand draft, depending on departmental discretion. Note: - The Yatra must be completed through the Ministry of External Affairs, Government of India. - The benefit is available only once in a lifetime. - A maximum of 100 beneficiaries per year. - Selection via lottery if applications exceed the quota.
summary: The objective of this scheme is to provide financial support to residents of Rajasthan who successfully complete the Kailash Mansarovar Yatra organized by the Ministry of External Affairs, Govt. of India. Under this scheme, each pilgrim is granted financial assistance of up to ₹1,00,000/-.

title: Cash Amount for Encouraging Scheduled Tribe Sportsperson Students
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a student. 1. The applicant should be a resident of Scheduled Tribe area of Rajasthan. 1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Tribe category. 1. The applicant should participate in a national or international-level sports competition. 1. The applicant should have secured a top-three position at national or international level competition.
benefits: Students who have secured top positions at national and international levels are rewarded with the following incentives as a form of encouragement: - Cash Prize - Certificate of Appreciation - Memento
summary: Under this scheme, cash awards, certificates, and mementos are provided as a form of encouragement to Scheduled Tribe sportsperson students who secure the top three positions in national and international sports events.

title: Gadiya Lohar Raw Material Purchase Grant-in-aid Scheme
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan. 1. The applicant should belong to the Gadiya Lohar community.
benefits: - Under this scheme, the member of Gadia Lohar community of Rajasthan receives a one-time financial grant of ₹10,000/- to purchase raw materials for their business.
summary: Under this scheme, the state government provides financial assistance of ₹10,000/- as a one-time grant to the Gadia Lohar community of Rajasthan for purchasing raw materials and making themselves self-reliant in their business.

title: Mukhyamantri Vishesh Yogyajan Swaraozgar Yojana
eligibility_details: - The applicant should be a specially-abled person as per the Persons with Disabilities Act, 1995. - The applicant should have a minimum disability of 40% or more. - The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan. - The applicant should be between 18 and 55 years of age. - The annual income of the applicant’s family should not exceed ₹2,00,000/- from all sources. - The applicant should not have availed of benefits under any other self-employment subsidy scheme like "Kiyosk Yojana" etc. - The applicant should not have any overdue loans from banks, cooperative societies, or government institutions. - The applicant should possess a valid disability certificate and passbook.
benefits: *Financial Assistance* - Loan up to ₹5,00,000/- for starting self-employment. - Subsidy of 50% of the loan amount or a maximum of ₹50,000, whichever is lower. NOTE: The loan is provided as one-time financial support.
summary: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to specially-abled individuals for self-employment. Under this scheme, a loan of ₹5,00,000/- will be provided to specially-abled individuals in the state whose annual family income does not exceed ₹2,00,000/-, enabling them to start their own business.

title: Nirman Shramik Antrashtriya Khel Pratiyogiyo Hetu Protsahan Yojana
eligibility_details: 1. Applicant should be a resident of Rajasthan State. 1. For this scheme, those construction workers will be eligible, who are registered as labour under labour law. 1. Those building and other construction workers will be eligible who are registered as beneficiaries in the board under Section-12 of The Building and Other Construction Workers (Regulation of Employment and Conditions of Service) Act, 1996 and are depositing their contribution regularly. 1. In addition to the above, unmarried sons and daughters of construction workers will also be eligible for assistance under the scheme. Other Terms & Conditions: - The provisions of the scheme will not be applicable to any online gaming / betting-related competition. - Declaration of invalidity of Sportsperson or withdrawal of medals won by the participant due to doping or any valid reason stipulated by the organising committee no incentives will be payable under the scheme. - During scrutiny of the application and documents, if any facts are found to be false resulting in the cancellation of eligibility, it will be the responsibility of the concerned beneficiary to deposit all the assistance amount sanctioned under the scheme along with interest.
benefits: The incentive amount under this scheme for International level sports competition to the eligible beneficiary or his children will be given as follows: - - Participating in the competition- ₹ 2,00,000/- - On receiving the Bronze medal- ₹5,00,000/- - On receiving the Silver medal- ₹8,00,000/- - On receiving the Gold medal- ₹11,00,000/-
summary: The purpose of the Nirman Shramik Antrashtriya Khel Pratiyogiyo Hetu Protsahan Yojana is to encourage people employed in Labour Department building, other construction works to participate in international sports by providing them incentives for participating and excelling in international sports.

title: Sindhu Darshan Pilgrimage Scheme - Rajasthan
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan. 1. The applicant's age should be 21 years or above. 1. The applicant should not be a person who subsists on alms. 1. The applicant should not be an income tax payer. 1. The applicant should not be a retired employee/officer of the Central Government/State Government/Central & State Government Undertakings/Local Body. 1. Only one-time assistance per lifetime is permitted. Note: Only the person selected by the Devasthan Department, Rajasthan is eligible to get the benefit of the scheme.
benefits: - Reimbursement of 50% of actual travel expenses, up to a maximum of ₹10,000 per pilgrim. Note: Payment is made via online bank transfer or through account payee cheque or demand draft, depending on departmental conditions.
summary: The objective of this scheme is to provide financial assistance to pilgrims undertaking a pilgrimage to the Sindhu River in the Ladakh region of India. Under this scheme, selected beneficiaries receive reimbursement of their travel expenses, up to a maximum of ₹10,000/- per pilgrim.

title: Technology Acquisition Assistance
eligibility_details: All Micro and Small Enterprises existing anywhere in Rajasthan will be required to comply with the following conditions to avail benefits under the scheme: 1. The enterprise will be required to have Udyam Registration Certificate (URC) as per MSME Development Act 2006. 1. The acquisition of technology can be in any form, including purchase of drawing and design/ plant/ machinery/ software etc. 1. Acquired technology should be related to the production/ manufacturing process of the enterprise. 1. The applicant should clearly demonstrate improvement in performance due to technology acquisition. Mere purchase of machinery and technology will not be considered as technology acquisition. 1. The enterprise should be in commercial production at the time of disbursement and the assistance shall not be released to the closed unit. 1. Acquisition of multiple machines of similar nature will not be entertained under the scheme. Only one machine will be eligible for the assistance under the scheme in such cases. 1. The improvement in performance due to technology acquisition can be demonstrated as follows: - An increase of at least 10% in Production Rate (Number of units produced/Total time taken); or - A decrease of at least 5% in Cycle Time (Net Production Time/ Number of Units Produced); or - A decrease of at least 2.5% in Rejection Rate (Number of units rejected/ Total number of units produced); or - A decrease of at least 10% in waste generation (Quantity of waste generated/ Quantity of relevant raw material used) Note 1: Improvement in performance to be certified by Chartered Engineer. Note 2: The average values of the above-mentioned indicators calculated three (3) months prior to technology acquisition will be compared with the average values calculated three (3) months post the deployment & commissioning of technology to demonstrate the performance improvement.
benefits: One-time Reimbursement Assistance: - Up to 50% of the cost incurred for technology/software acquisition. - Maximum assistance limit: ₹5,00,000/- per unit. MSEs may acquire technology/software from premier national institutes like: - Indian Institute of Science (IISc) - Indian Institutes of Technology (IITs) - National Institutes of Technology (NITs) - National Institutes of Design (NIDs) - Council of Scientific and Industrial Research (CSIR), OR - Other institutions set up by Government of India/Government of Rajasthan.
summary: The scheme aims to support Micro and Small enterprises in state to acquire advanced technology/ software related to their production/ manufacturing processes through assistance towards cost incurred for technology/ software acquisition.

title: Aapki Beti Yojana
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan. 1. The applicant should be a girl student 1. The applicant should be studying in a government school in Rajasthan. 1. The applicant should be studying in classes 1st to 12th.1. The applicant’s family should fall under the Below Poverty Line (BPL) category. 1. The applicant should have lost either one parent (single parent) or both parents.
benefits: Financial Assistance: - ₹2,100/- per annum for girl students in classes 1st to 8th.- ₹2,500/- per annum for girl students in classes 9th to 12th. *Mode of Disbursement:* - Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to the bank account linked with Jan Aadhaar of the family head or the girl child.
summary: Under the scheme, financial assistance of ₹2,100/- per year is provided to girls studying in Class 1 to 8 in government schools, belonging to families living below the poverty line (BPL) and whose both or one parent has passed away. Girls studying in Class 9 to 12 receive ₹2,500/- per year.

title: Additional Financial Assistance for the Children of Persons Engaged in the Cleaning Profession
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a student. 1. The applicant should be eligible for or currently receiving a scholarship under the Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme. 1. The applicant should belong to Scheduled Caste (SC), Scheduled Tribe (ST), Other Backward Classes (OBC), Economically Backward Classes (EBC), or Extremely Backward Classes (EBC). 1. The applicant's parents or guardian should be engaged in the cleaning profession and belong to the scavenger class. 1. If the applicant's parent is not alive, the guardian engaged in the cleaning profession and belonging to the scavenger class is eligible to apply.
benefits: Financial Assistance: - This scheme provides ₹500/- per month as additional financial assistance to children of individuals working in the cleaning/sanitation profession. Note: Assistance will be provided for a maximum of 10 months per year.
summary: This scheme aims to provide additional financial assistance of ₹500/- per month to children of individuals working in cleaning/sanitation profession. This assistance is given to students already receiving a scholarship under Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme, ensuring their continued education.

title: Ambedkar DBT Voucher Scheme
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Rajasthan. 1. The applicant should belong to Scheduled Caste (SC), Scheduled Tribe (ST), Other Backward Class (OBC), Most Backward Class (MBC) or Economically Weaker Section (EWS) category. 1. The applicant should be studying in a government college at the district level for the academic course. 1. The student should be regularly enrolled in an undergraduate or postgraduate course at a government college. 1. The student should be pursuing an academic course in a government college located at the district level. 1. The student should not be a resident of the Municipal Corporation, Municipal Council, or Municipality of the district where they are studying. 1. The student whose parent/guardian owns a house in the city or town where they are studying is not eligible for benefits under this scheme. 1. The student who is residing in government-run hostel will not be eligible for benefits under the scheme. 1. The benefit of the scheme will be available to the student for a maximum of five years. 1. The annual income of the applicant’s family should not exceed: - SC/ST/MBC: ₹2,50,000/- - OBC: ₹1,50,000/- - EWS: ₹1,00,000/-
benefits: Financial Assistance: - ₹2,000/- per month for a maximum of 10 months per academic year. Note: Students will be paid on monthly/monthly basis. Duration of Benefit: - Maximum 5 years per student. Total Number of Beneficiaries: - 5,000 students annually.
summary: The scheme aims to support students from SC, ST, OBC, MBC, and EWS categories by providing financial aid for accommodation. The students receive ₹2,000/- per month for up to 10 months per academic year.

title: Ambedkar Fellowship Scheme
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan. 1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste (SC) category. 1. The applicant should have completed a postgraduate degree with at least 55% marks. 1. The applicant should be below 35 years of age at the time of application. 1. The applicant's annual family income should not exceed ₹2,50,000/- from all sources. 1. Priority is given to candidates enrolled in central or state government universities in Rajasthan. 1. A maximum of two children from a single family (parents/guardians) can apply under the scheme. 1. The applicant should have secured admission in a Ph.D. program in a recognized university in Rajasthan in one of the following subjects: - Sociology - Public Administration - Law - Economics - Political Science - Anthropology *Other terms & conditions:* 1. The selected candidate will have to submit a certificate regarding admission from the Head of the concerned University or Institute in which he/she is pursuing Ph.D. 1. Candidates selected for Ph.D. will have to submit certificate regarding attendance as prescribed by University Grants Commission (UGC). 1. Every year a progress report of the research work done by the student will be submitted to the department and after completion of the research work a copy will be made available to the department also. 1. In case the amount received as fellowship is misused by the student, the amount paid along with 10% interest will be recovered from the concerned student. The student will have to submit an undertaking to this effect on a non-judicial stamp of ₹100/-.
benefits: *Financial Assistance:* - Selected Ph.D. candidates receive a monthly fellowship of ₹15,000 for up to three years. *Mode of Disbursement:* - The fellowship amount is directly transferred to the student's bank account by cheque or DD. Duration*:* - The fellowship continues for a maximum duration of 3 years, subject to satisfactory academic progress.
summary: The objective of this scheme is to provide financial assistance to meritorious students from the Scheduled Caste category for research at the Ph.D. level. The selected students receive a monthly fellowship grant to support their research in specific subjects.

title: Ambedkar International Scholarship - SC
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Rajasthan. 1. The applicant must belong to the Scheduled Caste (SC) category. 1. The applicant must have completed a postgraduate degree from a recognized Indian university with a minimum of 55% marks. 1. The applicant must have secured admission to a Ph.D. program in a foreign university accredited by the respective country's authority. 1. The applicant's age must be below 35 years as of the application deadline. 1. The applicant’s family annual income should not exceed ₹6,00,000/-. 1. The applicant should not be beneficiary of any other govt scholarship program. 1. The Ph.D. program must be in one of the following fields: - Sociology. - Public Administration. - Law. - Economics. - Political Science. - Anthropology.
benefits: Financial Assistance: ₹25,00,000/- is granted to selected candidates in three installments: - ₹10,00,000/- in the first year - ₹10,00,000/- in the second year - ₹5,00,000/- in the third year Scholarship Validity: Up to three years.
summary: The "Ambedkar International Scholarship - SC" Scheme by the Rajasthan Social Justice and Empowerment Department provides financial assistance to meritorious SC students for pursuing Ph.D. studies in foreign universities in Humanities and Social Sciences.

title: Bicycle Distribution Scheme for Girl Students of Economically Weaker Section
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan. 1. The applicant should be a girl student. 1. The applicant should be studying in Class 6, 7, or 8 in a government school in Rajasthan. 1. The applicant should belong to the Economically Weaker Section (EWS) category. 1. The annual income of the applicant’s parents/guardian should be less than ₹1,00,000/-. 1. The applicant should have secured at least 60% marks in the previous examination. Note: Preference will be given based on merit (marks obtained).
benefits: Under this scheme, free bicycles will be distributed to girl students from the EWS category. *Number of beneficiaries:* 1. Total: 5,800 beneficiaries 1. Number of Beneficiaries Class-wise: - Class 6th: 1,933- Class 7th: 1,933- Class 8th: 1,934
summary: Under this scheme, free bicycles will be distributed to 5,800 girl students belonging to the Economically Weaker Section (EWS), who are studying in government schools from Class 6 to Class 8, to facilitate their commute between home and school.

title: Chhatraon Ke Liye Protsahan Rashi
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a Girl. 1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan 1. The applicant should be studying in schools, colleges, and universities recognized by the government and state government.
benefits: 1. Senior Secondary Level: - Girls studying agriculture in 11th and 12th standard will receive a scholarship of ₹15,000 per year. 1. Undergraduate Level: - Girls enrolled in undergraduate agricultural programs (4/5 years) like Horticulture, Dairy, Agricultural Engineering, Food Processing, and Shri Karna Narendra Business School, Jobner will receive a scholarship of ₹25,000 per year. 1. Postgraduate Level: - Girls pursuing M.Sc. Agriculture (2 years) will receive a scholarship of ₹25,000 per year. 1. PhD Level: - Girls pursuing PhD in Agriculture (maximum 3 years) will receive a scholarship of ₹40,000 per year.
summary: In the "Chhatraon Ke Liye Protsahan Rashi" scheme to encourages girl students to study agriculture subject and provides financial assistance to economically disadvantaged students who may face challenges in accessing education due to financial constraints.

title: Chief Minister Higher Education Scholarship Scheme
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan. 1. The applicant should be a regular student. 1. The student should be studying at a government or recognized non-government higher or technical institute in Rajasthan. 1. Students should have passed the 12th examination from the Rajasthan Board of Secondary Education, Ajmer, in the current year with a minimum of 60% marks and secured a position within the top one lakh of the board's merit list. 1. Disabled students should have a disability of 40% or more. 1. The total annual income of the applicant's parents or guardians should not exceed ₹2,50,000/-. 1. The student should not be receiving benefits from any other scholarship or equivalent scheme provided by the Government of India or the State Government. 1. The student should have a savings account in a nationalized bank. 1. The applicant should possess a valid Aadhaar card. 1. The student should have a Jan Aadhaar Card (Bhamashah Card).
benefits: Under this scheme, eligible students will receive the following financial assistance:: - The students will receive ₹500/- per month for a maximum of 10 months, totaling up to ₹5,000/- annually. - The students with a disability of 40% or more will receive ₹1,000/- per month for up to 10 months, totaling a maximum of ₹10,000/- annually. Note: The benefits under this scheme are available for a maximum of 5 years for regular students studying in higher educational institutions. If students discontinue their studies before completing 5 years, the benefits will be valid only for the previous year.
summary: The scheme was launched by the Higher Education Department, Government of Rajasthan. This scheme aims to enhance educational levels and provide scholarship to children from low-income families.

title: CM Anuprati Coaching Scheme

The candidate should belong to one of the following categories: Scheduled Caste (SC), Scheduled Tribe (ST), Other Backward Class (OBC), Extremely Backward Class (EBC), Economically Weaker Section (EWS), or Minority category. 1. The annual income of the candidate’s parents/guardians (including the candidate’s income, if applicable) must be less than ₹8.00 lakh, or the candidate's parents must be State Government employees receiving a salary up to Level-11 of the Pay Matrix. 1. The candidate should not have previously availed the benefits of this scheme. 1. The candidate must possess the minimum qualifications required for the competitive examination.

title: Competitive Exam Coaching
eligibility_details: Should be a student of ST category. Both Male and Female students are eligible for taking benefit of this scheme.
benefits:
Competitive exam Coaching for tribal students scheme was launched in Rajasthan by Tribal Area Development Department in the year 2016-17. Free coaching to tribal candidates for various competitive examinations through Mankyi Lal Verma Tribal Research and Training Institute, Udaipur and Scheduled Area Project Officer's Office.

Applicants can obtain their application form free of cost from the Director, M.L.Verma Tribal Research and Training Institute, Udaipur or through the Office of the Project Officer of the Scheduled Area, fill the forms, attach the documents and submit it in the same office.
This scheme is applicable to these districts: Banswara, Chittorgarh, Dungarpur, Pali, Sirohi, Udaipur, Rajsamand, and Pratapgarh.
The applicant must have the following documents to apply for Competitive Exam Coaching :- - Education Qualification Marksheet / Certificate Copy - Domicile Certificate Copy - Caste Certificate Copy - Sowing Certificate Copy This scheme can be availed only once by a student.
summary: Competitive exam Coaching for tribal students scheme was launched in Rajasthan by Tribal Area Development Department in the year 2016-17, under which free coaching to tribal students for competitive examinations through Mankyi Lal Verma Tribal Research and Training Institute, Udaipur is provided.

title: Devnarayan Gurukul Yojana
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a native resident of Rajasthan. 1. The applicant's family should not be a taxpayer. 1. The applicant must be a regular student in a government or non-government school. 1. The applicant must have passed class 5th with a minimum of 50% or above marks.1. The applicant should belong to one of the following Special Backward Class (SBC) communities: - Banjara, Baldia, Labana - Gadiya Lohar, Gadolia - Gujar, Gurjar - Raika, Rebari (Debasi) - Gadaria (Gadri, Gyari) Note 1: Only students who qualify on merit after clearing the pre-admission examination will be admitted to the 59 schools selected by the department. Note 2: Students will be given admission in Class 6 as per their merit based on marks obtained in Class 5.
benefits: Under this scheme, eligible students receive free education, accommodation, meals, uniforms, text books and study materials in government-approved schools.
summary: The scheme aims to provide free residential education to students from Special Backward Classes. Under this scheme, selected students receive free education, accommodation, meals, uniforms, books, and study materials in government-approved schools.

title: Devnarayan Post Matric Scholarship Scheme
eligibility_details: 1. The students should be a native of Rajasthan state. 1. Applicant students should belong to the following Other Backward Classes, that must have been issued by Tehsildar or a higher-level revenue officer. 1. Banjara, Baladiya, Labana. 1. Gadia-Lohar, Gadolia. 1. Gujar, Gurjar. 1. Raika, Raibari (Debasi). 1. Gadariya (Gadri), Gayari. 1. The annual income of the parents/guardian of the applicant from all sources (including the candidate's own income, if any) should be up to Rs.2,50,000 (Rupees two lakh fifty thousand in words). 1. An employed student who studies as a full-time student by taking leave without pay during the entire course will be eligible for the scholarship. 1. All the children of the same parent/guardian will be eligible to benefit from this scheme.
benefits: - Reimbursement of maintenance allowance and fee according to the time of course.
summary: In Rajasthan, the Post-matriculation scholarship scheme is run by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment for the educational upliftment of students.

title: Devnarayan Pratibhawan Chhatra Protsahan Yojana
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan. 1. The applicant should be a student. 1. The applicant’s family’s annual income should not exceed ₹2,00,000/-. 1. The applicant should be studying in a government school or college. 1. The applicant should have passed class 10th to graduation with a first division.1. The applicant should have obtained at least 48% marks in the postgraduation first year and be enrolled in the final year. 1. The applicant should belong to one of the Special Backward Class communities: - Banjara, Baldiya, Labana - Gadia-Lohar, Gadoliya - Gurjar, Gujjar - Raika, Raibari (Debasi)
benefits: - Financial assistance of ₹3,500/- per year per student.
summary: The scheme aims to encourage academic excellence among students belonging to Special Backward Classes (SBC). It provides an annual financial incentive of ₹3,500/- to students pursuing education from Class 10th to postgraduate level in government schools or colleges.

title: Devnarayan Pre-Matric Scholarship Scheme
eligibility_details: 1. The students should be a native of Rajasthan state. 1. Applicant students should belong to the following Other Backward Classes, that must have been issued by Tehsildar or a higher-level revenue officer. (i). Banjara, Baladiya, Labana. (ii). Gadia-Lohar, Gadolia. (iii). Gujar, Gurjar. (iv). Raika, Raibari (Debasi). (v). Gadariya (Gadri), Gayari. 1. The annual income of the parents/guardian of the applicant from all sources (including the candidate's own income, if any) should be up to Rs.2,00,000 (Rupees two lakh). 1. An employed student who studies as a full-time student by taking leave without pay during the entire course will be eligible for the scholarship. 1. All the children of the same parent/guardian will be eligible to benefit from this scheme. 1. Students who are not getting any kind of scholarship or allowance for study from central, state / public sources.
benefits:
1. Selected students have to study according to the approved syllabus by State Government. 1. As per the rules Education, Accommodation, Meal, Dress, text writing material and books will be provided Free of cost.

title: Devnarayan Scooty Distribution And Incentive Scheme
eligibility_details: 1. Girl students should be from extremely backward classes of Rajasthan origin. 1. Students have secured 50% or more marks in the 12th (C.S.) 1. The examination should be conducted by the Rajasthan Board of Secondary Education / Central Board of Secondary Education and have been admitted to Government Colleges, State Funded Universities located in Rajasthan. 1. Applicants should be studying regularly after being admitted in the first year of their bachelor's degree. 1. The annual income of the student's parent/guardian/guardian/husband should be less than Rs.2.50 lakh. 1. The benefit of the Devnarayan Higher Education Financial Assistance Scheme / other financial assistance scheme will not be payable to the student who gets the benefit in this scheme.
benefits: 1. 1500 scooties will be distributed free of cost every year according to the merit list of marks obtained in the 12th examination. 1. Those are studying regularly in government colleges, state-funded universities, 12th (Senior Secondary) (girls who are not in the priority list of scooty acceptance) 10,000/- per annum in the first year, second year and third year. 1. For Postgraduate first-year (P.G. degree) students, 20,000/- per annum in the admission year and Rs. 20,000/- per annum in the second year of post-graduation will be given as an incentive amount on obtaining 50% or more marks in the first year of post-graduation.
summary: The Government of Rajasthan has launched the Devnarayan Chatra Scooty Yojana Scheme for the year 2023 in order to encourage female students in the state to study and to address the state’s low female literacy rate.

title: Distance Education Scheme for Girls
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a girl student. 1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan. 1. The applicant should be enrolled in UG, PG, Diploma, Certificate or PG Diploma courses under distance education mode. 1. The applicant should be studying in a state-funded university or government institution in Rajasthan, including IGNOU (Indira Gandhi National Open University). 1. The applicant who is availing of other fee reimbursement in State Government Schemes during the same tenure is not eligible in this scheme. But these students will get reimbursement of difference amount of "Existing Scholarship" and "Distance Education Scheme for Girls". 1. Students holding prize/incentive scholarships are not excluded from applying for this scheme. Note: The student who is eligible for distance education course in Post Matric/Other Scheme of Social Justice Department, Govt. of Rajasthan will get fee reimbursement from the existing process of fee reimbursement under Social Justice Department/ Other Department. The student will not get fee reimbursement from SJE portal under the category "DE-HE".
benefits: *Reimbursement of full course fees for distance Education in:* - Undergraduate (UG) courses - Postgraduate (PG) courses - Diploma courses - Certificate and PG Diploma courses Note: No other additional grant will be payable. *Duration of Fee Disbursement:* - After selection, the candidate's fee will be reimbursed on Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) mode on annual basis on satisfactory academic performance of the student. - The fee reimbursement would be awarded from the date of joining the course as certified by the University/Institution.
summary: The scheme aims to support girls' higher education through distance learning by reimbursing their course fees for UG, PG, Diploma, Certificate, and PG Diploma undertaken by girls through distance education in Rajasthan.

title: Economic Help To Sahariya Tribal Girl Students (Class 11 And 12)
eligibility_details: 1. The girl student should belong to the Saharia tribe of the Baran district of Rajasthan. 1. The girl child should be studying regularly in a government school. 1. The mother/father/guardian/guardian of the student should not be an income taxpayer. 1. The girl students, who are studying in residential schools/ashram hostels run by the government, they will not be entitled. 1. Vaidya Bhamashah card and Aadhaar should be there. 1. Students should be a native of Rajasthan.
benefits: The student will be paid ₹3,500/- for a total of 10 months at the rate of Rs. 350/- per month.
summary: Rajasthan Government started a scholarship for Sahariya tribal girls' higher education (Class 11 and 12).

title: Economic Help To Tribal Girls For Higher Education (Class 11 & 12)
category: Social welfare & Empowerment, Women and Child
eligibility_details: 1. Should be studying regularly in 11th and 12th in government schools. 1. The girl student should belong to the Scheduled Tribe category of Rajasthan. 1. The parent/guardian/guardian/husband of the student should not be an income tax payer. 1. The student must be a native of Rajasthan. 1. The student who is studying by living in the hostel run by the government. They will not be entitled to benefit under the said scheme. 1. Must have Vaidya Bhamashah card and Aadhaar card.
benefits: - Rs. 3,500/- One time and fully in July
summary: Rajasthan Government started a scholarship for tribal girls higher education (Class 11 & 12) In the year 2011.

title: Economic Help To Tribal Girls For Higher Education (College Level)
eligibility_details: 1. The girl student should belong to the tribal class of Rajasthan. 1. The girl student should be regularly studying general education in a private/government college. 1. The parent/guardian/guardian/husband of the student should not be an income taxpayer. 1. After passing the board examination, there should not be any gap in the continuous study of the student applying for the scheme. 1. The student who is studying by living in a hostel run by the government. They will not be entitled to benefit under the said scheme. 1. Must have Vaidya Bhamashah card and Aadhaar card. 1. The girl student should be a native of Rajasthan.
benefits: - Annual financial assistance of Rs. 5,000/- is provided for 10 months at the rate of Rs.500/- per month.
summary: Rajasthan Government started a scholarship for tribal girls higher education (College Level) In the year 1994-95.

title: Financial assistance to Meritorious Scheduled Tribe Students who have Passed First Division from Board and University
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a student. 1. The applicant should have passed the 12th standard examination from the Madhyamik Shiksha Board/Central Board of Secondary Education with a first division, securing 60% or more marks. 1. The applicant should have secured at least 48% marks in the first year examination to be eligible for the incentive in the second year. 1. The applicant should have secured at least 48% marks in the second year examination to be eligible for the incentive in the third year. 1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Tribe category. 1. The applicant's parents/guardian/husband should not be income tax payers. 1. The student should be a native of Rajasthan. 1. There should be no gap in the applicant's studies after passing the board examination. 1. The applicant should be enrolled as a regular student in general education in a government college. 1. Students residing in government hostels are not eligible for benefits under this scheme. 1. The applicant must possess a Jan Aadhaar Card and an Aadhaar Card.
benefits: - A one-time financial incentive of up to ₹3,500/- will be provided to students, at the rate of ₹350/- per month for a maximum of ten months. Note: The incentive amount will be directly transferred to the student's bank account linked with their Jan Aadhaar through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).
summary: The objective of the scheme is to motivate meritorious Scheduled Tribe students of Rajasthan by providing one-time financial assistance of ₹3,500/- to those pursuing regular college courses and achieving first division.

title: Free Bicycle Distribution to Students of Vimukt, Ghumantu and Ardhghumantu Communities
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan. 1. The applicant should be a student. 1. The applicant should belong to one of the Denotified Tribes, Nomadic Tribes, or Semi-Nomadic Tribes as notified by the Government of Rajasthan. 1. The applicant should be studying in the 6th, 7th, 8th, 9th, 10th, or 11th class.1. The applicant should be enrolled in a government or a private educational institution/school affiliated with the Rajasthan Board of Secondary Education, Ajmer . 1. The applicant should have secured 60% or more marks in the previous academic year. 1. The students who has already availed the benefit of this scheme once will not be eligible. NOTE: Students belonging to a total of 32 communities (including 9 Denotified Tribes, 10 Nomadic Tribes, and 13 Semi-Nomadic Tribes) will be eligible as per Government Order No. F-1(1)(2)S.W/63 dated 24.02.1964 (https://sje.rajasthan.gov.in/Default.aspx?PageID=68), Annexure 'A'.
benefits: - Free bicycle distribution to students studying in classes 6th to 11th in government and recognized private educational institutions. - Equal distribution of benefits among boys and girls (50% boys and 50% girls).
summary: The scheme aims to provide free cycles to students studying in classes 6th to 11th in government and recognized private educational institutions and belonging to Denotified Tribes, Nomadic and Semi-Nomadic Tribes communities of Rajasthan.

title: Free Scooty Distribution for Girls (GEN-CATEGAORY-EWS)
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan. 1. The applicant should be a girl student. 1. The applicant should belong to the Economically Weaker Section (EWS) of General Category. 1. The applicant's family annual income should not exceed ₹2,50,000/-. 1. The applicant should have studied in a government or private school in Rajasthan. 1. The applicant should have secured at least 85% marks in class 10th or 12th.
benefits: Under this scheme, Eligible girl students will receive a scooty, a helmet, and 2 liters of petrol.
summary: Under this scheme, meritorious girl students from government and private schools who have scored 85% or above in the Class 10th and 12th (Arts, Commerce, Science streams) examinations are provided with a free scooty, along with a helmet and petrol.

title: Gargi Puruskar Yojana
eligibility_details: 1. The student must have secured minimum 75% marks in class 10th. 1. The girl student should be studying regularly in class 11 or 12. 1. There is no restriction on income, occupation and caste etc. of the parents of the student.
benefits: - Payable for 11 & 12 class girl students: Rs. 3,000/- each year on the day of Basant Panchami.
summary: The benefit of Gargi Puraskar Yojana is given every year to the beneficiary girl child of Rajasthan on the day of Basant Panchami. This time also the beneficiary girl students were taken on a tour of the girl students on the occasion of Basant Panchami very year.

title: Grant on Passing the Written Examination of Competitive Examinations for Recruitment in Armed Forces
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan. 1. The applicant should be the child of an ex-serviceman. 1. The applicant should have passed the written examination of NDA, CDS, IMA, OTA, Air Force, or Naval Academy.
benefits: - A one-time grant of ₹15,000/- is provided to children of ex-serviceman who pass the written examination of CDS, NDA, IMA, OTA, Air Force, or Naval Academy, for the purpose of coaching.
summary: Under this scheme, a grant of ₹15,000/- is provided from the Amalgamated Fund to the children of ex-servicemen who pass the written examination of CDS, NDA, IMA, OTA, Air Force, or Naval Academy, for the purpose of coaching.

title: Hostel Rent Assistance Scheme for Tribal Students
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be studying regularly a undergraduate or postgraduate course in a government college. 1. The student should belong to a Scheduled Tribe community residing in the Scheduled Areas of Rajasthan. 1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan. 1. The applicant should be studying in a government college. 1. The applicant should not be residing in a government-run hostel. 1. The applicant's parents/guardian/husband should not be an income tax payer. 1. The applicant should not have any academic gap (break) after passing the last board examination. 1. The applicant should possess a valid Bhamashah card and an Aadhaar card.
benefits: Students receive the following rental assistance as a cash benefit: Sl. summary: The scheme provides financial assistance towards hostel rent for Scheduled Tribe students pursuing undergraduate and postgraduate courses in government colleges, who are staying in rented accommodation for the purpose of regular studies.

title: Incentive Scheme for Meritorious Students of Economically Backward Class of General Category
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan. 1. The applicant should be a student. 1. The applicant should belong to the economically backward class from the general category. 1. The applicant should be studying in a government or private school. 1. The applicant should have passed Class 10th, Praveshika, Class 12th (Science/Commerce/Arts), or Varishta Upadhyay examination conducted by Rajasthan Board of Secondary Education (RBSE), Ajmer. 1. The applicant should have secured a minimum of 75% marks in the qualifying examination. 1. The applicant’s parents’ combined annual income from all sources should be less than ₹2,50,000.
benefits: Financial Assistance: - One-time financial assistance of ₹15,000/- is provided to economically backward students from the general category studying in government and private schools. Certificate of Appreciation: - An official certificate is awarded along with the monetary benefit.
summary: Under this scheme, a one-time financial assistance of ₹15,000/- along with a certificate of appreciation is awarded to top 100 meritorious students of Class 10 & each stream of Class 12, who are listed in state-level merit list of Rajasthan Board of Secondary Education, Ajmer.

title: Incentive To Saharia Students For B.Ed
eligibility_details: 1. The student should be a native of Rajasthan. 1. The student should belong to Saharia class, a tribe of the Baran district of Rajasthan. 1. The student should be a regular trainee in the government / non-government BEd training institute. 1. The student's mother/father/guardian/guardian should not be a taxpayer. 1. The student who is studying while living in the hostel is run by the government. They will not be entitled to benefit under the said scheme. 1. Students should have a Vaidya Bhamashah card and Aadhaar.
benefits: Saharia tribe students who are taking regular B.Ed training are given Rs.30,000 in the first year and Rs.30,000 in the second year. Details are given below : 1. Rs. 26,000/- for college fees and purchase of books. 1. Rs. 32,000/- for house rent and food. 1. Rs. 2,000/- for clothes.
summary: In Rajasthan, "Incentive To Saharia Students For B.Ed" scheme is run by the "Tribal Area Development Department" from 2004-05.

title: Indira Mahila Shakti Prashikshan Evam Kaushal Sanvardhan Yojna -RS-CIT
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant is a native citizen of Rajasthan. 1. Only women of the state will be considered eligible for the scheme. 1. Only girls and women between the ages of 16 years to 40 years will be considered eligible for the scheme. 1. Widow/divorced/abandoned women suffering from violence be given priority. 1. The applicant trainees who have passed class 10th from a government school and are graduates. 1. The applicant Anganwadi worker must be a Graduate.
benefits: Free basic computer training for women and girls, general information about MS Word, MS Excel, MS PowerPoint, email, etc. is given. Training will be given through RKCL ( Rajasthan Knowledge Corporation Limited).
summary: The objective of Indira Mahila Shakti Prashikshan Evam Kaushal Sanvardhan Yojna is to provide empowerment to the girls and women of the state in the field of computers by providing free computer courses to them.

title: Indira Mahila Shakti Prashikshan Evam Koshal Sanvardhan Yojana (RS-CSEP)
eligibility_details: - The applicant is a native citizen of Rajasthan. - The applicant's age should be 16 to 45 years old. - The applicant should have passed class 12th. - Widow/divorced/abandoned women suffering from violence be given priority.
benefits: RKCL( Rajasthan Knowledge Corporation Limited), free spoken English and personality development training is given to women and girls.
summary: The Indira Mahila Shakti Prashikshan Evam Koshal Sanvardhan Yojana, offered by the Rajasthan Knowledge Corporation Limited (RKCL), provides free training in spoken English and personality development for women and girls.

title: Indira Priyadarshini Award
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan. 1. The applicant should be a girl student and enrolled as a regular student. 1. The applicant should belong to one of the following categories: Scheduled Castes (SC), Scheduled Tribes (ST), Other Backward Classes (OBC), Minority Communities, Differently-abled (Disabled), General Category, Special Backward Classes (SBC), or Below Poverty Line (BPL). 1. The applicant should have secured the first position at the district level in Class 8, 10, or 12 examinations (Arts, Science, or Commerce stream) conducted by the Rajasthan Board of Secondary Education. 1. The student should have obtained at least 60% marks in the respective examination. 1. Girl students who secure the first position at the state level in Class 8, (10) Praveshika, or (12) Varishtha Upadhyay examinations conducted by the Sanskrit Education Department are also eligible. 1. Girl students securing the first position at the state level in vocational education examinations for Class 10 or 12 are eligible under the scheme. 1. Girl students from Swami Vivekananda Government Model Schools who score a CGPA of 9.0 or above in Class 10 or 12 are also eligible. Note: The caste/category certificate submitted by the student at the time of applying for the board examination will be treated as final.
benefits: The scheme provides the following one-time financial rewards to the girl students: *Class 8 Girl Students:* - ₹40,000/- cash prize (Who secure first position at the district or state level). *Class 10 Girl Students:* - ₹75,000/- cash prize (Who secure first position at the district or state level). *Class 12 Girl Students (Arts, Science, and Commerce streams – considered separately):* - ₹1,00,000/- cash prize (Who secure first position at the district or state level). - A Scooty is also provided to all awardees of Class 12. *Vocational Education (From 2021–22):* - Girls from the above categories who secure first position at the state level in vocational exams are also awarded. *Swami Vivekanand Government Model Schools (From 2021–22):* - Top 8 girls each from Class 10 and Class 12 who score 9 CGPA or more are awarded at the state level.
summary: The scheme aims to promote academic excellence among girl students by providing one-time financial rewards to those securing the first position in Class 8th, 10th, and 12th examinations, along with vocational & Swami Vivekanand Government Model Schools achievers at the district and state levels.

title: Kali Bai Bheel Medhavi Chhatra Scooty Scheme
eligibility_details: 1. Girl students who have passed class 12th with a minimum of 65% marks in Rajasthan Board of Secondary Education and passed class 12th with a minimum of 75% marks in Central Board of Secondary Education who are studying in any school in Rajasthan. 1. Graduation degree from any Rajasthan-based college like (B.A.BED/ B.SC.BED/ B.COM.BED/BE / B.TECH/ B.ARCH / MBBS / IIT / BBA / BBM / BCA / BDS / BHMS / BAMS / LAW/ etc.) and studying as a regular student. 1. The benefit of the scheme will not be payable if there is a gap of one year from the year of passing the 12th class in the admission of a bachelor's degree. 1. Girl students getting financial assistance in any other scheme will also be benefited from this scheme. Girl students receiving financial aid/scholarships in any other scheme will not be deprived of this scheme. 1. The girl students who have got the benefit of scooty in any scheme of the state government on the basis of their marks in any class before the implementation of the said scheme, those girl students will not be eligible to get scooty in this scheme. 1. In the past, on the basis of 10th class results from the TAD Department, School Education Department, if a girl child has received scooty on the basis of 10th result, then that girl student will get a lump sum amount of Rs 40,000 if she is eligible on the basis of 12th result.
benefits: - Scooty distribution to girl students.
summary: In 2015-16, Rajasthan State started the "Kali Bai Bheel Medhavi Chhatra Scooty Scheme" for Girls students.

title: Kasturba Gandhi Special Term Deposit Receipt Scheme
eligibility_details: General Eligibility 1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan state. 1. The applicant should be a girl student. 1. The applicant should have passed the 8th class from a Kasturba Gandhi Residential Girls School in Rajasthan. Eligibility Criteria for Class 10th Students 1. The applicant should have passed the 10th class with a minimum of 50% marks while studying in a government school. 1. The applicant should be enrolled in the 11th class in a government school. Eligibility Criteria for Class 12th Students 1. The applicant should have passed class 12th with at least 50% marks from a government school 1. The applicant should be enrolled in the first year of a recognized undergraduate course.
benefits: Monetary Benefits: - A Special Term Deposit Receipt (STDR) of ₹2,000/- for girl students enrolled in Class 11. - A Special Term Deposit Receipt (STDR) of ₹4,000/- for girl students pursuing a graduation course. Mode of Disbursement: - STDRs (Special Term Deposit Receipts) in the name of the student. Validity: - An STDR of ₹2,000/- is valid for 5 years. - An STDR of ₹4,000/- is valid for 3 years.
summary: Under this scheme, girls who pass Class 8 from Kasturba Gandhi Schools, secure at least 50% marks in Class 10, & enroll in Class 11 receive an STDR of ₹2,000/- (5-year term). Those who score 50% in Class 12 and enroll in graduation receive an STDR of ₹4,000/- (3-year term).

title: Maa-Badi / Maa-Badi Day-Care Centre Scheme
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a child aged 6 to 12 years. 1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Tribe, Kathodi, or Sahariya community. 1. The applicant should reside in Udaipur, Dungarpur, Banswara, Pratapgarh, Sirohi, or Rajsamand districts. 1. The applicant should not currently be enrolled in any formal school. 1. The applicant should reside in areas where the nearest school is at least 1.5–2 km away.
benefits: At these centers, children are provided following benefits: - Free primary education (classes 1st to 4th).- Breakfast and nutritious mid-day meals. - Free uniforms, school bags, shoes, socks, sweaters, ties, and belts. - Free sports equipment etc. Day-Care Centre Specific Benefits: - Full-day (9:00 AM to 5:00 PM) operation. - 2 education facilitators and 3 assistants at each centre. - Meals are provided twice a day. Maa-Badi Centre Specific Benefits: - Operates as per the school calendar. - 1 education facilitator and 2 assistants per centre. - Breakfast and one mid-day meal.
summary: The scheme aims to impart basic education, nutrition, and awareness to tribal children aged 6–12. The scheme offers meals, learning material, and other support through community-run centres.

title: Mukhya Mantri Sarvajan Uchcha Shiksha Chhatravriti Yojana
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan. 1. The annual income of the parent/guardian of the student/applicant from all sources (including the applicant’s own income, if any) should be less than ₹5,00,000/-. 1. The applicant should be enrolled in IITs, IIMs, NITs, AIIMS, or other national institutions listed (https://sje.rajasthan.gov.in/Default.aspx?PageID=198) under the scheme.1. The applicant should not be availing of any other government scholarship for the same course. 1. The applicant should maintain academic performance as required for renewal of the scholarship. 1. An employee pursuing full-time studies while on leave without pay for the entire duration of the course will also be eligible for the scholarship. 1. The student studying outside Rajasthan in the listed national institutions (https://sje.rajasthan.gov.in/Default.aspx?PageID=198) are eligible.
benefits: Financial Assistance: - Students receive 50% reimbursement of their non-refundable institutional fees (such as tuition, library, medical, and examination fees). Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT): - The scholarship amount is transferred directly to the student's bank account. Annual Disbursement: - The scholarship is disbursed annually throughout the duration of the course. Covers Multiple Institutions: - Includes IITs, IIMs, NITs, AIIMS, and other national institutions listed in the scheme guidelines (https://sje.rajasthan.gov.in/Default.aspx?PageID=198).
summary: This scheme aims to provide financial assistance to students from all sections of Rajasthan who are pursuing higher education at IITs, IIMs, and other national-level institutions. Under this scheme, 50% of the non-refundable fees are reimbursed to eligible students.

title: Mukhyamantri Hunar Vikas Yojana- Higher Education/Technical Education
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a beneficiary under the Palanhar Scheme of Rajasthan. 1. The applicant should have completed 15 years of age. 1. The applicant’s maximum age should not exceed 21 years or till course completion (whichever is earlier). 1. The applicant should be pursuing education from a university/college/technical educational institution recognized by the Government of India/State Government. 1. Financial assistance is applicable for regular higher or technical education at the graduate or postgraduate level. 1. The applicant should not be receiving any scholarships or grants for higher/technical education from the Central or State Government.
benefits: Higher Education /Technical Education Benefits: - Financial assistance for career-oriented higher or technical education (graduation/post-graduation courses). Mode of Disbursement: - Reimbursement of the actual course fee through bank account transfer.
summary: Under this scheme, the State Government provides financial assistance to eligible boys and girls enrolled under the Palanhar Scheme to pursue higher or technical education, based on their qualifications and interest in employment-oriented courses.

title: Mukhyamantri Shiksha Alankar Yojana for Students of Economically Weaker Section
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan. 1. The student should belong to the Economically Weaker Section (EWS). 1. The student is studying in government schools in Rajasthan. 1. The applicant should be enrolled in the 10th or 12th class.1. The student should have secured the highest marks in the 10th and 12th class board examinations conducted by the Rajasthan Board of Secondary Education, Ajmer (for Arts, Commerce, and Science streams). Note: Students benefiting from any other incentive schemes run by the state and central government will also be eligible for benefits under the scheme.
benefits: *Each selected student will receive:* - A one-time cash award of ₹50,000/- per student. - A Certificate of Appreciation. *No. of Students selected:* - A total of 32 students will be benefitted under the scheme. *For Class 10 students:* - 10 boys and 10 girls (total 20 students) will be selected. *For Class 12 students:* - In Arts stream: 2 boys and 2 girls (total 4 students) will be selected. - In Science stream: 2 boys and 2 girls (total 4 students) will be selected. - In Commerce stream: 2 boys and 2 girls (total 4 students) will be selected. Note: The amount receive through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to the bank account linked to the student's JanAadhaar.
summary: Under the scheme, a cash award of ₹50,000 will be given to students studying in government schools affiliated with the Rajasthan Board of Secondary Education, Ajmer, who secure the highest marks in the EWS category in the Class 10th and Class 12th examinations (Arts, Commerce, and Science streams).

title: NEET/JEE Coaching For Tribal Students
eligibility_details: 1. Belong to a tribal community. 1. Have successfully completed 12th grade in the science stream with a first-class standing.
benefits:
The NEET/JEE Coaching for Tribal Students Scheme is a government initiative launched by the Rajasthan Tribal Area Development Department to provide free coaching to tribal students in the state who are preparing for the National Eligibility cum Entrance Test (NEET) and Joint Entrance Examination (JEE). The aim of the scheme is to help talented tribal students in Rajasthan to get admission to prestigious medical and engineering colleges in India by providing them with high-quality coaching.
Under the scheme, the Rajasthan government has partnered with reputed coaching institutes to provide free coaching to eligible tribal students. The coaching includes intensive classroom sessions, doubt clearing sessions, study materials, and mock tests. The coaching institutes also provide guidance and mentorship to students to help them develop a better understanding of the subjects and excel in the exams.
To be eligible for the scheme, the student must belong to a tribal community, have passed the 12th class examination, and have a valid NEET/JEE score.
The NEET/JEE Coaching for Tribal Students Scheme is an important initiative to help talented students from tribal communities in Rajasthan to realize their dreams of pursuing a career in medicine and engineering.
summary: NEET/JEE Coaching for tribal students scheme launched in Rajasthan by Tribal Area Development in the year 2001.

title: Nirman Shramik Avm Unke Aashrit Bacchon Dwara Bhartiya Rajasthan Prashasnik Seva Hetu Aayojit Pratibhabhik Yojana
eligibility_details: 1. Applicant should be registered construction workers who are continuously depositing contributions 1. The annual income of the applicant parents from all sources should not exceed ₹2,50,000/- 1. Applicant who are already working in government services will not be given benefits. 1. The applicant must have passed the following preliminary competitive examination:- 1. Indian Administrative Service. 1. Rajasthan Administrative Service. 1. No benefit will be payable under this scheme for administrative examination of states other than Rajasthan state. 1. Incentive amount will be given maximum once only for Indian Administrative Service and Rajasthan Administrative Service, that is, if incentive amount has been given for competitive examination in the past, then in the coming year, incentive amount will be given again for passing the preliminary examination of the same competitive examination. But incentive amount will not be payable. 1. If any fact is found to be false in the information given by the beneficiary in the assistance application submitted under the scheme, then it will be the responsibility of the concerned beneficiary to deposit the entire amount of assistance accepted under the scheme in one lump sum along with interest.
benefits: 1. On passing the preliminary examination of Indian Administrative Service – ₹1,00,000/- 1. On passing the preliminary examination of Rajasthan Administrative Service – ₹50,000/-
summary: The Labor department of Rajasthan started "Nirman Shramik Avm Unke Aashrit Bacchon Dwara Bhartiya Rajasthan Prashasnik Seva Hetu Aayojit Pratibhabhik Yojana" to help the children of construction workers.

title: Nirman Shramik Siksha Kaushal Vikas Yojana
eligibility_details: 1. The beneficiary must be a registered construction worker in the board. 1. Only the son/daughter/wife of the beneficiary will be eligible for the education assistance (scholarship) scheme. 1. A maximum of two children of the beneficiary or one child and wife will be eligible to receive the scholarship. However, if both husband and wife are registered beneficiaries, then a maximum of two children of the husband and wife will be eligible for the scholarship. However, there will be no limit for meritorious students to receive cash awards. 1. The student must be studying regularly in a government or private school or college recognized by the Central/State Government from class 6 to postgraduate level. 1. The student must be studying regularly in a government or recognized private ITI and polytechnic course run in the state. 1. To receive the cash award, meritorious students must have passed the class 8 to 12th examination with 75% marks or equivalent grade. Must have obtained/passed 60% or more marks or equivalent grade in diploma, graduation and postgraduate level examination (including medical, engineering or other professional examination). 1. The age of the beneficiary's wife should not be more than 35 years for the eligibility of scholarship and she should be studying regularly in an educational institution. 1. Scholarship will be payable only after passing the relevant examination for a year. 1. The student will be eligible for the scholarship only after getting admission in the next class after the opening of the educational/training institution after the summer vacation. However, in case of passing the final examination of 12th class, diploma, graduation or postgraduate course, it will not be necessary to take admission in the next class. 1. A beneficiary who does not deposit the contribution for a continuous period of one year will cease to be a beneficiary. Therefore, the son/daughter/wife of such a construction worker who fails to deposit the contribution will not be eligible for the scholarship under the scheme. However, the scholarship will be paid on restoration of the beneficiary under the proviso of the above section and rule.
benefits:
The following scholarships will be provided to the male and female students after taking admission in the upcoming class: -
ClassStudentStudent / Specially abledFrom class 6th to 8th₹ 8,000/- per year₹ 9,000/- per yearFrom class 9th to 12th₹ 9,000/- per year₹ 10,000/- per yearITI₹ 9,000/- per year₹ 10,000/- per yearDiploma₹ 10,000/- per year₹ 11,000/- per yearGraduation (General)₹ 13,000/- per year₹ 15,000/- per yearGraduate (Professional)₹ 18,000/- per year₹ 20,000/- per yearPost Graduate (General)₹15,000/- per year₹ 17,000/- per yearPost Graduate (Professional)₹ 23,000/- per year₹ 25,000/- per year
Beneficiary meritorious students will be given the following cash awards under the scheme:-
