summary: The NIRMAN SHRAMIK SIKSHA KAUSHAL VIKAS YOJANA (NSKKVY) is a scheme launched by the Government of Rajasthan to provide financial assistance for education and skill development to the children of registered construction workers in the state.

title: Operation of Ashram Hostels
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan. 1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Tribe community. 1. Scheduled Tribe students are eligible if there is no primary school within 1.5 km, no upper primary school within 3 km, and no secondary/higher secondary school within 5 km of their residence. 1. The parents/guardians should not be an income tax payee. 1. The applicant's family should not own more than 400 square yards of urban land. 1. The applicant's family should not own more than 15 bighas of agricultural land. 1. The student should pass the current academic year to continue enrollment in the next year. 1. The student should be a resident of the same district in which the hostel application has been made. Notes: - All new admissions will be made on the basis of merit. - Admission to hostels in specific tribal areas will be given only to tribal students belonging to the same area. - Re-admission in the next academic year will be granted only if the student passes the annual examination.
benefits: Students are provided with the following annually and monthly benefits: Annually (per student): - School uniform with stitching - Shoes, socks, towel, and warm sweater Monthly (per student): - Nutritious breakfast and meals - Hair oil - Bathing and washing soap - Hair cutting service - Laundry for bed linen (sheet, pillow cover, blanket) - Electricity and water facilities - Newspapers and magazines
summary: Under this scheme, free accommodation, nutritious meals, educational materials, uniforms, personal hygiene items, and other facilities are provided to Scheduled Tribe (ST) students residing in ashram hostels operated by the Tribal Area Development Department.

title: Rajiv Gandhi Scholarship For Academic Excellence
eligibility_details: 1. Bonafide Resident of Rajasthan. 1. Less than 35 years of age on 1st July 2023 1. Admitted / Obtained offer letter in top 150 World QS ranked Universities as of 1st April, 2023 1. All disciplines for UG, PG, PhD and Post Doc courses. 1. Maximum 7.5 % seats ( 37 ) for Engineering, Architecture, Medical, Dentistry courses at UG level
benefits: 1. E1: Family gross annual income less than 8 Lakh (i). Tuition Fees and Bench fee: Max 50 lakh (ii). Living Expenses: 12 Lakh Rupees. (iii). One-time advance of Rs 3 Lakh to candidates who will start their course after application on the portal (adjusted against living expenses). 1. E2: Family gross annual income 8 – 25 Lakh (i). Tuition Fees and Bench fee: Max 50 lakh (ii). Living Expenses: 6 Lakh Rupees 1. E3: Family gross annual income above 25 Lakh (i). Tuition Fees and Bench fee: Max 50 lakh (ii). No Living Expenses
summary: In order to provide financial assistance to meritorious students of Rajasthan to study in top foreign universities of the world. The scheme commenced from 5th October 2021.

title: Rajya Pratibha Khoj Pariksha Chhatravriti Yojana
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan. 1. The applicant should be a student currently enrolled in Class 10 or Class 12. 1. The student should be studying in a government school, a recognized private school, or a Swami Vivekanand Model School located in Rajasthan. 1. For Class 10 applicants, a minimum of 50% marks should have been secured in Class 9. For Class 12 applicants, at least 50% marks should have been obtained in Class 11. 1. The applicant should have appeared for and qualified in the State Talent Search Examination conducted by the Board of Secondary Education, Rajasthan. 1. To be considered for selection, the applicant should have scored a minimum of 80% marks in the Talent Search Examination.
benefits: Type of Benefit: Scholarship and One-Time Incentive Class at the time of applicationNo. of Selected Students &amp;amp; Basis of Selection BasisScholarship Rate (For a period of 10 Months)One-Time Incentive (20 students in each)Class 10th50 students (≥80% marks)₹1,250/month (for Class 11-12)₹4,000 for topper, ₹2,000 each for othersClass 12th - Arts50 students (≥80% marks)₹2,000/month (for UG &amp;amp; PG)₹4,000 for topper, ₹2,000 each for othersClass 12th - Commerce50 students (≥80% marks)₹2,000/month (for UG &amp;amp; PG)₹4,000 for topper, ₹2,000 each for othersClass 12th - Science50 students (≥80% marks)₹2,000/month (for UG &amp;amp; PG)₹4,000 for topper, ₹2,000 each for othersNOTE: - Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to the beneficiary’s bank account. - Monthly (for up to 10 months per academic year).
summary: Under this scheme, students are provided with scholarships or a one-time incentive for pursuing education up to the postgraduate level, after being selected through the State Talent Search Examination organized by the Board of Secondary Education Rajasthan, Ajmer.

title: Research Fellowship Scheme for Scheduled Tribe Candidates
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan. 1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Tribe community. 1. The applicant should be a resident of Scheduled Area of Rajasthan or a resident of Shahbad and Kishanganj tehsils of Baran district (Saheria Project Area). 1. The applicant should have completed Post-graduation with at least 50% marks from a recognized university. 1. The applicant should be registered in a recognized Central/State/Deemed/Private University in India for pursuing a Ph.D. programme.
benefits: *Financial Assistance:* - The selected scholar shall be paid @ ₹15,000/- per month. - A contingency grant of ₹40,000/- shall be given to the candidate for meeting the recurring expenditure viz. books/ Journals/Traveling/Stationery etc. *Tenure:* The tenure of the scholarship shall be for a period of maximum five years from the date of sanction from the Tribal Research Institute or completion of Ph.D. whichever is earlier. *Extension of Fellowship Term & Final Payments:* The scholarship term shall not be extended under any circumstances. If, per chance, the candidate fails to complete his/her Ph.D work within the period of five years, the final installment of scholarship (equivalent to six month and last installment of contingency) shall be withheld until the Ph.D. is awarded to the candidate.
summary: The scheme aims to support the Scheduled Tribe candidates from Scheduled Areas and the Saharia Area of Rajasthan to register themselves as research scholars with all recognized Central/State/Deemed/Private University located in any part of India for pursuing Ph.D. Programme.

title: Schedule Caste Pre-Metric Scholarship Class 06 To 08
eligibility_details: 1. The student should belong to the Scheduled Caste category. 1. The student should study as a regular student in classes 6 to 8 in schools run by the Central Government, State Government, Municipalities and schools recognized by the Department of Education. 1. Student guardians should not be income taxpayers in case of parent(s) are not alive. 1. The students who are not getting any other type of scholarship or allowance for study from central, state / public sources. 1. The student who has not failed in the lower class in the last session. If he fails in the examination of any year, his scholarship will be stopped, but if he passes the same class in the next examination, he will be eligible for scholarship in the new class from the next session. For this, the student will have to apply for a new scholarship again.
benefits: - For Schedule Caste Boy Students Rs. 75/- per month. - For Schedule Caste Girl Students Rs. 125/- per month.
summary: In the year 1998, Rajasthan Government started a scholarship to encourage the education of Schedule Cast.

title: Schedule Tribe Pre-Metric Scholarship Class 06 To 08
eligibility_details: 1. The student should belong to the Scheduled Tribe category. 1. The student who is studying as a regular student in classes 6 to 8 in schools run by the Central Government, State Government, Municipalities and schools recognized by the Department of Education. 1. Students whose parents/guardians are not income taxpayers when they are not alive. 1. The student who is not getting any other type of scholarship or allowance for study from central, state / public sources. 1. The student who has not failed in the lower class in the last session. If he fails in any year's examination, his scholarship will be stopped, but if he fails in the same class in the next 1. If he passes the examination, he will be eligible for the scholarship in the new class from the next session. For this, the student will have to apply for a new scholarship again. 1. Students who are not living in hostels are run or aided by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment.
benefits: - For Schedule Caste Boy Students Rs. 75/- per month. - For Schedule Caste Girl Students Rs. 125/- per month.
summary: In the year 1984, Rajasthan Government started a scholarship to encourage the education of the Schedule Tribe.

title: Scheme For Study In Abroad
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant girl should be among the first three girls at the state level studying in class 10th government school of Board of Secondary Education, Rajasthan. 1. The girl students securing the first three positions are given the opportunity to pursue graduate-level education abroad
benefits: 1. A maximum of Rs. 30,000 for coaching and up to Rs.50,000 for registration for SAT (Scholastic Aptitude Test) examination will be borne by the state government per student on the basis of actual expenditure. 1. An amount of Rs. 25 thousand will be given to each girl student for submitting an application form for admission to a foreign university. 1. After the acceptance of the application by the foreign university, full accommodation facility of the university will be given and the economy class fare will also be provided to meet the parent once a year 1. A maximum amount of up to Rs.10.00 lakh per year will be spent on all the items on each student in the 4-year course.
summary: In the year 2010-11, Rajasthan Government has taken the initiative to encourage girl child education by starting a scheme to Study Abroad.

title: Scholarship for Children of Ex-Servicemen for Vocational and Technical Education
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan. 1. The applicant should be an ex-serviceman of the rank of Havildar or below, or his widow/dependent. 1. The applicant should be pursuing a vocational or technical education course included in the Prime Minister Scholarship Scheme (https://www.ksb.gov.in/writereaddata/DownLoad/ListofAuthorisedprofessionaldegreecoursesunder_PMSS.pdf) (PMSS). 1. The applicant should not be receiving benefits under the Prime Minister’s Scholarship Scheme or any other scholarship scheme. 1. This scholarship is not admissible in cases of Battle Casualty/Disability and Physical Casualty (attributable cases), as in such cases, scholarships are already provided by the Army Headquarters. 1. The applicant must have passed the previous academic year successfully; failure to pass results in the discontinuation of the scholarship. 1. The scholarship will not be payable to more than two children of an ex-serviceman. Notes: - Once selected, the scholarship will continue for the remaining duration of the course, subject to annual renewal. - In case of failure in any year, the scholarship will be cancelled for the entire course.
benefits: Financial Assistance: - An scholarship of ₹15,000/- per year per student. Mode of Disbursement: - Scholarship is disbursed through online payment to the beneficiary’s bank account. Note 1: Only 50 students are selected each year based on merit. Note 2: Scholarship will be payable in the passing year i.e. scholarship of first year will be payable in the second year. Similarly, scholarship of second year will be payable in the third year.
summary: Under this scheme, a scholarship of ₹15,000 per year is provided to the children of ex-servicemen, from the rank of Sepoy to Havildar, who are pursuing vocational & technical education & have not received scholarship assistance under the Prime Minister's Scholarship Scheme or from any other source.

title: Transgender Utthan Kosh - College/Higher/Technical Educational Fees Refund for Transgender Students
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Rajasthan. 1. The applicant should belong to the transgender community. 1. The applicant should be pursuing a higher or technical course. 1. The applicant should be enrolled in a recognized school, college, or technical education institute in Rajasthan. 1. The applicant’s family annual income should not exceed ₹8,00,000/-.
benefits: *Educational Fee Refund:* - Full reimbursement of prescribed fees is provided for transgender students enrolled in schools, colleges, or technical institutes pursuing higher or technical education. *Direct Bank Transfer:* - The amount is credited directly to the beneficiary's bank account after verification.
summary: The scheme aims to promote higher and technical education among transgender individuals by providing financial assistance for their educational expenses. Under this scheme, transgender students receive a refund of their school, college, higher, or technical education fees.

title: Transgender Utthan Kosh - Financial Assistance for Studying Bisexual Children
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan. 1. The applicant should belong to transgender community. 1. The applicant should be studying in class 6th or higher class. 1. The applicant should be residing away from their home for study purpose. 1. The gross annual income of applicant should be up to ₹8.00 lakh.
benefits: - Financial assistance of ₹6,000/- per month for up to 12 months to support transgender students living away from their homes for education. NOTE: - Assistance is provided directly to the student's bank account. - Students must submit a rental receipt each month to continue receiving assistance.
summary: The scheme objective is to provide financial assistance of ₹6,000 per month for up to 12 months to transgender students from Class 6 and above for accommodation and daily needs if they live away from their homes for education.

title: Transgender Utthan Kosh - Post Matric Scholarship for Studying Transgender
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Rajasthan. 1. The applicant should belong to the transgender community. 1. The applicant should be studying at the post-matric level. 1. The applicant should be enrolled in a recognized school/college in Rajasthan. 1. The applicant’s family annual income should not exceed ₹8,00,000/-.
benefits: *Post-Matric Scholarship:* - Scholarship @ ₹1,000/- per month per student for 10 months. NOTE: The scholarship amount is directly transferred to the beneficiary's bank account.
summary: The scheme aims to support transgender students pursuing post-matric education. Under this scheme, transgender students receive a monthly scholarship of ₹1,000/- to cover educational expenses for their post-matric studies.

title: Transgender Utthan Kosh - Pre Matric Scholarship for Studying Transgender
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Rajasthan. 1. The applicant should belong to the transgender community. 1. The applicant should be studying at the primary to pre-matric level. 1. The applicant should be enrolled in a recognized school within Rajasthan. 1. The applicant’s family annual income should not exceed ₹8,00,000/-.
benefits: *Pre-Matric Scholarship:* - ₹225/- per month per student for 10 months. NOTE: The scholarship amount is directly transferred to the beneficiary's bank account.
summary: The scheme aims to support transgender students by providing scholarships to encourage their education and social upliftment. Under this scheme, transgender students receive a monthly scholarship of ₹225/- per month to cover educational expenses from primary to pre-matric levels.

title: Urdu Scholarship- Rajasthan
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan. 1. At graduation level, only female students are eligible. 1. At post-graduation level, both male and female students are eligible. 1. The applicant should be studying Urdu as an optional subject at the graduation or post-graduation level. 1. For graduation level applicants, a minimum of 50% marks in the previous qualifying examination is required. 1. For post-graduation level applicants, the student should have passed graduation/post-graduation with at least second division. 1. It is mandatory to study Urdu as a subject to receive the scholarship. 1. The scholarship is applicable only for those who are regularly enrolled in recognized colleges/universities.
benefits: - A monthly scholarship of ₹100/- for students studying Urdu at the undergraduate level. - A monthly scholarship of ₹150/- for students studying Urdu at the postgraduate level.
summary: The scheme aims to promote the Urdu language among female students at the undergraduate and postgraduate levels. Under this scheme, a monthly scholarship is provided to undergraduate and postgraduate students who are studying Urdu as an optional subject.

title: Vishesh Yogyajan Chhatravriti Yojana
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan. 1. The applicant should be a student. 1. The applicant should have at least 40% disability. 1. The applicant should be a regular student in a government or recognized educational institution. 1. The applicant’s family annual income should not exceed ₹2,00,000/-. 1. The applicant should have passed the previous academic year. 1. The applicant should not be a recipient of any other state government or NGO/trust-provided scholarship or allowance.
benefits: Scholarship Grant: - Financial assistance is provided as a scholarship to the students. Tuition Fee Reimbursement: - The scheme covers the tuition fee expenses for students studying in government-recognized institutions.
summary: Under this scheme, scholarships and tuition fee reimbursement are provided to specially-abled students belonging to families with an annual income not exceeding ₹2.00 lakh, who are regularly studying in government and recognized educational institutions.

title: Vishesh Yogyajan Palanhar Yojana
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Rajasthan. 1. Only children aged 0 to 18 years of specially-abled parents are eligible for assistance. 1. The child must be between 2 to 5 years of age and enrolled in an Anganwadi or school. 1. Children above the age of 6 must be studying in a recognized educational institution. 1. The family's annual income should not exceed ₹1,20,000/-.
benefits: 1. Financial assistance of ₹500/- per month for children aged 0-6 years. 1. Financial assistance of ₹1,000/- per month for children aged 6-18 years.
summary: Under this scheme, children receive monthly financial support based on their age to ensure their well-being and education. To be eligible for assistance, the child must attend an Anganwadi/school between the ages of two to five years and study in school after the age of 6 years.

title: Widow B.Ed Scheme-Rajasthan
eligibility_details: 1. It is mandatory for the candidate to be of Rajasthan origin. 1. Only women taking B.Ed training will be made beneficiaries. 1. Applicants must be regular students of the B.Ed training program from any government and recognized private institute in Rajasthan. 1. It is necessary for the beneficiary woman to be divorced and abandoned. 1. Women who have obtained a B.Ed degree earlier by taking admission in B.Ed course will be ineligible. 1. 75 percent attendance of women in the concerned institute will be mandatory. 1. The female candidate should not be a beneficiary of any other scholarship or equivalent scheme of the Government.
benefits: - Financial Assistance : ₹17,880 (Fee Reimbursement).
summary: In 2015-16, Rajasthan State started the "Widow B.Ed Scheme" for Widow/abandoned women.

title: Young Interns Program
eligibility_details:
General 1. The age of the applicant should be between 21 years and 30 years. 1. The applicant should have excellent communication/presentation/intra–personal skills/soft skills. 1. The applicant should have good Knowledge of English as well as Hindi language (Reading, Speaking, Writing and Understanding) 1. The applicant should have well-versed ICT skills and knowledge of MS Office and other similar programs on alternative platforms. 1. It is mandatory for all the interns to have their own Laptop and data card/internet facility.
Education Specific 1. The applicant should have a post-graduate qualification with a minimum of 60% marks or a CGPA of 6 on a scale of 10 in any stream from a recognized university. 1. The graduate applicant of Engineering/Medical/Law/CA/CS Streams from a recognized University with a minimum 60% mark or a CGPA of 6 on a scale of 10 shall also be eligible for this internship.
Reservation / Preference / Priority 1. The applicant with working experience in the field of his/her choice of department shall be given priority.
NOTE 1: Any other additional educational and/or technical qualifications and experience shall be as per the special requirements submitted by the concerned department/district collector/divisional HQ, if any. NOTE 2: In case of any dispute, the decision of the Secretary-in-charge of, Statistics Department will be binding and final.
benefits:
Stipend ₹ 30,000/- per month.
Laptop Connectivity and Mobility Support ₹ 2500/- shall be paid to each intern per month.
Leaves Every intern will be eligible for one casual leave every month on an accrual basis. Such leaves shall be provided in a cumulative manner i.e. 12 leaves for the entire year (from January to December).
summary: The Young Interns Program (YIP) is an internship program, envisaged by the Government of Rajasthan, for providing opportunities for talented and progressive youth to upgrade their skills by gaining practical experience working in programs, schemes and projects of the government departments.

title: Assistance Scheme For Reimbursement For Expenditure On Visa By Construction Workers For Employment Abroad
eligibility_details:
1. Applicant should be a resident of Rajasthan State. 2.Applicant should be registered as Construction Worker under labor laws.
Other Conditions 1. For getting contract employment abroad, it is necessary to take permission for migration from the office of Protectors of Emigrants (POE) under the Migrant Act, 1983. 2. Registration of the recruiting agency under the Overseas Act or a valid permit from the POE office is necessary. 3. Reimbursement of visa amount under the above scheme will be payable on the beneficiary passport having a minimum validity of 6 months including valid visa. 4. Under the scheme, the benefit of assistance amount will be payable to the beneficiary only once. 5. During scrutiny of application and documents, if any facts found to be false resulting in the cancellation of eligibility, it will be the responsibility of the concerned beneficiary to deposit all the assistance amount sanctioned under the scheme along with interest. 6. The benefit of this scheme will be payable only if the beneficiary is employed abroad, is in the building and other construction works.
benefits:
The Reimbursement of Expenditure Incurred on Visa for Employment Abroad to Construction Workers is a scheme implemented in the state of Rajasthan to provide financial assistance to construction workers who are seeking employment abroad. Under this scheme, registered construction workers in Rajasthan who have secured employment in foreign countries are eligible for reimbursement of expenses incurred on obtaining the necessary visa and related documentation.
To be eligible for this scheme, the construction worker must be registered with the Construction Workers Welfare Board in Rajasthan and provide proof of employment in a foreign country. The aim of this scheme is to reduce the financial burden on construction workers who are seeking employment abroad by providing financial support for expenses related to obtaining visas, which can often be a significant expense. This scheme aims to promote the welfare of construction workers and support them in their efforts to secure employment opportunities abroad.
summary: This scheme will be called "Reimbursement of expenditure incurred on visa for employment abroad to construction workers". The purpose of this scheme is to provide assistance to the registered beneficiaries employed in building and other construction works for better employment opportunities.

title: Leather Training Scheme - Rajasthan
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan. 1. The applicant's age should be between 18 to 35 years. 1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste (SC), Scheduled Tribe (ST), Other Backward Class (OBC), or General category. 1. The applicant should be literate. Note 1: The Selection Committee has the authority to provide up to 10 years of age relaxation on a case-by-case basis. Note 2: Preference will be given to trainees who have passed 8th standard and are more educated.
benefits: Skill Development Training - Modern technical training in Nagara Jooti (15 trainees per batch). - Leather goods training (20 trainees per batch). Stipend - Each trainee receives ₹500/- per month during the training period. Tool Kits - Tool kits worth up to ₹1,000/- are provided to each trainee after successful completion of the training. Training Duration - Two months.
summary: The scheme aims to promote leather industry, improve production & quality of leather products, develop new designs, & generate self-employment. Under this scheme, training is provided in latest techniques for leather dyeing, Nagara Jooti, leather goods, etc. through District Industry Centers.

title: Mahila Swayamsiddha Yojana Rajasthan
category: Housing & Shelter, Women and Child, Skills & Employment
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a registered voluntary organization, trust, or NGO. 1. The organization must be operational for at least three years before applying. 1. The organization should be non-profit and focused on women’s welfare. 1. The organization must have a formally structured administrative and management committee. 1. The organization should not be blacklisted or penalized by any government department.
