summary: The scheme objective is to provide free skill training and self-employment support to widowed, abandoned, and destitute women through voluntary organizations. The scheme is implemented by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department with financial assistance provided to participating NGOs.

title: Motorized Tricycle Yojana
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a native of Rajasthan. 1. The applicant should be self-employed or a student pursuing senior higher secondary education. 1. The applicant must have a 50% or more locomotor disability. 1. The annual family (parents/guardians including applicant's income, if any) income should not exceed ₹2,50,000/-. 1. The applicant's age must be 18 years or older. 1. The applicant must have prior experience in operating a vehicle and hold a valid driving license.
benefits: Under this scheme, beneficiaries will receive a motorized tricycle free of cost to support self-employment and higher education from the Senior Secondary level onwards.
summary: Under this scheme, motorized tricycles are provided to specially-abled individuals with 50% or more locomotor disability to support self-employment and pursuing higher education from Senior Higher Secondary onwards.

title: Mukhyamantri Hunar Vikas Yojana- Professional/Technical Training
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a beneficiary under the Palanhar Scheme of Rajasthan. 1. The applicant should have completed 15 years of age. 1. The applicant’s maximum age should not exceed 21 years, or till course completion (whichever is earlier).
benefits: *Professional/Technical Training Benefits:* - Vocational/technical training will be provided to Palanhar beneficiary boys/girls through recognized training providers by the Rajasthan Skill and Livelihood Development Corporation / Rajasthan Knowledge Corporation Limited (RKCL) / Jan Shikshan Sansthan / industrial training institutes recognized by the state government/central government. - The State Government will reimburse the prescribed fees and other expenses to the training provider institute for the related program. - If the boy/girl wants to avail hostel or any other prescribed facility/fee (mess fee, stationery and dress fee) of the concerned institute, then that will also be reimbursed. - A maximum of 2 training programmes can be availed under this scheme, provided the beneficiary is below 21 years of age or till the completion of the respective course. - The boy / girl receiving training under the scheme will be given a training certificate by the concerned institute / training provider. Note: Fees and other expenses will be provided directly to the concerned training institute after admission of the boy / girl in the respective programme.
summary: Under this scheme, vocational/technical training is provided to Palanhar beneficiary boys & girls through recognized training providers such as the Rajasthan Skill & Livelihood Development Corporation, Rajasthan Knowledge Corporation Ltd., it is etc. recognized by the State or Central Govt.

title: Mukhyamantri Hunar Vikas Yojana- Self-Employment/Business
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a beneficiary under the Palanhar Scheme of Rajasthan. 1. The applicant should have completed skill training under the scheme. 1. The applicant’s age should be 21 years or above. 1. The applicant should be registered their business through Udyam Aadhaar Portal is required for self-employment assistance.
benefits: Financial Assistance: - Financial assistance up to ₹50,000 or the actual/estimated cost, whichever is lower, to establish self-employment/business. Payment Disbursed in Two Installments - First Installment: 60% for establishing the necessary shop/location or purchasing equipment, raw materials, etc. - Second Installment: After establishing, the remaining 40% amount will be paid based on the inspection report by the officer appointed by the District Collector. Mode of Disbursement: - The financial assistance is directly deposited into the beneficiary's bank savings account.
summary: Under this scheme, eligible boys and girls receive financial assistance in two installments - 60% initially and 40% later, to establish self-employment or business ventures. The support is specifically linked to the training course completed by the beneficiary.

title: Shubhshakti Yojana
eligibility_details: 1. One parent (either father or mother or both) must be registered as a beneficiary/construction worker for at least one year in the board. 1. A maximum of two daughters of the beneficiary or the female beneficiary and her one daughter will be given the incentive amount. 1. The female beneficiary must be unmarried or the beneficiary's daughter must be at least 18 years old and unmarried. 1. The daughter of the beneficiary/female beneficiary must have passed at least the 8th standard. 1. There should be a savings bank account in the name of the daughter of the beneficiary/female beneficiary. 1. If the beneficiary has his own house, there should be a toilet in the house. 1. The beneficiary must have worked as a construction worker for at least 90 days during the year before the application date. 1. The incentive amount will be payable only after physical verification of the beneficiary being a construction worker, which can be done by various authorities. 1. The incentive amount can be used by the female beneficiary/daughter for further education, vocational training, starting her own business, or for her own marriage, with proper counseling. 1. The application for the scheme must be submitted in the prescribed form by the beneficiary after completing one year as a registered beneficiary, and the beneficiary's identity card must be valid/active at the time of application. 1. Girls who have already received assistance under the Board's Marriage Assistance Scheme earlier will not be eligible for assistance under this scheme.
benefits: - Receives a financial assistance of ₹55,000/-. - The amount is directly transferred to the beneficiary's bank account. - The funds can be used for various purposes, including: 1. Higher education 1. Vocational training 1. Starting a business 1. Skill development training 1. Marriage expenses
summary: The Shubshakti Yojana has been initiated by the Rajasthan government with the aim of providing financial assistance to regular construction workers, unmarried laborers, and their daughters.

title: Transgender Utthan Kosh - Self Employment Programme for Transgender
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Rajasthan. 1. The applicant should be a transgender person. 1. The applicant should be between 21 and 50 years of age. 1. The applicant should secure a loan from a nationalized/cooperative bank. 1. The gross annual income of applicant should not exceed ₹8,00,000/-. 1. Each transgender individual can avail the benefits of this scheme only once.
benefits: - Financial Assistance: 25% of the total business cost or ₹50,000/- (whichever is lower) for self-employment/business establishment.- Loan Support: The beneficiary must secure a loan from a nationalized/cooperative bank to avail of the grant.- One-Time Benefit: The assistance is available only once per individual. Note: The grant is disbursed only after the beneficiary starts the business and gets it verified by the lending agency.
summary: The scheme objective is to provide financial assistance to transgender individuals for self-employment/business establishment. Eligible beneficiaries can receive up to ₹50,000/- or 25% of the project cost.

title: Transgender Utthan Kosh - Training Programme for Transgender
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Rajasthan. 1. The applicant should be a transgender person. 1. The gross annual income of applicant should not exceed ₹8,00,000/-. 1. A maximum of two training courses can be availed under this scheme. Note 1: The applicant must meet the minimum age and educational qualification criteria set by the respective training institution. Note 2: The State Government will reimburse the prescribed fees and other expenses to the training providing institute for the concerned programme. Note 3: The fees will be made available directly to the concerned training institute after the transgender person is admitted to the respective programme.
benefits: *Skill Development:* - Vocational/technical training will be provided to transgender persons through the Rajasthan Skill and Livelihood Development Corporation (RSLDC), Rajasthan Knowledge Corporation Limited (RKCL), Jan Shikshan Sansthan, Industrial Training Institutes (ITIs), or training providers recognized by the State or Central Government. *Financial Assistance:* - After receiving skill development training, each trainee will be given a lump sum amount of ₹5,000/- per month for one course (for maximum three months and for two courses). - Transgender persons can avail maximum 2 training programmes only. *Training Fee Coverage:*** - The state government reimburses the training fee directly to the training institutions. *Employment Support and Certificate:* - Upon completion of training, the beneficiary will receive a certificate and employment assistance.
summary: The scheme aims to support the socio-economic development of transgender individuals by providing financial assistance, skill training, and employment opportunities.

title: Indira Gandhi National Vidhva Pension yojana
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should have a domicile in the state of Rajasthan. 1. The applicant should be from a Below Poverty Line (BPL) family. 1. The application should be aged 40 years.
benefits: - Women who are more than 40 to less than 75 years old monthly pension of ₹ 1000/-. - Women who are more than 75 years old monthly pension of ₹ 1500/-.
summary: In the Indira Gandhi National Vidhva Pension Yojana (IGNWPS), financial support is provided to the widows of the state of Rajasthan.

title: Indira Gandhi National Vrdhavastha Pension Yojana
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan. 1. The age of the applicant (male or female) is 60 years or more. 1. The applicant should belong to a family living below the poverty line as per the criteria set by the Government of India.
benefits: Pension amount: ₹ 1000 /- per month.
summary: In this scheme, pension is payable to persons below from BPL category families listed as per the norms of the Government of India.

title: Jan Samuh Bima Yojana
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be native Rajasthan. 1. The applicant should be a family member or dependent of the deceased person. 1. The deceased person should belong to the Sahariya community. 1. The deceased person should be a resident of the Baran district, Rajasthan. 1. The insured person must be registered under the scheme before death.
benefits: Financial Assistance: - The insurance company provides financial assistance of ₹25,000/- to the family in case of death of the insured person. Insurance Premium: - Fully paid under the Swachh Project.
summary: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to Sahariya families in the event of the death of the heads of the families. Under this scheme, a one-time financial assistance of ₹25,000/- is provided by the insurance company to the deceased's family to help reduce their economic burden.

title: Nirman Shramik Auzaar Toolkit Sahayata Yojana
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a native of the Rajasthan state. 1. The applicant must be a registered construction worker for 3 years. 1. Amount payable only on purchasing tools/toolkits related to one's work or business. 1. The purchase of tools/toolkits will be done by the construction worker himself and the bill is required to be attached to the application.
benefits: Actual cost of purchasing tools/toolkit or ₹ 2,000/-, whichever is less
summary: The NIRMAN SHRAMIK AUZAAR TOOLKIT SAHAYATA YOJANA is a social welfare scheme launched by the Government of Jharkhand to provide financial assistance to registered construction workers in the state for the purchase of essential tools and equipment required for their work.

title: Nirman Shramikon ke Liye Vyavsayik Rin Par Byaj ki Punarbharan Yojana
eligibility_details: 1. Applicant must be construction worker and registered with the board are regularly depositing contributions. 1. Applicant can utilities the loan amount only for own business work. 1. Application can not use loan amount for purchase of shop/plot/vehicle or household goods. 1. Applicant have to submit a certificate of intention to repay interest to the financial institution every year. 1. This scheme will be applicable only on the loan taken by one of the registered beneficiary's wife/husband at a time. 1. If any information provided in the application for assistance under the scheme by the beneficiary is found to be false, the responsibility of depositing the entire sanctioned assistance amount along with interest in lump sum will be of the concerned beneficiary.
benefits: The board will reimburse the interest payable on business loans up to ₹5,00,000/-
summary: The "Nirman Shramik Rin Punarbharan Yojana" helps construction workers by reimbursing interest on their business loans. This program aims to ease the financial burden of construction workers by reducing their loan interest payments.

title: Scheme for Additional Interest Subsidy over and above RIPS 2024 and Reimbursement of Annual Credit Guarantee Fee
eligibility_details: Following type of beneficiaries would be eligible for additional interest subsidy as per the scheme: 1. Interest subvention subsidy should have been approved for the applicant under RIPS 2024; and 1. Beneficiary enterprise should fall under any of the following categories: - One District One Product (ODOP) enterprises in respective districts. - Enterprises owned by Scheduled Caste (SC)/Scheduled Tribe (ST) or women entrepreneurs. - Young entrepreneurs in the state in the age group of 18 to 45 years for starting their new enterprise for a maximum loan amount of up to ₹10 crore. - Establishment of new MSMEs or expansion/ diversification/ modernization of existing MSMEs in Area Category 3 as defined in RIPS 2024.
benefits: Additional Interest Subsidy support over and above RIPS 2024 will be provided to eligible projects for establishment of new MSMEs or for expansion/ diversification/ modernization of existing MSMEs as per below: Loan Amount for plant and machinery/equipment or apparatusInterest Subvention as per RIPS 2024Additional Interest Subvention under the schemeUp to INR 5 crores6%2%INR 5 crores-10 crores4%1%INR 10 crores-50 crores3%0.5%Note 1: The duration of the additional interest subsidy will be the same as prescribed under RIPS’2024 for MSMEs. Note 2: Enterprises availing collateral free term loan for plant and machinery/ equipment or apparatus (for loan amount below INR 5 Cr. only) from Member Lending Institutions (MLIs) under CGTMSE will be eligible to avail assistance as reimbursement of 100% Annual Guarantee Fees paid to MLIs for the period of seven (7) years.
summary: As per the MSME Policy 2024, it supports the establishment of new MSMEs and the expansion, diversification, or modernization of existing ones by offering interest subsidies and reimbursement of guarantee fees to ease access to finance and reduce the cost of credit.

title: Aastha Yojana
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan. 1. The two or more members should be specially abled from the same family. 1. The applicant must have a disability of 40%. 1. The annual family income should not exceed ₹1,20,000/-.
benefits: - Aastha cardholder families receive benefits similar to BPL families, including free medical treatment and ration supplies. Note: Aastha cardholders are entitled to benefits from all BPL-related schemes run by different state government departments.
summary: The scheme aims to provide BPL-equivalent benefits to families with two or more specially-abled members. Under this scheme, eligible families receive free medical treatment, ration supplies, and other welfare benefits.

title: Financial Assistance for the Treatment of Blind, Disabled, Deaf, Dumb, or Mentally Challenged Ex-Servicemen and their Dependents (Wife and Children)
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan. 1. The applicant should either be an ex-serviceman as defined by the Government of India or a dependent family member (excluding parents) of ex-serviceman. 1. Only an ex-serviceman holding the rank of Havildar or below, or their family members, are eligible to apply. 1. The ex-serviceman or their dependent should have a disability of 40% or more. 1. Both pensioner and non-pensioner are eligible. However, ex-serviceman who is already receiving a disability pension from the Army cannot apply for financial assistance for himself based on their disability. He may apply on behalf of a disabled family member with 40% or more disability. 1. Under this scheme, the family members do not include parents. Only wife/widow, son/daughter are included. 1. The ex-serviceman’s disability will be considered valid regardless of whether it occurred during military service or after retirement. 1. The name of the disabled wife, son, or daughter should be recorded in the discharge book or Part II Order of the ex-serviceman. 1. Assistance will not be provided to more than two members of the same family, including the ex-serviceman. 1. A valid recommendation from the District Sainik Welfare Officer (DSWO) is mandatory.
benefits: Financial Assistance: S. No.Percentage of DisabilityFinancial AssistancePriority180% and above₹3,000/- per monthFirst Priority260% but less than 80%₹2,000/- per monthSecond Priority340% but less than 60%₹1,000/- per monthThird PriorityNote: - The assistance is provided for three years. After that, the applicant will re-apply for renewal. - The financial aid is disbursed online through the District Sainik Welfare Office. - A maximum of two disabled family members of an ex-serviceman can avail of this benefit. - The financial assistance will cease upon the death of the disabled ex-serviceman or the disabled family member.
summary: The scheme aims to provide monthly financial assistance for the treatment of ex-servicemen and their dependents (wife & children) who have a disability of 40% or more and are suffering from serious illnesses such as cancer, leprosy, tuberculosis, kidney and cardiac ailments, paralysis, etc.

title: Financial Assistance Scheme for Dependents of Deceased Journalists and Litterateurs - Rajasthan
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a dependent of a deceased journalist or litterateur. 1. The deceased journalist or litterateur should have been a resident of Rajasthan. 1. The applicant should fall under one of the following categories: - Widow of the deceased journalist or litterateur with no other source of income. - Unemployed son below 28 years of age. - Unmarried daughter. - Father or mother of the deceased, provided they have no other source of income. Note: Financial assistance will be given to only one person at a time.
benefits: Monetary Assistance for Medical Treatment: - Up to ₹1,00,000/- for treatment of critical diseases (e.g., cancer, bypass surgery, kidney transplant, brain stroke, etc.). - In special cases, the committee may approve up to ₹2,00,000/-. Monthly Financial Assistance: - ₹1,000/- to ₹2,500/- per month for a maximum of one year.
summary: The scheme aims to provide financial support to the dependents of deceased journalists and litterateurs in situations such as medical emergencies, unemployment, or when there is no other source of income.

title: Financial Assistance Scheme for Journalists and Litterateurs - Rajasthan
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Rajasthan. 1. The applicant should be a journalist or litterateur. 1. The journalist or litterateur should meet one or more of the following criteria: - Suffering from incurable diseases such as tuberculosis, cancer, leprosy, or requiring treatment for serious conditions like valve replacement, transplantation, angioplasty, bypass surgery, or kidney-related ailments. - Unemployed due to ill health and without any other source of income. - Aged 60 years or above and having no other source of income. - Eligible on any other humanitarian grounds as recommended by the designated Committee. Note: Financial assistance will be given to only one person at a time.
benefits: Monetary Assistance for Medical Treatment: - Up to ₹1,00,000/- for treatment of critical diseases (e.g., cancer, bypass surgery, kidney transplant, brain stroke, etc.). - In special cases, the committee may approve up to ₹2,00,000/-. Monthly Financial Assistance: - ₹1,000 to ₹2,500 per month for a maximum of one year to unemployed journalists or those without income due to illness or old age.
summary: The scheme aims to provide financial support to journalists and litterateurs for the treatment of critical illnesses, medical emergencies and no source of income, unemployment, or advanced age.

title: Hita-dhikaari Ke Samanye Athava Durghatana Me Mrityu Ya Ghayal Hone Ki Dasha Me Sahayata Yojana
eligibility_details: 1. Construction workers must be between 18 to 60 years of age. 1. Construction workers must be registered with the labor board. 1. Construction worker must be depositing their contributions regularly.
benefits: 1. In case of death due to accident : ₹5,00,000/- 1. In case of permanent total disability due to accident : ₹3,00,000/- - Permanent total disability means disabling of two eyes or both hands or both legs due to accident. 1. In case of partial permanent disability due to accident : ₹1,00,000/- - Permanent partial disability means disabling of one hand or one leg. 1. In case of serious injury in an accident : Up to ₹20,000/- - (Serious injury in an accident means the beneficiary being admitted as an in-patient in the hospital for at least 5 days. The determination of serious injury will be decided based on the certificate issued by the Medical Board .) 1. In case of minor injuries in an accident : Up to ₹5,000/- - Minor injuries means hospitalization as an inpatient in a hospital for less than 5 days 1. In case of normal death of a construction worker : ₹75,000/-
summary: By the labor department of Rajasthan started "Hita-Dhikaari Ke Samanye Athava Durghatana Me Mrityu Ya Ghayal Hone Ki Dasha Me Sahayata Yojana" for the construction workers.

title: Mukhyamantri Chiranjeevi Swasthya Beema Yojana
ministry: Medical, Health and Family Welfare Department
eligibility_details: Under the scheme, eligible families have been divided into two categories- 1. Category receiving free benefits:- 100 percent of the premium of the eligible families of such category determined by the state government is paid by the government. Presently eligible families under Food Security Act, eligible families of Socio-Economic Census (SECC) 2011, contract workers working in state government departments/boards/corporations/government companies, small marginal farmers and those who received Covid-19 ex-gratia last year destitute and helpless families are included in the free category. 1. Category receiving benefits by paying Rs.850/- per family per year:- The families of the state who do not come under the category of free eligible families and are not government employees/pensioners and are not taking benefits under the Medical Attendance Rules They can avail the benefits of the scheme by paying 50% of the fixed premium Rs. 850/- per family per year. The remaining 50 percent of the premium will be borne by the government. 1. All EWS families are also proposed to be given the benefit of Chiranjeevi Yojana free of cost.
benefits: 1. Cashless treatment facility up to Rs. 25,00,000/- will be provided to each family of Rajasthan. 1. National Food Security Act, the insurance premium of families eligible for Socio-Economic Census, small and marginal farmers and contract workers will be borne by the state government. 1. Other families will have to pay a premium of Rs. 850/- per year.
summary: The state government has announced the implementation of 'Universal Health Coverage' in the state in the budget announcement 2021-22, in compliance of which Chief Minister Chiranjeevi Health Insurance Scheme was started in the state from May 1, 2021.

title: Nirman Shramik Jeevan va Bhavishya Suraksha Yojana
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be registered as a beneficiary with the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board. 2. The applicant must have a savings bank account in their name. 3. The applicant must be eligible for membership under the following schemes: - Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY) - Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY) - Atal Pension Yojana (APY) 4. The applicant must provide consent to their bank for the deduction of premium/contribution from their savings account. 5. The applicant must have gotten the annual premium/contribution amount deducted from their savings account.
benefits: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY) - 100% reimbursement of annual premium amount (₹12) - Premium amount is fully reimbursed through electronic transfer - No partial reimbursement option is available - Beneficiary must show proof of premium deduction in bank passbook Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY) - 50% reimbursement of the annual premium amount - Total premium: ₹330 - Reimbursement amount: ₹165 - Remaining ₹165 to be borne by the beneficiary - Must provide proof of full premium deduction from bank account Atal Pension Yojana (APY) - 50% reimbursement of the annual contribution amount - Specifically for the ₹1,000 monthly pension plan - Reimbursement is calculated based on the average annual contribution - Beneficiary must continue paying their share to maintain scheme validity - Must show proof of contribution deduction from bank account
summary: The scheme "Nirman Shramik Jeevan va Bhavishya Suraksha Yojana" aims to provide financial security and social protection through insurance and pension benefits to registered construction workers and their families. Benefits under various flagship schemes are provided.

title: Rajasthan Chief Minister's Relief Fund - Medical Help
ministry: Medical, Health and Family Welfare Department
eligibility_details: - The applicant should be Non BPL - The Annal Income of the Family should be greater than 2 LPA - Not be listed in ABMGRSBY (Ayushman Bharat Mahatma Gandhi Rajasthan Swasthya Bima Yojana)
benefits:
Rajasthan Chief Minister’s Relief Fund – medical help scheme launched on April 1999 under Chief Minister’s Relief Fund in Rajasthan. Dependents of untimely dead due to famine, floods, excessive rains, fires and accidental accidents help.
For treatment information - Assistance is accepted in recognized private hospitals from the major Government/ Chief Minister’s Relief Fund of the state. 40% maximum amount of rs1.50 lakh in government hospitals and 30% maximum amount of Rs 90,000 in recognized private hospitals, whichever is less, is accepted and sent to the concerned hospital.
summary: Rajasthan Chief Minister’s Relief Fund – medical help scheme launched on April 1999 under Chief Minister’s Relief Fund in Rajasthan for Individual for Non BPL whose family income should be at least 2lakhs per annum.

title: Silicosis Pidit Hita-dhikariyon Hetu Sahayata Yojana
eligibility_details:
1. Those construction workers who are registered with the Board as beneficiaries and are depositing contributions 1. The beneficiary is suffering from silicosis as certified by the Pneumoconiosis Medical Board constituted under the Rajasthan Workmen's Compensation (Occupational Diseases) Rules, 1965. 1. The beneficiary cannot receive silicosis assistance amount from the Rajasthan Environment and Health Care Fund (Rehab).
Note - A person suffering from silicosis will be eligible to get assistance only under any one of the schemes of Rajasthan Environment and Health Cess Fund or the Board.
benefits: 1. In case of suffering from silicosis : ₹1,00,000/- 1. In case of death of a victim of silicosis : ₹3,00,000/-
summary: The Silicosis Affected Workers Welfare Scheme is an initiative launched by the Government of Rajasthan to provide financial assistance to workers suffering from silicosis and their families.

title: Gadiya Lohar Maharana Pratap Bhawan Nirman Yojana
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan. 1. The applicant should belong to the Gadiya Lohar community. 1. The applicant should own a plot for house construction. 1. The applicant or their family should not own any other house within the district or anywhere in Rajasthan.
benefits: Financial Assistance: - ₹1,20,000/- is provided to each eligible beneficiary. Mode of Disbursement: - First Installment: ₹40,000/- is provided after verification of land ownership and submission of required documents. - Second Installment: ₹40,000/- is disbursed after verification of construction progress. - Third Installment: ₹40,000/- is given upon completion of construction and submission of utilization proof. Frequency & Validity: - This is a one-time financial grant. - The entire house construction must be completed within one year from the approval of the first installment. *Note:* - If a beneficiary misuses the grant, legal action will be taken, and the amount will be recovered. - The constructed house cannot be sold or transferred for 20 years.
summary: This scheme provides financial assistance of ₹1,20,000/- in three instalments to Gadiya Lohar families in Rajasthan for the construction of permanent houses and ensuring their settlement.

title: Gaushala Vikas Yojana
eligibility_details: 1. Gaushalas with ownership or leased land (minimum of 20 years) approved by a competent authority are eligible. 1. Gaushalas must have consistently maintained at least 100 cows for the past two years to qualify for infrastructure construction. 1. Gaushalas should not have any pending cases of financial irregularity or embezzlement. 1. Gaushalas committed to developing their own resources to achieve self-reliance and self-sufficiency are encouraged to apply. 1. Gaushalas willing to share information and cooperate on relevant initiatives are eligible. 1. Basic infrastructure required under the scheme should not have been previously constructed in the Gaushala. However, if existing infrastructure is insufficient based on the number of cattle, the Gaushala will be eligible for additional construction work as per requirements. 1. Gaushalas registered under the Rajasthan Gaushala Act, 1960, Rajasthan Society Registration Act, 1958, or Lalsamay Pravat Law are eligible. 1. Institutions recommended or approved by the District-Level Gaushala Committee in exceptional circumstances are also eligible.
benefits: - Financial aid of up to ₹10,00,000/- for infrastructure development.
summary: This initiative provides financial assistance to registered gaushalas for building permanent infrastructure. Under this scheme, up to ₹10,000,00/- can be provided, with 90% of the funding from the state government and 10% contributed by the gaushala.

title: Operation of Sports Hostels
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Rajasthan. 1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Tribe community. 1. The applicant should be studying in class 6th to 12th.1. The applicant should not have any disability or suffering from any serious illness. 1. The applicant’s parents/guardians should not be income tax payers. 1. The applicant should not be a failed student in the last examination. Note: Only those students who pass the selection test will be admitted to the sports hostel.
benefits: The following facilities are provided in the sports hostel: - Free residential accommodation in sports hostels. - Nutritious meals, snacks, and special dietary arrangements as per approved pattern. - Sports training with modern equipment by expert coaches (especially in archery and athletics). - Free school uniforms and educational materials.
summary: The scheme aims to encourage tribal students to participate in sports and prepare them for national & international competitions. Tribal students from Classes 6 to 12 are provided with free accommodation, specialized training, nutritious meals & other necessary facilities in the sports hostels.

title: Panchayat Samiti Nandishala Jan Sahbhagita Yojana
eligibility_details: 1. Eligible entities include local bodies, Panchayati Raj institutions, registered trusts, NGOs, and government-recognized institutions. 1. The organization must have been operational for at least 3 years. 1. Ownership of 20 bighas of private land to sustain 250 male cattle. 1. Minimum of 3 years of experience in operating a cattle shelter or similar activities. 1. Availability of 10% contribution towards the project cost.
benefits: - One-time assistance of 90% of the total construction cost.
summary: The "Panchayat Samiti Nandishala Jan Sahbhagita Yojana" was initiated to provide shelter for stray male cattle by constructing infrastructure in Panchayat Samitis.

title: Vadh Se Bachaye Govansh Ko Sahayata Yojana
eligibility_details: - Registered Gaushalas/ Nandi Shalas/ Kanj Houses/ Local bodies/ Panchayati Raj institutions/Other approved institutions which are taking care of cows rescued from cow smuggling/ slaughter.
benefits: - Financial assistance of ₹40/day for large cattle and ₹20/day for small cattle. - Support is provided for a maximum of one (1) year or the custody period, whichever is shorter.
summary: The "Vadh Se Bachaye Govansh Ko Sahayata Yojana" scheme, initiated by the Directorate of Gopalan on 02/07/2015, provides financial assistance for the care and maintenance of cattle rescued from illegal slaughter or smuggling.

title: Scheme for Assistance to MSMEs for Market Development
eligibility_details: All MSMEs existing anywhere in Rajasthan will be required to comply with the following conditions to avail benefits under the scheme: 1. The enterprise will be required to have Udyam Registration Certificate (URC) as per MSME Development Act 2006 1. The selection of MSME units would be done by Department of Industries and Commerce as per display product profile, theme of the fair and its relevance. 1. Participation in Government/ Government agency/(ies) sponsored/ approved Fairs/Exhibitions as well as Fairs/ Exhibitions approved by Export Promotion Councils (under Ministry of Commerce & Industry, GoI) will be eligible for the claim to be made under the scheme. Note: Preference shall be given to participants/units who have not availed of the benefits under this scheme.
benefits: Financial assistance for participation in fairs/exhibitions: S. No.Type of EventFinancial Assistance1Participation in National/International Fairs/Exhibitions in Rajasthan₹37,500/- or 75% of the stall rent per event, whichever is less, for a maximum of 3 events in a financial year. (Actual Fare of 3-AC Class Train or AC Bus for 2 persons)2Participation in National/international fairs/Exhibitions in the country (other than Rajasthan)₹1,12,500/- or 75% of the stall rent per event, whichever is less, for a maximum of 2 events in a financial year. (Actual Fare of 3-AC Class Train or AC Bus for 2 persons)3Participation in Fairs/Exhibitions organized abroad₹1,50,000/- or 75% of the stall rent, whichever is less, for a maximum of 1 event in a financial year. (Actual Fare on Travel through Airplane in Economy Class for 2 persons)*Note:* After availing the benefit in a particular category in one financial year, the beneficiary cannot avail it in the same category for the next 2 financial years.
summary: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to MSMEs participating in national and international fairs/exhibitions/buyer-seller meets, etc., under the Rajasthan MSME Policy 2024.

title: Antheyesthi Anudan Yojana
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a voluntary organization recognized by the state government. 1. The voluntary organization should be registered under the Societies Act. 1. The voluntary organization should be actively working in the welfare of destitute and helpless individuals or have prior experience in this field. 1. The financial condition of the voluntary organization should be strong. 1. The voluntary organization should not have been penalized or blacklisted in the past for any reason. 1. The deceased should be identified as unclaimed or destitute, with no known family or relatives to perform the last rites. 1. The death should have occurred within the jurisdiction of Rajasthan. 1. The organization should agree to conduct the last rites of the unclaimed or destitute deceased immediately at its own level with full legal procedure and to receive reimbursement of the amount fixed under this scheme from the State Government.
benefits: A one-time grant of ₹5,000 is provided to voluntary organizations for conducting the last rites of unclaimed or destitute deceased individuals.
summary: The scheme provides financial assistance of ₹5,000/- to NGOs for performing the last rites of any unclaimed or destitute person of any age/caste/class, who has died either naturally or due to an accident within Rajasthan or outside the state, provided that the cremation is conducted in Rajasthan.

title: Assistance for Daughter's Marriage
category: Social welfare & Empowerment, Women and Child
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan. 1. The applicant should be the widow of an ex-serviceman of the rank of Havildar or below. 1. The assistance is available for a maximum of two daughters of the widow of an ex-serviceman. 1. The daughter should be at least 18 years of age at the time of marriage. 1. The daughter’s name should be duly recorded in the ex-serviceman’s discharge book or Part-2 order. 1. The applicant should possess a valid Ex-Serviceman/Widow Identity Card issued by the respective District Sainik Welfare Office. 1. The applicant should not have received marriage assistance for the same purpose from the Kendriya Sainik Board. 1. The application should be submitted within one year from the date of marriage to be eligible for assistance under this scheme. 1. Widows of ex-servicemen who are classified as Battle Casualties or Physical Casualties (attributable cases) are not eligible under this scheme, as marriage assistance in such cases is provided by the Army Headquarters. 1. If the applicant is eligible for the Daughter Marriage Assistance Scheme run by the Kendriya Sainik Board for ex-servicemen, then financial aid from the Amalgamated Fund shall not be granted. 1. The benefit shall be extended only to the widow of an ex-serviceman who meets the definition of an ex-serviceman as prescribed by the Government of India.
benefits: - Financial assistance of ₹25,000/- per daughter (up to two daughters) is provided.
summary: Under this scheme, financial assistance of ₹25,000/- per girl is provided for a maximum of two marriageable daughters of widows of ex-servicemen up to the rank of Havaldar, who are not receiving a Marriage Grant from the Kendriya Sainik Board.

title: Assistance Scheme For Construction Worker In Case Of General Or Accidental Death Or Injury
eligibility_details: 1. Applicant should be a Resident of Rajasthan State. 2. Construction workers in the age group of 18 to 60 years will be eligible for this scheme. 3. Applicant should be registered as Construction Worker under labor laws. No assistance shall be payable in the event of death or injury caused by suicide or by consumption of drugs or substances or in case of death or injury caused by assault on one another in contravention of law for the purpose of committing an offence.
benefits:
The Assistance to Construction workers in case of injury or death or accident is a scheme implemented in the state of Rajasthan to provide financial assistance to construction workers and their families in case of an accident resulting in injury or death. Under this scheme, a compensation of up to Rs. 3 lakhs is provided in case of permanent disability or accidental death of a registered construction worker. Additionally, medical expenses are covered for the treatment of injuries sustained during an accident at the construction site.
To be eligible for this scheme, the construction worker must be registered with the Construction Workers Welfare Board in Rajasthan. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance and support to construction workers and their families during times of distress and help them cope with the financial burden of medical expenses and loss of income due to the accident.
summary: This scheme will be called "Assistance Scheme for Beneficiary in Normal Death or Accident (in case of death or injury)" registered in Rajasthan Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board. This scheme will be effective in entire Rajasthan.

title: Assistance to Persons with Disabilities for Purchase/Fitting of Artificial Limbs/Appliances
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan. 1. The applicant should be a disabled person. 1. The applicant should be suffering from 40% disability. 1. The applicant’s family should not be an income tax payer.
benefits: 1. Financial assistance of up to ₹10,000/- for purchasing artificial limbs/equipment to overcome physical disabilities. 1. Covers aids like tricycles, crutches, wheelchairs, calipers, hearing aids, blind sticks, smartphones, Jaipur Foot/Shoes/Palm pads, etc.
summary: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance of ₹10,000/- to specially-abled individuals for self-employment and the purchase of artificial limbs/equipment to overcome physical disabilities.

title: Chief Minister Ekal Nari Samman Pension Yojana
category: Social welfare & Empowerment, Women and Child
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant's age should be 18 years or more. 1. A native of the Rajasthan state. 1. A widow/abandoned/divorced woman who does not have any source of regular income of her own for subsistence. (or) 1. Annual income from all sources should be less than Rs. 48,000/-.
benefits: 1. From 18 to 55 years old: Rs. 500/- per month. 1. From 55 to 60 years: Rs. 750/- per month. 1. From 60 to 75 years: 1000/- per month. 1. Above the age of 75 years: 1500/- per month.
summary: The Rajasthan State government started the "Chief Minister Ekal Nari Samman Pension Yojana" scheme for women's support and empowerment.

title: Chief Minister Specially Abled Samman Pension Scheme
eligibility_details: 1. Specially abled persons of any age with 40% and above disability. 1. Applicants are suffering from any one or more following disabilities : 1. Blindness, 1. Short-sightedness, 1. Locomotor disability, 1. Leprosy free, 1. Hearing loss, 1. Mental retardation, 1. Mental illness, 1. Dwarfism (less than 3 feet 6 inches in height in case of an adult and holding a certificate issued by an authorized medical officer), 1. Naturally suffering from eunuchism. 1. Native of Rajasthan and living in Rajasthan. 1. Own combined annual income (from all sources) is up to Rs. 60,000/-.
benefits: 1. For women below 55 years of age and men below 58 years of age: Rs. 750/- per month. 1. To women aged 55 years and above, men aged 58 years and above but less than 75 years of age: Rs. 1,000/- per month. 1. To the beneficiaries of 75 years and above age ( male and female): Rs. 1,250/- per month. 1. To leprosy-free beneficiaries of all ages ( male and female): Rs. 1,500/- per month.
summary: Rajasthan Government started a scholarship for Specially Abled persons.

title: Devnarayan Chhatra Cycle Scheme
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a girl student. 1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan. 1. The applicant should be enrolled in class 9th in a government school of Rajasthan.1. The applicant must belong to one of the following Special Backward Class (SBC) communities: - Banjara, Baldia, Labana - Gadiya Lohar, Gadolia - Gujar, Gurjar - Raika, Rebari (Debasi) - Gadaria (Gadri, Gyari)
benefits: - Free distribution of cycles to girl students.
summary: The scheme provides free bicycles to girl students studying in Class 9 in government schools of Rajasthan who belong to the Special Backward Classes or specific communities such as Banjara, Baldia, Labana-Gadiya Lohar, Gadolia, Gujar Gurjar, Raiko, Rebari (Debasi).

title: Dr. Savita Ben Ambedkar Antarjatiya Vivah Prothsahan Yojana
eligibility_details: 1. One of the applicants should belong to the general category, and the other should be from the scheduled caste. 1. Both applicants should be natives of Rajasthan. 1. The age of the applicant should not be more than 35 years (females above 18 years and males above 21 years) at the time of applying. 1. The annual family income of the couple must not exceed ₹2,50,000/-. 1. The applicant should not have any criminal record. 1. The couple must not have received financial benefits from similar state/central government schemes. 1. There should be no case of remarriage; the benefit of this scheme is given only on the first marriage. 1. A man who marries a widow shall be free from the contract of first marriage.
benefits: Financial Assistance: - Financial assistance of ₹5,00,000/- is provided per couple. Disbursement Process: - ₹2,50,000/- is deposited as a fixed deposit in a nationalized bank for eight years (not withdrawable before maturity). - ₹2,50,000/- is directly transferred to the couple’s joint bank account for household and essential needs.
summary: The "Dr. Savita Ben Ambedkar Antarjatiya Vivah Prothsahan Yojana" aims to eliminate caste discrimination and promote social harmony. Under this scheme, eligible inter-caste married couples receive a financial incentive.

title: Financial Help On Death Of Family Head
eligibility_details: 1. The person must be from Sahariya Tribe (ST)
benefits:
Financial help on death of family head scheme was launched by Rajasthan state government under tribal area development on 20/08/2008. ₹10,000/- to the wife of the deceased on the premature death of the head of the family of Saharia primitive tribe. Financial assistance is provided so that the family does not face financial burden immediately after the death of the head of the family and his family can be helped.
Scheme Delivery Time :180 Days Designated Officer of Scheme :ADDITIONAL DISTRICT MAGISTRATE FINANCIAL HELP ON DEATH OF FAMILY HEAD is implemented in the following District :Baran
summary: Financial help on death of family head scheme was launched by Rajasthan state government under tribal area development on 20/08/2008. Under this scheme, ₹10,000/- to the wife of the deceased on the premature death of the head of the family of Saharia primitive tribe.

title: Indira Gandhi Matritva Poshan Yojana
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a married woman. 2. The applicant should be a permanent resident of one of the five tribal districts of Rajasthan: Pratapgarh, Dungarpur, Banswara, Udaipur, or Baran. 3. Woman will be eligible if they meet either of the following conditions: - She become pregnant with her second child on or after 1st November 2020. - She has registered her first antenatal check-up (ANC) for the second child after 1st November 2020. 4. Pregnant or lactating woman working as Anganwadi worker, Anganwadi helper, Asha Sahayogi, or Saathin will also be eligible under the scheme, subject to fulfillment of the scheme’s conditions. 5. In the event of abortion or stillbirth, the beneficiary woman will remain eligible for the scheme if she conceives again in the future. 6. The applicant should deliver her child at a government health facility or an empanelled private health institution. 7. The applicant should not have more than two living children. Notes: - Eligible beneficiaries will receive cash assistance in addition to benefits from other central and state government schemes such as Janani Suraksha Yojana (JSY) and Rajshree Yojana. - The date of pregnancy will be calculated based on the last menstrual period (LMP) recorded in the Pregnancy and Child Tracking System (PCTS) online portal maintained by the Medical and Health Department. - If a beneficiary does not comply with any phase of the scheme, the payment for that phase will be withheld. However, if the beneficiary meets the conditions of subsequent phases, the payment for those phases will be disbursed accordingly. - The applicant must complete all health milestones and ensure the child's immunizations are done as per the schedule.
benefits: Financial Assistance: - A financial assistance of ₹6,000/- is provided in five conditional installments to the beneficiary. InstallmentConditionsAmountFirst InstallmentOn pregnancy registration at Anganwadi Centre and health check-up within 120 days (4 months) of pregnancy.₹1000Second InstallmentAfter completion of second antenatal check-up during the 6th month of pregnancy.₹1000Second InstallmentUpon delivery at a government or empanelled private hospital and registration of child’s birth.₹1000Second InstallmentOn successful administration of 3 key immunizations (BCG, OPV, DPT, Hepatitis B) within 105 days of birth.₹2000Second InstallmentAfter administration of measles vaccinations and child weight measurement at 9th months₹1000> Validity: - Valid only for the birth of second child. Mode of Disbursement: - Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to the beneficiary’s bank account. NOTE: Beneficiaries who miss a stage's requirements won't receive payment for it. However, fulfilling later stage conditions will make them eligible for subsequent payments.
summary: Under the scheme, women who conceive their second child and fulfill the prescribed conditions will receive cash assistance of ₹6,000/-, paid in five installments.

title: Indira Gandhi Shehri Credit Card Yojana
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Rajasthan. 1. The age of the applicant should be between 18 to 40 years. 1. To get the benefit of this scheme, the monthly income of the applicant should be Rs 15,000/- or less. 1. The monthly income of the applicant's family should be Rs. 50,000 or less. 1. All those small traders who have been provided with a certificate or identity card by the urban body are also eligible for this scheme. 1. Traders left out in the survey or beneficiary Wonder with a recommendation letter from Town Vending Committee will also be eligible for this scheme. 1. The vendors selected during the survey will also be eligible for this scheme. (To whom a certificate or identity card has not been issued)
benefits: 1. Providing interest-free loan facility up to Rs.50,000/- (fifty thousand). 1. To promote the development of small businesses in the informal sector. 1. To encourage self-employment. 1. To make available financial resources for day-to-day needs. 1. Mitigating the impact of COVID-19 on the informal business sector. 1. This scheme will pave the way for the development and promotion of the economy by helping 5 lakh beneficiaries working in the informal business sector of Rajasthan state.
summary: Indira Gandhi Urban Credit Card Scheme-2021 is implemented to provide employment / self-employment opportunities in urban areas and to provide financial resources for everyday needs.

title: Indira Mahila Shakti Udyam Protsahan Yojana
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant's age should be 18 years or more. 1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Rajasthan. 1. The women's self-help group or group of these groups (cluster/ federation) must be registered under any department of the state government and in case of cluster/federation of groups, it will be necessary to be registered under the Cooperative Act as per the rules.
benefits:
Loan Limit 1. Loan amount of ₹ 50,00,000/- to individual women. 1. Loan amount of Rs 1,00,00,000/- to self-help groups.
Margin Money - A margin money of 25% of the sanctioned loan amount will be provided under the scheme. For women belonging to Scheduled Castes/Tribes, Scheduled Castes, widows, abandoned women, victims of violence and disabled women, the margin money will be 30% of the sanctioned loan amount. - Note: 1. The maximum limit of margin money will be ₹ 15,00,000/-. 1. The applicant's own contribution (5% / 10% of the project proposal) will be considered for margin money. 1. Land value will not be included in the project proposal. The maximum limit of loan amount payable for construction of workshop/building will be up to 20% of the sanctioned amount of the project proposal. 1. The maximum limit of loan for business will be Rs. 10 lakh. Business refers to wholesale or retail purchase-sale of commercial products.
Promotion of collateral security free loans: - As per the guidelines of the Reserve Bank of India, collateral security will not be required for loans up to Rs. 10 lakh. Loans above Rs. 10 lakh can be linked with the Credit Guarantee Trust Fund for Micro and Small Enterprises (CGTMSE). The fee amount will be borne by the beneficiary. If the applicant voluntarily wants to give collateral security on the loan, they can do so.
summary: This scheme launched by the Rajasthan government to empower women by providing them with loans and other financial assistance to start or expand their businesses

title: Laado Protsahan Yojana
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a woman who is a native of Rajasthan. 1. The applicant should deliver the girl child in a government medical institution or a private medical institution authorized under the Janani Suraksha Yojana (JSY). 1. The applicant should ensure full immunization of the child (for second installment). 1. The applicant's child should be enrolled in a recognized school or institution for subsequent installments. 1. The applicant’s daughter should graduate from a recognized higher education institution and attain the age of 21 to receive the final installment.
benefits: Monetary Benefit: - Total financial benefit of ₹1,50,000/- disbursed in 7 installments: InstallmentDescriptionAmount (₹)1Girl&amp;#39;s birth in eligible medical institutions2500/-2Girl completes one year of age and all vaccinations2500/-3Girl&amp;#39;s admission to Class 1st in a government/government-recognized private school4000/-4Girl&amp;#39;s admission to Class 6th in a government/government-recognized private school5000/-5Girl&amp;#39;s admission to Class 10th in a government/government-recognized private school 11000/- 6Girl&amp;#39;s admission to Class 12th in a government/government-recognized private school25000/-7Girl passes graduation from government-recognized educational institutions and completes 21 years of age 1,00,000/- Total Amount ₹1,50,000> Mode of Disbursement: 1. A commitment letter of ₹1.50 lakh will be issued at the birth of a girl child. 1. The entire amount will be disbursed online through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) in seven installments. 1. Until the girl attains adulthood, the first six installments will be transferred to the bank account of her parents or guardian, and the seventh installment will be transferred to the girl's own bank account through DBT. Notes: - If the benefit of any installment is not availed at any stage after the first two installments of the scheme, the eligible girl child may still be granted the next installment, provided a valid and reasonable justification is given. - There is no limit on the number of girl children eligible to receive the third and subsequent installments under the scheme. All girls who have already received the first two installments will be entitled to continue receiving benefits under the scheme. - The Rajshree Yojana will be merged with the Laado Protsahan Yojana, and the remaining installments of the Rajshree Yojana will be provided under the Laado Protsahan Yojana as per eligibility.
summary: The scheme aims to encourage the birth of girl children in poor families and promote their holistic development. Under this scheme, financial support ₹1,50,000/- is provided in seven installments to the parents or guardians of girls born in Government/authorized Medical Institutions.

title: Mukhyamantri Asahaya Punarwas Yojana
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a resident of the Rajasthan. 1. The applicant should belong to one of the following categories: - Destitute individual with no one to care for them. - Individual abandoned by their parents. - Orphaned, destitute or completely dependent individual. Note: The applicant should not already be receiving benefits under pension schemes (for financial aid support).
benefits: One-Time Financial Assistance: - Under this scheme, eligible women and men receive a one-time financial assistance of up to ₹2,000/-. Admission to Day-Care Centers and Old-Age Homes: - Admission into day-care centers and old-age homes run by the Social Justice and Empowerment Department and funded by the state and central government. Provision for Pension Approval: - If the destitute applicant qualifies for Old Age Pension, Widow Pension, or Disability Pension, then the pension will be sanctioned within one month of identification.
summary: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance and rehabilitation support to destitute individuals who are orphaned, abandoned by their parents, or have no one to care for them. Beneficiaries receive one-time financial aid and support for admission to day-care centers or old-age homes.

title: Mukhyamantri Kanyadaan Yojana
category: Social welfare & Empowerment, Women and Child
eligibility_details: This scheme is specifically for Divyang and Women that belong to following : 1. BPL family belonging to the Scheduled Tribe category 1. Minority category BPL families 1. Specially Qualified Individuals (Not Income Tax Payers) 1. A female player (if self-married) who fulfills the prescribed criteria as per the circulars issued by the Personnel Department. Self or parents are not income taxpayers. 1. Beneficiary in Palanhar Yojana.
benefits: - The implementation of this scheme will be reviewed at the district level and a committee meeting will be held every 3 months. - The state government will provide financial assistance of ₹ 31,000 to ₹ 41,000 to the eligible beneficiaries at the time of the girl's marriage. - Under this scheme, a provision of savings of about ₹24 crore has been approved. - If the girls of the state pass 10th then the government will provide an amount of ₹41 thousand at the time of their marriage. - If the girls of the state pass 12th then the government will provide an amount of ₹51 thousand at the time of their marriage.
summary: Mukhyamantri Kanyadaan Yojana launched by Social Justice and empowerment in 2015 by Rajasthan for Family provides financial support to eligible families to help them cover the expenses associated with their daughters' weddings.

title: Mukhyamantri Rajshri Yojana
eligibility_details: 1. The girl child must be a resident of Rajasthan. 1. She must be born on or after June 1, 2016. 1. The girl child must be born in a government or private medical institution registered with Janani Suraksha Yojana (JSY). 1. Only two girl child will be eligible. 1. Girl's parents must have an Aadhar Card and a Bhamashah Card.
benefits: - Financial Benefits are Time to provide benefitsAmount of profitAt the time of birth₹2,500/-1 year after vaccination₹2,500/-On admission to first class₹4,000/-On taking admission in sixth class₹5,000/-On taking admission in the tenth class₹11,000/-On taking admission in class 12th₹25,000/-
summary: The Mukhyamantri Rajshri Yojana is a program launched by the Rajasthan government in June 2016. It aims to improve the overall development of girls in the state by providing financial assistance for their health and education.

title: Mukhyamantri Vishesh Yogyajan Sammaan Pension Yojana
eligibility_details: 1. Beneficiary must be permanent resident of Rajasthan State. 1. The beneficiary must have any one of the following disabilities: - 40% or more disability (blindness, shortsightedness, locomotor disability, leprosy free, hearing loss, mental retardation, mental illness, dwarfism, eunuch) - Dwarfism with height less than 3 feet 6 inches. - Suffering from Eunuchism. - Cured leprosy or Silicosis disease. 1. Annual family income must not exceed ₹60,000/-
benefits: The following monthly pension will be provided: Age CriteriaAmount75 Years or Less₹1,000/- per Month.75 Years or More₹1,250/- per Month.Leprosy Free Patient₹2,500/- per Month.Silicosis Disease Patient₹1,500/- per Month.
summary: The "Mukhyamantri Vishesh Yogyajan Samman Pension Yojana" (MVSYS) stands as a testament to the commitment of the Government of Rajasthan towards the welfare of its citizens, particularly those with disabilities.

title: Mukhyamantri Vriddhjan Samman Pension Yojana
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan and living in Rajasthan, 1. The female applicant should be 55 years or older. 1. The male applicant should be aged 58 years or older 1. The total annual income of the wife/husband from all sources should be less than ₹48,000/- 1. People belonging to BPL/Antyodaya/Aastha Card holding families/Sahariya/Kathauri, Khairwa castes have been exempted from the income-related condition.
benefits: Pension amount : ₹1,000/- per month
summary: The Rajasthan government's Social Justice and Empowerment Department launched the "Mukhyamantri Vriddhjan Samman Pension Yojana" program, a social welfare initiative that aims to improve the lives of senior citizens residing in the state by providing them with monthly financial assistance.

title: Mukhyamantri Work Form Home-Job Work Yojana
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Rajasthan. 1. The minimum age of the applicant should be 18 years. 1. Preference will be given to widow/abandoned/divorced/disabled/victim of violence.
benefits: Financial and non-financial incentives - 1. Advertisement of such private unit which provides work from home-job work to a maximum number of women will be displayed free of cost on the Work from Home-Job Work portal. 1. If a private unit provides work from home - job work to women and the payment for the work given to the woman is more than ₹ 5,000, then ₹ 3,000 per trainee will be given as a training incentive, as a training fee. However, the payment of the training incentive amount will be given to the female trainee only after the offer letter is given by the private entity in the form of work from home- job work.
summary: The main objective of the "Mukhyamantri Work from Home" Scheme is to provide an opportunity for the women of the state to get employment sitting at home and to empower women by providing them with financial help by giving them work.

title: Mukyamantri Samuhik Vivah Evam Anudan Yojna
eligibility_details: 1. The bride/groom should be a native of Rajasthan 1. The bride's age should be above 18 years and the groom's age should be above 21 years. 1. Both bride and groom should be unmarried 1. Marriages should be registered as per rules.
benefits: - Total Grand : ₹25,000/- will be provided as 1. To the bride : ₹21,000/- is given 1. To Marriage Organizer : ₹4,000/- through IFMS.
summary: The Rajasthan Government to encourage the organization of mass marriages in the state, provide financial grants to reduce wastage in marriages,

title: Nirman Shramiko Ko Videsh Mai Rojgar Hetu Visa Per Hone Wale Vyay Ka Punarbharan Yojana
eligibility_details: 1. Construction workers must be registered with the board as beneficiaries and must be continuously depositing their contributions. 1. To obtain overseas contract employment, construction worker need permission from the Protector of Emigrants (POE) office under the Emigration Act, 1983. 1. The recruiting agency must be registered under the Emigration Act or possess a valid permit from the POE office 1. The reimbursement of the visa amount will be payable only if the beneficiary has a valid passport with a minimum validity of 6 months along with a valid visa. 1. The benefit of this scheme will be payable only if the future employment of the beneficiary abroad is in the construction and other construction works. 1. The beneficiary will be entitled to the assistance amount only once. 1. If any information given in the assistance application submitted by the beneficiary under the scheme is found to be false, the concerned beneficiary will be responsible for depositing the entire assistance amount approved under the scheme along with interest in one go.
benefits: The beneficiary will be reimbursed for the expenses incurred for a visa for employment abroad up to a maximum of ₹5,000/-.
summary: The Labor department of Rajasthan started "Nirman Shramiko Ko Videsh Mai Rojgar Hetu Visa Per Hone Wale Vyay Ka Punarbharan Yojana" to help construction workers.

title: Palanhar Scheme
eligibility_details: 1. Orphan boy/girl. 1. Children of parents sentenced to death/life imprisonment under judicial orders. 1. Children of a widowed mother receiving a pension (maximum 3 children at a time). 1. Children of remarried widowed mothers. 1. Children of HIV/AIDS affected mother/father. 1. Children of parents suffering from leprosy. 1. Children of related mothers (Maximum 3 children at a time). 1. Children of specially-abled parents. 1. Children of divorced/abandoned women receiving the pension. 1. Children of parents suffering from silicosis. 1. The age of the child should be less than 18 years. 1. If Child age is 18 and still studying/staying in 12th class or lower class, then in such a situation such children will be given an additional one year ( The benefit can be provided till the age of 19 years). The said benefit will not be payable after the child completes 19 years of age or passes 12th class. 1. The certificate that the guardian is a native of Rajasthan state or has been residing in the state for more than three years. 1. Guardian Family income should not be more than Rs. 1.20 Laks per annum.
benefits: 1. Orphan Category : For the age group (0 to 6 years) : Rs. 1500/- per month. For the age group (6 to 18 years) : Rs. 2500/- per month. 1. Other Category: For the age group (0 to 6 years) : Rs. 500/- per month. For the age group (6 to 18 years) : Rs. 1000/- per month. 1. For Books/Stationaries/Dress/Sweater/shoes etc: Rs. 2000/- per year.
summary: Palanhar Yojana has been started by the state government of Rajasthan to benefit the orphan and needy children of the state.

title: Prakashan Sahayata Yojana
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be native of Rajasthan. 1. The applicant should be an author and belong to the Scheduled Tribe community. 1. The manuscript/research work/literature should be related to Scheduled Tribes and should be an original creation by the author. 1. The manuscript should be unpublished and original in nature.
benefits: Monetary Assistance: - Authors of original manuscripts or research work related to tribal subjects receive financial support ranging from ₹6,000/- to ₹12,000/- for publication through reputed publishers.
summary: The scheme aims to support original literary/research work related to tribal communities. Authors are provided financial assistance of ₹6,000 to ₹12,000 for publication.

title: Prasuti Sahayata Yojana
eligibility_details: 1. The female worker must be holding a beneficiary identity card under Section 13 of the Maternity Benefit Act. 1. The age of the female beneficiary should not be less than 20 years at the time of delivery. 1. Maternity benefits will be payable for a maximum of two deliveries only. If the beneficiary has two or more children before registration, assistance will not be provided. In case of having one child before registration, assistance will be provided for only one delivery. 1. Construction worker beneficiaries who fail to make their monthly contributions to the Board's fund will not be eligible for the Maternity Assistance Scheme. 1. If the beneficiary rectifies the default by making the required monthly payments, they will become eligible for the Maternity Assistance Scheme. 1. Maternity benefits under the scheme will be provided only for institutional deliveries.
benefits: - The birth of a daughter: ₹ 21,000/- - The birth of a son : ₹ 20,000/- - In case of not receiving cash benefits under Janani Suraksha Yojana, ₹1,000/- additional assistance will be payable.
summary: The Rajasthan Prasuti Sahayata Yojana is a scheme launched by the Government of Rajasthan to provide financial assistance to pregnant women from registered construction worker families in the state

title: Rajasthan Chief Minister's Relief Fund - Accident Assistance
eligibility_details: 1. The victim should be a resident of the state of Rajasthan. 1. The victim should have suffered serious injury / death. 1. In case of death, the assistance is payable only to the dependent parents/husband-wife/son-daughter of the deceased in the accident. 1. Under special circumstances, assistance can be given to grandparents/dependent siblings with the consent of the Chief Minister's Office. 1. In cases of murder and rape, action should be taken to give compensation under the Rajasthan Victim Compensation (Amended) Scheme-2015 under the provision of providing assistance in cases of murder and rape. 1. The applicant must apply within a maximum period of 6 months from the date of accident.
benefits: Launched in April 1999, "Rajasthan Chief Minister's Relief Fund - Accident Assistance" is a scheme by the Chief Minister's Secretariat, Govt. of Rajasthan. In case of death due to accident, ₹ 1,00,000 is provided to the dependent of the deceased. In case of serious injury, assistance should be approved up to ₹ 20,000, keeping in view the seriousness of the injury to the ordinary injured. A revolving fund of ₹20,00,000 each has been made available to all district collectors. The assistance is "one-time full-support" and is sanctioned by the concerned District Collector. For assistance, one has to apply either to the Tehsil/District Collector's Office or to the Chief Minister's Office.
summary: "Rajasthan Chief Minister's Relief Fund - Accident Assistance" is a scheme by the Chief Minister's Secretariat, Govt. of Rajasthan. In case of death due to accident, ₹ 1,00,000 is provided. In case of serious injury, assistance is up to ₹ 20,000. The assistance is "one-time full-support".

title: Rajasthan Varishth Patrakar Samman Yojana
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a full-time accredited journalist. 1. The applicant must have continuously worked for at least 20 years in daily newspapers, weekly newspapers, fortnightly news publications, independent journalism, electronic media, or news agencies, including roles such as editor, publisher, or owner of such media organizations. 1. Accredited journalists who have been regularly accredited with the Department of Information and Public Relations, Rajasthan for at least 10 years will be eligible for this scheme. 1. The journalist should be 60 years of age or older as of the application date. 1. The applicant should not be receiving any salary, pension, or regular financial assistance from any newspaper, institution, or any other regular assistance from the State Government. 1. The applicant must declare (via affidavit) that they do not fall under the category of an income tax payee. 1. The applicant should not have any criminal case registered against them. Note: The honorarium will be given for an initial period of five years.
benefits: Financial Assistance: - Monthly Honorarium: ₹15,000/- per month to the senior accredited journalists. - In case of the journalist's death, 50% of the amount is provided to the widow. Duration: - Paid for a maximum period of 5 years, subject to review. Mode of Disbursement: - Direct Bank Transfer to the journalist’s savings account.
summary: Under this scheme, a monthly financial assistance of ₹15,000/- is provided to full-time accredited journalists who are 60 years of age or older & have served continuously for at least 20 years in daily, weekly, fortnightly newspapers, independent publications, electronic media, or news agencies.

title: Samman Bhatta to War Widows and Parents of Martyrs
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan. 1. The applicant should either be a war widow of a martyr or a parent of an unmarried martyr who sacrificed their life in wars, counter-insurgency operations, or aid to civil authorities before 31st March 1999.
benefits: - Samman Bhatta is provided at ₹5000/- per month for a lifetime. Note: The amount of assistance is deposited in beneficiary’s bank account every month.
summary: The scheme aims to provide lifelong financial assistance of ₹5,000/- per month to war widows and parents of unmarried martyrs who sacrificed their lives in various wars, counter-insurgency operations, and aid to civil authorities before 31st March 1999.

title: Suraksha Laghu Evan Simant Vriddhajan Krishak Samman Pension Yojana
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan State. 1. The applicant should be a farmer. 1. The female applicant's age should be more than 55 years and the male more than 58 years.
benefits: 1. To a pensioner below 75 years of age : ₹750/- per month 1. To pensioners aged 75 years and above : ₹1,000/- per month
summary: The Rajasthan government's Social Justice and Empowerment Department launched the "Suraksha Laghu Evan Seemaant Vrddhajan Krshak Sammaan Penshan Yojana" program, a social welfare initiative that aims to improve the lives by providing them with monthly financial assistance.

title: Transgender Utthan Kosh – Identity Card for Transgender
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Rajasthan. 1. The applicant must belong to the transgender community.
benefits: - Issuance of identification cards to recognized transgender individuals. - Transgender person applies for an ID card themselves, the payment will be made to their account upon presentation of the ID card. - This certificate/identity card will be valid for all government purposes like ration card, Aadhaar card and birth certificate etc.
summary: This scheme aims to identify transgender persons and issuing identity cards to them. This certificate/identity card will be valid for all government purposes, including obtaining a ration card, Aadhaar card, birth certificate, etc.

title: Vidhva Vivah Uphar Yojana
eligibility_details: 1. Applicant must be a widow women from Rajasthan State. 1. Applicant must be resident of Rajasthan or living in Rajasthan for 3 years before re-marriage. 1. Applicant should be entitled to pension as per widow pension rules. 1. Applicant age should be between 18-50 years. 1. If the applicant has remarried before this scheme then he/she will not be eligible.
benefits: Financial Assistance/Gift amount ₹51,000/-
summary: The Rajasthan government's Social Justice and Empowerment Department launched the "Vidhva Vivah Uphar Yojana" program, a social welfare initiative that aims to improve the lives of widow women.

title: Vishesh Yogyajan Sukhad Dampatya Jeevan Yojana
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan. 1. The applicant should be a specially-abled individual (male or female). 1. The applicant should possess a disability certificate with 40% or more disability, issued by a Medical Officer or Medical Board. 1. The groom should be at least 21 years old, and the bride should be at least 18 years old. 1. The applicant’s family income from all sources should not exceed ₹2,50,000/- per year.
benefits: - Financial assistance of ₹50,000/- per couple is provided.
summary: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to specially-abled individuals to support a happy married life after marriage. Under this scheme, financial assistance of ₹50,000/- per couple is provided.

title: World War II Pension
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a native of Rajasthan. 1. The applicant should be either an ex-serviceman who served during World War II (1st September 1939 to 15th August 1945) or his widow. 1. The applicant should not be receiving any pension or financial assistance from any other source.
benefits: Financial Assistance: - A pension of ₹15,000 per month is provided for a lifetime. Mode of Disbursement: - The pension is deposited monthly into the beneficiary’s bank account.
summary: The aim of the scheme is to provide lifelong financial assistance of ₹15,000/- per month as a measure of relief to World War II ex-servicemen and their widows who are not receiving any pension or financial assistance from any other source.

title: Chief Ministers’ Education Assistance Scheme
eligibility_details: 1. The student must be a domicile of the Sikkim state. 1. The student must belong to the Economically Weaker Section (EWS) as defined by the government. 1. The student must be enrolled in a recognized educational institution, a recognized distance education institution, or a recognized institution abroad. 1. The student should be studying in a registered coaching center. 1. A special consideration shall be given to students from marginalized, minority communities and specially abled categories (Divyangjan) and orphans. 1. The annual family income of the student shall not exceed a limit specified by the government, as revised from time to time.
