An assistance will be provided to maximum two children of the family. 1. The annual income of the family of all the categories of children should be less than ₹3,00,000/- but the condition of income limit will not apply to those where both mother and father have died.
Institutional Children: 1. Under the age group of 0-18, previously lived in children's homes and reintegrated back into families or residing in child care institutions. 1. Support: Receives financial assistance and family/aftercare services for readjustment.
benefits: Financial Assistance : ₹ 2,500/- per month.
summary: "Uttar Pradesh Mukhyamantri Bal Seva Yojana (General)" scheme provides financial assistance to children in Uttar Pradesh who face various hardships.

title: Uttar Pradesh Old Age Pension Scheme
eligibility_details: Eligibility 1. Age should be between 60 to 150. 1. Applicant should be below poverty line or his/her annual income should be upto for Rural Areas Rs. 46,080/- and Urban Areas Rs. 56,460/-.
benefits: Features 1. The government will allow only the senior citizens from the economically weaker sections to avail the benefits under this scheme. 1. Under this Uttar Pradesh old age pension scheme, the Government will transfer the pension amount to the beneficiaries through their bank account
summary: The Government of Uttar Pradesh has introduced an old-age pension scheme for the benefit of the senior citizens in the state. Under this scheme, eligible senior citizens will be provided with financial assistance in the form of a monthly pension.

title: Widow Pension - Uttar Pradesh
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Uttar Pradesh state. 1. The applicant's husband has died. 1. The age of the applicant should not be less than 18 years. 1. The annual income of the applicant and her family from all sources should not exceed ₹ 2,00,000/-
benefits: Financial Assistance : ₹1,000/- per month
summary: Widow pension in Uttar Pradesh is a social welfare scheme by the Government of Uttar Pradesh to provide financial assistance to widows residing in the state. The scheme is administered by the Women Welfare Department of the state government.

title: Bakri Palan Yojana
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must belong to the General, Scheduled Caste, or Scheduled Tribe category. 1. The applicant must be included in the SECC (Socio-Economic and Caste Census) category. 1. The applicant should have an interest in goat rearing.
benefits: - Self-employment in goat rearing is facilitated by providing beneficiaries with a goat unit comprising 10 female goats and 1 male goat for a period of 10 to 14 months. - The total cost of the unit is ₹70,000/-, of which 90% (₹63,000/-) is funded by the State Government, and the remaining 10% (₹7,000/-) is contributed by the beneficiary.
summary: The scheme aims to promote goat rearing as a source of self-employment and livelihood generation for eligible beneficiaries, particularly from SECC categories, by providing financial support for rearing a goat unit.

title: Bhed Palan Yojana
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must belong to the Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribe category. 1. The applicant must be included in the SECC (Socio-Economic and Caste Census) category. 1. The applicant should have an interest in sheep rearing.
benefits: - Self-employment in sheep rearing is facilitated by providing beneficiaries with a sheep rearing unit comprising 10 female sheep and 1 male sheep for a period of 10 to 14 months. - The total cost of the unit is ₹70,000/-, of which 90% (₹63,000/-) is funded by the State Government, and the remaining 10% (₹7,000/-) is contributed by the beneficiary.
summary: The scheme aims to promote sheep rearing as a source of self-employment and livelihood generation for eligible beneficiaries, particularly from SECC categories, by providing financial support for rearing a sheep unit.

title: Establishment of Broiler Farms
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant may belong to any caste. 1. Preference will be given to women and self-help groups (SHGs). 1. The applicant must own land or have land on lease. 1. The applicant must have a KYC-certified bank account.
benefits: Under this scheme: - A subsidy of ₹15/- per bird is provided for 6 batches, amounting to a total subsidy of ₹45,000/- per beneficiary. - An additional grant of ₹15,000/- per beneficiary is provided for fence construction, making the total subsidy ₹60,000/- per beneficiary. - With a minimum of 500 broiler birds, the total unit cost is approximately ₹3.05 lakh.
summary: The scheme aims to promote commercial broiler rearing by providing financial assistance in the form of subsidies for poultry rearing and infrastructure development, thereby enhancing income generation and employment opportunities, especially for women and self-help groups (SHGs).

title: Establishment of Poultry Valley
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a member of a Multi-Purpose Agricultural Cooperative Society (MPACS). 1. Preference will be given to female beneficiaries under this scheme. 1. The applicant must not have any outstanding loans from MPACS or any other bank. 1. The selected applicant must be eligible to receive Medium-Term (MT) and Short-Term (ST) loans under the Deendayal Upadhyaya Krishi Kalyan Yojana. 1. The applicant must own or have land on lease.
benefits: - Under the project, each farmer will rear 750 chicks annually in three phases. The Animal Husbandry Department will supply 500 one-day-old chicks from the state sector budget through M-PACS, while the farmer will bear the cost of the remaining 250 chicks. - The Cooperative Department will provide an interest-free loan for the construction of poultry sheds and for the care & rearing of the chicks.
summary: The scheme aims to promote sustainable and organized poultry farming among cooperative society members, especially women, by providing financial and technical support for poultry rearing, thereby enhancing income generation and livelihood opportunities in the state.

title: Farmer Pension Scheme
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a farmer actively engaged in cultivating their own land. 1. The applicant must be above 60 years of age. 1. The applicant must own and cultivate up to 2 hectares of agricultural land.
benefits: A pension of ₹1,200/- per month is provided to eligible farmers.
summary: The scheme aims to provide financial support to elderly farmers residing in the state of Uttarakhand. Under this scheme, a monthly pension of ₹1200/- is provided to farmers who are above 60 years of age, own up to 2 hectares of land, and cultivate their own land.

title: Fish Farming Diversification (Scheduled Caste / Scheduled Tribe) Scheme
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a native of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribe community. 1. The applicant should be engaged in fish production and possess a pond or be landless and interested in engaging in fish processing or marketing businesses to be eligible.
benefits: Under this scheme: - Fishermen who already own ponds are provided a 60% subsidy for repairing or improving their ponds, or for undertaking duck/poultry farming and other integrated activities. - To connect landless individuals with fish processing and marketing businesses, a 60% subsidy of ₹1,50,000/- is provided against the cost of a mobile fish stall amounting to ₹2,50,000/-. - A 60% subsidy of ₹42,000/- is provided against the cost of ₹70,000/- for the improvement of a 100-square-meter pond. - A 60% subsidy of ₹3,00,000/- is provided against the cost of ₹5,00,000/- for the improvement of a 10-hectare pond in plain areas. - A 60% subsidy of ₹83,000/- is provided against the cost of ₹1,39,000/- for establishing one integrated unit (chicken/duck/banana/papaya) in mountainous areas. - In plain areas, a grant of 60%, i.e. ₹3,96,000/-, is provided against the cost of construction of one integrated unit valued at ₹6,60,000/-.
summary: The scheme aims to promote economic empowerment and livelihood diversification among Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe communities through fisheries-based activities.

title: Gau Palan Yojana
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must belong to the General, Scheduled Caste, or Scheduled Tribe category. 1. The applicant must be included in the SECC (Socio-Economic and Caste Census) category. 1. The applicant should have an interest in cow rearing.
benefits: Under this scheme, a milch cow up to the fourth stage of pregnancy is provided. Of the total cost of ₹40,000/-, 90% (₹36,000/-) is borne by the state government, while 10% (₹4,000/-) is to be contributed by the beneficiary.
summary: The scheme aims to promote cow rearing among eligible Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe beneficiaries, enhancing their livelihood and income generation by providing financial support for cow rearing units.

title: Hamara Ped Hamara Dhan
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must have either their own private land or a joint landholding suitable for plantation. 1. There is no minimum land area requirement to avail the benefits under this scheme.
benefits: - Under this scheme, as an incentive for planting fuelwood, fodder, fruit, and timber species on private land, a Fixed Deposit Receipt (FDR) will be created at the rate of ₹300/- per plant and mortgaged to the Divisional Forest Officer. - Based on the survival and success of the plants, the concerned beneficiary will receive the secured amount in the form of an FDR after three years. - A maximum of 100 plants per applicant/family will be eligible for this benefit each year.
summary: The scheme aims to encourage residents of Uttarakhand to plant and protect trees on their private land by providing financial incentives, thereby promoting environmental conservation, increasing green cover, and linking economic benefits with tree plantation.

title: Mahila Bakri Palan
category: Agriculture,Rural & Environment, Women and Child, Business & Entrepreneurship
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a woman. 1. The applicant must be from one of the following categories: - Abandoned - Widow - Destitute - Single woman - Disaster-affected woman
benefits: Under this scheme, one unit of goats (3 females and 1 male) aged 12 to 18 months is provided to eligible women. The entire cost of the scheme, ₹35,000, is borne by the State Government.
summary: The scheme aims to empower women, especially abandoned, widowed, destitute, single, and disaster-affected women, by providing them support for goat rearing to generate livelihood and improve household income.

title: Mahila Nursery Yojana
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a Women Self-Help Group, Mahila Mangal Dal, or a Local Women’s Group from Uttarakhand.
benefits: - Under this scheme, women’s groups are enabled to establish nurseries. High-quality seeds are procured from Silvahill or Silvasal, and the resources required for nursery operations are provided through a fixed grant. Technical support and training are also provided. - Department purchases the plants grown by women in these nurseries on a contract basis.
summary: The scheme aims to promote nursery establishment by providing women's groups with high-quality seedlings or saplings from certified sources, along with a fixed grant, technical support, and training to ensure effective nursery operations.

title: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana: Accident Insurance Scheme - Uttarakhand
category: Banking,Financial Services and Insurance, Agriculture,Rural & Environment
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be engaged in fish production or fishing as a profession. 1. The applicant may belong to any caste category, including General, Scheduled Caste (SC), Scheduled Tribe (ST), Other Backward Class (OBC), or be a woman. 1. The applicant’s age must be between 18 and 70 years at the time of enrollment.
benefits: Under this scheme, an annual insurance coverage is provided as follows: - ₹5,00,000/- in case of accidental death or total permanent disability. - ₹2,50,000/- for partial disability (such as loss of limbs, fingers, or partial loss of vision/hearing/speech, etc.). - ₹50,000/- for hospitalization expenses due to accidents. - The fish farmer is not required to pay any insurance premium. The entire premium amount is borne by the Department.
summary: Under this scheme, fish farmers are provided insurance coverage of ₹5 lakh in case of accidental death/total permanent disability, ₹2.5 lakh for partial disability, & ₹50,000 for hospitalization. No premium is required to be paid by fish farmers, entire cost of the insurance is fully borne by Dept.

title: Scheduled Tribe/Scheduled Caste Subplan
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be an individual belonging to the Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribe category and residing in the mountainous or plain areas of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be interested in, or currently engaged in, fish farming or fish production. 1. The applicant (individual or group) must own or lease land and have a nearby water source within the state. 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand.
benefits: Under this scheme: - Pond clusters, comprising a minimum of 10 ponds at one location, are created for individuals belonging to the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes. The scheme provides 60% of the total cost as a grant for pond construction and the first-year investment, including expenses on fish hatcheries and feed. A minimum of 10 ponds will be constructed in each village. - Individual beneficiaries are eligible to receive a grant for a maximum of 500 cubic meters, up to ₹3,00,000/-. For societies, groups, mahasanghs, federations, or mangal dals belonging to the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes, a grant of ₹5,10,000/- is provided, which constitutes 60% of the total project cost of ₹8,50,000/- for the construction of a 1-hectare pond in the plains. - Ponds of sizes ranging from 0.05 to 0.50 hectares will be constructed in the plains under this scheme.
summary: The scheme aims to promote fish farming as a sustainable livelihood opportunity among individuals and groups belonging to the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes.

title: Scheme for Construction of Ideal Fish Pond in Hilly Areas
eligibility_details: 1. All caste categories, both women and men from the hilly areas of Uttarakhand who are interested in or engaged in fish production, are eligible under this scheme. 1. The beneficiary must have land or leased land and an available water supply source within the state. 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand.
benefits: Under this scheme: - Pond clusters (a minimum of 10 ponds must be built at one location) are created to better utilize water resources in mountainous areas, individuals of all castes are eligible to receive a 50% grant for pond construction and the first year’s investment, including fish hatchery and feed. A single individual can construct up to 10 ponds, or a group of individuals may construct them collectively. - Free technical assistance is provided for rearing fish species with high growth rates. - Individual beneficiaries are eligible for a grant for pond construction up to 500 cubic meters, with a maximum grant amount of ₹2.5 lakh. - For a society, group, federation, or mangal dal, a maximum grant of ₹5 lakh is provided for pond construction up to 1000 cubic meters. - Beneficiaries are required to contribute the remaining 50% of the cost from their own resources or through a bank loan.
summary: The scheme aims to encourage individuals and groups to construct fish ponds by providing financial assistance and to promote sustainable fish farming while enhancing livelihood opportunities in the hilly regions of the state.

title: State Fisheries Input Scheme
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be currently engaged in fish farming. 1. The applicant may belong to any caste category, including General, Scheduled Caste (SC), Scheduled Tribe (ST), Other Backward Class (OBC), or be a woman.
benefits: Fish farmers who are already engaged in fish farming are provided a 50% subsidy on the total cost of essential fishery inputs such as fish feed, medicines, etc. - A subsidy of 1 quintal of fish feed is provided for a 100 square meter pond, and 6 quintals of fish feed for ponds ranging from 500 to 2000 square meters. - A grant of 7 quintals of fish feed is provided for RAS/Biofloc systems. - A subsidy of 10 quintals of fish feed is provided for trout farming. - A 50% subsidy is provided on the total market rate cost of essential input materials for fisheries such as hand nets, hapas, nets, and minikits. - A 50% subsidy is admissible for one hand net/hapa/net and one minikit per fish farmer.
summary: The scheme aims to aims to enhance the productivity and income of fish farmers by providing financial support in the form of subsidies on essential fishery inputs such as hand nets, hapa, nets, mini kits, etc.

title: Akhil Bharatiya Civil Services Pratiyogita
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be an employee of a government department in Uttarakhand.
benefits: There is a provision to provide travel allowance, accommodation allowance, food allowance, sports kits, and other necessary support to all players and team members participating in the 'Akhil Bharatiya Civil Services Pratiyogita', in accordance with departmental standards.
summary: The scheme aims to provide an opportunity for personnel from various government departments of the state to participate annually in the All-India level competitions in various sports, organized by the Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions, Government of India.

title: Assistance for Purchase of Traditional Musical Instruments and Costumes for Scheduled Caste/Tribe Individuals
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a folk artist. 1. The applicant must belong to the Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribe community. 1. The applicant's monthly income must not exceed ₹2,000/-. 1. Only one set of musical instruments is provided per artist in a family under this scheme.
benefits: - Persons belonging to the Scheduled Castes or Scheduled Tribes, whose source of income is through their traditional art, and who do not possess musical instruments or costumes, are provided with traditional musical instruments (such as Dhol, Damaun, Masakbeen, Ransingha, Trumpet, Nagada, Shield, Sword, etc.) and costumes free of cost to help them sustain their livelihood. - The instruments are provided only once in a lifetime.
summary: The scheme aims to support scheduled caste and scheduled tribe individuals whose livelihood depends on traditional arts by providing them with essential musical instruments and costumes.

title: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Sahkarita Kisan Kalyan Yojana
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a general, small, or marginal farmer, or a farmer living below the poverty line, including their family members or a self-help group (SHG) from Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a member of the cooperative society in their respective area or hold a savings account in the District Cooperative Bank. 1. Only one member from a family will be eligible to receive benefits under the scheme. 1. The benefits of the scheme will not be extended to defaulting cooperative members. 1. Currently, there is no income limit prescribed for farmers to avail of the scheme’s benefits. *(Note: A small farmer is one who owns up to 5 acres of unirrigated land or up to 2.5 acres of irrigated land. A marginal farmer is one who owns up to 2.5 acres of unirrigated land or up to 1.25 acres of irrigated land.)*
benefits: Under the scheme, an interest-free loan of up to ₹1.00 lakh is provided for agricultural activities, up to ₹3.00 lakh for non-agricultural activities (such as animal husbandry, dairy, poultry, fisheries, cultivation of herbs, aromatic plants, spices, mushrooms, floriculture, horticulture, agricultural processing, farm mechanization, organic farming, off-season vegetable cultivation, poly-house farming, etc.), and up to ₹5.00 lakh for self-help groups (SHGs).
summary: The scheme aims to provide interest-free loans to farmers and self-help groups for agricultural and non-agricultural activities to promote self-employment and strengthen the rural economy.

title: Financial Assistance and Grants to Sports Associations/ Clubs/ Sports Committees of Uttarakhand
eligibility_details: 1. The recognized Sports Associations, Clubs, and Sports Committees in Uttarakhand are eligible to receive financial assistance or grants under this scheme.
benefits: Recognized associations, clubs, and sports committees will receive financial assistance as follows: - National-level competitions: ₹3.50 lakh - State-level competitions: ₹2.50 lakh - District-level competitions: ₹1.00 lakh Additionally, there is a provision to provide ₹2.50 lakh to players selected to represent at the international level.
summary: The scheme aims to provide financial support or grants to recognized sports associations, clubs, and committees in the state for organizing sports competitions and for purchasing sports equipment for associations and players at the national, state, and district levels.

title: Financial Assistance to Authors for Book Publication
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a native or permanent resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be an eminent litterateur, writer, author, or poet. 1. The applicant’s literary work must remain unpublished solely due to financial constraints.
benefits: Under this scheme, the department provides financial assistance to eminent litterateurs, writers, and poets of the state whose works remain unpublished due to lack of funds.
summary: The scheme aims to support the state's eminent litterateurs, writers, poets, and authors by providing financial assistance whose literary works remain unpublished due to financial constraints.

title: Financial Assistance to Permanent Residents of Uttarakhand for Religious Pilgrimages
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must have successfully completed the Kailash Mansarovar Yatra organized by the Government of India. 1. The applicant must have undertaken the journey through the Kumaon Mandal Vikas Nigam.
benefits: The Uttarakhand State Government provides financial assistance of ₹50,000/- to permanent residents of the state, irrespective of religion or caste, who successfully complete the Kailash Mansarovar Yatra organized by the Government of India.
summary: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance of ₹50,000/- to permanent residents of the state who have successfully completed the Kailash Mansarovar Yatra, irrespective of their religion or caste.

title: Financial Assistance to Youth Groups
ministry: Department of Youth Welfare and Provincial Protection Corps
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a Mangal Dal affiliated with the Youth Welfare and PRD Department of Uttarakhand. 1. The members of Mangal Dal must be permanent residents of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant (Mangal Dal) must not have benefited previously under the scheme.
benefits: Financial support for starting one of the 18 Identified Business Activities for Starting Employment-Oriented Projects/Businesses in Uttarakhand State: - Dairy Production – ₹1,00,000/- - Tent Utensil Rental – ₹50,000/- - Sound System Rental – ₹50,000/- - Flour Mill Setup – ₹50,000/- - Photocopy/Fax/Lamination Machine – ₹1,00,000/- - Mushroom/Vegetable/Flower Cultivation – ₹50,000/- - Handloom/Woolen Items Production Equipment – ₹50,000/- - Adventure Sports Equipment – ₹4,00,000/- - Tailoring/Beauty Parlor Equipment – ₹50,000/- - Organic Fertilizer/Animal Feed Production – ₹50,000/- - Fruit Preservation Unit – ₹50,000/- - Animal Husbandry – ₹50,000/- - Cultural Instrument Purchase – ₹50,000/- - Electronics Repairs/Works – ₹50,000/- - Vehicle Repair Work – ₹50,000/- - Plumbing Work – ₹10,000/- - Mobile Phone Repair – ₹12,000/- - Innovative Projects – ₹1,50,000/- Funding Process: Financial assistance will be 75% of the total project cost or the specified amount for the chosen activity (whichever is lower). The remaining cost must be arranged by the beneficiary youth groups on their own.
summary: The scheme aims to promote self-employment & entrepreneurship among rural youth by providing financial support. Financial assistance is provided to Mangal Dals affiliated with the department to help them start employment-oriented projects in 18 identified business sectors.

title: License for Repairers of Weights-Measures and Weighing Instruments
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must possess one of the following qualifications: - ITI (Electronics) or its equivalent along with 2 years of relevant experience; or - Diploma in Electronics, Instrumentation, or Electrical Engineering with 1 year of relevant experience; or - B.Sc. degree with Physics and 1 year of relevant experience; or - B.E./B.Tech degree in Electrical, Electronics, or Instrumentation Engineering.
benefits: - For self-employment, traders can obtain licenses for weights, measures, and weighing instruments by paying the repair tax, repair fee, and prescribed government charges to ensure their livelihood.
summary: Under this scheme, a government-approved license is issued to repairers of weights and measuring instruments, enabling them to repair such instruments used by traders as a means of self-employment and to ensure their livelihood.

title: Mukhyamantri Udeeyman Khiladi Unnayan Chhatravriti Yojana
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a boy or girl between 8 and 14 years of age. 1. The boy or girl who obtain the highest marks based on merit in the final district-level competition, conducted through various stages of the Physical and Sports Aptitude Test (P-SAT) assessing physical abilities such as strength, flexibility, endurance, speed, and coordination, will be eligible for the sports scholarship.
benefits: - Under this scheme, players aged 8 to 14 years are selected every year on the basis of the Physical and Sports Aptitude Test (P-SAT). - From each district, 150 boys and 150 girls are selected (25 boys and 25 girls from each age group: 8–9 years, 9–10 years, 10–11 years, 11–12 years, 12–13 years, and 13–14 years). - Each selected player is awarded a scholarship of ₹1,500/- per month for one year.
summary: The scheme aims to promote sports among talented children aged 8 to 14 years in Uttarakhand by providing a monthly scholarship of ₹1,500. Players in this age group are selected every year on the basis of Physical & Sports Aptitude Test (P-SAT), with 150 boys & 150 girls selected from each district.

title: Operation of River Rafting / Kayaking Activities
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand for at least ten years or a native of the state. 1. The applicant should possess advanced practical and technical knowledge of aero sports.
benefits: Rafting companies are permitted to operate, and licenses are issued to river guides, providing revenue benefits to the state and economic benefits to tourism businesses.
summary: The scheme aims to promote safe & regulated adventure tourism in the state by allowing licensed rafting companies to operate & issuing certifications to qualified river guides. Under this scheme, rafting companies are granted permission to operate, and licenses are issued to qualified river guides.

title: Organisation of Cultural Programs
eligibility_details: - The applicant must be a cultural group or an artist registered with the Department of Culture, Uttarakhand.
benefits: After the presentation of cultural programmes by groups/folk singers enlisted with the Culture Department on the occasion of traditional fairs, festivals, celebrations, and national festivals organized within or outside the state, the following honorarium and allowances are payable: 1. Group Leader: Honorarium of ₹1,000/- and travelling allowance of ₹500/-. 1. Other Artists: Honorarium of ₹800/- each and travelling allowance of ₹400/- each. 1. Folk Singers: - Category A: ₹7,500/- as honorarium. - Category B: ₹4,250/- as honorarium. - Travelling allowance: ₹300/- along with ordinary bus fare or second-class rail fare for the journey.
summary: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to cultural groups and artists registered with the Department for performing in cultural programs organized during traditional fairs, festivals, regional celebrations within and outside the state, as well as on the occasion of national festivals.

title: Organization of Sports Competitions and Training Programs
ministry: Department of Youth Welfare and Provincial Protection Corps
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a youth (boy or girl).
benefits: - Organizing Khel Mahakumbh Competitions – Various sports competitions are organized for the age groups Under-14, Under-17, and Under-21. - Prizes are awarded for first, second, and third places as follows: Sl. No.Level1st Rank (Cash Prize ₹)2nd Rank (Cash Prize ₹)3rd Rank (Cash Prize ₹)1Gram Panchayat₹300/-₹200/-₹150/-2Block Development ₹500/-₹400/-₹300/-3District Level₹800/-₹600/-₹400/-4State Level₹1,500/-₹1,000/-₹700/- - During the competitions, talented players who perform best at the Block Development levels and District levels are identified by the department and provided free training prior to state-level participation.
summary: The scheme aims to promote sports & identify grassroots-level talent among youth through structured competitions & training. Players are provided with cash prizes and free training, & participation is encouraged at multiple levels, including Gram Panchayat, Development Block, District, and State.

title: Provision of Sports Kits to Players Participating at the National Level
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a player or a member of a team representing Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant or their team must be participating in national-level sports competitions.
benefits: - Under this scheme, sports kits are provided through sports associations to players and team members participating in various sports disciplines at the national level across different age groups. - Approximately 1,000 players benefit from the scheme annually.
summary: This scheme provides a sports kit worth ₹5000/- (including tracksuit, jersey, shorts, socks, etc.) to approximately 1000 players annually who participate in various sports at the national level, selected through their respective sports federations.

title: Uttarakhand Tourism Entrepreneur Promotion Scheme
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a permanent resident/entrepreneur of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant's proposed investment in identified tourism activities/operations should be between ₹1,00,00,000 and ₹5,00,00,000. 1. The applicant's unit should be registered as a sole proprietorship/partnership/LLP/private limited company, or any other legal entity. The participation in all these companies/organizations must be exclusively by permanent residents/entrepreneurs of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant's unit should be established on fully owned land. If the unit is to be built on leased land, the remaining lease period must be more than 10 years. 1. The applicant should obtain in-principle approval (CAF) through the Single Window Portal under the Uttarakhand Udhyam Ekul Khidki Sugamata aur Anugyapan Adhiniyam, 2012 (as amended), prior to establishing a new unit or expanding an existing one. This is necessary for the grants mentioned under this scheme. 1. The applicant's unit should provide a minimum of 70% permanent local employment. 1. The applicant's tourism unit should be mandatorily registered with the State Goods and Services Tax Department. 1. Units that commence commercial operations under this scheme within 180 days from the date of the notification will need to submit documentation and records for capital investment assistance in a comprehensive and clear manner. 1. The right to interpret the rules/provisions of this scheme, or to add, remove, or modify new tourism activities, is vested with the Uttarakhand Government.
benefits: Stamp Duty Reimbursement: 1. Amount: 100% of the applicable stamp duty. 2. Intended Use: For new eligible tourism units to receive reimbursement on the stamp duty paid on: - Sale/lease deeds related to the purchase/lease of land/built-up area for tourism projects, provided the sale/lease deed is executed during the scheme's validity period. - Loan agreements are made for initiating the project during the scheme's validity period. - Mortgages and pledges were made for initiating the project during the scheme's validity period. 3. Conditions: The stamp duty reimbursement will be provided in a lump sum after the tourism unit commences commercial operation (COD). The application for stamp duty reimbursement must be submitted along with the capital grant application. Capital Grant/Assistance: 1. Amount: Financial grant/assistance will be provided based on the permissible capital investment for establishing new or expanding existing eligible tourism units in the identified categories. - Category A districts: ₹33,00,000 plus 15% of the additional permissible capital investment above ₹1,00,00,000, with a maximum grant of ₹80,00,000. - Category B districts: ₹33,00,000 plus 25% of the additional permissible capital investment above ₹1,00,00,000, with a maximum grant of ₹1,20,00,000. - Category C districts: ₹33,00,000 plus 30% of the additional permissible capital investment above ₹1,00,00,000, with a maximum grant of ₹1,50,00,000. 2. Eligible Capital Investment: For calculating the capital grant/assistance, "permissible capital investment" includes peripheral infrastructure (boundary wall, internal roads, and other basic structural facilities), structure and building, plant, indigenous and imported machinery and equipment, material handling equipment, mechanical, electrical, and plumbing installations, fixtures, furniture and fittings, waste management facilities, transformers, generators, captive power plants, and other auxiliary facilities installed for use on the premises and their related installation expenses. 3. Excluded Capital Investment: Investment in "land and land development," pre-construction expenses, consulting fees, capitalised interest, and working capital will not be included in the calculation for the capital grant. 4. Conditions: Full payment by the investor for all capital assets and complete ownership of the project is required. All capital assets must be installed and used at the project site. Interest Subsidy Reimbursement: 1. Amount: 3% interest subsidy on term loans. - Category A districts: Maximum ₹4,00,000 per year, per unit. - Category B districts: Maximum ₹5,00,000 per year, per unit. - Category C districts: Maximum ₹6,00,000 per year, per unit. 2. Intended Use: Applicable to eligible tourism units on term loans taken from notified commercial banks, financial institutions, state government cooperative banks, regional rural banks, or financial institutions recognised by the Government of India/State Government for financing the permissible capital investment. 3. Conditions: The interest subsidy reimbursement will be payable for a maximum of 3 years from the date of commercial operation commencement. The percentage of interest subsidy reimbursement will be calculated annually based on the interest paid by the unit on the term loan after commercial operation commences.
summary: The scheme aims to aims to encourage and financially strengthen permanent residents/entrepreneurs of the state who invest ₹1 crore to ₹5 crore in the tourism sector.

title: Veer Chandra Singh Garhwali Paryatan Swarojgar Yojana
eligibility_details: 1. To avail the benefits of this scheme, the applicant must be a native or permanent resident of Uttarakhand. 1. If land is required for implementing the scheme, the applicant must either be the owner of the land or, if the land is in the name of a close relative, the mortgage of the land will be acceptable as priority security. If the landowner becomes a partner with the applicant as a co-borrower or guarantor, the grant amount will be payable only to the applicant. 1. The applicant can also avail the benefits of the scheme on leased land, provided the lease period exceeds the loan repayment period and the applicant is not a defaulter of any bank or financial institution. 1. Definition of Unemployed - an unemployed person is one who is not currently engaged in any business, enterprise, or profession.
benefits: Under this scheme, both vehicle items (ordinary bus, taxi, max, electric bus) and non-vehicle items (hotel/paying guest scheme, construction of motor garage/workshop, establishment of fast food centres, establishment of Sadhna Kutir Yoga Meditation centres, adventure activities, establishment of modern tourist information centres with P.C.O. facility, development of tented residential facilities, establishment of sales centres for local handicrafts and symbolic items, establishment of bakery, establishment of laundry, purchase of equipment for terrain bikes, star gazing and bird watching for tourism, herbal tourism, purchase and operation of kayaking/boats, caravan/motor home tourism, purchase of angling equipment, construction of museums containing memorabilia and establishment of memorabilia/souvenir centres, construction of floating hotels, and establishment of centres for providing trekking equipment, suits, jackets, etc. on rent) are included. Apart from the above, applicants can also submit any innovative project based on the attractions and characteristics of their particular area. The following grants/subsidies are provided under the scheme: (a) Non-vehicle items: A grant of up to 33% of the project cost, with a maximum of ₹33.00 lakh in hilly areas, and up to 25% of the project cost, with a maximum of ₹25.00 lakh in plain areas. (b) Vehicle items: A grant of up to 25% of the project cost, with a maximum of ₹10.00 lakh in both hilly and plain areas. For specific buses/electric buses—pushback 30 and 42 seater (2*2), pushback 26–28 seater, and 42 seater (2*2) electric/air-conditioned buses—a grant of 50% of the project cost, up to a maximum of ₹20.00 lakh, is provided. This provision applies only to buses/electric buses meeting the prescribed criteria, with a maximum of 50 buses/electric buses eligible per financial year. *To avail the subsidy under the scheme, the applicant must contribute 12.5% of the total project cost as Margin Money.*
summary: The scheme aims to promote tourism-based self-employment and entrepreneurship among unemployed residents of Uttarakhand by providing financial assistance and subsidies for the development of tourism-related infrastructure and services. This scheme is applicable in entire Uttarakhand.

title: Akhil Bhartiya Sanskrit Kavi Sammelan
eligibility_details: 1. The fifteen Sanskrit poets from Uttarakhand and other states, who compose and recite poetry in Sanskrit, are invited.
benefits: An honorarium of ₹2501/- is given to each invited poet.
summary: The scheme aims to promote and popularize Sanskrit language and literature by encouraging poets who compose and recite in Sanskrit. 15 poets from Uttarakhand and other states are invited to present their works at national/state festivals, each receiving ₹2501/-.

title: Award Scheme for Candidates Selected in NDA, IMA, OTA, INA, IAF
eligibility_details: 1. The candidate must be a native or permanent resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The candidate should have been selected for service at one of the premier defence academies, such as National Defence Academy (NDA), Indian Military Academy (IMA), Officers Training Academy (OTA), Indian Naval Academy (INA) or Indian Air Force (IAF). 1. The applicant must either be currently undergoing training at the respective academy or have been formally inducted into the defence service. 1. The candidate must have successfully completed the relevant training and course.
benefits: Award Amount: ₹50,000/- per candidate
summary: Under this scheme, a one-time award of ₹50,000/- is given to each candidate from Uttarakhand who has been selected for service at premier defence academies such as the NDA, IMA, OTA, INA, and IAF.

title: Dr. Bhimrao Ambedkar Sanskrit Scholarship Scheme for Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe Students
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a student studying in Class 6 to Class 12 at Sanskrit schools in Uttarakhand. 1. The student must belong to the Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribe community. 1. A total of 200 students studying in Class 6 to Class 12 at Sanskrit schools in the state will be eligible for the scholarship. 1. The student must possess a valid caste certificate issued by a competent authority.
benefits: Scholarship Amount: - Students from Class 6 to Class 12 will be provided ₹3,012/- per year, at the rate of ₹251/- per month.
summary: The scheme aims to encourage and motivate students belonging to Scheduled Caste (SC) and Scheduled Tribe (ST) communities who are studying in Sanskrit schools from Class 6 to Class 12 in Uttarakhand by providing financial scholarships to support their education.

title: Free Computer Training
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be an ex-serviceman, serving soldier, widow of a serviceman, or their dependent, and must have passed the 12th standard.
benefits: Under this scheme, eligible beneficiaries are provided with a one-year free training course in Computer, Accounting, Web Designing, or Digital Marketing.
summary: The scheme aims to provide a one-year free training course (Computer / Accounting / Web Designing / Digital Marketing) to ex-servicemen, serving soldiers, their widows, and dependents who have passed the 12th standard.

title: Freeship less than ₹1,00,000 (UG students only)
eligibility_details: - The applicant should be enrolled as an undergraduate student at Govind Ballabh Pant University. - The applicant’s annual family income should be less than ₹1,00,000. - The applicant must be among the best-performing students as per the university’s merit guidelines. - The applicant must submit the application in the prescribed format within the deadline
benefits: - Eligible students get a 100% tuition fee waiver. - Aims to reduce the financial burden on low-income families and encourage academic excellence. - The fee waiver is directly applied during fee processing. - Granted once every academic year, at the beginning of the session. - Disbursed after the final selection list is approved by the Registrar and Vice Chancellor. - Validity: Boys: Up to 3 academic years Girls: Up to 4 academic years
summary: The scheme "Freeship Less than ₹1,00,000 only for UG students" by the Dean Student Welfare, GBPUAT, Pantnagar aims to support meritorious undergraduate students from low-income families. This Freeship scheme provides full tuition fee exemption to eligible students.

title: Freeship less than ₹1,00,000 (UG students only)
eligibility_details: - The applicant should be enrolled as an undergraduate student at Govind Ballabh Pant University. - The applicant’s annual family income should be less than ₹1,00,000. - The applicant must be among the best-performing students as per the university’s merit guidelines. - The applicant must submit the application in the prescribed format within the deadline.
benefits:
Eligible students get a 100% tuition fee waiver.

Aims to reduce the financial burden on low-income families and encourage academic excellence.

The fee waiver is directly applied during fee processing.

Granted once every academic year, at the beginning of the session.

Disbursed after the final selection list is approved by the Registrar and Vice Chancellor.

Validity:

Boys: Up to 3 academic years

Girls: Up to 4 academic years
summary: The scheme "Freeship Less than ₹1,00,000 only for UG students" by the Dean Student Welfare, GBPUAT, Pantnagar aims to support meritorious undergraduate students from low-income families. This Freeship scheme provides full tuition fee exemption to eligible students.

title: Gargi Sanskrit Balika Chhaatravrtti Yojana
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a girl student of any category. 1. The girl student must be studying from class 6 to class 12 in a Sanskrit school of Uttarakhand. 1. A total of 175 enrolled girl students will be eligible.
benefits: Scholarship Amount: - Girl students from classes 6 to 12 are provided ₹251/0 per month, at the rate of ₹3,012/- annually.
summary: The scheme aims to encourage and motivate girl students studying in Classes 6 to 12 at Sanskrit schools in the state by providing financial scholarships to support their education.

title: Green Skill Development Programme (GSDP)
eligibility_details: - The applicant should be a student. - The applicant should have completed at least 10th standard. - The applicant should be a farmer/ youth or individual seeking self-employment. - The applicant should be below 55 years of age at the time of application. - The applicant should have an interest in environmental and ecological training topics such as wildlife, biodiversity, or natural resource interpretation.
benefits: - Skill Development Training: Free-of-cost training in environment-related fields such as bird identification, wildlife conservation, biodiversity interpretation, and eco-tourism education. - Self-Employment Opportunities: Empowers youth and farmers to pursue independent livelihood avenues through knowledge-based interventions. - Government Scheme Readiness: Makes candidates eligible for roles under various central/state schemes and government-supported training projects.
summary: The scheme "Harit Kaushal Vikas Karyakram" implemented by the Govind Ballabh Pant National Institute of Himalayan Environment (NIHE), aims to impart eco-based livelihood skills to youth and communities in the Himalayan regions.

title: Gunavatta Evam Navaachar Nishulk Paathy Pustak Yojana
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a student from Classes 1 to 8. 1. The applicant must be studying in a government or government-aided school, or a recognized madrasa that follows the Uttarakhand state government curriculum.
benefits: Every year, in accordance with the guidelines of the Directorate of Elementary and Secondary Education, free textbooks are provided to all students from Classes 1 to 8 in government schools, government-aided schools, and recognized madrasas following the state government curriculum.
summary: The scheme aims to provide free textbooks to all students from Classes 1 to 8 studying in government and government-aided schools, as well as recognized madrasas that follow the state government curriculum.

title: Maulana Azad Education Finance Foundation Scheme
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must belong to a minority community (Muslim, Sikh, Christian, Parsi, Buddhist, or Jain). 1. The age of the applicant should be between 18 and 35 years. 1. The applicant must have passed Class 12. 1. The applicant must be studying in or have taken admission to a university/college/institute recognized by the Central Government, State Government, or any other competent authority. 1. The annual family income of the applicant from all sources should not exceed ₹2,50,000/-. 1. The beneficiary availing the loan must repay it within 3 years after the completion of education or upon gaining employment, whichever is earlier.
benefits: Under this scheme, students from minority communities are provided interest-free loans of up to ₹5 lakh for pursuing higher education in India and abroad.
summary: The scheme aims to provide interest-free loans of up to ₹5 lakh to students from minority communities for pursuing higher education in India and abroad.

title: Minority Scholarship Scheme for Class 1 to 10
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must belong to a minority community (Muslim, Sikh, Christian, Parsi, Buddhist, or Jain). 1. The applicant must be studying in Classes 1 to 10. 1. The applicant must be enrolled in a recognized government/non-government educational institution in the state of Uttarakhand.
benefits: At present, the State Government provides the following monthly scholarships for students from Class 1 to 10: - Class 1 to 5: ₹50/-- Class 6 to 8: ₹80/-- Class 9 to 10: ₹120/-
summary: The scheme aims to provide scholarships to students belonging to minority communities who are studying in Classes 1 to 10 in any recognized government/non-government educational institution in Uttarakhand.

title: Mukhyamantri Alpasankhyak Medhwi Balika Protsahan Yojana
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must belong to a minority community in Uttarakhand. 2. The applicant must be a girl student. 3. The girl student must have secured 60% or more marks as an institutional candidate in the High School Examination of the Uttarakhand Secondary Education Board / Madrasa Board or its equivalent (Munshi/Maulvi), or in the Intermediate Examination or its equivalent (Alim). 4. The applicant’s mother/father/guardian should belong to the Below Poverty Line (BPL) category, or their annual family income from all sources should not exceed: - ₹81,000 in rural areas - ₹1,03,000 in urban areas 5. The girl student must be unmarried. 6. The age of the girl student should not be more than 20 years. 7. A maximum of two daughters from the same family can avail of this benefit.
benefits: The following incentives are given to meritorious girl students of minority community: High School / Munshi / Maulvi: - ₹10,000/- for securing 60% or above marks - ₹15,000/- for securing 70% or above marks - ₹20,000/- for securing 80% or above marks Intermediate / Alim: - ₹15,000/- for securing 60% or above marks - ₹20,000/- for securing 70% or above marks - ₹25,000/- for securing 80% or above marks
summary: The scheme aims to provide financial incentives to meritorious girl students belonging to minority communities based on their performance in the High School Examination or its equivalent (Munshi/Maulvi) and Intermediate Examination or its equivalent (Alim).

title: Mukhyamantri Alpasankhyak Protsahan Yojana
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must belong to a minority community (Muslim, Sikh, Christian, Parsi, Buddhist, or Jain). 1. The applicant must have successfully cleared either the Preliminary or Main Examination stage of UPSC, UKPSC (Combined Competitive or Higher Judicial Services), or the entrance examination of a national-level institution (such as IITs, IIMs, etc.). 1. The annual income of the applicant’s parents/guardians (including the applicant’s own income, if any) must not exceed ₹4.50 lakh. 1. The grant amount will be released only after the candidate submits the admit card of the relevant examination and the original application form/certificate of success to the competent authority.
benefits: The following incentives are provided to candidates from the minority community for their preparation: For the All India Civil Services Examination conducted by the Union Public Service Commission (UPSC): - ₹75,000/- after passing the Preliminary Examination and applying for the Main Examination. - ₹25,000/- for interview preparation after passing the Main Examination. For the Uttarakhand State and Subordinate Services (Direct Recruitment), Combined Competitive Examination, Higher Judicial Service, and Provincial Civil Services (Judicial) conducted by the Uttarakhand Public Service Commission (UKPSC): - ₹60,000/- after passing the Preliminary Examination and applying for the Main Examination. - ₹20,000/- for interview preparation after passing the Main Examination. For admission to national-level institutes through entrance examinations: - Group A: Admission to IITs and IIMs – ₹60,000/- after clearing the entrance examination and securing admission. - Group B: Admission to AIIMS, IISc Bangalore, IISER (Kolkata & Bangalore), national-level medical colleges recognized by the Medical Council of India (MCI), National Institutes of Technology (NITs) recognized by the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE), National Law Universities recognized by the Bar Council of India (BCI), and through the Common Law Admission Test (CLAT) – ₹50,000/- after passing the entrance examination and securing admission.
summary: The scheme supports minority community candidates of Uttarakhand by offering financial incentives for competitive exam preparation. Incentives are provided at different stages of success in exams like UPSC, UKPSC (including judicial services), and entrances to IITs & IIMs.

title: Mukhyamantri Chhaatrvrtti Yojana
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be an NCC cadet. 1. The applicant must have passed the 10th or 12th class or an equivalent examination in the previous academic session. 1. The applicant must have completed two years of NCC training. 1. The applicant must have maintained a minimum of 80% attendance in each year of NCC training. 1. The applicant must be currently pursuing higher education. 1. The applicant must not be receiving any other general or special scholarship from the State Government.
benefits: Group Level: - For Senior Division/Senior Wing cadets: ₹2,400/-. - For Junior Division/Junior Wing cadets: ₹1,200/-. Unit Level: - For Senior Division/Senior Wing cadets: ₹1,200/-. - For Junior Division/Junior Wing cadets: ₹600/-.
summary: The scheme aims to support eligible NCC cadets through financial incentives to encourage continued participation in education and NCC training. Under this scheme, scholarship amounts ranging from ₹600/- to ₹2,400/- are provided annually to eligible NCC cadets at group and unit levels.

title: Mukhyamantri Uchcha Shiksha Shodh Protsahan Yojana
eligibility_details: 1. The regular professors working in state government colleges and state university campuses of Uttarakhand, as well as students and research scholars enrolled in regular programs at recognized institutions within the state, are eligible to apply. 1. A research proposal may also include a co-investigator alongside the principal investigator. 1. The broad subject areas for research include Science, Arts and Humanities, Home Science, and Commerce & Management, while interdisciplinary subjects will also be accepted. 1. Research related to the state that proves to be productive and useful in social, economic, contemporary, or other areas of special importance will be encouraged. 1. Priority will be given to problem-oriented, solution-driven, and action-based research topics (Problem and Action-Based Research Programme). 1. Research proposals may also be invited based on requests for specific issues raised by any department of the state government. 1. A maximum period of two years will be allowed for completing the research work, which may be extended by one additional year under special circumstances. 1. Only one research project will be permitted for any teacher or research scholar at a time.
benefits: The maximum research grant provided by the state government is ₹15 lakh, which may be increased up to ₹18 lakh in special circumstances.
summary: The scheme aims to promote high-quality, interdisciplinary research in higher education institutions across state. The broad subject areas for research include Science, Arts & Humanities, Home Science, & Commerce & Management, while proposals in interdisciplinary subject areas are also encouraged.

title: Nishulk Ganavesh Yojana
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be either a girl student, or a boy student belonging to the Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe, or General Category BPL family. 1. The applicant must be studying in Classes 1 to 8.
benefits: Under this scheme, two sets of uniforms per student are provided through DBT/SMC to students studying in classes 1 to 8 of government and government-aided schools, covering all girls, all boys belonging to Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe categories, and boys from the General category belonging to BPL families.
summary: The scheme aims to provide free uniforms to all girl students studying in Classes 1 to 8 of government and government-aided schools, as well as to all boys belonging to Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes, and boys from the General category who fall under the BPL category.

title: Pre-Examination Coaching Scheme
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Tribe community. 1. The applicant should be a student. 1. The applicant should be preparing for competitive examinations such as IAS, PCS, Engineering, Medical, Nursing, NDA, or Group ‘C’ exams. 1. The applicant should have passed High School, Intermediate, or Graduation.
benefits: Free Coaching: - Provided for competitive exams such as IAS, PCS, Engineering, Medical, Nursing, NDA, Group ‘C’, and others. Monthly Scholarship: - ₹1,500/- per month for external (non-local) students. - ₹750/- per month for local students.
summary: Under this scheme, free coaching and monthly scholarships are provided to eligible Scheduled Tribe students appearing for exams like IAS, PCS, engineering, medical, NDA, Group ‘C’ exams and other competitive examinations.

title: Printing and Free Distribution of Sanskrit Textbooks
eligibility_details: 1. The students studying in Classes 1 to 12 at Sanskrit schools across Uttarakhand are eligible.
benefits: Each student is provided annual financial assistance under the scheme as follows: - Classes 1st to 5th: ₹250/- per student - Classes 6th to 8th: ₹400/- per student - Classes 9th to 10th: ₹600/- per student - Classes 11th to 12th: ₹700/- per student
summary: The scheme aims to promote Sanskrit education by providing free Sanskrit textbooks to students studying in Classes 1 to 12. Under this scheme, annual financial assistance ranging from ₹250/- to ₹700/- is provided to each student enrolled in Classes 1 to 12 of Sanskrit schools.

title: Provision of Special Assistance for Development of Low-Cost Educational Materials (SIPDA)
eligibility_details: Individual Eligibility: - The applicant must be a visually impaired student enrolled in school or pursuing higher education. - The applicant must have a valid Unique Disability ID (UDID) card issued by the competent authority. Institutional Eligibility: - The agency must be approved for SIPDA projects. - The agency must be actively involved in the development, production, or distribution of educational materials for persons with visual disabilities.
benefits: - Support for Braille Presses: Assistance is given for the installation of new Braille presses and enhancement of the capacity and modernization of existing Braille presses. - Upgradation of Talking Book Studios: Financial support is offered for increasing the capacity and modernization of existing Talking Book Studios. - Creation and Enhancement of Digital Book Production Centers: Grants are available for setting up new Digital Book Production Centers and modernizing existing centers to improve production capabilities. - Support for Large Print Book Production: Funding is provided for establishing new Large Print Book Production Centers and increasing the capacity and modernization of existing large print facilities.
summary: The scheme aims to provide financial support for the development and supply of low-cost educational materials for visually impaired students. Through this scheme, grants are provided to implementing agencies for purchasing and producing assistive learning devices.

title: Rajya/Mukhyamantri Swarn/Rajat Padak Protsahan Puraskar
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be an NCC cadet. 1. The applicant must have demonstrated outstanding performance in one of the following camps during the current training year: RDC (Republic Day Camp), TSC (Thall Sainik Camp), VSC (Vayu Sena Camp), or NSC (Nau Sainik Camp). 1. The applicant must be among the top 6 performers for the gold medal or the next 6 performers for the silver medal.
benefits: - Gold Medal Winners: A cash award of ₹3,000/- each is given to 6 cadets who achieve gold medals during NCC training and camps.- Silver Medal Winners: A cash award of ₹2,000/- each is given to 6 cadets who achieve silver medals during NCC training and camps.
summary: This scheme awards cash incentives to NCC cadets who demonstrate outstanding performance in the current year's RDC, TSC, VSC, or NSC camps, recognizing six gold medal recipients with ₹3,000/- and six silver medal recipients with ₹2000/-.

title: Rani Laxmi Bai Self-Defense Training
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant (girl student) must be studying in an upper primary or secondary government school in Uttarakhand.
benefits: Free self-defense techniques training is provided to girl students.
summary: The scheme aims to provide free self-defense skills training (including judo, karate, martial arts, and boxing) to girl students in upper primary and secondary schools across Uttarakhand.

title: Rural Technology Complex
eligibility_details: - The applicant should belong to any of the following categories: 1. A central or state government officer or staff member. 1. A representative of a non-governmental organisation (NGO). 1. A student from a recognised university or educational institution. 1. A teacher or faculty member from any recognised educational institution. 1. A rural woman or man interested in acquiring environment-friendly livelihood-based technological skills. 1. A member of a registered self-help group (SHG).
benefits: - Free Training: All training programmes under the scheme are provided at no cost. - Livelihood Enhancement: Training equips individuals with skills for sustainable, eco-friendly income generation. - Practical Exposure: Training includes hands-on learning and field demonstrations. - No Participation Charges: There is no fee for training or the exposure visit to the Rural Technology Campus.
summary: The scheme "Rural Technology Complex" by the Programme Implementation Department, Government of Uttarakhand, aims to enhance livelihood opportunities in the Himalayan region through the use of local, need-based and environment-friendly technologies.

title: S.P. Nautiyal Museum
eligibility_details: - The applicant can be any national/ international visitor, or a large group/ an institution seeking a guided tour.
benefits: - Educational Insight: Provides in-depth knowledge and understanding of the Great Himalayas through geo-scientific exhibits. - Awareness Generation: Raises awareness about the geological and natural heritage of the Himalayan region. - Diverse Exhibits: Offers a wide range of exhibits including maps, charts, models, and actual samples of rocks, minerals, and fossils. - Accessibility: Open to both national and international visitors, making it a globally accessible resource for Himalayan studies.
summary: The scheme “S.P. Nautiyal Sangrahalaya” implemented by the Wadia Institute of Himalayan Geology, provides insights into the Great Himalayas through geological maps, charts, models, and educational exhibits, displaying rock, mineral, and fossil samples from the entire Himalayan region.

title: Samaaveshit Shiksha
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a child with a disability, aged 6 to 18 years, eligible for all facilities approved by the Government of India under the ‘Samaveshit Shiksha’ scheme. 1. The applicant must be studying in government schools from Classes 1 to 12.
benefits: - Escort facility, home-based education, sports activities, exposure visits, stipend for girls, and free equipment are provided to all children with special needs studying in government schools from Classes 1 to 12. - Marking and equipment distribution camps are also organized for such children, where assistive devices are provided free of cost as per the requirement of disabled children.
summary: The scheme aims to provide equal and inclusive educational opportunities to all children with special needs (Divyang children) studying in government schools from Classes 1 to 12.

title: Sanskrit Shodh Chhaatravrtti Yojana
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a student registered for a Ph.D. in Sanskrit at any university in Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must belong to the General, Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe, and Economically Weaker Section. 1. A total of 20 research scholars are eligible for the scholarship, including 10 from the General category, 5 from Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes, and 5 from Economically Weaker Section (EWS) certificate holders. 1. Selection will be based on the highest marks obtained in the NET examination.
benefits: - A research scholarship of ₹40,000/- per year is awarded to 20 students registered for a Ph.D. in Sanskrit at universities across Uttarakhand. - The scholarship is provided for a period of three years at ₹40,000/- per year and must be renewed by submitting an application each year/semester.
summary: The aim of the scheme is to encourage and support high-quality research in Sanskrit by providing financial assistance to meritorious Ph.D. students across state universities.

title: Scholarship to Poor Students
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a student. 1. The student must be enrolled in an undergraduate or postgraduate course at Uttarakhand Sanskrit University. 1. The student must have the lowest annual family income among all students in the same course, class, or subject.
benefits: Under this scheme, one student from each undergraduate and postgraduate class at Uttarakhand Sanskrit University is awarded a scholarship equal to the tuition fee of their respective class.
summary: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to economically disadvantaged students enrolled in undergraduate and postgraduate programs at Uttarakhand Sanskrit University.

title: Shodhgrantha Chayan Yojana
eligibility_details: 1. Authentic and socially relevant research books related to Sanskrit literature in the context of Uttarakhand are invited for publication. 1. Scholars from any state of the country (who write research papers within the scope of research methodology) will be eligible.
benefits: For the research paper, the author receives an honorarium of ₹151/- per page, and 25 copies of the published book are provided free of cost.
summary: The scheme aims to invite scholars from any state in India to submit research manuscripts on Sanskrit literature, as well as socially relevant research books related to Sanskrit literature in the context of Uttarakhand.

title: Skill Development
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must possess a postgraduate degree in any discipline of Geosciences, Earth Sciences, or allied fields. 1. The applicant may also be pursuing an integrated postgraduate degree course and should be in the fourth or fifth year of the curriculum. 1. The applicant must be from fields such as geophysics, geochemistry, structural geology, sedimentology, paleontology, environmental geoscience, and related disciplines.
benefits: - Research Experience: Provides opportunities for self-sponsored research work, allowing students to gain practical experience in Earth Sciences. - Seasonal Training: Offers valuable summer and winter training programs, enhancing practical skills and knowledge in specialized geological disciplines. - Exposure to Diverse Fields: Exposes students to a wide array of sub-disciplines within Earth Sciences, such as structural geology, geochemistry, glaciology, engineering geology, palaeontology, and environmental geology.
summary: The scheme "Skill Development" by the Wadia Institute of Himalayan Geology, aims to impart practical training to postgraduate students in various Earth Science disciplines, including structural and evolutionary geology, geochemistry, geomorphology, glaciology, magnetostratigraphy, etc.

title: Son/Daughter Education Assistance (UKBOCWWB)
eligibility_details: 1. The two (2) children of a construction worker registered with the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board will be eligible to avail benefits under this scheme. Applications must be submitted between November of the same financial year in which admission is taken (from Class 1 to Post Graduation) and June of the next academic session. Applications received after this period will not be considered by the Board. Financial assistance for education is provided on an annual basis.
benefits: Financial assistance for education will be provided to the children of construction workers at the following rates: Sl. No.Class/CourseFinancial Assistance (Yearly)1Class 1 to 5₹1,800/-2Class 6 to 10₹2,400/-3Class 11 to 12₹3,000/-4Graduation/Post Graduation or its equivalent₹10,000/-5ITI, Polytechnic courses or higher educationThe course fee will be payable to the Government Institutions / College.
summary: The scheme provides financial assistance to the children of registered building and construction workers pursuing education from Class I up to higher education or professional courses.

title: Special Financial Assistance Scheme for Meritorious Students of the State for Preparation of Competitive Examinations
eligibility_details: 1. The 100 candidates who qualify in the preliminary examination of Group ‘A’ and ‘B’ conducted by the State Public Service Commission. 1. The candidates must have passed the preliminary examination for Group 'A' or 'B', or the written examination for the Armed Forces (such as NDA, CDS, OTA, Indian Naval Academy, Indian Air Force Academy, etc.) conducted by the Union Public Service Commission. 1. The candidate must be a native or permanent resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The candidate must have passed Graduate/Postgraduate examinations, or the minimum educational qualification prescribed for the above services, from recognized educational institutions (regular/open) located in the State of Uttarakhand. 1. The total annual family income of the candidate from all sources should not exceed ₹5 lakh. 1. The candidate should not have availed the benefit of any other equivalent scheme of the State or Central Government. 1. A candidate who is engaged in any job/business/profession, or whose spouse is engaged in any job/business/profession, will not be eligible for the benefit.
benefits: A one-time grant of ₹50,000/- per candidate is provided to eligible candidate.
summary: The scheme aims to provide financial support of ₹50,000/- to meritorious students who have cleared the preliminary examination conducted by the State or Union Public Service Commission for Group 'A' and 'B' services, or the written examination for the Armed Forces (e.g., NDA, CDS, OTA, etc.).

title: Student Program Under AcSIR
eligibility_details: - The applicant must have a postgraduate degree (M.Sc./M.Tech.) in any discipline of Earth Sciences. - The applicant must hold a valid national-level fellowship such as: 1. NET-JRF (UGC/CSIR). 1. INSPIRE Fellowship. 1. Any other equivalent national fellowship.
benefits: - Advanced Research Opportunities: The program provides opportunities for conducting high-quality, interdisciplinary research in various fields of Himalayan Geo-science. - Leadership Development: The scheme aims to develop leaders in the field of Himalayan Geo-science through the PhD program. - Career Advancement: Successful completion of the PhD program leads to a postgraduate degree, enhancing career prospects in the field.
summary: The scheme "Student Program Under AcSIR" implemented by the Academy of Scientific and Innovative Research (AcSIR), aims to promote high-quality research and leadership development in Earth Sciences through doctoral education. It provides research opportunities to geoscience postgraduate students.

title: Uchcha Shiksha Protsahan Chhatravriti Yojana
eligibility_details: 1. The student must be studying in a Government College or State University campus of Uttarakhand. 1. At each college/campus level (per faculty): Undergraduate Students: 1. First-year students: Monthly scholarships of ₹3,000/-, ₹2,000/-, and ₹1,500/- will be awarded to students securing first, second, and third positions, respectively, based on a minimum of 80% marks or equivalent grade in the 12th examination. 1. Second- and third-year students: Monthly scholarships of ₹3,000/-, ₹2,000/-, and ₹1,500/- will be awarded to students securing first, second, and third positions, respectively, based on a minimum of 60% marks or equivalent grade in the previous year’s examination. 1. Graduation-level examination toppers: Students securing first, second, and third positions based on a minimum of 60% marks or equivalent grade in the first-year examination will be awarded a lump-sum scholarship of ₹35,000/-, ₹25,000/-, and ₹20,000/-, respectively. Postgraduate Students: 1. Second-year students: Students securing first, second, and third positions based on a minimum of 60% marks or equivalent grade in the first-year examination will be awarded monthly scholarships of ₹5,000/-, ₹3,000/-, and ₹2,000/-, respectively. 1. Final-year or one-year course students: Students must have secured a minimum of 60% marks or equivalent grade in the first-year examination. First, second, and third position holders will receive a one-time scholarship of ₹60,000/-, ₹35,000/-, and ₹25,000/-, respectively. Merit-based Scholarships: 1. 10% of students from each faculty of each college/university campus securing a minimum of 75% marks and having at least 75% attendance in the first, second, and third years of graduation (as applicable) will be awarded a scholarship of ₹1,500/- per month. Additional Notes: 1. Marks obtained after improvement tests will not be considered for scholarship calculation. 1. The academic session is calculated from July 1 to June 30.
benefits: Under the scheme, scholarships ranging from a minimum of ₹1,500/- to a maximum of ₹60,000/- are awarded to students who secure first, second, and third positions in each faculty at the undergraduate and postgraduate levels.
summary: The scheme aims to promote higher education among meritorious students by providing financial support to regular undergraduate and postgraduate students in government colleges and state universities of Uttarakhand.

title: Adventure Training for Youth
ministry: Department of Youth Welfare and Provincial Protection Corps
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a male or female. 1. The applicant must be between 15 to 30 years of age as on 1st March, 2023. 1. The applicant must have passed at least class 8th.1. The applicant must be physically fit to undergo adventure training. 1. The applicant must not be suffering from Heart disease, Asthma, Epilepsy, or have rods implanted in arms or legs. 1. The applicant will be given preference if they belong to volunteer of PARD, member of NSS, NCC, member/official of Yuvak or Mahila Mangal Dal.
benefits: Under this scheme, free training is provided to the youth of the state in various adventure-based activities such as White Water River Rafting Guide Training, Disaster Management and Disaster Rescue Operations, First Aid, Burma Bridge, Trekking, etc.
summary: The scheme aims to empower the youth of Uttarakhand by providing free adventure training programs that develop their skills and capabilities through various adventure activities.

title: Alpshankhyak Vikas Nidhi
eligibility_details: - The project must benefit notified religious/linguistic minority communities in Uttarakhand. - The project must address critical gaps in education, livelihoods, or social welfare. *Priority given to districts with high minority populations (e.g., Ghaziabad, Saharanpur).
benefits:
1. Financial Support for Community Development Fund Corpus: - Initial allocation of ₹4,00,00,000/- (revised periodically). - Annual replenishment based on project demand and state budget provisions. Project-Specific Grants: - Education: Up to ₹10,00,000/- per institution for infrastructure (e.g., classrooms, libraries). - Livelihoods: ₹5,00,000/- max for vocational training centers (e.g., sewing, computer courses). - Healthcare: ₹3,00,000/- for mobile clinics or health camps in minority-concentrated districts.
2. Targeted Group Coverage Eligible Communities: - Religious Minorities: Muslims, Sikhs, Christians, Buddhists, Jains (constituting ~15.4% of UP’s population per 2001 census). - Linguistic Minorities: Urdu, Bengali, and Punjabi speakers. Priority Districts: Ghaziabad, Saharanpur, and other regions with >25% minority population.
3. Empowerment Through Education Scholarships: Pre-Matric: ₹1,000/month for school students (grades 1–8). Post-Matric: ₹5,000/year for higher education (grades 9–12). Skill Development: Subsidized courses in partnership with ITIs and NSDC (e.g., ₹2,000 stipend per trainee).
4. Infrastructure and Welfare Initiatives Community Infrastructure: Grants for: - Construction of community halls (₹20,00,000/- max). - Renovation of religious institutions (₹5,00,000/-, excluding places of worship). Basic Amenities: Funding for water supply, sanitation, and electricity in minority-dominated slums.
5. Employment and Entrepreneurship Subsidized Loans: Interest subsidy of 5% for small businesses via partner banks (e.g., ₹2,00,000/- loan at 7% instead of 12%). Self-Help Groups (SHGs): Seed money of ₹50,000 per SHG for handicrafts, agro-based businesses.
6. Healthcare Access Mobile Health Units: Free check-ups and medicines in remote areas (₹5 ,00,000/unit annually). Awareness Camps: Subsidized camps for maternal health, TB, and diabetes (₹1,00,000/camp).
7. Transparency and Accountability Digital Tracking: Real-time project updates on UP Social Welfare Dashboard. Third-Party Audits: Mandatory CA-certified utilization reports for funds >₹5,00,000/-.
8. Special Provisions for Women Women-Centric Schemes: 50% reservation in scholarships/vocational training. ₹25,000 grants for home-based enterprises (e.g., embroidery, food processing).
9. Supplement to Central Schemes Gap Funding: Covers shortfalls in central schemes like MSDP (Multi-Sectoral Development Programme). Example: Additional ₹2,00,000/- for a school building if MSDP allocates ₹8,00,000/- against a ₹10,00,000/- estimate.
10. Long-Term Impact Social Inclusion: Bridges disparities in literacy (e.g., Urdu-speaking women’s literacy rate improved by 12% in pilot districts). Economic Upliftment: 1,200+ minority-owned startups supported since 2015.
summary: The scheme establishes a ₹4 crore fund to support marginalized minorities in Uttarakhand, targeting gaps in existing central/state welfare programs through district-level initiatives.

title: Appointment of Contract Sports Coaches
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a sportsperson or a coach from Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be between 21 and 70 years of age. 1.
