The applicant must possess the relevant educational and sports qualifications. 1. The sports coach is not required to be a domicile or permanent resident of Uttarakhand.
benefits: Every year, around 250 coaches benefit from these training camps and gain employment.
summary: The scheme facilitates the annual appointment of contract-based sports coaches to conduct various local training camps across Uttarakhand, thereby promoting employment opportunities and strengthening the state’s grassroots sports infrastructure.

title: Free Pre-Recruitment Training
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a son of an ex-serviceman. 1. The applicant's age should be more than 16 years and less than 21 years. 1. The applicant should have passed high school with 45% marks. *All expenses incurred on training (honorarium of trainers + food + accommodation) are borne by the Directorate of Sainik Welfare.* Note: 5 courses are conducted each year.
benefits: Under this scheme, 8 weeks of free pre-recruitment training for recruitment into the Military, Paramilitary, and Police Forces is provided to eligible beneficiaries.
summary: The scheme aims to provide 8 weeks of free pre-recruitment training for recruitment into the Military, Paramilitary, and Police Forces to sons of ex-servicemen aged between 16 and 21 years who have passed high school with at least 45% marks.

title: Free Training for Vehicle Drivers
eligibility_details: - The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. - The applicant must belong to a Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribe category.
benefits: Under this scheme, training will be provided to vehicle drivers to enhance their driving skills, which will help reduce road accidents and enable them to pursue better self-employment opportunities.
summary: The scheme aims to improve the driving skills and employability of Scheduled Caste (SC) and Scheduled Tribe (ST) candidates by providing free, high-quality driving training, thereby reducing road accidents and promoting self-employment opportunities.

title: Livelihood Opportunity Promotion Scheme (Disabled)
category: Banking,Financial Services and Insurance, Skills & Employment, Business & Entrepreneurship
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must possess a minimum of 40% disability. 1. The applicant’s annual family income must not exceed ₹2,00,000 in urban areas and ₹1,60,000/- in rural areas. 1. The applicant’s age must be between 18 and 50 years.
benefits: Term Loan Scheme: - Project Cost: ₹75,000/- - Grant: 20% or ₹10,000/-, whichever is less - Term Loan: ₹65,000/- at 6% annual interest rate Shop Construction Scheme: - Project Cost: ₹50,000/- - Grant: 20% or ₹10,000/-, whichever is less - Margin Money Loan: ₹40,000/- at 4% annual interest rate, repayable in 60 monthly installments Margin Money Loan Scheme for Bank Supported Loan: - Project Cost: Up to ₹2,00,000/- - Grant: 20%, maximum of ₹10,000/- - Margin Money: 25% of the project cost at 4% annual interest rate, repayable in 36 monthly installments
summary: The scheme aims to promote self-reliance among persons with disabilities through grants, term loans, and margin money assistance.

title: Livelihood Opportunity Promotion Scheme (Scheduled Caste)
category: Banking,Financial Services and Insurance, Business & Entrepreneurship, Skills & Employment
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must belong to the Scheduled Caste category. 1. The applicant’s age must be between 18 and 50 years. 1. The applicant’s annual income must not exceed ₹1,05,600/- for rural areas and ₹1,29,840/- for urban areas.
benefits: Financial Assistance: - Project Cost Limit: ₹50,000/- to ₹2,00,000/- - Bank Loan: 60% of the project cost - Margin Money: 30% of the project cost (payable with applicable interest over 60 monthly installments) - Grant: Maximum of ₹10,000/- Beneficiary Contribution: - No contribution for project cost up to ₹1,00,000/- - 10% contribution for project cost between ₹1,01,000/- and ₹2,00,000/-.
summary: The scheme aims to promote self-employment among Scheduled Castes. It provides financial aid, including loans, margin money, and grants, for livelihood projects.

title: Livelihood Opportunity Promotion Scheme (Scheduled Tribes)
category: Banking,Financial Services and Insurance, Business & Entrepreneurship, Skills & Employment
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must belong to the Scheduled Tribe (ST) category. 1. The applicant's age must be between 18 and 50 years. 1. The applicant’s annual family income should not exceed ₹2,50,000/-.
benefits: Financial Assistance: - Project Cost: Between ₹50,000/- and ₹2,00,000/-. - Bank Loan: 60% of the project cost - Margin Money: 30% of the project cost, repayable at 7% annual interest in 60 monthly installments - Grant: Up to ₹50,000/-. Beneficiary Contribution: - No contribution for project cost up to ₹1,00,000/- - 10% contribution for project cost between ₹1,01,000/- and ₹2,00,000/-
summary: The scheme aims to promote self-employment among Scheduled Tribe individuals through financial support, including loans, margin money, and grants.

title: Mukhyamantri Hunar Yojana
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a man or woman belonging to a minority community (Muslim, Sikh, Christian, Parsi, Buddhist, or Jain). 1. The age of the applicant should be between 18 and 45 years. 1. The applicant must have completed education either from a Government school or from a Madrasa. 1. For traditional training courses such as sewing, embroidery, plumbing, electronics, knitting, etc., the applicant must be at least Class 5 pass or literate. 1. For Information Technology courses (Computer Hardware, Software, Networking, Accounting, etc.), the applicant must have passed at least High School. 1. The annual family income should not exceed ₹3,50,000/- in rural areas and ₹4,50,000/- in urban areas.
benefits: Under this scheme, free training is provided along with an honorarium during the training period. The honorarium is paid as follows: - ₹2,000/- for 100 hours of training, - ₹2,500/- for 150 hours of training, - ₹4,000/- for 250 hours of training, - ₹4,500/- for 300 hours of training, The training is conducted through implementing agencies, and the honorarium is disbursed based on attendance. A minimum of 90% attendance is mandatory.
summary: The scheme aims to provide free training in trades such as sewing, embroidery, knitting, plumbing, electronics, and in Information Technology fields including computer hardware, software, networking, accounting, and more, to individuals belonging to minority communities.

title: Self-Employment Scheme for Scheduled Castes and Tribes
category: Business & Entrepreneurship, Skills & Employment, Banking,Financial Services and Insurance
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must belong to a Scheduled Castes and Tribes community. 1. The applicant must be living below the poverty line. 1. The applicant annual income must not exceed ₹15,975/- in rural areas and ₹21,206/- in urban areas. 1. The applicant must not be a defaulter of any bank or financial institution. 1. The applicant must not have availed any subsidy from any government scheme earlier. 1. The applicant must possess a commercial driving license.
benefits: Financial Assistance: - Loan Amount: Project loans from ₹20,000/- to ₹7,00,000/- through nationalized banks.- Subsidy: 50% of the project cost or up to ₹10,000/- as government subsidy.- Margin Money: 25% of project cost provided at 4% annual interest.
summary: The scheme aims to support scheduled castes and scheduled tribes families below the poverty line through concessional loans and subsidies for self-employment in various sectors.

title: Self-Employment Scheme for Unemployed Minority Communities
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must belong to a minority community (Muslim, Sikh, Christian, Parsi, Buddhist, or Jain). 1. The applicant’s age should be between 18 and 55 years. 1. The annual family income from all sources should not exceed ₹2,50,000/-, or the applicant should be a member of a BPL family.
benefits: - Under this scheme, a grant is provided for self-employment. On taking a loan of ₹1 lakh to ₹10 lakh, a grant of 25% of the loan amount is given, with a minimum grant of ₹25,000/- and a maximum of ₹2,50,000/-. - The benefit of the scheme is available only on taking a loan, in which 60% of the project cost is provided as a loan, 25% as grant/subsidy by the department, and 15% as contribution by the applicant. - Interest on the loan will be charged according to the current prevailing rates of the bank.
summary: The scheme aims to provide a grant of 25% of the loan amount (for loans ranging from ₹1 lakh to ₹10 lakh) to individuals belonging to minority communities, who are permanent residents of Uttarakhand, for the purpose of self-employment.

title: Shilpi Gram Scheme (Scheduled Caste / Scheduled Tribe)
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must belong to a Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribe community. 1. The applicant's annual income should not exceed ₹1,05,600 in rural areas and ₹1,29,840 in urban areas.
benefits: Free Skill Training: - Training is offered at three levels — awareness & orientation, basic training, and vocational training. Infrastructure Support: - Development of artisan villages with electricity, water, roads, and common facilities. Marketing Assistance: - Support for exhibitions, fairs, permanent haats, and promotion of Uttarakhand-branded craft products. Raw Material Support: - Establishment of raw material depots like Wool Bank, Wood Bank. Recognition & Awards: - Awards for outstanding artisans and participation in national/international fairs. Exposure Visits: - Exposure tours to other states with advanced handicrafts.
summary: The scheme aims to re-establish traditional artisan skills among SC/ST communities. It provides free training, infrastructure support, and marketing opportunities to artisans in selected artisan villages.

title: Skill Development and Economic Empowerment
eligibility_details: - The applicant should belong to the Persons with Disabilities category. - The applicant should be a visually challenged (Blindness/ Low-Vision) individual. - The applicant should be willing to undergo full-time vocational training or other training courses.
benefits: Free Vocational Training: - Provides training in various professional courses, including Computer Operator, Stenographer, Mushroom Producer, Radio Jockey, Data Entry Operator, Reflexology, and Gardener. Essential Skill Training: - Offers training in Braille orientation and mobility, computer typing, Hindi and English, and home management skills. > Modern Learning Tools: - Senior students receive smartphones and laptops to facilitate modern and convenient studies. Comprehensive Support for Trainees: - Free food and accommodation are provided. - Commuting allowance is given for participation in the program. - Uniforms are provided. - Library facilities are accessible. - Medical facilities are available. - Accessible teaching materials are supplied. - Assistive devices are provided.
summary: The scheme "Skill Development and Economic Empowerment" aims to provide vocational training and skill enhancement for visually challenged individuals. Through this scheme, free education, food, accommodation, and training in various job-oriented fields are provided to eligible candidates.

title: Sponsorship for Employment
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be an ex-serviceman (Army, Navy, or Air Force), their legal dependent, or a widow of an ex-serviceman (Veer Nari).
benefits: Under this scheme, employment opportunities are provided to ex-servicemen and their legal dependents by sponsoring them for contractual posts through outsourcing.
summary: The scheme aims to provide employment opportunities to ex-servicemen and their legal dependents by sponsoring them for contractual posts. Under this scheme, eligible candidates are sponsored for various departmental positions based on demand and their qualifications.

title: State Level Awards for Divyang Persons
category: Social welfare & Empowerment, Sports & Culture, Skills & Employment
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant should be a person with a disability. 1. The applicant should have verifiable records of achievements or work. 1. The applicant should be in any one of the following categories: - Differently-abled (Divyang) employee - Outstanding Sportsperson - Best Self-Employed Service Provider
benefits: Award Details: - An amount of ₹8000/- is given as a cash prize. - Medal and Certificate of Appreciation. Mode of Disbursement: - The amount disbursed through the cheque or bank draft at the award ceremony. Expected Time of Disbursement: - Awarded annually on December 3 (World Disability Day).
summary: Under this scheme, a cash prize of ₹8,000/-, along with a medal and a certificate of appreciation, is awarded to outstanding individuals in categories such as disabled employees, outstanding sportspersons, and best self-employed service providers.

title: Toolkit Assistance (UKBOCWWB)
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a construction worker registered with the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
benefits: Under this scheme, registered construction workers are provided with a toolkit worth up to ₹10,000/-.
summary: The scheme aims to provide registered construction workers with a toolkit, including hand gloves and other construction-related tools, worth up to ₹10,000/-.

title: Financial Assistance/Pension to Former Renowned Sportspersons
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant should be an ex-sportsperson. 1. The applicant must be above 50 years of age. 1. The applicant should not be currently employed. 1. The applicant’s monthly income from all private sources should not exceed ₹20,000/-. 1. The applicant should be a former medalist or participant in: - Olympic Games, World Cup/Championship - Asian Games, Commonwealth Games - Afro-Asian Games, SAF Games - Para-Olympic/Special Olympic (Mental/Physical Disabilities) - World Marathon (Disabled), International Veteran (Masters) Championships
benefits: Under this scheme, financially weak former renowned sportspersons of the state are provided a lifelong monthly pension, with a minimum of ₹4,000/- and a maximum of ₹10,000/-.
summary: The scheme aims to provide lifelong monthly financial assistance ranging from ₹4,000/- to ₹10,000/- in the form of a pension to former renowned sportspersons of Uttarakhand who are above 50 years of age and are financially weak.

title: Pension Scheme for Elderly, Destitute Artists, Litterateurs and Writers of Uttarakhand State
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be an elderly, destitute artist, litterateur, or writer from Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must have dedicated their life to the development of art, culture, and literature. 1. The applicant must have made significant and distinguished contributions in their field. 1. The applicant must be at least 60 years of age. 1. The applicant must be a native or permanent resident of Uttarakhand.
benefits: The department provides a monthly pension of ₹3,000/- to the beneficiaries under this scheme.
summary: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to elderly and impoverished artists, litterateurs and writers who have dedicated their lives to the development of art, culture, and literature and have made significant and distinguished contributions.

title: Personal Interest Subsidy Scheme
ministry: Uttrakhand Khadi Evam Village Industries Board
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be between 18 and 45 years of age. 1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant should be an educated unemployed youth who is no longer eligible for government service due to the age limit. Or, the applicant should be trained by an Industrial Training Institute (ITI) or a Polytechnic. 1. The applicant should be a woman interested in self-employment. 1. The applicant should have passed Vocational Education (10+2 level) with Village Industries as a subject. 1. The applicant should establish the project in a rural area.
benefits: 1. The project is financed up to a maximum cost of ₹5,00,000 through bank support. 1. The entrepreneur is required to bear 4% interest on the bank-financed amount. 1. The Government bears up to 10% of the differential interest amount over and above what the entrepreneur pays.
summary: The scheme aims to support rural entrepreneurs in setting up industries using local resources. Through this scheme, interest subsidy on bank-financed projects up to ₹5,00,000 is provided.

title: Mukhyamantri Aanchal Amrit Yojana
ministry: Department Of Woman Empowerment & Child Development
eligibility_details: 1. The beneficiary must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The beneficiary must be a child between 3 and 6 years of age.
benefits: Under this scheme, children between 3 to 6 years of age are provided fortified and flavored milk enriched with Vitamins A and D, four days a week.
summary: The scheme aims to improve the health of children between 3 to 6 years of age by providing them fortified and flavored milk containing Vitamins A and D, four days a week, at Anganwadi Centres.

title: Mukhyamantri Bal Poshan Yojana
ministry: Department Of Woman Empowerment & Child Development
eligibility_details: 1. The beneficiary must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. Children aged 3 to 6 years are eligible to receive nutritious food under this scheme.
benefits: Under the scheme, pre-school children (aged 3 to 6 years) are provided with eggs twice a week and banana chips twice a week.
summary: The scheme aims to improve the health of pre-school children (aged 3 to 6 years) by providing nutritious food, including eggs twice a week and banana chips twice a week, at Anganwadi Centres.

title: Mukhyamantri Mahalakshmi Kit Yojana
ministry: Department Of Woman Empowerment & Child Development
eligibility_details: 1. The beneficiary must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The beneficiary must be a pregnant woman registered with an Anganwadi Centre and eligible to receive a Mahalakshmi Kit after delivery. 1. The beneficiary must not be an income tax payer.
benefits: In the state, after the institutional delivery of a pregnant woman, the following benefits will be provided: - The woman will receive one Mahalakshmi kit for the birth of each of her first two girl children. - In the case of twins, the woman will be given one Mahalakshmi kit, and each child will receive a separate Mahalakshmi kit.
summary: The scheme aims to improve the health and well-being of both mothers and their newborn girl children by providing essential item kits after the institutional delivery of pregnant women registered at an Anganwadi Centre.

title: Mukhyamantri Mahila Poshan Yojana
ministry: Department Of Woman Empowerment & Child Development
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a pregnant or lactating woman.
benefits: Under the scheme, pregnant and lactating women are provided eggs two days a week and dates two days a week. Dates are given to those registered women who do not consume eggs.
summary: The scheme aims to improve the health of pregnant and lactating women by providing nutritional food such as eggs twice a week and dates twice a week at Anganwadi Centres.

title: Rural Sports and Health Promotion Scheme
ministry: Department of Youth Welfare and Provincial Protection Corps
eligibility_details: 1. All Gram Panchayats in Uttarakhand are eligible.
benefits: Under this scheme, an amount of ₹17,960/- is allocated to Mangal Dals for setting up community fitness equipment (open gym) in each Gram Panchayat to promote the health and fitness of the youth.
summary: The scheme promotes fitness among rural youth by providing financial assistance to the mangal dals for setting up open gyms in each Gram Panchayat. Financial assistance of ₹17,960/- is allocated per gram panchayat for installing open gym/community fitness equipment to encourage fitness & well-being.

title: Sanitary Napkin Scheme
ministry: Department Of Woman Empowerment & Child Development
eligibility_details: All adolescent girls and women are eligible to purchase sanitary napkins at subsidized rates from Anganwadi centres.
benefits: - Sanitary napkins are distributed to adolescent girls/women at a cost of ₹6/-.
summary: The scheme aims to provide sanitary napkins to adolescent girls and women at subsidized rates through Anganwadi centres across the state. Under this scheme, sanitary napkins are made available to adolescent girls and women at a cost of ₹6.00 through Anganwadi centres.

title: Sanitary Napkin Scheme (UKBOCWWB)
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a registered construction worker with the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board. 1. The benefits of the scheme will be provided to the daughters of registered construction workers and to women construction workers registered with the Board.
benefits: 1. Under the scheme, free sanitary napkins will be provided to the daughters of registered construction workers and to women construction workers.
summary: The scheme aims to provide free sanitary napkins to the daughters of registered construction workers and to women construction workers, in order to promote health and hygiene.

title: Scholarship for Engineering and Medical Education
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a dependent of an ex-serviceman. 1. The applicant should be pursuing a course in Engineering, Medical, or Ph.D. from a recognized institution. Note: It is mandatory that the applicant's correct name is mentioned both in the bank account and the discharge book.
benefits: Rate of Scholarship: - ₹12,000/- per year for Engineering students - ₹15,000/- per year for Medical students - ₹10,000/- per year for PhD students
summary: The scheme aims to support the higher education of dependents of ex-servicemen by providing financial assistance for pursuing engineering, medical, and PhD courses. Under this scheme, annual scholarships are awarded to beneficiaries based on their course of study.

title: Atal Awas Yojana - Uttarakhand
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a native of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant should belong to a Scheduled Caste family. 1. The applicant should belong to the Below Poverty Line (BPL) category or have an annual income not exceeding ₹48,000/-. 1. The applicant should not have their own house. 1. The applicant should have their own land for constructing a house.
benefits: Financial Assistance - ₹1,30,000/- for hilly areas - ₹1,20,000/- for plain areas Note: The amount is disbursed in 3 installments to construct a house.
summary: Under this scheme, financial assistance of ₹1,30,000/- is provided for constructing houses in hilly areas and ₹1,20,000/- for plain areas to homeless Scheduled Caste families who are below the poverty line (BPL) or fall within a defined income limit.

title: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grah Aawas (Home-Stay) Vikas Yojana
eligibility_details: 1. This benefit is provided as a subsidy for the construction of homestays across the state of Uttarakhand, excluding areas under Municipal Corporations and Municipalities. 1. The applicant must be a native of Uttarakhand. 1. The building owner, who resides in the building with their family, may construct a minimum of one and a maximum of six guest rooms. 1. Upon construction of a new homestay or renovation of an existing one, the property must be registered with the Uttarakhand Tourism Development Council. 1. Preference will be given to buildings constructed or developed in the traditional hill-style architecture.
benefits: - There is a provision for financial assistance to permanent residents/native of the state who take a loan for the construction of homestays. - In hilly areas, a subsidy of up to 50% of the project cost, subject to a maximum of ₹15.00 lakh, is provided along with an interest grant of up to ₹1.50 lakh for the first five years. - In plain areas, a subsidy of up to 25% of the project cost, subject to a maximum of ₹7.50 lakh, is provided along with an interest grant of ₹1.00 lakh for the first five years. The beneficiary’s contribution at the time of availing the loan must be 12.5%. - The subsidy is applicable only when the loan is taken. - In addition to the construction of new houses, funds/subsidy are also provided for the upgradation of old buildings, including their extension, renovation, improvement, and construction of toilets, as mentioned above.
summary: The scheme aims to promote rural and eco-tourism by encouraging local residents to develop homestay facilities, thereby generating employment and income opportunities within the state.

title: Financial Assistance for Purchase or Construction of House (UKBOCWWB)
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a construction worker registered with the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board. 1. To avail an advance loan for the purchase or construction of a house, the worker must have been a member of the fund for at least five years and should have a minimum of 15 years remaining until superannuation/retirement age.
benefits: 1. Under the scheme, registered construction workers are eligible to receive an advance loan amount of up to ₹50,000/- for the purchase or construction of a house, subject to the conditions specified by the Board. 1. Interest of at least 5% per annum is applicable on this loan.
summary: The scheme provides loans of up to ₹50,000/- to construction workers registered with the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (UKBOCWWB) for the purchase or construction of a house, at a minimum interest rate of 5% per annum.

title: Anganwadi Workers Welfare Fund
ministry: Department Of Woman Empowerment & Child Development
category: Women and Child, Banking,Financial Services and Insurance
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be an Anganwadi woman worker/mini worker/assistant working on an honorarium basis. 1. The applicant must have completed 60 years of age.
benefits: - A minimum amount of ₹30,000/- will be provided. - Upon completing 20 years of service, ₹1,30,000/- will be provided. Note: There is a provision for a 5% annual increase on the deposited amount.
summary: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to Anganwadi workers, mini workers, and assistants of the state upon attaining the superannuation age of 60 years. A minimum amount of ₹30,000/- is granted, while those completing 20 years of service receive ₹1,30,000/-.

title: Bicycle/Sewing Machine Assistance Scheme (UKBOCWWB)
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a construction worker registered with the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, or a dependent of such a worker.
benefits: Bicycles are provided to construction workers in the plain areas, while sewing machines are provided to construction workers or their dependents in the hilly areas.
summary: Under the scheme, bicycles are provided to registered building & construction workers in plain areas, while sewing machines are provided to registered workers or their dependents in mountainous/hilly areas. These benefits are granted only once in a lifetime.

title: Braille Equipment Provision
eligibility_details: - A person with visual impairment/ a Special School/ Organisation serving visually impaired persons shall be eligible under this scheme.
benefits: - Subsidized Access of Braille Appliances: Makes Braille equipment affordable by providing it at subsidized rates to visually impaired persons, special schools, and institutions.
summary: The "Braille Equipment Provision" scheme aims to empower persons with visual disabilities to live independently by supporting their writing, computing, mobility, and entertainment needs. Through this scheme, Braille equipment is manufactured and made available to individuals and institutions.

title: Coaching Scheme for Divyang Students
eligibility_details: - The applicant must be a student with a benchmark disability (40% or more) as defined. - The applicant must hold a valid disability certificate issued by a competent authority. - The applicant must possess a Unique Disability ID (UDID). - The applicant must have an Aadhaar number or Aadhaar enrollment number. - The total annual family income of the applicant should not exceed ₹8,00,000/-.
benefits: Financial Allowances: - Coaching fees. - Transport or hostel allowance. - Disability allowance. - Book allowance.
summary: The scheme "Coaching Scheme for Divyang Students" by the National Institute for the Empowerment of Persons with Visual Disabilities (NIEPVD), Dehradun, aims to support students with disabilities in preparing for competitive government examinations.

title: Construction of Sports Infrastructure Facilities (Badminton, Table Tennis, Squash, Indoor Cricket, Basketball, Volleyball, Football, Hockey, and Swimming) in Private Sector
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand.
benefits: Under this scheme, 25% of the total cost of the infrastructure, or up to a maximum of ₹50.00 lakh, is provided as a grant.
summary: The scheme aims to provide grants of 25% of the total cost, up to a maximum of ₹50.00 lakh, for the construction of sports infrastructure facilities in the private sector, including Badminton, Table Tennis, Squash, Indoor Cricket, Basketball, Volleyball, Football, Hockey, and Swimming.

title: Deployment of Prantiya Rakshak Dal (PRD) Volunteers (For volunteer)
ministry: Department of Youth Welfare and Provincial Protection Corps
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a youth (male or female) aged between 18 and 42 years. 1. The applicant must be a Prantiya Rakshak Dal (PRD) volunteer.
benefits: Under this scheme, PRD volunteers are paid a daily honorarium of ₹570/- for providing police assistance and performing duties in various offices.
summary: The scheme aims to provide financial security to PRD volunteers aged 18 to 42 years by paying a daily honorarium for their assistance in police duties and deployment in various offices.

title: Deserted Women Pension Scheme
category: Women and Child, Social welfare & Empowerment
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant’s family monthly income must not exceed ₹4,000/- or the applicant must belong to the Below Poverty Line (BPL) category. 1. The applicant should fall into one of the following categories: - An abandoned/deserted married woman, or - A mentally ill deserted husband or wife, or - A destitute unmarried woman aged above 40 years. *For abandoned/deserted married women:* - Marriage duration must be more than 1 year. - Husband must have been missing/absent for more than 1 year or must have deserted her. - A self-declaration regarding desertion must be certified by the Gram Pradhan/Ward Member. *For mentally ill deserted husbands/wives:* - Must submit a disability certificate from a government hospital certifying the inability to earn a livelihood due to mental disability. *For destitute unmarried women:* - Must be above 40 years of age. - Pension will be discontinued if the woman gets married.
benefits: - Pension Amount: ₹1,200/- per month.- For Mentally Disabled ill Husband/Wife: ₹1,400/- per month.
summary: The scheme aims to provide a monthly pension to Abandoned married women, mentally ill husband/wife & destitute unmarried women in the state. Under this scheme, beneficiaries receive a pension of ₹1,200/- per month, & in case of mental disability (spouse), the amount is ₹1,400/- per month.

title: Destitute Widow Pension Scheme - Uttarakhand
category: Social welfare & Empowerment, Women and Child
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a widow. 1. The widow must be at least 18 years of age. 1. The widow’s family monthly income should not exceed ₹4,000/-, or she must possess a valid BPL (Below Poverty Line) certificate. 1. The widow must not be receiving any other pension benefits.
benefits: A pension of ₹1,500/- per month is provided to eligible beneficiaries.
summary: Under this scheme, a monthly pension of ₹1,500/- is provided to widows whose family income does not exceed ₹4,000/- per month or who belong to the BPL category, and who are not receiving any other pension benefits.

title: Disability Pension (UKBOCWWB)
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a construction worker registered with the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board who has become permanently disabled due to paralysis, leprosy, tuberculosis, accident, etc.
benefits: - Pension Amount: ₹1,000/- per month - One-time Ex-gratia Amount: ₹40,000/-
summary: The scheme aims to provide a monthly pension of ₹1,000 to construction workers registered with Uttarakhand Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board who have become permanently disabled due to paralysis, leprosy, accidents, etc. In addition, an ex-gratia amount of ₹40,000 is also provided.

title: Divyang Pension Scheme - Uttarakhand
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be above18 years of age. 1. The applicant must have a disability of more than 40%. 1. The applicant must have a monthly income of up to ₹4,000/- or belong to the Below Poverty Line (BPL) category. 1. The applicant must not be availing any other pension benefits.
benefits: A pension of ₹1,500/- per month is provided to eligible beneficiaries.
summary: The scheme aims to support persons with disabilities in meeting their basic needs and improving their quality of life. Under this scheme, a monthly pension of ₹1,500/- is provided to persons with disabilities who are above18 years of age & have a disability of more than 40%.

title: Dwarf Pension Scheme
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be above 21 years of age. 1. The applicant’s height must be less than 4 feet. 1. There is no income limit for eligibility under the scheme.
benefits: A pension of ₹1,200/- per month is provided to eligible beneficiaries.
summary: The scheme aims to provide financial support to individuals suffering from dwarfism to help them meet their basic needs and improve their quality of life. Under this scheme, a monthly pension of ₹1200/- is provided to persons above 21 years of age whose height is less than 4 feet.

title: Family Pension Scheme (UKBOCWWB)
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be the spouse (husband/wife) of the deceased construction worker. 1. The deceased construction worker must have been registered with the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board. 1. The deceased construction worker must have been receiving a pension from the Board at the time of death.
benefits: - Pension Amount: ₹500/- per month or 50% of the pensioner's pension, whichever is higher.
summary: The scheme provides financial assistance to the spouse of a registered construction worker in the event of the worker’s death, if the deceased was a pensioner. Under this scheme, the family pension will be ₹500/- per month or 50% of the pensioner's pension, whichever is higher.

title: Financial Assistance After Death (UKBOCWWB)
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a dependent of the deceased construction worker. 1. The dependent’s name must be mentioned in the labour card as a dependent. 1. The deceased construction worker must have been registered with the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
benefits: - ₹2,00,000/- will be provided in the event of the natural death. - ₹4,00,000/- will be provided in the event of the accidental death.
summary: The scheme provides financial assistance of ₹2 lakh in case of natural death and ₹4 lakh in case of accidental death to the dependents of registered construction workers.

title: Financial Assistance for Construction of Toilet (UKBOCWWB)
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a construction worker registered with the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
benefits: Under the scheme, registered construction workers receive financial assistance of ₹12,000/- in two installments for the construction of toilets. - First Installment: ₹8,000/- - Second Installment: ₹4,000/-
summary: The scheme provides financial assistance of up to ₹12,000/- to registered construction workers for building toilets. The assistance is disbursed in two installments: the first installment of ₹8,000/- and the second installment of ₹4,000/-.

title: Financial Assistance for Daughter's Marriage (UKBOCWWB)
category: Women and Child, Social welfare & Empowerment
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a construction worker registered with the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board. 1. Financial assistance is available for the worker’s own marriage and for the marriage of up to two daughters.
benefits: - An amount of ₹51,000/- for each marriage is provided. Note: Assistance is provided for the marriage of up to two daughters of the registered worker as well as for the worker’s own marriage.
summary: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance of ₹51,000/- per marriage for the marriage of registered construction workers themselves or for the marriage of up to two daughters.

title: Free Travel in Uttarakhand Transport Corporation Buses to Widowed Daughters-in-Law of Freedom Fighters
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a widowed daughter-in-law of a freedom fighter from Uttarakhand. 1. The beneficiary must possess a valid identity card for the journey.
benefits: Under this scheme, widowed daughters-in-law of freedom fighters are entitled to free travel in Uttarakhand Transport Corporation (UTC) buses across the state.
summary: The scheme aims to provide free travel facilities in Uttarakhand Transport Corporation (UTC) buses to the widowed daughters-in-law of freedom fighters. Beneficiaries under this scheme are entitled to avail complimentary travel across all UTC bus services within the state.

title: Grant for Marriage of Daughters of Scheduled Caste Individuals
category: Social welfare & Empowerment, Women and Child
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand. 2. The applicant must belong to the Scheduled Caste category. 3. The family’s total monthly income from all sources must not exceed ₹4,000/-, or the family must belong to the BPL category. 4. At the time of marriage, the bride’s age must be between 18 and 45 years. 5. At the time of marriage, the groom’s age must be between 21 and 45 years. 6. The grant is applicable for the marriage of up to two daughters.
benefits: Grant Amount: ₹50,000/- per daughter, for the marriage of up to two daughters.
summary: The scheme aims to provide a grant of ₹50,000/- per daughter to Scheduled Caste families, for a maximum of two daughters, whose total monthly family income from all sources does not exceed ₹4,000/- or who belong to a BPL family, to help cover marriage expenses.

title: Grant for Purchase and Repair of Various Assistive Devices/Equipment for Persons with Disabilities
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant should be a person with a disability. 1. The applicant should have a minimum disability of 40%. 1. In the case of a minor beneficiary, the monthly income of parents/guardians should not exceed ₹4,000/-. 1. The applicant should have a medical recommendation from a Government Medical Officer or specialist recommending the device or its repair.
benefits: Grant Amount: - ₹50/- to ₹3,500/- for the purchase of assistive devices (maximum ₹7,000/- in special cases). - ₹500/- for repair of artificial limbs and assistive equipment.
summary: Under this scheme, a grant of up to ₹3,500/- is provided for the purchase of individual aids, which may be increased to a maximum of ₹7,000/- in special cases. Additionally, ₹500/- is provided for the repair of prosthetic limbs and other assistive equipment.

title: Grant for the Marriage of Daughter of Destitute Widow
category: Social welfare & Empowerment, Women and Child
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a destitute widow. 1. The widow must be receiving widow pension. 1. The family’s total monthly income from all sources must not exceed ₹4,000/-, or the family must belong to the BPL category. 1. At the time of marriage, the bride’s age must be between 18 and 45 years. 1. At the time of marriage, the groom’s age must be between 21 and 45 years. 1. The grant is applicable for the marriage of up to two daughters. Note: The Social Welfare Department verifies whether the widow is receiving widow pension or not.
benefits: Grant Amount: ₹50,000/- per daughter, for the marriage of up to two daughters.
summary: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance of ₹50,000/- per daughter for the marriage of up to two daughters of destitute widows who are receiving widow pension and whose total monthly income from all sources does not exceed ₹4,000/-, or who belong to BPL families.

title: Housing Assistance Grant
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 2. The applicant must be either: - A widow or dependent of a soldier martyred in a war or border clash, or - A war-disabled retired soldier. 3. The grant is provided only once in a lifetime for the purpose of building construction or repair.
benefits: - A one-time grant of ₹2,00,000/- for the construction/ repair of the house.
summary: The scheme provides financial support to widows/dependents of soldiers martyred in wars and border clashes, as well as to war-disabled retired soldiers. Under this scheme, eligible beneficiaries receive a one-time grant of ₹2 lakhs for the construction or repair of a house during their lifetime.

title: Incentive Scheme for Marrying a Disabled Young Man/Woman
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant couple should be residents of Uttarakhand or have been domiciled in the state for at least five years. 1. The couple must be citizens of India. 1. The couple should not be income tax payers. 1. Neither partner should have a living spouse at the time of marriage. 1. No member of the couple should have been convicted in any criminal case. 1. The benefit is provided when a person with 40% or more disability marries a non-disabled person, or when both partners have disabilities. 1. At the time of marriage, the groom should be between 21 and 45 years of age. 1. At the time of marriage, the bride should be between 18 and 45 years of age. 1. The marriage should be conducted in accordance with prevailing social customs and traditions or be legally registered.
benefits: On marriage, the couple is given ₹25,000/- as incentive.
summary: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance of ₹25,000/- to couples on marriage, where at least one partner has 40% or more disability and marries a non-disabled person, or where both partners have disabilities.

title: Indira Amma Bhojanalya
category: Social welfare & Empowerment, Women and Child
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a women Self-Help Group (SHG) formed according to the guiding principles of the National Rural Livelihoods Mission (NRLM). 1. Self-Help Groups (SHGs) formed as per NRLM guidelines that are actively functioning and have received the minimum Revolving Fund (RF) — either under the restructured SGSY scheme or directly under NRLM, if not previously covered under SGSY — shall be eligible to operate the canteen. 1. In urban areas, self-help groups (SHGs) under the National Urban Livelihoods Mission (NULM) are also eligible to operate Indira Amma Canteens. The Rural Development Department provides grants to support these groups in running the canteens. *Notes:* - It is essential for self-help groups to maintain complete records of beneficiaries, including their names and places of residence, to ensure transparency and prevent any irregularities in receiving contributions provided by the state government. - SHGs formed under NRLM guidelines and having received the Community Investment Fund (CIF) or a Micro Credit Plan specifically for operating an Indira Amma Canteen will be given preference. - The tenure of operation of State Government funded/aided canteens operating in Municipal Corporation areas shall be maximum of 01 year and thereafter they will be eligible to operate the canteen again only after a period of 02 years. - Except Municipal Corporation areas, the tenure of operation of canteens funded/aided by the State Government in other institutions/offices/bodies etc. will be maximum 02 years. Thereafter, they will be eligible to operate the canteen again only after a period of 04 years.
benefits: 1. Nutritious and affordable food at subsidized rates. 2. Subsidized Rates: - The consumer pays ₹25/- per plate in hilly areas. - The consumer pays ₹20/- per plate in Dehradun, Haridwar, Udham Singh Nagar, and Nainital districts. - A subsidy of ₹10/- per plate is borne by the State Government. 3. The Urban Development Authority, Municipal Corporation, or Municipality provides free space, furniture, and other essential resources required for the operation of the canteen. 4. Uttarakhand Power Corporation and Uttarakhand Jal Sansthan provide electricity and water, respectively, free of cost. 5. The arrangement of fuel/LPG gas for running the canteen is made through the District Supply Officer. 6. Provides continuous income-generating employment, leading to economic strengthening for women's Self-Help Groups (SHGs). Conditions: 1. Maximum 1,200 plates of food are to be provided per day in high-population districts like Dehradun, Haridwar, and Udham Singh Nagar. 1. A maximum of 800 plates of food are to be provided per day in other districts. 1. Canteens opened solely for employees within office premises are not eligible for subsidy. 1. The State Government reserves the right to determine future subsidies based on the canteen's annual income or profit. 1. Canteens aiming to become self-sustainable will continue to receive facilitator support from the State Government.
summary: The primary objective of the scheme is to provide nutritious and affordable food to the poor and needy sections of society and to economically strengthen rural women's self-help groups (SHGs) by providing continuous income-generating employment through the operation of these canteens.

title: Maintenance Grant for Children with Disabilities from Birth
eligibility_details: - The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. - The applicant must be the parent or guardian of a child with more than 40% disability. - The child must be below 18 years of age. - The family’s monthly income must be less than ₹4,000/- or the family must belong to the Below Poverty Line (BPL) category.
benefits: ₹700/- per month is provided to parents or guardians for caring for their children.
summary: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance of ₹700/- per month to parents or guardians for the care of children below 18 years of age with more than 40% disability.

title: Maternity Financial Assistance (UKBOCWWB)
category: Social welfare & Empowerment, Women and Child
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a woman construction worker registered with the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board. 1. Financial assistance is admissible only for the birth of up to two children.
benefits: ₹6,000/- per child (limited to a maximum of two children).
summary: The scheme aims to provide financial support to registered women construction workers during the maternity period. This assistance is admissible only for the birth of up to two children.

title: Monthly/Family Pension for Freedom Fighters and their Widows of Uttarakhand State
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be either a Freedom Fighter or the widow of a Freedom Fighter.
benefits: Monthly/Family Pension Amount: ₹25,000/-
summary: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance in the form of a monthly pension of ₹25,000/- to the freedom fighters of Uttarakhand and to the widows of deceased freedom fighters, in recognition of their contribution to the nation.

title: Mukhyamantri Nishulk Gas Refill Yojana
eligibility_details: - The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. - The applicant must hold an Antyodaya (pink card) ration card issued by the state.
benefits: Under this scheme, Antyodaya ration card (pink card) holders in the state are entitled to receive 03 free gas cylinder refills every year.
summary: The scheme aims to support poor families by reducing their household fuel expenses. Under this scheme, Antyodaya (pink card) ration card holders in the state are entitled to receive three free gas cylinder refills every year.

title: Nandaa Gaura Yojana
ministry: Department Of Woman Empowerment & Child Development
category: Social welfare & Empowerment, Women and Child
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant family must be permanent residents of Uttarakhand. 2. The family’s monthly income should not exceed ₹6,000/-, or the family should belong to the BPL category to be eligible. 3. The benefit is applicable for up to two girls per family. 4. It is mandatory for the mother/father/guardian to submit an affidavit regarding availing or not availing the benefit of the scheme for other girl children in the family in the past. The affidavit must include the following declarations: - All information regarding movable and immovable properties and other details sought by me have been provided correctly. - I certify that this benefit is being availed for my first/second daughter. - No facts have been concealed by me. - I have provided the details of all family bank accounts along with bank statements for the last one year. - In the case of applying after passing Class 12, I confirm that my daughter is unmarried. 5. Girls living in Nari Niketan, Balika Niketan, orphanages, or other state government-aided homes will be exempted from the requirement of birth certificate, permanent residence certificate, income certificate, or parent’s name to avail the benefit after passing Class 12.
benefits: Under this scheme, financial assistance is provided to two girls of an eligible family in two installments for each girl child: - ₹11,000/- at the time of birth. - ₹51,000/- when the girl passes Class 12. For the first installment, the application must be submitted within six months of the girl’s birth, and the child must be born in a hospital/ANM center. For the second installment, the application can be submitted when the girl passes Class 12. Applications are invited from July to November of the same year in which she passes. If applied in the next year, the application will not be considered valid. The second installment will be granted only if the girl has passed Class 12 from the Uttarakhand Board, Secondary Education Board of other states, CBSE, ICSE, or the National Institute of Open Schooling, New Delhi, and the girl must be unmarried.
summary: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance for upto 2 girls in a family. Assistance is given in 2 installments per girl child: 1st installment of ₹11,000 is provided at the time of birth if girl is born in a hospital/ANM center & 2nd installment of ₹51,000 is given when girl passes Class 12th.

title: Old Age Pension Scheme - On Completion of 60 Years (UKBOCWWB)
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a construction worker registered with the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board. 1. The applicant must have completed 60 years of age.
benefits: - Pension Amount: ₹1,000/- per month
summary: The scheme aims to provide a monthly pension of ₹1,000/- to construction workers registered with the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board who have attained the age of 60 years.

title: Old Age Pension Scheme - Uttarakhand
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be 60 years of age or above. 1. The applicant’s family monthly income must not exceed ₹4,000/- or the applicant must belong to the BPL category. 1. The applicant must not be receiving any other pension.
benefits: A pension of ₹1,500/- per month is provided to eligible beneficiaries.
summary: Under this scheme, a monthly pension of ₹1,500/- is provided to senior citizens (both husband and wife) in the state who are 60 years of age or above and whose family’s monthly income is up to ₹4,000/- or who belong to the BPL category.

title: Old Age Pension Scheme- On Completion Of 65 Years (UKBOCWWB)
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a registered construction worker with the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board. 1. The applicant must have attained the age of 65 years.
benefits: - Pension Amount: ₹1,500/- Per Month
summary: The scheme aims to provide a monthly pension of ₹1,500/- to construction workers registered with the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board who have attained the age of 65 years.

title: One-time and Annual Financial Grant to Soldiers Awarded with Gallantry Medals
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant should be a serving soldier, an ex-serviceman, or in the event of martyrdom/death of the soldier, an eligible dependent. 1. The soldier must have been conferred with a “Gallantry Medal Award.” 1. In case of martyrdom or death of the soldier, the following dependents are eligible to apply: - Veer Nari (lifelong or until remarriage) - Son (up to 25 years of age) / Daughter (till marriage) - Parents - Unmarried sisters - Brother (up to 25 years of age)
benefits: - A one time grant of maximum of ₹50,00,000/- and minimum ₹4,00,000/- is given. - Annual financial assistance of a maximum of ₹3,00,000/- and a minimum of ₹40,000/- is given.
summary: Under this scheme, a one-time financial assistance/annuity is provided to serving or ex-servicemen who have been conferred with the “Gallantry Medal Award.” In the event of martyrdom or death of the soldier, the grant is extended to the eligible family members or dependents.

title: One-Time Grant Money to Soldiers Conferred with Vishisht Seva Medal Award
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a serving soldier or an ex-serviceman of the state who has been conferred with the 'Vishisht Seva Medal Award'.
benefits: - A one-time grant ranging from a minimum of ₹75,000/- to a maximum of ₹2,00,000/- is given to serving soldiers and ex-servicemen of the state.
summary: Under this scheme, a one-time financial assistance/grant ranging from a minimum of ₹75,000/- to a maximum of ₹2,00,000/- is provided to serving soldiers and ex-servicemen of the state who have been conferred with the ‘Vishisht Seva Medal Award’.

title: Payment of Ex-Gratia Amount on Death of the UPNL Employee During Service
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a legal dependent of the deceased UPNL employee. 1. The deceased employee must have been a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must have been nominated during the service period of the deceased employee to receive the ex-gratia amount.
benefits: A one-time ex-gratia payment of ₹1,00,000/- shall be made from the UPNL fund to the family/legal dependents of a UPNL employee in the event of the employee’s death during the service period.
summary: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance of ₹1,00,000/- to the legal dependents of deceased UPNL employees in the event of the employee’s death during their service period.

title: Pension for Agitators Who were Jailed for 7 Days or Injured During the Uttarakhand State Movement
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be an agitator who was jailed for 7 days or injured during the Uttarakhand State Movement. 1. The applicant must be unable to gain employment due to certain reasons.
benefits: Pension Amount: ₹6,000/- per month
summary: The scheme provides a monthly pension of ₹6,000 to agitators who were jailed for 7 days or injured during the Uttarakhand State Movement and are unable to gain employment due to certain reasons.

title: Pension Scheme for State Agitators Other Than Category of Agitators Who Went to Jail for 7 Days or got Injured during the Uttarakhand State Movement
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be an identified state agitator, excluding those who were jailed for seven days or injured during the Uttarakhand state movement. 1. The applicant must not be entitled to an agitational pension or any other pension from a government source. 1. The applicant must not be employed in any government service.
benefits: Pension Amount: ₹4,500/- per month
summary: The scheme provides a monthly pension of ₹4,500/- to state agitators not imprisoned for 7 days or injured during the Uttarakhand State Movement, who are not eligible for any other government pension and are not employed in government service.

title: Pension Scheme to the Dependents (Husband/Wife) of Identified State Agitators, Other than those Who either went to Jail for 7 Days or were Injured During the Uttarakhand State Movement, after the Death of the Agitator
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be the dependent (husband/wife) of a deceased identified state agitator. 1. The deceased agitator must not fall under the category of those who went to jail for 7 days or were injured during the Uttarakhand State Movement. 1. The deceased agitator must not have been receiving agitator pension or any other pension from a government source, nor employed in government service.
benefits: Pension Amount: ₹4,500/- per month
summary: The scheme provides a monthly pension of ₹4,500/- to the dependents (husband/wife) of identified state agitators, excluding those jailed for 7 days or injured during the Uttarakhand movement, who were not receiving any government pension or in government service.

title: Samman Pension Yojana for All First-Generation Living Legal Heirs of Freedom Fighters of Uttarakhand State
eligibility_details: - The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand. - The applicant must be a first-generation living legal heir of a freedom fighter.
benefits: Samman Pension Amount: ₹4,800/- per month
summary: The scheme provides financial assistance of ₹4,800/- per month as pension to all first-generation living legal heirs of freedom fighters residing in the state of Uttarakhand.

title: Samuhik Kanya Vivah Sahayata Yojana (UKBOCWWB)
category: Social welfare & Empowerment, Women and Child
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a registered construction worker. 1. In the case of a mass marriage, registration must be completed at least 15 days prior to the scheduled date of the marriage.
benefits: - ₹61,000/- will be provided as financial assistance to registered construction workers for the marriage of their daughters. - ₹10,000/- per couple will be paid to the organizer to cover expenses incurred in organizing the mass marriage. - ₹5,000/- will be provided to each bride and groom for purchasing their wedding attire.
summary: The scheme aims to support the marriage of daughters of registered construction workers by providing financial assistance of ₹61,000/- for their daughter’s marriage in a group marriage event.

title: Solar Energy Assistance Scheme (UKBOCWWB)
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a registered construction worker with the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
benefits: Under this scheme, solar energy plates/panels will be provided, and for maintenance and service charges, beneficiaries will have to contact the concerned supplier.
summary: The scheme aims to provide solar energy plates/panels to the families of construction workers registered with the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.

title: State Food Scheme (Yellow Ration Card)
eligibility_details: - The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. - The annual family income of the applicant should be ₹5 lakh or less.
benefits: Under this scheme, each ration card holder receives 7.50 kg of rice per month at the rate of ₹11/- per kg.
summary: The scheme aims to provide rice at subsidized rates to yellow ration card holders in the state, under which 7.50 kg of rice is distributed to each card holder every month at the rate of ₹11.00 per kg.

title: State Government-Run Old Age and Infirm Homes
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant should be a male or female. 1. The applicant's age must be 60 years or above. 1. There is no income ceiling for eligibility. 1. The applicant must not have a communicable disease (certified by a government doctor).
benefits: The following facilities are provided to elderly individuals in government-run Old Age and Infirm Homes: - Free accommodation - Free nutritious meals - Free clothing - Free medical care, etc.
summary: Under this scheme, free residential, food, clothing, and healthcare are provided to destitute elderly individuals above 60 years in state-run residential facilities.

title: Umbrella Assistance Scheme (UKBOCWWB)
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a construction worker registered with the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
benefits: Under the scheme, an umbrella will be provided to registered construction workers to protect them from rain and sunlight.
summary: The scheme aims to provide free umbrellas to construction workers registered with the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, to protect them from rain and sunlight.

title: Uttarakhand Shaheed Kosh Anudan
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant should be a widow or dependent of a soldier or paramilitary force personnel martyred in a war, border conflict, or internal security operation. Distribution Criteria: (a) In case the martyr was married: - Widow (Veer Nari) – 60% of the grant amount - Parents – 40% of the grant amount (b) If the parents are not alive, then the full prescribed amount shall be given to the widow (Veer Nari) and where the widow (Veer Nari) is not alive then 40% of the prescribed amount shall be given to the parents and 60% shall be distributed equally among all the dependent children. (c) In a situation where the parents and the widow (Veer Nari) are not alive, the prescribed amount shall be divided equally among all the dependent children. (d) In a situation where the widow (Veer Nari) is not alive and has no children, the entire prescribed amount will be given to the parents.(e) In a situation where the martyr is unmarried or widower, the prescribed amount will be given to the parents.
benefits: - One-Time Grant: ₹10,00,000/- per martyr
summary: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to widows/dependents of soldiers & paramilitary personnel who were martyred in wars, border clashes, or internal security operations. Under this scheme, a one-time grant of ₹10 lakh is provided, subject to eligibility criteria.

title: Yuvak Mangal Dal and Mahila Mangal Dal Swavalamban Yojana
ministry: Department of Youth Welfare and Provincial Protection Corps
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant must be a recognized Yuvak Mangal Dal or Mahila Mangal Dal in Uttarakhand, formally affiliated with the Department of Youth Welfare and PRD, Government of Uttarakhand.
benefits: Under this scheme, financial assistance of ₹14,268/- is provided to purchase essential materials for community use, aimed at making the Mangal Dals self-reliant.
summary: The scheme aims to promote self-reliance among village-level male and female youth groups (Mangal Dals) by providing financial support for the purchase of essential materials, enabling them to become self-reliant and undertake community-based activities.

title: Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme for Rural Entrepreneurs to set up Custom Hiring Centres (CHC) of Farm Machinery
eligibility_details: - Individual farmers registered under Krishak Bandhu (New) Scheme. Or, Groups like SKUS/PACS/FPO/FPC/FIG/SHG duly graded /LAMPS etc. approved/recognized by any Govt. Institutions/Departments are eligible to set up CHC. - The project cost/Total Financial Outlay (TFO) should be between minimum ₹20,00,000/-to maximum as per SMAM Guideline (https://agrimachinery.nic.in/Files/Guidelines/smam.pdf) and SPMT recommendation.- The applicant should have sufficient land under his possession (own land/leased/hired) for setting up the CHC. - The land in question must belong to “commercial or bastu or viti” category. - The age of the beneficiary should be minimum 18 years at the time of application.
benefits: Pattern Of Assistance: - The maximum subsidy will be limited to 40% of the Total Financial Outlay(TFO) (TFO = indicative cost of machinery including transportation + AMC for 3 years + cost of open shed + insurance for 1 year). - Minimum TFO would be ₹20,00,000/- and the maximum would be as per SMAM Guideline and SPMT recommendation. An individual entrepreneur shall avail subsidy amounting ₹16,00,000/- or 40% of the TFO whichever is less to set up CHC. - The maximum amount allowed for the cost of open shed for machinery will be limited to 5% of the TFO and total ancillary cost (other than machinery) should not exceed 10% of TFO. - An individual entrepreneur shall avail subsidy amounting ₹16,00,000/- or 40% of the TFO whichever is less. Note: - The applicant will have to deposit margin money of a minimum amount of 25% of TFO to the financing bank before release of subsidy by the DDA (Admn.) to the Bank and remaining amount will be bank loan. - No machine/equipment will be procured by the Government. The Government will only release subsidy as back ended subsidy against procurement by the beneficiaries as per their choice under CHC with Bank Loan. The subsidy will be released through DBT mode to the concerned bank branch to subsidy reserve fund/loan account for CHC. - The subsidy will only be applicable for purchase of farm machinery/equipment from the approved Farm machinery Manufacturers and Dealers as enlisted in the Departmental portal. - A beneficiary or his/her spouse will not be eligible to apply afresh before completion of 4(four) years from release of the last subsidy for CHC scheme from the State under this Guidelines. - The subsidy will be provided from SDS and different CSS like RKVY- Cafeteria, SMAM, NFSM( Pulse/Rice/Nutri Cereals), TRFA ( Pulse/Coarse Cereals), NMEO for implementation of CHC.
summary: “Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme for Rural Entrepreneurs to set up Custom Hiring Centres (CHC) of Farm Machinery” by the Agriculture Dep, Government of West Bengal aims to provide opportunity to rural entrepreneurs for setting up of Custom Hiring Centres.

title: Farm Machinery Bank (FMB)/Farm Machinery Hub (FMH)
eligibility_details: - Individual Rural Youth Entrepreneur registered under Krishak Bandhu (New) Scheme. Or, Groups like SKUS/PACS/FPO/FPC/FIG/SHG duly graded /LAMPS etc approved/recognized by any Govt Institution/Departments . - The Group should be successfully running at least for last 1(one)year are only eligible to setup FMB/FMH in a selected village - The project cost/Total Financial Outlay (TFO) should be minimum ₹10,00,000/-. - The applicant should have sufficient land under his possession (own land/leased/hired) for setting up the FMB/FMH. - The land in question must belong to “commercial or bastu or viti” category. - The age of the beneficiary should be minimum 18 years at the time of application.
benefits: Pattern Of Assistance: - The subsidy will be 80% of the Total Financial Outlay (TFO) subject to maximum Rs 8.00 lakh and minimum TFO will be ₹10,00,000/-. The TFO includes indicative cost of machinery + Cost of shed +AMC + insurance. The remaining amount of the TFO will be borne by the beneficiary. - The maximum amount allowed for cost of open shed for machinery will be limited to 5% of the TFO and total ancillary cost (other than machinery) should not exceed 10% of TFO. Note: - The applicant will have to deposit margin money of a minimum amount of 25% of TFO to the financing bank before release of subsidy by the DDA (Admn.) to the Bank and remaining amount will be bank loan . - No machine/equipment will be procured by the Government. The Government will only release subsidy as back ended subsidy against procurement by the beneficiaries as per their choice under CHC with Bank Loan. The subsidy will be released through DBT mode to the concerned bank branch to subsidy reserve fund/loan account for CHC. - The subsidy will only be applicable for purchase of farm machinery/equipment from the approved Farm machinery Manufacturers and Dealers as enlisted in the Departmental portal. - A beneficiary or his/her spouse will not be eligible to apply afresh before completion of 4(four) years from release of the last subsidy for CHC scheme from the State under this Guidelines.
summary: “Farm Machinery Bank (FMB)/Farm Machinery Hub (FMH)” by the Agriculture Department, Government of West Bengal aims to facilitate end-to-end (from land development to residue management) use of farm machinery which can be within the reach of the small and marginal farmers at reasonable charges.

title: Financial Support Scheme for Farm Mechanization (FSSM)
eligibility_details: - Individual farmers registered under Krishak Bandhu (New) Scheme. Or, Groups like SKUS/PACS/FPO/FPC/FIG/SHG duly graded /LAMPS etc. approved/recognized by any Govt Institution/Departments. - Minimum 0.5 (half) acre agricultural land (RoR) is required by the applicant for purchase of power tiller & solar photo-voltaic water pumping system under FSSM. - The age of the beneficiary should be minimum 18 years at the time of application.
benefits: Pattern Of Assistance: - Subsidy ranging from 50-60% of the indicative price of machinery subject to maximum ceiling of ₹3,00,000/- will be provided to the beneficiary. Available Equipment: - An exhaustive list of different farm machinery with subsidy limits is provided in Annexure-II (https://matirkatha.net/rails/activestorage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBa1lDIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--6e05a52aaf58b7fbfa749a5d71be15309a5101ea/FMSOperational%20Guidelines202425.pdf?disposition=attachment) (Page No. 33) based on Cost Norms and Pattern of Financial Assistance under Sub Mission on Agricultural Mechanization(SMAM). Available models of different farm machinery /implements as mentioned in Annexure-II along with indicative price will be published in Matirkatha portal by the SPMT before starting of online application of the beneficiary . However, No large machines like tractor, rice transplanter “above 4 rows”, combine harvester etc. will be provided under FSSM. Note: - No machine/equipment will be procured by the Government. The Government will only release subsidy as back ended subsidy against procurement by the beneficiaries as per their choice under FSSM with Bank Loan. The subsidy will be released through DBT mode to the beneficiaries for FSSM. - The subsidy will only be applicable for purchase of farm machinery/equipment from the approved Farm machinery Manufacturers and Dealers as enlisted in the Departmental portal. - A beneficiary or his/her spouse will not be eligible to apply afresh before completion of 4(four) years from release of the last subsidy for any type of machinery under any FSSM scheme from the State under this Guidelines.
summary: "Financial Support Scheme for Farm Mechanization (FSSM)" by the Agriculture Department, Government of West Bengal aims to provide financial support as subsidy to the small and marginal farmers of the State for purchase of power operated farm equipment/ machinery.

title: Krishak Bandhu Scheme
eligibility_details: For Income Support - The applicant must be a resident of West Bengal. - The applicant must own cultivable land (up to 2 acres). - The applicant must be actively engaged in farming. For Death/Disability Benefit - The deceased/disabled person must have been a farmer aged 18–60 years. - The applicant must be the legal heir (for death benefit).
benefits: Direct Income Support - Farmers with one acre or more of cultivable land receive ₹10,000/- per annum, payable in two equal installments of ₹5,000/- each (one for Kharif and one for Rabi season). - Farmers with less than one acre of cultivable land receive assistance on a pro-rata basis, subject to a minimum of ₹4,000/- per annum, paid in two equal installments. Death/Disability Benefit - In the event of the death of a farmer between the ages of 18 and 60 years, a one-time lump sum grant of ₹2,00,000/- is provided to the legal heirs of the deceased. The farmer must have been enrolled under the Krishak Bandhu scheme at the time of death. - A one-time lump sum grant of ₹2,00,000/- for permanent disability of the farmer due to accident. Disbursement Conditions - Income support is linked to land ownership records. - Death benefit requires submission of legal heir certificates. - Disbursed via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to the beneficiary&#39;s bank account.
summary: The scheme aims to provide financial security to farmers through direct income support and death/disability benefits. It benefits small and marginal farmers with annual assistance of ₹5,000/- per acre and a one-time payout of ₹2,00,000/- in case of death.

title: One Time Assistance to Small and Marginal Farmers for Purchase of Small Farm Implements (OTA-SFI)
eligibility_details: - Individual farmers registered under Krishak Bandhu (New) Scheme. Or, Groups like SKUS/PACS/FPO/FPC/FIG/SHG duly graded /LAMPS etc approved/recognized by any Govt Institution/Departments. - The age of the beneficiary should be minimum 18 years at the time of application.
benefits: Pattern Of Assistance: - Maximum ₹10,000/- or 50% of total indicative price of purchased manually operated machinery/implement whichever is lower. Available Equipment: - A list of different manually operated machinery/implements is provided in Annexure-III (https://matirkatha.net/rails/activestorage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBa1lDIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--6e05a52aaf58b7fbfa749a5d71be15309a5101ea/FMSOperational%20Guidelines202425.pdf?disposition=attachment) (Page No. 37). Available models of different farm machinery /implements as mentioned in Annexure-III along with indicative price will be published in Matirkatha portal by the SPMT before starting of online application of the beneficiary .Combination of machinery/equipment from the list can be purchased within the subsidy limit. But, maximum two nos. implements of the same item may be chosen by the applicant. However, battery operated sprayers and PVC pipes for carrying water will also be eligible under this component. Note: - No machine/equipment will be procured by the Government. The Government will only release subsidy as back ended subsidy against procurement by the beneficiaries as per their choice under FSSM with Bank Loan. The subsidy will be released through DBT mode to the beneficiaries for OTA-SFI. - The subsidy will only be applicable for purchase of farm machinery/equipment from the approved Farm machinery Manufacturers and Dealers as enlisted in the Departmental portal. - A beneficiary or his/her spouse will not be eligible to apply afresh before completion of 4(four) years from release of the last subsidy for any type of machinery under OTA-SFI from the State under this Guidelines.
summary: “One Time Assistance to Small and Marginal Farmers for Purchase of Small Farm Implements (OTA-SFI)” by the Agriculture Department, Government of West Bengal aims to aid the farmers in procuring manually operated small farm implements necessary for agricultural operations.

title: Gatidhara Scheme
eligibility_details: 1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of West Bengal. 1. The applicant should be enrolled in the Employment Bank of Labour Department, GOWB. 1. The age of the applicant should be between 25 years to 45 years (Relaxation 5 years for SC/ST & 3 years for OBC). 1. The family income of the applicant should be less than ₹25000/- per month. 1. More than one member of the same family is not eligible.
benefits: 1. Under the scheme, the subsidy @ 30% of the ex-showroom price of the vehicle subject to a maximum of ₹1,00,000/- will be provided to the beneficiary for purchasing any commercial vehicle.
summary: The scheme “Gatidhara Scheme” was launched by the Transport Department, Government of West Bengal in August 2014 for employment of registered unemployed youth of the State in the transport sector.

title: Lokprasar Prakalpo Scheme
eligibility_details: - The applicant may have a lineage or belong to a family practicing a given folk form or may belong to a tribal cultural/dance team or a folk-based instrumentalist as recognized by the Folk & Tribal Cultural Centre. - The applicant must be between 18 to 60 years. - The applicants above 60 years will be eligible for pension. - The applicant must be a resident of West Bengal.
benefits: 1. Issuing identity cards to each folk artiste. 2. Under the scheme, the veteran and distressed folk-artistes who are above 60 years of age will get a monthly pension of ₹1000/-. 3. The enlisted folk artists under the age of 60 years, who are engaged in publicity campaigns in different departments, have been receiving ₹1000/- per month as a retainer fee. 4. The state government will arrange the minimum income for folk artists by engaging them in the public campaign programme on development projects such as Kannyasree, Yubasree, Sikshasree, etc. and programmes like Nirmal Bangla, Sarbo Sikhsa Avijan, etc. 5. Performance Fees: Performance-based fees @₹1000/- per head per day as and when engaged to perform their own genre mostly at any Government programme like fair/festival/Krishi Mela/Sabala Mela, etc.
summary: The scheme “Lokprasar Prakalpo Scheme” was launched by the Department of Information & Cultural Affairs, Government of West Bengal in 2014 to revive the Folk and Tribal Culture in their respective genre across various zones and districts in the State.

title: The West Bengal Incentive Scheme: Additional Incentive for Adventure Tour Operators
eligibility_details: - The Scheme shall be generally applicable to all eligible tourism projects/units/expansion projects of existing units set up on or after the effective date (i.e. 22nd February, 2021) of this incentive scheme.
